</details>


### [27] [Coverage Hides Churn: Auditing and Preserving Conformal Decisions as VLM Label Registries Grow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07502)
*Jai Kumar Sharma,Peeyush Tapadiya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: softmax-based conformal scores suffer silent decision drift on old labels when the label registry grows; we propose a lifecycle audit and PrefixCP to keep old decisions stable.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision-language classifiers can learn labels from text alone, so their label lists keep growing. Common softmax-based conformal scores normalize each label by an average over all labels, so adding labels changes every old label's score even when model, image, and old calibration data are unchanged. Coverage only checks the true label and hides this drift.

Method: Define a lifecycle audit that measures old-decision changes alongside coverage and set size. Propose PrefixCP: each class retains the label registry present at the time it was added, and one prefix scan computes all historical normalizers at once.

Result: Across eleven settings, recalibration changes at least one old decision on 53-90% of new images. In five controlled settings where only the normalizer changes, old-class coverage moves by at most 0.01 while 60-67% of images change. PrefixCP keeps old decisions unchanged, preserves exact class-conditional coverage under exchangeability, and recovers 40.9-58.5% of the set-size gap between never updating the reference and recalibrating.

Conclusion: Label-registry growth silently perturbs conformal decisions on old labels, invisible to coverage; lifecycle audits expose it and PrefixCP provides a stable, coverage-preserving fix that yields smaller sets than the never-update baseline.

Abstract: Vision-language classifiers can learn new labels from text alone, so the label lists they serve keep growing. We show that this growth silently changes conformal decisions about old labels. Common softmax-based conformal scores compare each label with an average over all labels; adding labels changes that average, and with it the score of every old label, even when the model, the image, and the old calibration data stay the same. Recalibrating after the update keeps the coverage guarantee, yet across eleven settings it changes at least one old decision on 53-90% of new images. Coverage cannot reveal this, because it checks only the true label: in five controlled settings that keep the old calibration, so that only the normalizer changes, old-class coverage moves by at most 0.01 while 60-67% of images change. We propose a lifecycle audit that measures these changes alongside coverage and set size, and a simple fix, PrefixCP: each class keeps the label registry that existed when it was added. Its old decisions then never change, each class keeps exact class-conditional coverage under exchangeability, and one prefix scan computes all historical normalizers at once. PrefixCP recovers 40.9-58.5% of the set-size gap between never updating the reference and recalibrating, which gives smaller sets but changes old decisions.

</details>


### [28] [Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07513)
*Chengcheng Wang,Wei He,Wenhao Li,Hongguang Li,Kai Han,Jianyuan Guo,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出eVLM架构Concertina，将连续轨迹表征、分块生成与物理坐标监督直接置于共享扩散VLM骨干的计算与参数路径上，以0.21%参数增量实现操作与认知的一体化，在LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/CALVIN上取得SOTA级结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略将操作与认知解耦：或把动作量化为离散token（误差与物理位移无稳定对应），或交由独立action expert生成连续轨迹（其梯度与VLM骨干竞争或被阻断）。作者主张操作与认知应内嵌于同一模型，从解耦VLA转向具身视觉语言模型（eVLM）。

Method: Concertina在共享扩散VLM骨干上实现：每个控制时间步编码为骨干隐空间中的单个连续latent action token；共享Transformer复用多模态预训练的"破坏—重建"算子，以blockwise方式重建时序有序的动作块；采用物理坐标监督；新增活跃动作投影仅占4.46B模型的0.21%，无独立动作生成器层。并提出Action Interface Audit用于诊断跨时间轨迹耦合的位置。

Result: 对比代表性强连续VLA需16.5%–35.1%专用action expert容量；Action Interface Audit显示跨时间轨迹耦合出现在共享骨干的中后层而非动作接口处。基准上：LIBERO常规任务平均成功率98.15%，10,030任务的LIBERO-Plus达85.9%，CALVIN ABC-D平均完成任务链长4.142。

Conclusion: 将连续动作表征与生成统一进共享扩散VLM骨干，可在极小参数开销下实现认知与操作的深度耦合，性能优于依赖独立action expert的解耦式VLA，支持"具身化VLM"这一范式。

Abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) policies decouple manipulation from cognition by bolting an external action mechanism onto a vision-language model (VLM)--either quantizing actions into discrete tokens whose errors bear no stable correspondence to physical displacements, or delegating continuous trajectory generation to a separate action expert whose gradients compete with or are blocked from updating the VLM backbone. We argue that manipulation and cognition should instead be embodied in the same model, shifting from a decoupled VLA to an Embodied Vision-Language Model (eVLM). We introduce Concertina, an eVLM that places continuous trajectory representation, blockwise generation, and physical-coordinate supervision directly on the computation and parameter path of a shared diffusion VLM backbone. Each control timestep is encoded as one continuous latent action token in the backbone hidden space, and the shared Transformer reconstructs temporally ordered action blocks via the same corrupt-and-reconstruct operator used for multimodal pretraining. Active action projections account for only 0.21% of parameters in the 4.46B model with zero separate action-generator layers, compared with 16.5%-35.1% dedicated action-expert capacity in representative continuous VLAs. Using our proposed Action Interface Audit, we confirm that cross-time trajectory coupling emerges in the middle and late layers of the shared backbone rather than at the action interfaces. On standard benchmarks, Concertina achieves 98.15% average success on regular LIBERO, 85.9% on the 10,030-task LIBERO-Plus benchmark, and 4.142 average completed chain length on CALVIN ABC-D.
  Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Concertina Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/collections/Traly/concertina

</details>


### [29] [Action-Conditioned VLM Monitoring for Autonomous Vehicle Semantic Anomalies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07540)
*Daniel Adejumo,Omkar Ankalkope,Kunal Runwal,Aliasghar Arab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究语义异常驾驶场景下的"动作条件化"行为监控：同一场景允许正常与异常动作，故仅凭视觉异常不足以判定标签。提出由VLM先预测场景所需动作、再与真实自车轨迹按显式相容规则比对的两阶段监控器，并贡献六字段分类法、112组配对场景、生成视频语料及初步监控方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶行为监控若仅依赖视觉异常检测，无法区分"场景本身不寻常"与"自车动作不恰当"；同一场景可同时容许正常与异常行为，因此监控标签需以动作是否与场景要求相符为判据，而非视觉新颖性。

Method: 提出两阶段监控：第一阶段用VLM在隐藏结果的视频窗口上预测场景所需动作；第二阶段将期望动作与已实现的自车运动轨迹在显式相容规则下比对。构建六字段场景分类法，覆盖两类失败极性共112组配对场景（其中42组来自有据可查的事故案例），并生成带估计轨迹的视频语料；采用固定T−2.5 s视频窗口的两阶段协议。

Result: 在来自15个场景族的235个片段上，固定T−2.5 s窗口的两阶段协议取得83.0%准确率、异常召回0.773；单阶段纯视频基线为74.5%准确率、召回0.536。特异性方面两阶段为0.880，基线为0.928。

Conclusion: 显式的"预期动作—实际轨迹"相容性校验可显著提升异常召回与总体准确率，代价是特异性略降；表明动作条件化建模是语义异常场景下行为监控的有效路径。当前结果基于生成语料与探索性协议，尚需真实数据验证。

Abstract: We study action-conditioned monitoring of autonomous-vehicle behavior in semantically unusual driving scenes. The target is whether the executed ego action is appropriate for the scene: the same scene can admit both normal and anomalous behavior, so visual unusualness alone does not determine the monitoring label. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) first predicts the scene-required action from an outcome-hidden video window; the monitor then compares that expectation with the realized ego-motion trajectory under an explicit compatibility rule. To study this monitoring task, we contribute a six-field taxonomy of 112 paired scenarios spanning both failure polarities (42 derived from documented incidents), a generated video corpus with estimated trajectories, and an exploratory two-stage monitor on that corpus. On 235 clips from 15 scenario families, the two-stage protocol with a fixed T-2.5 s window obtains 83.0% accuracy and anomaly recall 0.773, versus 74.5% and 0.536 for a single-stage video-only baseline; specificity is 0.880 versus 0.928.

</details>


### [30] [OptIMerge: Optimization-Based Merging of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07543)
*Viraj Shah,Ashwini Pokle,Peyman Milanfar,Mauricio Delbracio,Hossein Talebi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OptIMerge，一种基于梯度的参数高效模型合并框架，用于将多个针对稠密图像复原任务微调的 I2I 扩散专家合并为单一多任务模型，性能接近联合训练并显著优于零样本 model soup。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 model souping 主要面向 LLM 与 T2I 扩散模型，标量平均或逐元素合并在 I2I 扩散专家上会因卷积核编码的空间先验（如各向异性运动模糊 vs. 各向同性散焦模糊）相互冲突而产生破坏性参数干扰与可见伪影，该设定尚未被充分研究。

Method: 冻结各专家参数，仅学习轻量合并系数，通过在小规模图像集（100–500 张）上最小化多任务扩散损失进行梯度优化；合并参数化具架构感知：注意力层采用带显式通道偏置的结构化低秩特征对齐，卷积层采用逐核合并系数与低秩 Cayley 变换，以正交旋转对齐通道而不扭曲滤波器；可训练参数不足网络规模的 0.4%。

Result: 合并后模型同时具备多任务能力，性能与计算昂贵的联合训练相当，并明显优于零样本 model soup，且避免了标量平均与 LLM 式逐元素合并带来的伪影。

Conclusion: 在 I2I 扩散模型合并中，用少量数据学习架构感知的、参数高效的合并系数，可有效缓解结构分歧导致的空间先验冲突，为稠密预测类多任务合并提供可行方案。

Abstract: The arithmetic merging of weights from multiple task-specific models fine-tuned from a shared base model, commonly known as model souping, has emerged as a popular strategy for multi-task learning without the computational overhead of joint retraining. However, naive scalar weight averaging frequently leads to severe performance degradation when the constituent models learn structurally divergent feature representations, leading to destructive parameter interference. We study this problem in a largely unexplored setting: merging image-to-image (I2I) diffusion models fine-tuned for dense, pixel-accurate tasks such as image restoration. Unlike the large language models (LLMs) and text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models for which most merging methods were developed, I2I experts encode conflicting spatial priors (e.g., anisotropic motion-blur vs. isotropic defocus-blur) in their convolutional filters, where both naive soup and LLM-style element-wise merging introduce visible artifacts. We introduce OptIMerge, a gradient-based optimization framework: instead of relying on heuristic scalars, OptIMerge learns highly expressive, yet parameter-efficient merger coefficients by minimizing a multi-task diffusion loss over a small set of 100-500 images. OptIMerge parameterizes the merge with architecture-aware transformations: for attention layers, a structured low-rank feature alignment with explicit channel biases; for convolutional layers, per-kernel merger coefficients, and a low-rank Cayley transform that aligns channels by orthogonal rotation without distorting the filters. By keeping the experts frozen and optimizing only these lightweight merger parameters (equivalent to <0.4% of the network footprint), OptIMerge achieves simultaneous multi-task capabilities that rival computationally expensive joint training and decisively outperform zero-shot model soups.

</details>


### [31] [Training-Free Predictive Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning for Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07551)
*Jia Li,Xurui Peng,Xing Wang,Hayden Kwok-Hay So*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架 PreSTP，利用模型自身早期去噪估计定位跨帧与跨步的 token 级冗余，进行预测式时空 token 剪枝，在少步自回归视频扩散模型上实现 1.52x–3.20x 加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散模型逐 chunk 生成已使视频生成变得高效，但现有免训练缓存方法依赖跨步冗余，而少步蒸馏压缩了这种冗余，导致难以进一步推向实时生成。

Method: 重新审视该设定并识别两种 token 级冗余模式：相邻帧静态内容带来的跨帧冗余，以及去噪早期即收敛 token 的跨步冗余；发现模型自身去噪轨迹上的早期干净估计可作为无需重训、无辅助预测器、无参考视频的在线信号。据此构建由跨帧相似度与跨步收敛度组成的统一 token 级冗余掩码，被标记冗余的 token 跳过后续计算并采用一致的“最近计算值恢复”规则，另加内容自适应掩码复用策略降低密集探测开销。

Result: 5 秒生成取得 1.52x–3.20x 加速，效率—保真度权衡优于 TeaCache、FlowCache 等粗粒度缓存基线；30 秒生成最高 1.96x 加速，同时提升 VBench-Long 并抑制长时程漂移；在跨步冗余完全消失的极端一步设定下仍能降低推理开销。

Conclusion: token 级、预测式的时空剪枝比步级粗粒度缓存更适合少步自回归视频扩散，且在极端一步场景仍有效，为实时视频生成提供了免训练的加速路径。

Abstract: Few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk and have made efficient video generation practical. However, further accelerating these models toward real-time generation remains challenging, as few-step distillation leaves little cross-step redundancy for existing training-free caching methods to exploit. We revisit this regime and identify two token-level redundancy patterns: cross-frame redundancy from static content shared across adjacent frames, and cross-step redundancy from tokens that converge early during denoising. Crucially, we find that early clean estimates along the model's own denoising trajectory provide an effective online signal for locating both patterns, requiring no retraining, auxiliary predictor, or reference video. Based on these findings, we propose PreSTP (Predictive Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning), a training-free framework that constructs a unified token-wise redundancy mask from cross-frame similarity and cross-step convergence. Tokens marked as redundant skip subsequent computation under a consistent last-computed-value restoration rule, and a content-adaptive mask reuse strategy further reduces dense probing cost. On 5-second generation, PreSTP achieves 1.52x-3.20x speedups and a better efficiency-fidelity trade-off than coarse-grained caching baselines such as TeaCache and FlowCache. On 30-second generation, it reaches up to 1.96x speedup while improving VBench-Long and suppressing long-horizon drift. Notably, it continues to reduce inference cost even in the extreme one-step regime, where cross-step redundancy vanishes entirely and coarse step-wise caching is no longer applicable.

</details>


### [32] [Improving Long-Tail Detection via Layout-Instruction Conditioned Diffusion Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07553)
*Xinyu Zhang,Xiaodi Wang,Yanpeng Sun,Lingfeng Yang,Jingdong Wang,Lingqiao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Tail-SD：一种以布局指令为条件的稳定扩散框架，支持文本、布局及混合条件，通过多任务交叉注意力与多任务嵌入 token 统一训练，用于生成覆盖长尾目标的合成数据以提升检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型合成数据可提升目标检测，但长尾性能受限于稀有类别样本稀缺以及条件形式不灵活（仅文本或仅布局），难以有效覆盖长尾目标。

Method: 设计布局指令条件化的稳定扩散框架，可通过框、掩码和/或提示词实现可控合成；引入多任务交叉注意力模块与多任务嵌入 token，以单一模型适配异构条件输入，提升生成质量与多样性。

Result: 在 COCO 与 LVIS 上的实验表明，混合条件扩散合成持续有益于检测；LVIS val 上稀有类 Box AP 提升 +4.89%、Mask AP 提升 +5.68%。

Conclusion: 混合条件可控扩散合成在缓解长尾检测问题上具有显著潜力。

Abstract: Synthetic data from diffusion models can improve object detection, but long-tail performance is still limited by scarce rare classes and inflexible conditioning (e.g., text-only or layout-only inputs). In this paper, we propose Tail-SD, a layout-instruction conditioned stable diffusion framework that supports text, layouts, or their hybrid, enabling controllable synthesis from boxes, masks, and/or prompts to better cover the long-tail objects. To train a single model across heterogeneous conditions, we introduce a multi-task cross-attention module and multi-task embedding tokens, improving generation quality and diversity. Extensive experiments on COCO and LVIS demonstrate that diffusion synthesis with hybrid conditioning consistently benefits detection, e.g., on LVIS val, it achieves +4.89% / +5.68% rare Box/Mask AP, highlighting strong potential for addressing long-tail challenges.

</details>


### [33] [MetricTrail: Revisiting the Power of Metric Depth and Local Optimization for Long-Sequence Streaming 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07555)
*Jingnan Gao,Jiahui Huang,Sven Elflein,Jianhao Zheng,Bingxin Ke,Xiaokang Yang,Yichao Yan,Laura Leal-Taixé,Qunjie Zhou,Jiawei Ren,Shengyu Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MetricTrail：结合单目度量深度与冻结DINOv3特征的流式相机位姿估计与稠密重建系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长单目视频上的相机运动估计与稠密重建需在长序列上保持推理效率，同时提升轨迹精度，并避免长序列训练与重复训练对应网络。

Method: 基于DPVO的稀疏局部估计器：用单图度量深度初始化patch深度并作为优化中的软约束；引入学习型adapter，将冻结的DINOv3表示注入匹配特征与循环上下文；仅用多样短片段训练对应估计器与adapter；模块化设计使深度提供方可独立升级，并支持外部相机内参与标定双目输入而无需重训。

Result: 在KITTI、Oxford Spires、VBR的RGB-only协议下取得最低平均轨迹误差；位姿与单图深度结合在室内外基准获得强稠密重建，并对in-the-wild视频产生连贯重建；提供内参时KITTI-02达12.70 FPS，峰值GPU显存3.21 GB。

Conclusion: 度量深度软约束与冻结基础模型特征的可插拔集成，可在不增加优化窗口、不重训对应网络、不做长序列训练的前提下显著提升精度与效率，且具备良好可扩展性。

Abstract: We present MetricTrail, a streaming system for accurate camera motion estimation and dense reconstruction from long monocular videos. To keep inference efficient over long sequences, we revisit DPVO's sparse local estimator. We find that single-image metric depth substantially improves its trajectory accuracy, without retraining the correspondence network or enlarging the optimization window. Metric predictions initialize patch depths and remain as soft constraints during optimization. We further improve correspondence estimation through learned adapters that augment matching features and recurrent context with frozen DINOv3 representations. The correspondence estimator and adapters are trained on diverse short clips without additional long-sequence training. This modular design also allows the depth provider to be independently upgraded and supports supplied camera intrinsics and calibrated stereo observations without retraining. Under the reported RGB-only protocols, MetricTrail achieves the lowest average trajectory error among evaluated methods on KITTI, Oxford Spires, and VBR. Pairing the estimated poses with single-image depth predictions also produces strong dense reconstruction on indoor and outdoor benchmarks and coherent reconstructions of in-the-wild videos. With supplied intrinsics, the system processes KITTI-02 at 12.70 FPS with 3.21 GB peak GPU memory.

</details>


### [34] [Guidance Is a Field, Not a Scalar: Interval-Integrated Classifier-Free Guidance for One-Step Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07566)
*Zijie Meng,Xixin Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出区间积分CFG恒等式，将任意引导场编译进MeanFlow目标，实现零推理开销的单步引导视频生成（AGAVE）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于MeanFlow的一步视频生成器将CFG尺度冻结或仅作为单一标量，而最优引导实际是随噪声水平、空间内容和帧位置变化的场；已有改进都依赖多步采样器重新调度引导，与一步模型的结构假设冲突。

Method: 关键观察：MeanFlow目标是对噪声区间的积分，因此任意引导场可被吸收进目标并编译为一次函数评估。形式化为区间积分CFG恒等式，证明编译后的引导无调度离散化误差；实例化为AGAVE——为平均速度场加入可学习时间调度、免训练的运动显著性空间调制和帧位置非对称性，仅增加不足十个标量。

Result: 在VBench、UCF-101与MSR-VTT上超越所有一步基线，并可匹配多步引导采样质量，且推理成本零增加。

Conclusion: 引导场可被解析地编译进MeanFlow积分目标，从而在单步生成框架下实现表达力更强的时空引导，突破一步模型无法重新调度CFG的限制。

Abstract: One-step generators built on MeanFlow synthesize a video in a single function evaluation, yet inherit a rigid treatment of classifier-free guidance (CFG): the guidance scale is frozen during training or, at best, exposed as a single scalar. This conflicts with mounting evidence that the optimal guidance is not a constant but a field that varies with the noise level, with spatial content, and, for video, with frame position. Every existing remedy presupposes a multi-step sampler along which guidance can be re-scheduled--an assumption one-step models violate by construction. We resolve this tension through a single observation: because the MeanFlow target is an integral over a noise interval, an arbitrary guidance field can be absorbed into the target itself and compiled into one evaluation. We formalize this as the interval-integrated CFG identity, prove that the compiled guidance carries no schedule-discretization error and can thus match or exceed any finite multi-step sampler, and instantiate it as AGAVE, which equips the average-velocity field with a learnable temporal schedule, a free motion-saliency spatial modulation, and a frame-position asymmetry. Adding fewer than ten scalars at zero inference cost, AGAVE surpasses all one-step baselines on VBench, UCF-101 and MSR-VTT while matching multi-step guided sampling. Project repository: https://github.com/YMlinfeng/AGAVE.

</details>


### [35] [Integrating Learned Priors through Prior-Space Reparameterization for Physically Based Inverse Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07573)
*Hun Hwangbo,Minjun Park,Yongsung Kim,Wooseok Song,Jungmin Ko,Junghyun Hwang,Sungroh Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于先验引导的材质重参数化，用预测特征关系约束优化空间而非修改目标函数，在保持纯光度目标的同时改进材质分解与重光照。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理逆渲染中材质与光照分解存在固有歧义，学习得到的材质预测可提供先验。现有方法多以辅助正则损失引入先验，会改变优化目标并需与光度拟合项权衡权重。

Method: 将多视角材质预测融合到网格上，在所得先验特征空间中构建permutohedral lattice（置换多面体格），使预测相似的表面点共享材质变量；这些变量与几何、光照在纯光度目标下联合优化。

Result: 在三个合成基准与Stanford-ORB上，配两种学习预测器均提升材质分解与重光照效果；在Synthetic4Relight与TensoIR-Synthetic上重光照PSNR较最强网格基线提升1.5–2.5 dB，并在受控对比中优于使用相同先验的正则损失；该方法对含噪光度梯度起池化作用，使跨视角更新更一致，从而支持不足一分钟的短周期联合优化，且在TensoIR-Synthetic上重光照质量仍高于所有评估基线。

Conclusion: 以重参数化代替正则损失引入材质先验，可在不改变目标函数的前提下提升逆渲染质量，并通过梯度一致性显著缩短联合优化时间。

Abstract: Physically based inverse rendering decomposes appearance into materials and illumination, an ambiguous problem for which learned material predictions provide useful prior information. Most existing methods incorporate these cues through auxiliary regularization losses, which alter the optimization objective and require balancing their influence against photometric fitting. We propose a prior-guided material reparameterization that uses the predicted feature relationships to restrict the optimization space while leaving the objective unchanged. We fuse multi-view material predictions onto a mesh and construct a permutohedral lattice in the resulting prior feature space. Surface points with similar predictions share material variables, which are optimized jointly with geometry and illumination using a purely photometric objective. Experiments with two learned predictors on three synthetic benchmarks and Stanford-ORB demonstrate improved material decomposition and relighting. Our method improves relighting PSNR by 1.5-2.5 dB over the strongest evaluated mesh-based baseline on Synthetic4Relight and TensoIR-Synthetic, and outperforms a regularization loss using the same prior in controlled comparisons. We further show that our reparameterization pools noisy photometric gradients, producing updates that are more consistent across sampled views. This consistency enables a shortened joint optimization schedule that takes less than a minute while retaining relighting quality above all evaluated baselines on TensoIR-Synthetic.

</details>


### [36] [Georeferenced Cross-View 3D Reconstruction from Ground and Satellite Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07575)
*David G. Shatwell,Mubarak Shah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: X-VGGT 提出一种前馈跨视角几何 Transformer，联合处理地面图像与带地理参考的卫星图像，直接预测地面相机位姿、稠密 3D 点图及场景级重力-尺度-偏航-平移变换，实现所有地面图像与卫星图的地理配准，并提出相应评测协议，性能优于以往跨视角定位与多视图重建方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法仅能估计单台地面相机的 GPS 坐标，无法重建稠密 3D 几何；而近期前馈多视图 3D 重建模型只在局部坐标系中预测点图与相机位姿。因此缺乏一个能同时完成稠密重建与地理配准的统一框架。

Method: 设计 X-VGGT：一个前馈跨视角几何 Transformer，将一组地面图像与一张带地理参考的卫星图像联合输入，统一预测地面视角相机位姿、稠密 3D 点图，以及由重力、尺度、偏航角、平移参数化的场景级变换；该变换把局部重建投影到卫星平面，从而实现全部地面图像与卫星图的地理配准。同时提出针对该联合任务的评测协议。

Result: 在多个跨视角数据集上，X-VGGT 生成准确的地理参考重建结果，并超越先前的跨视角地理定位方法与多视图 3D 重建模型。

Conclusion: 通过将跨视角地理定位与前馈多视图 3D 重建统一为单一前馈模型，X-VGGT 实现了带地理参考的稠密 3D 重建，验证了该联合任务范式的可行性与优越性，并为后续研究提供了评测基准协议。

Abstract: Georeferenced 3D reconstruction from ground images requires recovering not only the local scene geometry, but also localizing every camera center and 3D point in a geographic coordinate frame. Existing cross-view geo-localization methods are able to estimate the GPS coordinate of a single ground camera, but do not reconstruct dense 3D geometry, while recent feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction models predict point maps and camera poses only in a local coordinate frame. We introduce X-VGGT, a feed-forward cross-view geometry transformer that unifies these tasks by jointly processing a set of ground-level images and a georeferenced satellite image to predict ground-view camera poses, dense 3D point maps, and a scene-level transform parameterized by gravity, scale, yaw and translation. This transform projects the local reconstruction into the satellite plane, resulting in the geo-registration of all ground images with the georeferenced satellite image. We further propose an evaluation protocol for this joint task and show that, across multiple cross-view datasets, X-VGGT produces accurate georeferenced reconstructions and outperforms prior cross-view geo-localization and multi-view 3D reconstruction models.

</details>


### [37] [Subspace Learning with Outlier Exposure for Out-of-Distribution Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07580)
*Hongxu Shen,Kun Fang,Jiahui Zheng,Jian Sun,Qinghua Tao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RecOE框架，从InD与辅助离群样本中学习特征子空间，以两子空间的重构误差差异作为OoD检测分数，在多个基准上显著优于强基线且开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Outlier Exposure的OoD检测研究主要以logit为中心（生成多样离群样本或在预测输出层面正则化），未充分利用特征空间中的丰富信息。

Method: 从InD数据与辅助离群样本中学习特征子空间：最小化各自子空间内重构误差以捕获主导变化；引入样本级目标抑制在对立子空间中的重构；加入正交正则化降低子空间重叠以增强判别性；推理时以两子空间重构误差之差作为OoD分数。

Result: 在多个基准实验中，RecOE相较近期强基线取得显著性能提升，仅引入两个小尺寸子空间基矩阵带来的轻微额外开销。

Conclusion: 通过特征子空间建模可有效刻画InD-OoD差异，为OE类OoD检测提供了高效且有效的特征空间新范式。

Abstract: Out-of-Distribution (OoD) detection is pivotal for reliable deployments of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), aiming to distinguish anomalous samples from the In-Distribution (InD) data in training. By introducing outliers as surrogate OoD data to finetune DNNs, Outlier Exposure (OE) has greatly advanced OoD detection in recent years. Existing OE-based research remains predominantly logit-centric, either by generating diverse outliers or by regularizing them with objectives operating at the prediction-output level. Nonetheless, these approaches leave much of the rich information in feature spaces untapped. In this work, we propose an OE-based detection framework, named RecOE, that learns appropriate feature subspaces from InD data and auxiliary outliers, such that the InD-OoD discrepancy can be effectively characterized through the learned feature subspaces. Specifically, the feature subspaces are optimized to capture the dominant variations of InD and outliers by minimizing reconstruction errors therein. Besides, a sample-level objective discourages reconstruction in the opposing subspace, while an orthogonality regularizer reduces subspace overlap, further promoting discriminative subspaces. At inference, the difference in reconstruction errors between the learned subspaces serves as the OoD detection score. Extensive experiments show the superiority of RecOE on multiple benchmarks, in which significant performance gains are achieved over recent strong baselines with only slight extra overhead from two small-size matrices of subspace bases. The source code is available at https://github.com/shenhongxu123/RecOE.

</details>


### [38] [TACT-KV: Tri-Axis Cosine Transform for Compressing Volumetric KV Caches in Medical VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07593)
*Chongyu Qu,Ritchie Zhao,Yufan He,Dong Yang,Zhengyi Lu,Junchao Zhu,Tianyuan Yao,Juming Xiong,Junlin Guo,Yanfan Zhu,Yuechen Yang,Daguang Xu,Bennett Allan Landman,Yucheng Tang,Yuankai Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TACT-KV: 一种免校准的KV缓存压缩方法，对3D医学扫描视觉KV缓存做可分离三维DCT、逆注水式逐层比特分配与固定标量码本量化，利用三轴空间相关性降低失真，在1-bit预测翻转率上最优，同等HBM下解码批大小最高提升8×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D CT/MRI单个体数据产生数万视觉token，KV缓存随批大小与上下文线性增长，形成"结构内存墙"。现有KV压缩仅依赖特征/令牌统计或1D、2D变换，未利用缓存中三轴空间结构。

Method: 利用视觉KV状态沿三个解剖轴的空间相关性在频域集中的特性，对KV缓存施加可分离3D离散余弦变换（DCT）；通过逆注水（reverse water-filling）按频带能量分配逐层比特预算（高能分量多比特）；每个频带用固定标量码本量化；并推导失真降低量与变换后缓存频谱集中度之间的闭式关系。方法免校准。

Result: 在六个医学VLM与两个3D CT基准的主对比中，12个模型-数据集组合里有11个取得最低1-bit预测翻转率；在四个通用VLM的视频任务上同样复现该优势；相同HBM下单GPU解码批大小最高扩大8×。

Conclusion: 三轴空间结构的频域利用可显著提升3D视觉KV压缩效率，且优势不局限于医学影像，具备向视频等一般多模态场景迁移的通用性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) applied to 3D medical scans face a structural memory wall. A single CT or MRI volume produces tens of thousands of vision tokens, and the resulting key-value (KV) cache scales linearly with both batch and context. Existing KV compression methods operate on the cache's feature or token statistics, or apply 1D and 2D transforms, leaving the three-axis spatial structure in the cache unexploited. We propose TACT-KV (Tri-Axis Cosine Transform), a calibration-free KV compression method that exploits strong spatial correlations in visual KV states along all three anatomical axes of 3D scans. This correlation concentrates the KV cache energy under a frequency-domain transform. TACT-KV applies a separable 3D discrete cosine transform to the KV cache, allocates a per-layer bit budget across frequency bins via reverse water-filling (more bits to high-energy components), and quantizes each bin with a fixed scalar codebook. We derive a close-form relation: the distortion reduction from adaptive bit allocation is dominated by the spectral concentration of the transformed cache. Across six medical VLMs and two 3D CT benchmarks, TACT-KV achieves the lowest 1-bit prediction-flip rate on eleven of twelve model and dataset pairs in our main comparison. The same advantage reproduces on four general-purpose VLMs evaluated on video tasks, indicating that the benefit of exploiting three-axis structure generalizes beyond medical imaging. At equal high-bandwidth memory (HBM), TACT-KV scales the decoding batch size on a single GPU by up to $8\times$.

</details>


### [39] [FisherDistill: Diffusion Distribution Distillation via Closed-Form Fisher Critics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07604)
*Mahesh Bhosale,Yuanhao Zhai,Siwei Lyu,Junsong Yuan,David Doermann,Defang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FisherDistill，用 Fisher 线性判别分析替代学习型对抗判别器，为扩散蒸馏生成器提供轻量精修信号，缩小与多步教师模型的分布差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强蒸馏生成器虽仅需 1 次或几次 NFE，但与多步教师的真实分布仍存在残余差距；现有方法多依赖学习型对抗判别器进行精修，作者质疑该精修是否必须依赖对抗判别器。

Method: 利用冻结教师模型的中间表示，估计真实样本与生成样本的一阶/二阶统计量，推导出最大化类间可分性相对类内变异性的闭式 Fisher 方向，作为轻量精修信号与原始蒸馏目标互补，无需额外判别器及其优化循环。

Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion distillation have enabled high-quality image generation in only one or a few network function evaluations (NFEs). In this work, we ask whether such refinement necessarily requires a learned adversarial discriminator. Using intermediate representations from the frozen teacher, we estimate the first- and second-order statistics of real and generated samples and derive a closed-form Fisher direction that maximally separates their feature distributions relative to within-class variation. This direction provides a lightweight refinement signal that complements the original distillation objective without requiring an additional adversarial discriminator or its optimization loop. Across multiple distillation frameworks, our approach consistently improves generation quality over their respective distilled baselines and substantially closes the gap to adversarially refined counterparts. Code: https://bhosalems.github.io/FisherDistill/

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全波形LiDAR（FWL）能保留多路径回波、弱信号等丰富反射特性，但基于Transformer的方法存在两个瓶颈：低强度背景区域冗余token导致计算开销大；标注数据稀缺导致泛化能力有限。

Abstract: LiDAR is a critical sensor for autonomous driving and robotics, yet it remains vulnerable to adverse conditions such as fog, rain, transparent objects, and low-reflectance surfaces. Full-waveform LiDAR (FWL) addresses these limitations by capturing the complete return waveform as a histogram, preserving rich reflection characteristics including multi-path echoes and weak signals. While recent Transformer-based approaches have demonstrated promise on FWL data, two fundamental bottlenecks remain: high computational cost from redundant tokens in low-intensity background regions, and limited generalization due to scarce annotated training data. We address both bottlenecks by exploiting the physical structure inherent to FWL data. First, we propose FWL-ToPM, a token pruning and merging mechanism that leverages intensity distributions to selectively reduce tokens while retaining critical waveform content. Second, we introduce FWLAug, a data augmentation framework designed as a regularization method that preserves waveform structure, retaining the Time-of-Flight waveform of each ray and the frustum geometry, to improve generalization to unseen scenes. Evaluated on the Ghost-FWL benchmark, FWL-ToPM achieves over 8 times speedup at real-time throughput alongside a nearly 9-point F1 gain over the prior state of the art, establishing the first real-time FWL Transformer that simultaneously improves accuracy. FWLAug further improves performance on both the standard benchmark and an out-of-distribution test set of unseen scenes. Together, these methods push FWL-based perception toward practical deployment. The code and the OOD dataset are publicly available and can be accessed via the project page: https://keio-csg.github.io/FWL-ToPM

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像编辑服务记录了请求用户，但编辑后的图像本身不含账户信息；图像被下载并分享后，服务仅凭图像无法追溯到请求用户。直接嵌入用户水印可支持归因，但语义编辑容易抹除水印信号。

Conclusion: 通过编辑过程学习水印，可在不修改编辑器的前提下实现用户归因，说明编辑器感知训练是提升编辑后图像可追溯性的有效途径。

Abstract: An image editing service records which user requests each edit, but the edited image itself does not contain this account information. Once the image is downloaded and shared, the service cannot identify the requesting user from the image alone. Embedding a user-specific watermark could enable such attribution, but semantic editing may erase the signal. We propose Tracemark, an editor-aware watermarking framework for identifying users from edited images. A shared encoder embeds a user-specific signal before editing, and a shared detector recovers the user by comparing features of the edited image with learned reference vectors. Both components are trained jointly through an editor with fixed parameters. User identification errors encourage the encoder to produce watermarks that survive editing, while fidelity losses limit changes to the input image and intended edit. Each image domain and editing instruction uses a separately trained model shared across registered users. Experiments on three image domains show that editor-aware training improves user recovery with both reference-vector matching and binary watermark decoding. Separately trained models reach 87.5% mean identification accuracy among 500 users. When tested with a different editor without retraining, the watermark modules still recover user information. These results demonstrate that learning watermarks through the editing process enables user attribution without modifying the editor.

</details>

*Tiancheng Si,Wenlong Xu,Dahua Gao*

TL;DR: 提出内部-外部先验融合对齐(IE-PFA)上下文模型，引入编解码器共享的可学习字典作为外部先验，与四叉树空间-通道联合建模结合，实现SOTA率失真性能与高速编码。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Existing context models for learned image com- pression rely primarily on internal priors from the current image, overlooking common patterns and typical textures shared across natural images. To address this limitation, we propose an Internal-External Prior Fusion-Alignment (IE-PFA) context model built upon quadtree spatial-channel joint modeling, where a learnable dictionary shared by the encoder and decoder serves as an external prior. Specifically, an RWKV-based Spatial- Channel Prior Fusion (RSCPF) module efficiently fuses inter- nal and external priors along spatial and channel dimensions with linear complexity, while a training-only Self-Distilled Prior Alignment (SDPA) mechanism aligns them without inference overhead. Moreover, our model supports variable-rate coding over 64 quality levels within a single network and is accelerated by custom CUDA operators. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance, achiev- ing an average BD-Rate saving of 21.65% over VTM-22.0-Intra, with only 29.9M parameters and the fastest coding speed among advanced neural codecs (61 ms encoding and 52 ms decoding). </details>


### [43] [UniGADD: Universal Generator-Agnostic Deepfake Detector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07647)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度伪造检测模型多在训练时见过的生成器上表现优异，但面对未见过的生成技术时性能显著下降，缺乏泛化性与实用性。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce Universal Generator-Agnostic Deepfake Detector (UniGADD), a novel method that employs supervised learning to achieve high accuracy on known deepfake generators, while maintaining robust performance on previously unseen ones. The proposed approach follows a two-stage optimisation process. In the first stage, a contrastive loss encourages the model to learn discriminative feature embeddings from real and known fake images, resulting in strong performance within the training domain. In the second stage, the embedding space is refined by promoting inter-cluster separation and intra-cluster compactness, applied exclusively to real samples. This refinement enhances generalisability, enabling the method to exhibit improved robustness against unseen deepfake generation techniques. UniGADD achieves accuracy on par with state-of-the-art methods for known generators, while significantly outperforming them on unseen cases, demonstrating its scalability and practical applicability for adversarial content detection.

</details>


### [44] [Generator-Aligned Reward Modeling with Target-Aware Bounded Optimization for Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07648)
*Ziqiao Weng,Yuanzhi Liang,Haibing Huang,Weidong Cai,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 GARM + TABO 框架用于视觉生成模型的奖励引导后训练：GARM 通过生成器支撑匹配与内容匹配的真实对比构建生成器相关、属性聚焦的奖励；TABO 将奖励映射为有上界的平滑函数以抑制过优化，并配合 TA-GRPO 实现流式视频定向生成优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励引导后训练面临三方面问题：(1) 真实训练数据与生成器输出分布不匹配；(2) 属性监督被无关内容混淆；(3) 无界奖励最大化导致过优化与生成质量下降。目标是在增强目标属性的同时保持通用生成能力。

Method: 提出两组件框架：GARM（Generator-Aligned Reward Modeling）以生成器支撑匹配缓解分布不匹配，并用内容匹配的真实对比减少内容混淆，得到与生成器相关、聚焦属性的奖励监督；TABO（Target-Aware Bounded Optimization）将学习到的奖励映射为平滑、有上界的函数，其标定基于真实目标正样本，且与优化算法无关，兼容直接奖励梯度与基于策略的优化。进一步提出 TA-GRPO，在 Flow-GRPO 基础上引入固定分阶段优势缩放、生成器到目标的课程学习、以及时间步均衡的信用分配，用于流式视频优化。

Result: GARM 提升目标属性表达并保持有竞争力的生成质量；TABO 相比无约束奖励最大化更好地平衡属性增强与视觉质量；TA-GRPO 相比原始 Flow-GRPO 提升目标增强效果，并减少中性提示下的非预期属性泄漏。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了生成器对齐的奖励监督与受控、数据标定的优化对定向视觉生成的重要性。

Abstract: Post-training aims to enhance desired attributes in visual generative models while preserving their general generation capabilities. Reward-guided post-training faces two challenges: real training data may mismatch the generator's output distribution, and attribute supervision may be confounded by unrelated content. Unbounded reward maximization can also cause overoptimization and degrade generation quality. We propose a framework combining Generator-Aligned Reward Modeling (GARM) and Target-Aware Bounded Optimization (TABO). GARM mitigates distribution mismatch through generator-support matching and reduces content confounding using content-matched real contrasts, yielding generator-relevant, attribute-focused reward supervision. TABO maps the learned reward to a smooth, upper-bounded function calibrated from real target-positive examples. This transformation is independent of the optimization algorithm and supports both direct reward-gradient and policy-based optimization. We further introduce Target-Aware GRPO (TA-GRPO), an adaptation of Flow-GRPO that combines fixed stage-wise advantage scaling, a generator-to-target curriculum, and timestep-balanced credit assignment for flow-based video optimization. Experiments show that GARM improves target-attribute expression while maintaining competitive generation quality. TABO better balances attribute enhancement and visual quality than unconstrained reward maximization, while TA-GRPO improves target enhancement over vanilla Flow-GRPO and reduces unintended attribute leakage on neutral prompts. These results highlight the importance of generator-aligned reward supervision and controlled, data-calibrated optimization for targeted visual generation.

</details>


### [45] [ArtCrafter: Feed-Forward Generation of Articulated 3D Object with Analytic Joint Derivation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07658)
*Minh Canh Tu,Quang-Binh Nguyen,Khoi Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ArtCrafter是一个前馈生成模型，从一对静/开状态图像中联合生成具有一致几何与运动学的铰接3D资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铰接3D资产对机器人仿真与训练至关重要，但从日常图像生成时，部件几何与运动学（kinematics）难以同时保持一致，这是核心挑战。

Method: 基于DiT的生成模型在单次前向中联合输出两种状态的部件级网格；借鉴Slot Attention，采用1+2N槽位布局（1个共享base槽+N对rest/open槽）使同一对槽绑定同一运动部件；提出Triplet Attention经共享base槽锚定来约束跨状态几何一致性；在解码部件点云上施加排斥损失L_rep防止部件间穿插；URDF关节参数（类型、轴、原点、范围）由每对rest/open网格间刚体变换解析求解，替代学习式回归。

Result: 在分布内与分布外数据集上，几何质量与铰接精度均优于相同双状态设定下的现有方法；与不同输入设定/范式的其他方法相比也具竞争力。

Conclusion: 以成对网格+解析运动学推导的方式，为铰接3D资产生成提供了可解释、几何-运动学一致的方案，在双状态输入设定下取得领先表现。

Abstract: Articulated 3D assets are essential for robotic simulation and training, yet their generation from casual images poses a key challenge: recovering part geometry and kinematics that remain mutually consistent. We present ArtCrafter, a novel feed-forward generative model for controllable generation of articulated 3D objects from a pair of images, one depicting the object in the rest state and the other in the open state. At the core of ArtCrafter is a DiT-based generative model that jointly produces part-level meshes for both articulation states in a single forward pass. Inspired by Slot Attention, its denoising process operates on a $1+2N$ slot layout comprising one shared base slot and $N$ paired rest/open slots, encouraging each pair to bind to the same kinematic part. To ensure geometrically consistent and disjoint part generation, we introduce Triplet Attention to enforce cross-state geometric consistency between paired rest/open slots anchored through the shared base slot, and a repulsion loss $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}}$ on decoded part point clouds to prevent inter-part penetration throughout denoising. Given the resulting paired meshes, URDF joint parameters---type, axis, origin, and range---are derived analytically from the rigid transformation between each rest/open pair, providing an interpretable alternative to learned joint-parameter regression. Extensive experiments on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets demonstrate that ArtCrafter outperforms existing method under the same dual-state setting in geometry quality and articulation precision, while remaining competitive with methods operating under different input settings and paradigms.

</details>


### [46] [Which Objects Stay? Learning Hierarchical Persistence Beliefs for Lifelong Open-Vocabulary Object Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07662)
*Thanh Nguyen Canh,Haolan Zhang,Nak Young Chong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiPer：无需类别标签、由数据驱动初始化的分层持久性滤波器，用于终身物体地图中的物体存续信念估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终身物体地图需在物体离开视野后判断其是否仍留在原位；现有持久性滤波器依赖基于类别的存续先验，在开放词表场景中难以可靠适用。

Method: 对新物体检索视觉与几何相似的训练实例，由其观测历史估计初始存续率（无需类别标签）；以该估计初始化共轭Beta信念，在Rosen持久性滤波框架下用检测与漏检闭式更新；物体在新位置被重识别时迁移其持久性信念，实现物体级在线学习迁移规律。

Result: 120条留出仿真序列上持续优于对比方法；检索式先验优于CLIP标签先验，物体级在线学习带来额外增益；47个留出3RScan真实环境中亦优于SOTA基线。

Abstract: Lifelong object maps must estimate whether an object remains at its previously observed location after it leaves view. Existing persistence filters rely on class-based survival priors, making them difficult to apply reliably in open-vocabulary settings. We introduce HiPer, a hierarchical persistence filter that derives persistence beliefs directly from data rather than semantic categories. For a new object, HiPer retrieves visually and geometrically similar training instances and estimates an initial survival rate from their observed histories, without requiring class labels. This estimate initializes a conjugate Beta belief over the object's survival probability, which is updated in closed form using detections and missed observations under Rosen's persistence-filter framework. When an object is re-identified at a new location, its persistence belief is transferred with the object, enabling the map to learn object-specific mobility over time. Experiments on 120 held-out simulated sequences show that HiPer consistently achieves the best performance among competing methods. Retrieval-based priors outperform CLIP-derived label priors, and object-specific online learning provides further gains. Results on 47 held-out 3RScan environments demonstrate that the proposed retrieval-based prior also outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in real-world settings.

</details>


### [47] [CoGenRec: A Unified Generative Framework for Complementary Vision Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07665)
*Yapeng Meng,Yuguo Chen,Xiangru Chen,Shaojun Xu,Xuezhen Wang,Lijian Wang,Zheyu Yang,Yihan Lin,Luping Shi,Rong Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CoGenRec——面向互补视觉传感器(CVS)的生成式重建框架，统一视频去模糊、高帧率插帧与HDR融合，在SportsSloMo-CVS上较最强通用基线PSNR分别提升4.40/3.89/5.04 dB，并在129个真实场景上取得良好感知质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端运动与高动态范围场景的成像受制于时间分辨率、空间细节、信噪比与动态范围之间的根本权衡，受带宽、功耗与量子效率限制。传统帧相机因此产生时间欠采样、曝光运动模糊与饱和问题；作者希望利用CVS的双通路互补测量突破传统成像的极限。

Method: CVS将视觉信息分解为两条互补通路：空间密集/时间稀疏的长曝光RGB通路，与时间密集/空间稀疏的短曝光时空差分通路。CoGenRec以互补性驱动生成式重建：采用曝光感知的外观建模与双向时间传播，将互补测量编码为多尺度时空特征；用这些特征约束视频扩散模型，并注入VAE解码器以恢复潜空间压缩中丢失的细节，从而结合物理测量的场景保真度与学习式视频先验的外观恢复能力。

Result: 在SportsSloMo-CVS上，去模糊、帧插值与HDR融合的PSNR分别较最强通用基线提升4.40 dB、3.89 dB与5.04 dB；在129个真实CVS采集的未见场景上亦获得强感知质量。

Conclusion: 结果表明统一的互补性驱动生成式重建方案可在挑战性运动与光照条件下推进高质量成像，为超越传统相机极限的重建提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Capturing scenes with extreme motion and high dynamic range is fundamentally constrained by trade-offs among temporal resolution, spatial detail, signal-to-noise ratio, and dynamic range under practical bandwidth, power, and quantum-efficiency limits. Conventional frame-based cameras therefore suffer from temporal undersampling, exposure-induced motion blur, and sensor saturation. The Complementary Vision Sensor (CVS) addresses these limitations by decomposing visual information across two complementary pathways, a spatially dense, temporally sparse, long-exposure RGB pathway and a temporally dense, spatially sparse, short-exposure patiotemporal difference pathway. Their complementary measurements provide appearance, structural, and motion cues across a wide dynamic range that enable reconstruction beyond conventional imaging. We present CoGenRec, a complementarity-driven generative reconstruction framework that unifies video deblurring, high-temporal-resolution frame interpolation, and HDR fusion. CoGenRec encodes complementary measurements into multi-scale spatiotemporal features using exposure-aware appearance modeling and bidirectional temporal propagation. These features constrain a video diffusion model and are injected into the VAE decoder to recover fine structures lost during latent-space compression, combining the scene fidelity of physical measurements with the appearance recovery capabilities of learned video priors. On SportsSloMo-CVS, CoGenRec improves PSNR over the strongest general-purpose baseline by 4.40 dB for deblurring, 3.89 dB for frame interpolation, and 5.04 dB for HDR fusion, respectively. It also achieves strong perceptual quality on 129 unseen scenes captured with real CVS. These results establish a unified approach to advance high-quality reconstruction under challenging motion and illumination conditions. Project page: https://cogenrec.github.io/.

</details>


### [48] [Egocentric Action Recognition with Objects and Vision-Language Affordances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07673)
*Raúl Boix-Aldeguer,Manuel Benavent-Lledo,David Ortiz-Perez,Jose Garcia-Rodriguez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出融合冻结SlowFast视频专家与注意力物体专家（晚融合）的第一人称动作识别方法，物体以视觉语言模型零样本生成的affordance表示，并用交互affordance过滤非活跃检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称视频中动作在很大程度上由所涉物体定义，但现有基于RGB视频或深度的方法很少对物体建模；同时数据集仅标注动作涉及的物体，用检测框评估会泄漏"哪些物体活跃"的信息。

Method: 冻结的SlowFast视频专家 + 基于注意力的物体专家，晚融合；每个物体由视觉-语言模型零样本生成的affordance（可对其执行的操作）表示；再用同一视觉-语言模型生成交互affordance，判断手是否正在操作某个检测到的物体，以剔除非活跃检测。训练用标注框，评估分别用官方活跃物体检测器和标注框（上界）。

Result: 无affordance时，融合在标注框下Top-1为68.4%，在检测框下为49.0%，其中约一半下降来自非活跃检测。在MECCANO上，物体使视频专家Top-1从44.9%提升到49.0%，加入两种affordance后达到49.9%，优于SlowFast和物体感知的RGB基线。

Conclusion: 显式建模物体及其affordance可有效提升第一人称动作识别性能；交互affordance能缓解非活跃检测带来的性能损失，并在真实检测条件下超过视频与RGB基线。

Abstract: Action recognition, and more specifically egocentric action recognition, is a core task in computer vision, with applications such as monitoring the daily life activities of elderly people and task assistance. Recent methods rely on visual modalities such as RGB video or depth. However, in egocentric video, an action is largely defined by its objects, which these methods rarely model. We propose a method that combines a frozen SlowFast video expert with an attention-based object expert by late fusion. Each object is represented with its affordances, that is, what can be done with it, generated zero-shot by a vision-language model. Since datasets such as MECCANO annotate only the objects involved in each action, evaluating with these boxes tells the model which objects are active. We therefore train on annotated boxes and evaluate the method with detections from the official active-object detector, and with annotated boxes as an upper bound. Without affordances, our fusion reaches 68.4% Top-1 with annotated boxes but 49.0% with detections. About half of this drop comes from non-active detections. To remove them, the same vision-language model generates an interaction affordance that decides whether a hand is manipulating each detected object. On MECCANO, objects raise the Top-1 of the video expert from 44.9% to 49.0%, and the two affordances raise it to 49.9%, above SlowFast and object-aware RGB baselines. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [49] [GEKey: Learning Geodesic Eccentric 3D Keypoints via Self-Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07677)
*Pierre Onghena,Santiago Velasco-Forero,Beatriz Marcotegui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GEKey，一个基于测地偏心变换（geodesic eccentricity transform）的自监督点云关键点检测框架，用实例特定的显著点作伪标签训练模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督式关键点检测依赖人工标注，而无监督方法多依赖局部几何属性；需一种不依赖标注、能表示对象内在结构且保持类内差异的显著点定义方式。

Method: 采用SE(3)不变的测地偏心变换度量在点云上定位实例特定的显著点，将其作为伪标签，训练模型使预测对齐对象内在结构；设计上平衡实例特定结构与类别级结构。

Result: 在ShapeNetCoreV2、KeypointNet、CAPE、ITOP、DeformingThings4D上，关键点检测与对齐均达SOTA，并对噪声、下采样、形变及真实场景条件具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GEKey方法简单、高效、鲁棒，通过测地偏心变换的伪标签自监督实现了无需人工标注的高质量关键点检测与对齐，并开源代码与预训练模型。

Abstract: Point clouds represent 3D object geometry as sets of spatial coordinates. A fundamental task in their analysis is keypoint detection, i.e., identifying a sparse subset of points that captures the most salient features. While supervised methods rely on manual annotations, unsupervised approaches leverage intrinsic geometric properties to localize keypoints without human input. We introduce GEKey, a self-supervised framework that uses the geodesic eccentricity transform, an SE(3)-invariant geometric measure, to identify instance-specific salient points. These points serve as pseudo-labels to train a model that aligns its predictions with the object's intrinsic structure. GEKey is simple, efficient, and robust, preserving intra-class variation by balancing instance-specific and category-level structure. Extensive experiments on ShapeNetCoreV2, KeypointNet, CAPE, ITOP, and DeformingThings4D show state-of-the-art performance in both keypoint detection and alignment, with strong resilience to noise, downsampling, deformations, and real-world conditions. The code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/Pierreoo/GEKey.

</details>


### [50] [DEQ-Det: Dual Evidence Queries for Few-Shot Analog IC Device Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07682)
*Zidong Zhao,Rong Huang,Chengxing Fan,Jie Hu,Malik Haris,Ghazal A. Fahmy,Morteza Mousazadeh,Guoqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DEQ-Det，从同一支持图像自动构造前景与背景双证据参考，用于少样本模拟IC版图器件检测，在5类器件上AP50显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟IC版图器件检测受限于标注样本极少、器件几何形态差异大、且易与dummy结构或布线图案视觉混淆；仅依赖前景相似性会产生大量似是而非的候选，难以与干扰图案区分。

Method: DEQ-Det在无需额外标注的前提下，从同一支持图像派生互补的前景参考与背景参考：前景参考刻画目标器件形态，经筛选的背景参考刻画周围版图图案；二者共同参与查询选择与区域验证，将目标外观与版图上下文融合。

Result: 在5个留出器件类别、3个随机种子上，10-shot与30-shot的macro AP50分别为39.41和53.03，较最强基线提升3.97与9.71个点；匹配的30-shot消融显示，RoI背景证据在召回相当的情况下降低汇总假正例。

Conclusion: 显式建模背景/版图上下文证据是对前景匹配的有效补充，可在少样本条件下抑制干扰结构引起的误检，提升模拟IC版图器件检测的可靠性。

Abstract: Detecting analog integrated circuit (IC) devices in layout images supports circuit analysis and inspection. With only a few annotated examples, variation in device geometry and visual similarity to dummy or routing structures make reliable detection difficult. Foreground similarity alone can highlight plausible targets without distinguishing them from competing layout patterns. We propose Dual Evidence Queries for Detection (DEQ-Det), which constructs complementary foreground and background references from the same support images without additional annotations. Foreground references capture target morphology, while selected background references characterize surrounding layout patterns. Both sources guide query selection and region verification, combining target appearance with layout context. Across five held-out device categories and three random seeds, DEQ-Det achieves macro AP50 of 39.41 and 53.03 at 10 and 30 shots, exceeding the strongest listed baselines by 3.97 and 9.71 points, respectively. A matched 30-shot ablation further shows that RoI background evidence reduces pooled false positives at comparable recall, supporting its role in interference suppression.

</details>


### [51] [ReferClaw: Disambiguating User Intent for Egocentric Assistance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07683)
*Hangyu Qin,Junbin Xiao,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReferClaw，一个面向自我中心（egocentric）流式视频问答的智能体框架，将短而歧义的问题转化为"先澄清、后回答"的交互过程，通过三个协作智能体辨识候选意图、提出澄清问题并生成有视觉证据支撑的答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自我中心AI助手的用户常提出简短且指代不明的问句（如"我把它放哪儿了？"可能指多个先前操作过的物体），其目标指代无法仅凭视频与对话历史唯一确定。现有VideoQA系统通常强行给出单一解释，容易产生"看似合理但违背用户真实意图"的答案。

Method: 1）问题建模为交互式过程：回答前先向用户提出澄清问题以消解意图；2）三个协作智能体分别负责候选解释识别、澄清请求、以及基于消解意图与视觉证据的答案生成；3）采用有界、成本感知的策略，在期望信息增益与用户负担之间权衡，限制澄清轮数与问题复杂度；4）通过意图特定技能更新、过程奖励引导的策略优化，并结合智能体级信用分配实现交互学习。

Result: 在增强后的自我中心QA基准上，答案准确率以及"答案+定位"联合性能均优于现有基线，并具备跨数据集的零样本迁移能力。

Conclusion: 交互式澄清是解决自我中心流式辅助中在线用户意图歧义的有效且实用的路径。

Abstract: Users of egocentric AI assistants often ask short, ambiguous questions whose intended referents cannot be uniquely resolved from video and dialogue history. For example, "Where did I leave it?" may refer to several previously handled objects. Existing VideoQA systems typically commit to a single interpretation, risking plausible but intention-misaligned answers. We introduce ReferClaw, an agentic framework that formulates egocentric streaming QA as an interactive process: the assistant asks clarifying questions to resolve user intent before answering. Three cooperating agents identify candidate interpretations, request clarification, and generate answers grounded in the resolved intent and visual evidence. A bounded, cost-aware policy balances expected information gain against user effort while limiting clarification turns and question complexity. Referclaw learns from interaction through intent-specific skill updates and process-reward-guided policy optimization with agent-level credit assignment. Evaluations on augmented egocentric QA benchmarks demonstrate improved answer accuracy and joint answer-and-grounding performance over existing baselines, alongside zero-shot transfer across datasets. These findings support interactive clarification as a practical approach to resolving online user intent in egocentric streaming assistance.

</details>


### [52] [InfMasking: A Unified Variational Framework for Synergistic Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07702)
*Liangjian Wen,Qun Dai,Jiang Duan,Yong Dai,Jianzhuang Liu,Dongkai Wang,Jun Wang,Fuyuan Cao,Zenglin Xu,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 InfMasking 统一多模态学习框架，通过对各模态特征施加无限随机掩码并强制其融合表示与参考目标一致，抑制主导模态与共享信息依赖，促使融合模块学习跨模态协同信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型本应利用"协同信息"（仅多模态同时观测时才可得的信息），但实践中融合模块常依赖主导模态或模态间共享信息即可拟合训练目标，导致协同信息被闲置、未被利用。论文旨在从训练目标层面强制模型学习部分观测下依然有意义的跨模态交互模式。

Method: InfMasking 在融合前对每个模态特征随机掩码，每个采样掩码产生不同的跨模态证据部分组合及其对应融合表示；要求所有掩码融合表示与参考目标保持一致——无监督时为未掩码融合视图，有监督时为任务标签的类代理（class proxy）。由于目标是关于无限多掩码的期望，将掩码融合表示建模为高斯分布，优化闭式变分下界，其总体矩差距由该模型下掩码诱导的协方差控制。

Result: 在所评估的基准上，InfMasking 提升了预测性能；在学习到的模态特异表示上得到更高的任务标签协同性平均 PID 估计；训练后的预测器具有更高的 InterSHAP 交互归因。

Conclusion: 跨多样部分组合维持一致性可有效抑制对单一主导模态或共享信息的依赖，驱动融合模块学习部分观测下仍具意义的跨模态交互模式；无限掩码期望可借助高斯建模与闭式变分界高效优化。代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal models are expected to exploit synergistic information, that is, information available only when multiple modalities are observed together. In practice, however, a fusion module can fit the training objective by relying on a dominant modality or on information that modalities share, and the synergy between modalities is often left unused. We propose InfMasking, a unified multimodal learning framework based on Infinite Masking. Before fusion, InfMasking randomly masks the features of each modality; each sampled mask produces a different partial combination of cross-modal evidence and a fused representation of the corresponding modality interactions. All masked fused representations are required to remain consistent with a reference target: the unmasked fused view when training is unsupervised, and the class proxy of the task label when labels are available. Maintaining this consistency across diverse partial combinations discourages reliance on a dominant modality or on shared information alone, and drives the fusion module to learn cross-modal interaction patterns that remain meaningful under partial observations. Since the objective is an expectation over infinitely many masks, we model the masked fused representations as Gaussian and optimize closed-form variational bounds, whose population-moment gaps are controlled by the masking-induced covariance under this model. On the evaluated benchmarks, InfMasking improves predictive performance and yields higher mean PID estimates of task-label synergy in learned modality-specific representations, alongside higher InterSHAP interaction attribution in the trained predictors. Code is available at https://github.com/brightest66/InfMasking.

</details>


### [53] [FlyingDrones: A Dataset and Benchmark for Optical Flow Estimation from UAV motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07705)
*Laurenz Ruzicka,Roman Pflugfelder,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FlyingDrones基准（基于物理渲染生成、含稠密光流真值与分割掩码）及分辨率归一化指标EPE Norm，系统评测16个光流模型族对远距小型无人机目标的运动估计能力，并验证其与真实UAV影像表现的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光流是空中监视、空域监控与远程目标跟踪中无人机分析的重要线索，在表观特征弱时运动信息仍具判别性。但远距小型无人机目标像素极少、对比度低、且处于复杂动态背景中，现有标准光流基准侧重大型物体中心运动，难以刻画此类远距空中目标。

Method: 构建FlyingDrones合成基准，基于物理渲染生成稠密光流真值与分割掩码；定义按图像尺寸归一化的EPE Norm指标，可跨分辨率比较；在999对光流样本（按运动与尺寸分层）上以三种分辨率评测16个SOTA模型族。补充两项研究：在21台相机的真实UAV影像上进行无真值运动对齐评估，以及仅用800对样本的微调实验。

Result: 所有模型族均优于零流基线；分辨率越高族间差距越大，1920x1080下全局匹配、循环、Transformer与短时窗时序模型明显领先于金字塔、经典、自监督、轻量与扩散模型。族内检查点差异可与族间差异相当甚至更大，说明训练课程与架构同等重要。真实数据上合成排名具中等显著相关（Spearman ρ=0.63，41个检查点），但具体名次有差异；800对微调使留出无人机区域误差最多降低37%，并在四种架构上均改善真实影像中的无人机定位。

Conclusion: 现有光流基准不足以刻画远距小型空中目标，FlyingDrones与EPE Norm填补了这一空白；合成基准排名对真实性能具中等预测力，且少量该域样本微调即可显著提升远距无人机运动估计与定位，凸显训练数据域匹配的重要性。

Abstract: Optical flow is an important cue for drone analysis in aerial surveillance, airspace monitoring, and long-range target tracking, where motion remains informative when appearance is weak. Estimating the motion of small Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, however, is difficult because distant targets occupy few pixels, have low contrast, and move against complex dynamic backgrounds. Standard optical-flow benchmarks emphasize large, object-centric motions and therefore do not characterize distant aerial targets well. We introduce FlyingDrones, a generated benchmark with dense ground-truth optical flow and segmentation masks derived from physically based rendering, and define resolution-normalized metrics (EPE Norm) that normalize flow by image dimensions. We evaluate 16 state-of-the-art model families on a motion- and size-stratified subset of 999 flow pairs at three resolutions. Every family recovers drone motion better than the zero-flow reference, but the gap between families widens with resolution: at 1920x1080, global-matching, recurrent, transformer, and short-window temporal models separate clearly from pyramid, classical, self-supervised, lightweight, and diffusion models. Within-family checkpoint spread is comparable to or larger than between-family spread, so the training curriculum is as important as the architecture. Two complementary studies test the benchmark beyond synthetic accuracy: a ground-truth-free motion-alignment evaluation on 21 cameras of real UAV footage shows that the synthetic ranking carries a moderate, significant signal about real-world performance (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.63 over 41 checkpoints) while the exact top ranks differ, and a fine-tuning study shows that 800 FlyingDrones pairs reduce held-out drone-region error by up to 37% and improve drone localization on the real footage for all four architectures tested.

</details>


### [54] [AffineGS: Unlocking Accurate Geometry in 3DGS via Spatially Varying Affine Rectification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07709)
*Tze Ho Elden Tse,Jizong Peng,Richard Chen,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对单目深度先验在3DGS中采用单一全局scale-and-shift对齐的假设缺陷，提出空间变化仿射校正模型与法向感知正则化器，无需传感器即提升几何精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS视觉质量高但几何精度不足；现有深度引导方法假设单目深度与真实深度仅差一个全局仿射变换，而作者发现现代单目深度网络存在区域相关的分段线性畸变，使全局对齐反而扭曲场景几何。

Method: 提出空间变化的仿射校正模型，用区域平滑、边缘感知的场将单目视差校正为一致的度量深度；并推导法向感知正则化器，利用空间梯度将校正后的视差与3DGS的深度及法向耦合。

Result: 在多种实验设置下，该无传感器方法在保持3DGS强光度质量的同时显著提升几何精度，并优于当前聚焦几何的先进方法。

Conclusion: 打破全局对齐假设，以空间变化校正与法向耦合正则化可有效缓解单目先验畸变，实现高质量且几何准确的3DGS重建，无需额外传感器。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become the leading approach for photorealistic novel view synthesis, yet its geometric accuracy lags behind its visual quality. Existing depth-guided methods attempt to resolve this by regularizing the optimization with monocular depth priors, typically using a single global scale-and-shift alignment. Crucially, we discover a fundamental flaw in this assumption: modern monocular depth networks systematically exhibit region-dependent, piecewise-linear distortions. This discovery invalidates standard global alignment strategies, which warp scene geometry by enforcing a single transform. To address this, we introduce a spatially varying affine rectification model that corrects monocular disparity into consistent metric depth using regionally smooth, edge-aware fields. We further derive a normal-aware regularizer that uses spatial gradients to couple the rectified disparity with 3DGS depth and normals. Across diverse experimental settings, our sensor-free method shows strong photometric quality of Gaussian Splatting while substantially improving geometric accuracy and outperforming state-of-the art geometry-focused methods.

</details>


### [55] [Fast and Accurate Hand Estimation in Pixels, Interaction and World Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07711)
*Jinkun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FAH 是一组基于 SAM 3D Body 手部分支微调与特征蒸馏的手部网格估计模型，通过先预测 2D/3D 关节与表面点再拟合 MANO/MHR-Hand，显著提升网格精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单目手部网格估计器通常直接回归骨骼参数再投影求 2D 关键点，作者发现直接预测的 3D 关节与 2D 预测更一致，且以预测点拟合网格可降低网格误差，据此重新设计估计流程。

Method: 基于 SAM 3D Body 手部分支，经微调与特征蒸馏构建 FAH 模型系列；模型预测对应的 2D/3D 关节及表面点，据此拟合 MANO 或 MHR-Hand 参数；可选地在推理时不依赖物体几何估计解剖部位与接触；引入因果精修降低加速度误差，并通过相机估计将手定位到世界坐标系。

Result: 在图像空间对齐、手部几何、接触估计与世界坐标跟踪上均优于所评估基线；默认 ViT-L 模型在 RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 上含网格拟合达 65 fps，开启部位与接触为 49 fps；最小 ViT-S 模型在无网格拟合、部位与接触时达 125 fps。

Conclusion: 以点预测驱动网格拟合的范式在精度与效率上均具优势，FAH 提供了可实用的实时手部网格估计方案，并开源代码。

Abstract: Monocular hand mesh estimators commonly predict rig parameters and project the mesh to obtain 2D keypoints. We find that directly predicted 3D joints agree better with 2D predictions, and fitting a mesh to predicted points reduces mesh error. We present FAH (Fast and Accurate Hand Estimation), a family of models built on SAM 3D Body's hand branch through fine-tuning and feature distillation. The models predict corresponding 2D and 3D joints and surface points, fit MANO or MHR-Hand, and optionally estimate anatomical parts and contact without object geometry at inference. Causal refinement reduces acceleration error, and camera estimation places the hands in world space. Experiments show improvements in image-space alignment, hand geometry, contact estimation and world-space tracking over the evaluated baselines. The default ViT-L model runs at 65 fps with mesh fitting on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, or 49 fps with parts and contact enabled. The smallest ViT-S model reaches 125 fps without mesh fitting, parts or contact. Code: https://github.com/noahcao/FAH.

</details>


### [56] [Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors for Event-Based Point Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07713)
*Xiaokai Song,Zhang Li,Leqi Liu,Yibin Ye,Kun Wang,Xichao Teng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SEPT 是纯事件相机框架，通过任务自适应事件证据调制（TEEM）与持久轨迹先验（PTP）实现长序列任意点跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机虽适应快速运动与困难光照，但事件活动稀疏且随场景与运动变化，导致对应关系难建立，长序列轨迹估计易漂移，需要选择性利用信息性事件证据并在时间窗间保持轨迹约束。

Method: 在 ETAP 架构上引入两模块：TEEM 仅用跟踪监督学习有界可靠性场，在特征提取前对事件张量沿空间、时间与通道加权；PTP 通过 Schur 补对固定局部二次轨迹模型做边缘化以跨重叠窗口传递几何信息，其可见性感知校正细化重叠坐标，并用裁剪后的终端速度初始化新暴露时间戳坐标。

Result: 仅用合成 EventKubric 训练，在五个数据集上评测 TAP 与特征跟踪；平均 Jaccard 优于重训 ETAP 基线，特征年龄与期望特征年龄指标更优，并在 EC、EDS 上超过若干事件+帧融合方法。

Conclusion: 选择性事件证据加权与持久时序先验的结合可有效缓解事件稀疏性与长期漂移，使纯事件长序列点跟踪达到优于基线及部分融合方法的性能。

Abstract: Event cameras enable tracking under fast motion and challenging illumination. However, stable long-term point tracking remains challenging: event activity is sparse and varies with scene content and motion, complicating correspondence, while trajectory estimates can drift over long sequences. Together, these challenges motivate a tracker that selectively uses informative event evidence and retains trajectory constraints across temporal windows. We propose Selective Event Evidence and Persistent Temporal Priors (SEPT), an event-only framework for tracking any point (TAP) over long sequences. SEPT introduces two complementary modules: Task-Adaptive Event Evidence Modulation (TEEM) and Persistent Trajectory Prior (PTP). Using only tracking supervision, TEEM learns a bounded reliability field that weights the event tensor across space, time, and channels before feature extraction. PTP carries geometric information across overlapping windows by marginalizing a fixed local quadratic trajectory model with a Schur complement. Its visibility-aware correction refines overlap coordinates, while a clipped terminal velocity initializes coordinates at newly exposed timestamps. SEPT builds on the ETAP architecture. SEPT is trained exclusively on synthetic EventKubric data and evaluated on five datasets across TAP and feature tracking. Results show that SEPT outperforms the retrained ETAP baseline in average Jaccard for TAP and in feature age and expected feature age for feature tracking; it also surpasses several methods combining event and frame inputs on EC and EDS. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sssxxxkkkk/SEPT.

</details>


### [57] [Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck for Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07718)
*Liangjian Wen,Jiangtao Zheng,Jiang Duan,Qun Dai,Yong Dai,Jianzhuang Liu,Jun Wang,Shu-Dong Huang,Xinwang Liu,Zenglin Xu,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多模态信息交互瓶颈框架 MIIB，基于部分信息分解显式建模冗余、独特与协同信息，用可处理的熵目标优化，在多模态自监督基准上稳定优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态自监督学习面临异质性、信息量不均、跨模态复杂交互的挑战；对比学习依赖强多视图冗余假设，忽略模态独有与协同信息，导致表示次优。

Method: 以 Partial Information Decomposition 为理论基础构建 MIIB，显式编码冗余/独特/协同信息；采用双路径架构分别做模态特定编码与多模态融合；用可处理的熵替代目标（变分界 + score-based 熵估计）约束最小充分表示，避免显式互信息估计。

Result: 在多个多样化基准上相比 SOTA 多模态自监督方法取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 将信息瓶颈与信息分解结合可有效捕捉跨模态交互并抑制冗余信息，为多模态自监督提供原则性框架；代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal self-supervised learning is challenged by heterogeneity, unequal informativeness, and complex information interactions across multimodal data sources such as images, text, audio, and tabular data. While contrastive methods effectively align shared semantics, they typically rely on strong multi-view redundancy assumptions, overlooking modality-specific and synergistic information, thus leading to suboptimal representations. We propose the Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck (MIIB), a principled framework grounded in Partial Information Decomposition that explicitly encodes redundant, unique, and synergistic information within multimodal interactions. MIIB employs a dual-path model architecture for modality-specific encoding and multimodal fusion, optimized using surrogate tractable entropy-based objectives that enforce minimal sufficient representations without requiring explicit mutual information estimation. By leveraging variational bounds and score-based entropy estimation, MIIB efficiently captures complex cross-modal interactions while suppressing superfluous information. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art multimodal self-supervised methods. Code is available at https://github.com/wanglingzaishi/MIIB.

</details>


### [58] [BiGrounder: Bidirectional Training Unlocks the Potential of GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07765)
*Dengyao Shi,Tianyu Fu,Fei Hu,Anyang Su,Hanning Wang,Shuo Wang,Minghui Wu,Chenxu Zhao,Zhen Lei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出双向奖励范式（BiGrounder），通过"坐标→指令"生成与"指令→坐标"定位的循环一致性门控实现模型自强化，4B模型在五个GUI grounding基准上取得有竞争力的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GUI grounding将任务形式化为从指令预测动作-坐标对，仅用最终坐标做端到端监督；训练数据中每个目标坐标的指令描述数量少，而真实场景下同一目标的表述多样，模型对语言变化的鲁棒性不足。此外，现有强化学习范式下模型探索能力有限，即便数据相同，增益也受约束。

Method: 1) SFT阶段进行双向训练，使模型既能由坐标生成动作描述，也能由指令定位坐标；2) RL阶段模型on-policy采样语义一致的指令变体，并将每个变体重新定位回其目标；3) 设计循环一致性门控（cycle-consistency gate），将语义质量与定位成功耦合，使模型自身的指令策略成为持续刷新的强化轨迹来源。

Result: 4B参数模型在五个GUI grounding基准上取得有竞争力的准确率。

Conclusion: 双向训练结合循环一致性门控的奖励机制可缓解指令描述稀缺与探索不足问题，验证了该训练范式的有效性。

Abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding aims to map natural language instructions to precise operational coordinates, serving as a critical task for autonomous agent interaction. Current approaches formalize GUI grounding as predicting action-coordinate pairs from instructions, with end-to-end training supervised solely by final coordinates. Training datasets typically provide only a small number of descriptions per target coordinate, whereas real-world scenarios involve a much larger set of varied descriptions for the same target, which limits robustness to linguistic variation. While recent GUI grounding paradigms have begun employing reinforcement learning to enhance localization accuracy, models with limited exploratory capability before reinforcement yield constrained improvements even with identical training data during the reinforcement phase. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bidirectional reward paradigm that enables model self-reinforcement. During SFT, bidirectional training equips the model to generate action descriptions from target coordinates. During RL, the model samples semantically consistent instruction variations on-policy and grounds each variation back to its target. A cycle-consistency gate couples semantic quality to grounding success, turning the model's own instruction policy into a source of continually refreshed reinforcement trajectories. Our 4B-parameter model achieves competitive accuracy across five grounding benchmarks in our evaluation, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed training paradigm. https://github.com/Spell-shi/BiGrounder

</details>


### [59] [Rain Beyond Streaks: Cascaded Realistic Rain and Wet Surface Synthesis via Scene Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07793)
*Melissa Tijink,Kirill Tolstobrov,Shunxin Wang,Estefania Talavera,Duc V. Le,Luuk Spreeuwers,Shaodi You,Nicola Strisciuglio*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CascadeRS：利用深度与分割先验的零样本可控生成管线，联合合成雨痕、反射与积水，并构建Cityscapes-CascadeRS数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有雨合成方法多只生成雨痕，忽略反射、积水等地表效应，而这些对感知真实性与下游视觉任务鲁棒性至关重要。

Method: 基于深度与分割先验的级联式合成框架，采用物理启发的零样本、可控生成流程，使雨痕、反射与积水与场景语义对齐。

Result: 生成高感知真实感的城市雨天场景，经大规模用户研究与定量评估验证；发布Cityscapes-CascadeRS数据集以评测下游任务在真实降雨条件下的表现。

Conclusion: CascadeRS是可扩展、逼真的雨合成框架，可用于评估并提升恶劣降雨天气下视觉系统的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Realistic rain synthesis is a persistent challenge for vision systems operating in adverse weather. Existing methods primarily focus on generating rain streaks, often neglecting consequent surface effects such as reflections and puddles, which are critical for perceptual realism and robustness of downstream vision tasks. We introduce CascadeRS, a rain synthesis framework that leverages depth and segmentation priors to render scene-consistent rain and surface effects. In addition to rain streaks, CascadeRS produces reflections and puddles aligned with scene semantics through a physics-inspired zero-shot, controllable generative pipeline. It produces photorealistic rainy urban scenes, with high perceptual realism, which we validate qualitatively with an extensive user study and quantitatively. We produce the Cityscapes-CascadeRS dataset, to study downstream task performance under real rainy conditions. Our results establish CascadeRS as a scalable and realistic rain-generation framework for evaluating and enhancing the robustness of vision in adverse rainy weather. Code and dataset are available via https://github.com/nis-research/CascadeRainSynthesis

</details>


### [60] [Self-Supervised Diffusion Models for Handwritten Signature Verification via Ruin Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07810)
*Peirong Zhang,Zhenhua Yang,Jiaxin Zhang,Moises Diaz,Miguel A. Ferrer,Umapada Pal,Wei Zhou,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于扩散模型的自监督手写签名表征与验证框架 SigDiffuser，通过“废墟重建”(RFR) 预任务在严重揉皱破坏的签名上学习判别性表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手写签名验证(HVS)性能取决于表征判别力，但现有方法以监督学习为主，自监督学习在该领域几乎未被探索。

Method: 设计 Reconstruction from Ruins (RFR) 预任务：对签名施加剧烈揉皱以破坏结构完整性与书写风格；用视觉编码器从完整区域提取笔迹模式，引导去噪器重建被破坏区域；并引入金字塔特征聚合模块(PFAM)在编码器与去噪器间进行分层聚合与调制。

Result: 在多语种签名数据集上显著优于 SOTA 自监督方法与 HSV 模型；揉皱程度越高，表征质量越好。

Conclusion: 极端破坏结合自监督扩散模型可获得优于传统轻微形变的签名表征，为 HSV 及其他生物特征领域提供新思路。

Abstract: Handwritten signature verification (HSV) is a critical biometric technique in legal and forensic authentication, whose efficacy hinges on the discriminability of signature representations. Current HSV methods predominantly adopt supervised learning to enhance representation quality, leaving self-supervised learning largely unexplored. We propose \emph{SigDiffuser}, a diffusion-based self-supervised framework for signature representation and verification. At its core, \emph{SigDiffuser} introduces a novel pretext task termed \emph{Reconstruction from Ruins (RFR)}, which deliberately ``ruins'' signatures through severe crumpling, obliterating their structural integrity and writing styles. A visual encoder is employed to capture crucial handwriting patterns from intact signature regions, guiding the denoiser to reconstruct the ``ruined'' portions and learning meaningful representations. Additionally, we introduce a \emph{pyramidal feature aggregation module (PFAM)} to bridge the visual encoder and denoiser, enhancing representation quality via hierarchical aggregation and modulation. Extensive experiments on multilingual signature datasets demonstrate that \emph{SigDiffuser} significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art SSL methods and HSV models. We further show that increasing the crumpling severity on signatures effectively improves representation quality. Notably, our work demonstrates that extreme destruction, coupled with self-supervised diffusion models, can yield superior signature representation compared to traditional mild deformations, paving new avenues for HSV and other biometric domains. Code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [61] [MV-Sign: Multi-View 3D Motion Integration and Enhanced Text-to-Motion Conditioning for Sign Language Production](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07811)
*Singyu Muk,Kaustubh Kundu,Kunyuan Xie,Weijie Wang,Kalin Stefanov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 手语生成（SLP）3D方法受噪声监督与文本条件弱所困；本文构建多视角3D数据 How2Sign-MV3D，并设计含标志感知时空VQ-VAE、伪注释适配器与关键帧感知检索的SLP模型，在How2Sign上将身体/手部DTW-PA-JPE分别降低32.8%/20.9%，并发布ASLCitizen-3D、MM-WAuslan-MV3D及SGNify-MV基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前3D手语生成依赖从单视角正面视频拟合的伪3D动作数据，存在严重自遮挡并丢失手部细节，形成噪声监督；同时文本条件建模较弱，影响文本到动作的对齐质量，最终损害下游生成效果。作者因此希望同时解决数据噪声与文本条件弱两大瓶颈。

Method: (1) 提出How2Sign-MV3D数据集，通过新颖的跨视角整理流水线融合多视角估计以消除遮挡、过滤非手语片段；(2) 设计鲁棒SLP模型：标志感知时空VQ-VAE（ST-VQVAE）实现身体-手部联合token化，引入伪注释（pseudo-gloss）适配器，并采用关键帧感知检索增强文本-动作对齐。

Result: 在How2Sign基准上，相较SOTA，身体与手部的DTW-PA-JPE分别下降32.8%与20.9%。同时发布ASLCitizen-3D、MM-WAuslan-MV3D两个高质量3D数据集及SGNify-MV多视角视频基准。

Conclusion: 将多视角3D动作数据与文本条件路径联合优化，可有效缓解噪声监督与文本条件弱的问题，显著提升3D手语生成的保真度；所发布的数据集与基准有望推动更广泛的多视角手语生成研究。

Abstract: Sign language production (SLP) aims to generate appropriate sign language motion from spoken language text. However, current 3D SLP methods suffer from noisy supervision and weak text conditioning. Specifically, these methods typically rely on pseudo-3D motion data fitted from single-view frontal videos, which introduces severe self-occlusion and loses fine-grained hand details, ultimately degrading downstream production. To overcome these limitations, we propose a comprehensive framework that jointly integrates multi-view 3D motion data and optimizes the text-conditioning pathway. First, we introduce How2Sign-MV3D, a high-fidelity dataset constructed via a novel cross-view curation pipeline that fuses multi-view estimates to resolve occlusions and filter non-signing segments. Second, we design a robust SLP model incorporating a sign-aware spatio-temporal VQ-VAE (ST-VQVAE) for joint body-hand tokenization, a pseudo-gloss adapter, and keyframe-aware retrieval to enhance text-to-motion alignment. Evaluated on the How2Sign benchmark, our framework reduces body and hand DTW-PA-JPE by 32.8% and 20.9% respectively compared to the state-of-the-art. Finally, we release two new high-quality 3D datasets, ASLCitizen-3D and MM-WAuslan-MV3D, alongside SGNify-MV as a multi-view video benchmark to support broader community research.

</details>


### [62] [CMDiff: Left Atrial Scar Segmentation from 3D LGE MRI Using Conditional Mask Diffusion Model: A Feasibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07814)
*Jing Zhang,Bastien Bergere,Jonas Leite,Emilie Bollache,Mikaël Laredo,Alban Redheuil,Nadjia Kachenoura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出条件掩膜扩散模型CMDiff用于左心房瘢痕分割，实验表明其技术可行但性能未超越确定性基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LGE心脏MRI可无创评估左心房瘢痕，该指标与房颤消融预后相关。但自动瘢痕分割面临对比度低、心房壁薄、标注稀缺和极端类别不平衡等困难。条件扩散模型具备迭代式掩膜生成能力，但其在稀疏3D左心房瘢痕分割中的适用性尚不明确。

Method: 提出Conditional Mask Diffusion (CMDiff)，采用动态编码器条件化的3D正弦UNet直接预测干净掩膜。在60例公开LASCARQS瘢痕标注受试者上进行五折交叉验证（每折48训练/12测试），与确定性基线在同一设置下对比。

Result: CMDiff的瘢痕DSC为0.47±0.08，HD95为12.89±6.39 mm，ASD为1.91±0.96 mm；确定性基线分别为0.51±0.08、10.86±5.39 mm、1.58±1.03 mm。相同实现下，干净掩膜预测显著优于噪声预测配置。

Conclusion: CMDiff技术可行但未提升分割性能：DSC更低，HD95与ASD均更高。直接掩膜扩散可作为分析性替代方案，但并非该任务的竞争性性能突破。代码已开源。

Abstract: Late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) cardiac MRI enables non-invasive assessment of left atrial (LA) scar, an imaging marker associated with atrial fibrillation ablation outcome. However, automatic scar segmentation is hindered by low contrast, the thin atrial wall, scarce labels, and extreme class imbalance. Conditional diffusion offers iterative mask generation, but its suitability for sparse 3D LA scar segmentation remains unclear. To address this gap, we propose Conditional Mask Diffusion (CMDiff), which predicts clean masks using a dynamic-encoder-conditioned 3D sinusoidal UNet. We compared CMDiff with a deterministic baseline on identical cases in five-fold cross-validation of 60 scar-labelled public LASCARQS subjects, with 48 training and 12 held-out cases per fold. CMDiff achieved a scar DSC of 0.47 $\pm$ 0.08, HD95 of 12.89 $\pm$ 6.39 mm, and ASD of 1.91 $\pm$ 0.96 mm, compared with deterministic baseline values of 0.51 $\pm$ 0.08, 10.86 $\pm$ 5.39 mm, and 1.58 $\pm$ 1.03 mm, respectively. Under the same implementation, clean-mask prediction performed substantially better than the noise-prediction configuration evaluated in this study. Thus, CMDiff was technically feasible but did not improve segmentation performance: DSC was lower, and both HD95 and ASD were higher. Direct mask diffusion therefore provides an analytical alternative, but not a competitive performance advance for this task.
