The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/jizhang02/CMDiff.

</details>


### [63] [STAG-Net: Structure-Aware Attention over Landmark Groups for Lightweight Head Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07828)
*Asiri Gawesha Lindamulage,Sanka Mohottala,Dharshana Kasthurirathna,Nuwan Kodagoda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STAG-Net——基于面部关键点分组的结构感知注意力轻量头部姿态估计方法，精度领先且计算成本低数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 头部姿态估计在人机交互与驾驶员监控中很重要，但现有基于图像的方法计算成本高，不适合资源受限场景部署。

Method: 以面部关键点为输入，采用运动感知选择、空间聚类、紧凑DeepSet编码器、自注意力及全局几何描述子；分别基于FaceMesh与FAN关键点构建两个变体，并在300W-LP、AFLW2000、BIWI上以跨数据集和主体独立协议评估。

Result: 在所有评估设置下，基于关键点方法中MAE最低；FAN变体在BIWI有效检测帧上总体误差最低，跨数据集3.51°、主体独立2.39°。回归器仅0.012–0.043M参数、24.1–83.6K FLOPs，比FSA-Net少约三个数量级FLOPs；FaceMesh端到端在Tesla T4达322.9 FPS（约为最快图像基线164.5 FPS的两倍），CPU 111.0 FPS；训练吞吐为FSA-Net的7–8倍、HopeNet与TokenHPE的百倍以上，完整训练28分钟内完成。

Conclusion: STAG-Net在保持基于关键点方法领先精度的同时，显著降低训练与推理开销，适合资源受限部署。

Abstract: Head pose estimation is important for human computer interaction and driver monitoring, but many image based methods remain too costly for resource constrained deployment. We propose STAG-Net, a structure-aware attention over landmark groups for lightweight head Pose estimation that estimates head pose from facial landmarks using movement aware selection, spatial clustering, compact DeepSet encoders, self attention, and a global geometry descriptor. We develop variants using FaceMesh and Face Alignment Network landmarks and evaluate them under cross dataset and subject independent protocols on 300W-LP, AFLW2000, and BIWI. STAG-Net achieves the lowest mean absolute error among all compared landmark based methods in every evaluated setting. On BIWI frames with valid detections, the FAN variant also records the lowest overall error among all compared methods, reaching $3.51^\circ$ under cross dataset evaluation and $2.39^\circ$ under subject independent evaluation. The regressors use only 0.012 to 0.043 million parameters and 24.1 to 83.6 thousand FLOPs, about three orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs than FSA-Net. Despite including landmark extraction and regression, the FaceMesh pipeline reaches 322.9 frames per second on a Tesla T4 GPU, nearly twice the 164.5 frames per second of the fastest measured image based baseline, and 111.0 frames per second on CPU. After normalization by dataset size, STAG-Net processes training samples seven to eight times faster than FSA-Net and more than one hundred times faster than HopeNet and TokenHPE, while complete training finishes within 28 minutes. These results show that STAG-Net combines leading landmark based accuracy with substantially lower training and inference cost.

</details>


### [64] [THG-Omni: Traceable Human-Centric Graph Supervision for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07836)
*Jisheng Dang,Kai Wei,Ronghao Lin,Bimei Wang,Hong Peng,Wei-Shi Zheng,Bin Hu,Qi Tian,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 THG-Omni，一种以人为中心的图监督框架，将 SAM3 参与者轨迹与时间定位的 Qwen3-VL 标注连接，训练全模态模型从结构化图证据进行视频推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全模态模型能回答视频问题，但预测很少显示支持答案的参与者、事件或时间区间；仅用答案级监督无法教会模型解读结构化视频证据。

Method: 用 SAM3 提取参与者轨迹并与时间定位的 Qwen3-VL 标注关联；候选语义断言先经源视频与音频核验，再用于构建训练问题；轨迹几何提供显式时空监督。训练模型从结构化图解读参与者属性、动作、情感、交互及其时序；推理时使用由待评估视频预测得到的图。

Result: IntentBench 上在社会推理、情绪理解与欺骗感知均优于未适配骨干；NExT-QA 上匹配图达 89.54%（无图输入 85.10%）；紧凑图 78.22%、全图 78.02%、无图 77.58%；预测图在无源视频与音频时仍保留可用证据。

Conclusion: THG-Omni 在提升以人为中心视频推理的同时，将证据落地到可识别的参与者与事件上。

Abstract: Omni-modal models can answer questions about video, but their predictions rarely show which participant, event, or interval supports an answer. Moreover, answer-level supervision alone does not teach a model to interpret structured video evidence. To systematically mitigate this issue, we present THG-Omni, a human-centric graph-supervision framework that links Segment Anything Model~3 participant tracks with temporally grounded Qwen3-VL annotations. Candidate semantic claims are checked against the source video and available audio before they are used to construct training questions, while track geometry provides explicit spatial and temporal supervision. The resulting questions teach an omni-modal reasoning model to interpret participant attributes, actions, affect, interactions, and their timing from a structured graph. At inference, THG-Omni uses a predicted graph constructed from the evaluation video. Experiments on IntentBench show consistent improvements over the unadapted backbone across social reasoning, emotion understanding, and deception perception. On NExT-QA, THG-Omni achieves 89.54\% accuracy with the matched graph, compared with 85.10\% without graph input. Further validation experiments show that compact graph input achieves 78.22\% accuracy, compared with 78.02\% using the full graph and 77.58\% without graph input. A complementary diagnostic demonstrates that the predicted graph preserves evidence useful for answering questions even without the source video and audio. Together, these findings show that THG-Omni improves human-centric video reasoning while grounding its evidence in identifiable participants and events. Our codes are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/review-n94hhfcwp5666/

</details>


### [65] [Enhanced MRI brain tumor detection using deep learning in conjunction with explainable AI SHAP based diverse and multi feature analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07843)
*Asif Rahman,Maqsood Hayat,Nadeem Iqbal,Fawaz Khaled Alarfaj,Salem Alkhalaf,Fahad Alturise*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究系统比较LBP、Gabor、DWT、FFT、CNN、GLRLM等多种特征表示与KNN、RF、SVC、PNN、CNN五种学习算法的组合，用于MRI脑肿瘤识别；实验表明LBP+SVC/CNN在特异性与准确率上表现突出，并经卡方、p值与SHAP分析验证LBP特征的重要性，CNN在大规模基准数据集上达到98.9%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统脑肿瘤诊断方法存在分辨率低、辐射暴露和对比度有限等缺陷，而MRI虽具高分辨率、非侵入优势，仍需探索更优的特征表示与分类器组合以实现自动化、高精度诊断，并验证特征空间的有效性与模型泛化能力。

Method: 融合多种特征表示方案（LBP、Gabor滤波器、DWT、FFT、CNN、GLRLM）与五种学习算法（KNN、随机森林、SVC、概率神经网络PNN、CNN）进行组合对比；采用卡方检验与p值统计检验验证LBP特征空间的显著性，并利用SHAP分析识别分类中最关键的特征；在小数据集与大规模基准数据集上分别评估性能以考察泛化能力。

Result: 小数据集上CNN准确率97.8%、SVC准确率98.06%；LBP结合SVC与CNN获得高特异性与准确率；卡方与p值检验证实LBP特征空间对脑肿瘤识别具有显著影响；大规模基准数据集上CNN准确率达98.9%，SVC为96.7%。

Conclusion: LBP与SVC/CNN的组合是MRI脑肿瘤诊断的有效方法；CNN在自动化高精度肿瘤诊断中展现出最强的效果与泛化能力，SHAP与统计检验进一步验证了特征选择的可解释性与有效性。

Abstract: Recent innovations in medical imaging have markedly improved brain tumor identification, surpassing conventional diagnostic approaches that suffer from low resolution, radiation exposure, and limited contrast. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is pivotal in precise and accurate tumor characterization owing to its high-resolution, non-invasive nature. This study investigates the synergy among multiple feature representation schemes such as local Binary Patterns (LBP), Gabor filters, Discrete Wavelet Transform, Fast Fourier Transform, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Gray-Level Run Length Matrix alongside five learning algorithms namely: k-nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier (SVC), and probabilistic neural network (PNN), and CNN. Empirical findings indicate that LBP in conjunction with SVC and CNN obtained high specificity and accuracy, rendering it a promising method for MRI-based tumor diagnosis. Further to investigate the contribution of LBP, Statistical analysis chi-square and p-value tests are used to confirm the significant impact of LBP feature space for identification of brain Tumor. In addition, The SHAP analysis was used to identify the most important features in classification. In a small dataset, CNN obtained 97.8% accuracy while SVC yielded 98.06% accuracy. In subsequent analysis, a large benchmark dataset is also utilized to evaluate the performance of learning algorithms in order to investigate the generalization power of the proposed model. CNN achieves the highest accuracy of 98.9%, followed by SVC at 96.7%. These results highlight CNN's effectiveness in automated, high-precision tumor diagnosis. Code: https://github.com/asifrahman557/BrainTumorDetection

</details>


### [66] [OcTreeMamba: Topology-Aware Mamba for 3D Medical Segmentation via Octree Sparsification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07865)
*Kaixiang Mai,Jiaqi Yu,Yuzhu Ji,Yiqun Zhang,Zhijie Wang,Haijun Zhang,Yiu-ming Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OcTreeMamba，将八叉树结构引入状态空间模型（SSM），实现3D解剖结构的拓扑感知长程上下文建模，兼顾分割精度与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Mamba的分割方法虽以线性复杂度捕捉长程依赖，但启发式选择性扫描策略破坏内在空间层次、带来计算冗余，且忽略了3D解剖结构固有的稀疏性。

Method: 1) Structure Learner通过分层门控与Gumbel-Softmax采样实现解剖自适应结构化稀疏化，实现可微的解剖区域选择；2) Dynamic Octree Builder将选中区域组织为保持层次连通性的多级拓扑；3) 基于八叉树的Bidirectional Tree-SSM沿leaf–parent–root与root–parent–leaf轨迹进行连通性感知的上下文传播与整合。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上实验表明，方法在拓扑连续性与计算效率上具有竞争力，尤其在血管数据集上对复杂结构的恢复表现突出。

Conclusion: 用八叉树层次稀疏结构替代启发式扫描，可有效利用3D解剖稀疏性，实现拓扑感知的高效长程建模，代码已开源。

Abstract: Accurate segmentation of 3D anatomical structures is crucial to medical image analysis. Recently, Mamba-based approaches have achieved promising segmentation performance in capturing long-range dependencies with linear-time computational complexity. However, heuristic selective scanning strategies inherently disrupt the intrinsic spatial hierarchy and increase computational redundancy, ignoring the inherent sparsity of 3D anatomical structures. To this end, we propose OcTreeMamba, a hierarchical framework that incorporates Octree structures into SSM, achieving 3D topology-aware long-range context feature propagation and integration. Specifically, a Structure Learner performs anatomy-adaptive structured sparsification through hierarchical gating and Gumbel-Softmax sampling, enabling differentiable selection of anatomical regions. The selected regions are subsequently organized by a Dynamic Octree Builder into a multi-level topology that preserves their hierarchical connectivity. Based on the constructed Octree, a bidirectional Tree-SSM propagates and integrates contextual features along connectivity-aware leaf--parent--root and root--parent--leaf trajectories. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets show that our proposed OcTreeMamba achieves competitive performance \wrt topological continuity and computational efficiency, particularly for recovering the complex structure on vascular datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/MikeMak123/OcTreeMamba.

</details>


### [67] [PlayGen2: Learning Real-Time Playable Worlds with Explicit 3D State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07867)
*Jihai Zhang,Yuhan Zhou,Junyou Li,Deheng Ye,Qi Dou,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PlayGen2 提出一种将学习到的3D状态演化与神经渲染解耦的实时交互式世界模型，在 Doom 上实现约160ms后端延迟的可玩世界模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅用生成帧作为循环式世界表示，会把响应式控制、持久空间结构和动态实体交互的要求绑定到视角依赖的外观合成上，难以维持长时程的空间与时间一致性，因此需要将状态演化与渲染分离。

Method: 维护持久世界记忆：以体素占据栅格表示静态几何，以身份索引的3D状态表示玩家与其他实体。在固定尺寸局部区域内，世界状态模型联合学习动作条件化的实体动力学、几何补全与实体发现，并将更新提交至持久记忆；独立神经渲染器由世界状态的深度与语义投影合成第一人称观测，不将生成图像回馈至状态预测。

Result: 在 Doom 测试平台上成功学习几何感知的玩家运动与玩家—NPC交互等世界动力学；完整模拟与渲染管线在 M4 Pro MacBook Pro 上后端延迟约160ms；实现未见地图零样本部署、基于单玩家模型组合的多玩家交互，以及基于规则状态干预的可编程玩法。

Conclusion: 将3D状态演化与神经渲染分离可兼顾实时性、长时一致性与交互可控性，所学游戏世界模型具备可迁移性与可扩展性，代码与预训练权重已公开。

Abstract: Building a playable world requires more than generating plausible video: it demands responsive control, persistent spatial structure, and coherent interactions with dynamic entities. Using generated frames as the sole recurrent world representation ties these requirements to view-dependent appearance synthesis, making it difficult to maintain long-term spatial and temporal consistency in generation and interaction. We present PlayGen2, a real-time interactive world model that separates learned 3D state evolution from neural rendering. PlayGen2 maintains a persistent world memory comprising static geometry represented by a volumetric occupancy grid and identity-indexed 3D states for the player and other entities. Within a fixed-size local region, its world-state model jointly learns action-conditioned entity dynamics, geometry completion, and entity discovery, committing updates to a persistent world memory. A separate neural renderer synthesizes first-person observations from depth and semantic projections of the world state, without feeding generated images back into state prediction. Using Doom as a testbed, we demonstrate that the model successfully learns world dynamics including geometry-aware player motion and player--NPC interactions. The framework is computationally efficient, enabling the complete simulation and rendering pipeline to achieve approximately 160ms backend latency on a MacBook Pro with an M4 Pro chip. Beyond single-player interaction, we demonstrate zero-shot deployment on unseen Doom maps, multiplayer interaction through the composition of single-player models, and programmable gameplay through rule-based state interventions. These capabilities demonstrate the transferability and extensibility of the learned game-world model. Code and pretrained model weights are publicly available.

</details>


### [68] [PVDepth: Panoramic Video Depth Estimation via Geometry-Aware Spatiotemporal Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07873)
*Chuanxin Song,Peixi Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出大规模合成全景RGB-D视频数据集PanoCARLA与端到端全景视频深度估计框架PVDepth，通过球面感知噪声初始化与立方体贴图时序修正两大机制解决ERP畸变与时序非线性问题，实现几何准确、时序一致的深度序列估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景视频深度估计对VR与世界模型至关重要，但受制于两大障碍：一是大规模训练数据稀缺；二是等距柱状投影（ERP）特有的时空挑战，导致透视视频深度模型无法直接迁移。

Method: 首先构建PanoCARLA——大规模合成RGB-D全景视频数据集，具备自然运动轨迹与类无人机漫游视角。在此基础上提出PVDepth，由透视视频深度模型改造的端到端框架，并引入两项核心机制：(1) 渐进式球面感知噪声初始化（Progressive Sphere-aware Noise Initialization），将噪声分布从平面退火至球面，引导模型适应非均匀信息密度；(2) 立方体贴图时序建模模块（Cube-rectified Temporal Modeling），引入辅助立方体贴图时序分支以修正ERP域中的非线性时序动态。

Result: 大量实验表明PVDepth性能优越，可生成几何准确且时序一致的深度序列。

Conclusion: PanoCARLA数据集与PVDepth框架有效缓解了数据稀缺与ERP时空畸变问题，验证了透视模型向全景域迁移的可行性；代码与数据将开源（https://github.com/ChuanxinSong/PVDepth）。

Abstract: Panoramic video depth estimation is pivotal for applications such as Virtual Reality and World Models. However, advancements in this field are impeded by two primary obstacles: the scarcity of large-scale training data and the unique spatiotemporal challenges of Equirectangular Projection (ERP), which hinder the direct transfer of perspective models. In this paper, we first present PanoCARLA, a large-scale synthetic RGB-D panoramic video dataset, featuring natural motion trajectories and drone-like roaming perspectives. Building on this foundation, we propose PVDepth, an end-to-end framework adapted from perspective video depth models. To tackle ERP-specific geometric distortions and consequent non-linear temporal dynamics, we introduce two core mechanisms: (1) A Progressive Sphere-aware Noise Initialization strategy that anneals the noise distribution from planar to spherical, guiding the model to adapt to non-uniform information density; and (2) A Cube-rectified Temporal Modeling module that incorporates an auxiliary cubemap temporal branch to rectify non-linear temporal dynamics in the ERP domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVDepth achieves superior performance, generating geometrically accurate and temporally consistent depth sequences. Code and data will be released at https:// github.com/ChuanxinSong/PVDepth.

</details>


### [69] [InnerLogic-Surg: An Open Surgical Foundation Model via Continual Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07883)
*Kun Yuan,Hao Ding,Yiqing Shen,Gasper Podobnik,Benjamin Killeen,Tito Porras,Axel Krieger,Mathias Unberath*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 InnerLogic-Surg 手术视觉编码器家族（21M–300M），通过在海量手术图像上持续预训练 DINOv3 编码器，在 20 项手术任务上取得最佳线性探测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术视觉系统多依赖自然图像预训练编码器或在小规模数据上从头训练的专用模型，缺少大规模手术域预训练的通用骨干网络。

Method: 从 11,965 段网络来源手术视频（约 2,900 小时、15+ 术式）中构建数百万手术图像，对基于 Transformer 的图像编码器进行持续预训练，沿用 DINOv3 预训练流程以保留表征能力，并引入可学习特征上采样模块，以低 token 成本实现高分辨率密集预测。

Result: 在覆盖工作流、器械与解剖识别、分割、检测、单目深度的基准上，同架构下最大模型在全部 20 项手术任务的线性探测中取得最佳性能。

Conclusion: 手术域持续预训练可产生跨术式、跨解剖区域、跨任务类型可迁移的表征，为替代传统术式专用表征学习提供了可扩展方案。

Abstract: Vision foundation models are the backbone of modern surgical image analysis, yet most surgical systems still rely on encoders pretrained on natural images or on specialist models trained from scratch on comparatively small datasets. Pretraining encoders on large amounts of surgery-specific data has the potential to generally enhance the performance of surgical image analysis methods simply by providing stronger backbones. Here we present InnerLogic-Surg, an open family of surgical vision encoders (21M--300M parameters) obtained by continually pretraining a transformer-based image encoder on millions of surgical images curated from 11,965 internet-sourced surgical videos spanning ~2,900 hours and more than fifteen procedure types. Our training recipe inherits DINOv3's pretraining stage to preserve representation ability after surgical adaptation, and additionally applies a learned feature-upsampling module for high-resolution dense prediction at low token cost. Across a benchmark covering workflow, instrument and anatomy recognition, segmentation, detection, and monocular depth, under the same architecture, the largest InnerLogic-Surg model achieves the best linear-probe performance in all 20 surgical tasks. We demonstrate that surgical continual pretraining yields transferable representations that generalize across procedures, anatomical regions, and task types, showing our surgical image encoders as a promising and scalable alternative to the procedure-specific representation learning approaches that have traditionally dominated surgical computer vision.

</details>


### [70] [Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07900)
*Takuhiro Kaneko*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出将Structure from Collision (SfC)重构为"假设空间推理"：用显式结构假设表示隐藏空腔，全局阶段用无梯度的前向MPM仿真搜索假设，局部阶段用可微MPM梯度优化精化，在SfC基准上优于基于密度的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物体内部隐藏空腔在静态可见表面上无任何直接痕迹，只能通过碰撞引起的形变间接推断。基于密度表示的SfC基线存在两难：表面匹配梯度不直接指向空腔位置，而空腔对应材料缺失，密度梯度在空洞内或附近微弱甚至无信息，导致直接密度优化困难。

Method: 将SfC重构为假设空间推理，把隐藏空腔表示为显式结构假设，其变量编码结构先验/假设而非隐式密度更新。两阶段：1) 全局阶段，在假设空间上进行无梯度优化，仅用前向MPM仿真评估候选假设；2) 局部阶段，将选中假设表示为拉格朗日粒子系统，利用可微MPM仿真做基于梯度的精化。

Result: 在SfC基准上，隐藏结构重建与未来预测均优于基于密度的SfC基线；并通过内部拓扑压力测试与鲁棒性分析刻画了方法的适用范围与局限性。

Conclusion: 以显式结构假设替代隐式密度表示可有效规避空腔"材料缺失"带来的梯度贫乏问题，配合前向搜索+可微精化的两阶段策略实现隐藏内部结构恢复，但方法仍受假设空间设计与拓扑复杂度限制。

Abstract: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.

</details>


### [71] [XM4D: 4D Reconstruction through Certifiable Geometric Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07902)
*Haoyu Han,Jack Benarroch Jedlicki,Jiahui Lei,Heng Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: XM4D将4D重建拆分为相机运动估计与非刚性形变两阶段，各自建模为仅含旋转变量的QCQP，通过SDP松弛给出可验证的全局最优性证书，并用GPU加速的Burer-Monteiro黎曼优化求解，再以恢复几何初始化动态高斯泼溅进行光度细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合估计相机运动、场景几何与非刚性形变是高度非凸优化问题，全局最优性难以保证；现有4D重建方法在精度、效率与可扩展性上存在不足。

Method: 解耦相机运动与形变估计。相机阶段：用基础深度模型将静态点轨迹提升为3D，构建联合估计位姿、深度尺度与静态路标的scaled bundle adjustment，解析消去平移与路标，约化为旋转变量的QCQP。形变阶段：用嵌入形变图（EDG）表示动态运动，其跟踪、刚性与时序正则目标同样约化为仅旋转的QCQP。两问题均取SDP松弛，用基于黎曼优化的GPU加速Burer-Monteiro求解器高效求解；所得几何初始化动态高斯泼溅做光度精修。

Result: 在七个基准上实验：静态与动态场景相机运动估计准确；优化高效，可扩展至数千帧；新视角渲染质量达到state-of-the-art。

Conclusion: 通过可验证全局最优的几何优化与解耦建模，XM4D在精度、效率与规模化上取得兼顾，并可与动态高斯泼溅互补形成完整4D重建流程。

Abstract: Accurate 4D reconstruction remains challenging: jointly estimating camera motion, scene geometry, and non-rigid deformation entails highly nonconvex optimization, making global optimality difficult to guarantee. We present XM4D, a framework for accurate and efficient 4D reconstruction built upon certifiably globally optimal geometric optimization. By separating the estimation of camera motion from non-rigid deformation, we formulate both stages as structured quadratically constrained quadratic programs (QCQP) that admit semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations and verifiable global optimality certificates. For camera motion estimation, we lift static point tracks into 3D using foundational depth prediction models and formulate a scaled bundle adjustment problem that jointly estimates camera poses, depth scales, and static landmarks. By analytically eliminating translations and landmarks, we reduce the problem to a QCQP over scaled rotations. For non-rigid reconstruction, we represent dynamic motion using an embedded deformation graph (EDG) and show that its tracking, rigidity, and temporal regularization objectives similarly reduce to a rotation-only QCQP. Both problems admit SDP relaxations that we solve efficiently with a GPU-accelerated Burer-Monteiro solver based on Riemannian optimization. The recovered geometry further initializes dynamic Gaussian splatting for photometric refinement. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate accurate camera motion estimation on both static and dynamic scenes, efficient optimization that scales to thousands of frames, and state-of-the-art novel-view rendering quality.

</details>


### [72] [StitchEdit: Stitching Depth Priors into Image Editors via Per-Layer Gradient Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07922)
*Qin Guo,Dan Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StitchEdit通过逐层梯度探测发现扩散骨干中"编辑"与"深度"目标在浅层兼容、深层冲突，据此设计深度去噪适配器+探测引导的逐层学习率调度，在几何依赖类编辑任务上同时提升感知质量与几何保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本引导的图像编辑在涉及空间变换、遮挡操作、视角变化等依赖3D场景结构的编辑上表现不佳。Marigold等工作表明预训练扩散骨干已蕴含强几何先验（可用于深度估计），但如何将这些先验重定向到编辑任务仍未解决。

Method: 1) 逐层梯度探测：分析编辑目标与深度目标在Transformer各层的一致性/冲突关系；2) 轻量级深度去噪适配器激活骨干的几何能力；3) 探测引导的逐层学习率调度，选择性地微调适配器——在有益层保留深度知识，在冲突层剪除。

Result: 在提出的StitchEditBench（含150个几何依赖编辑样本，覆盖空间变换、遮挡操作、视角变化三类）上，StitchEdit在感知质量与几何保真度两方面均持续优于基于指令的基线和深度条件基线。

Conclusion: 编辑与深度目标的分层冲突是朴素深度条件编辑失效的根因；通过适配器激活+探测引导的分层微调，可将骨干的几何先验有效迁移至空间编辑，验证了先验重定向的可行性与必要性。

Abstract: Text-guided image editing with diffusion models struggles with spatial edits (e.g. manipulating objects, changing viewpoints, manipulating occlusions) that depend on the 3D structure understanding of a scene. Marigold and follow-up work demonstrate that a pretrained diffusion backbone already harbors strong geometric priors that can be activated for depth estimation, yet how to redirect these priors toward editing remains unresolved. Through per-layer gradient probing, we discover that the editing and depth objectives are compatible in early transformer layers but actively conflict in late layers, explaining why naive depth-conditioned editing either ignores geometry or degrades visual quality. We present StitchEdit, which first activates the backbone's geometric capability via a lightweight depth-denoising adapter, then selectively fine-tunes this adapter for editing using a probe-guided per-layer learning rate schedule that preserves depth knowledge where it helps and prunes it where it conflicts. On the proposed StitchEditBench, a benchmark of 150 geometry-dependent edits spanning spatial transformation, occlusion manipulation, and viewpoint change, StitchEdit consistently surpasses both instruction-based and depth-conditioned baselines on perceptual quality and geometric fidelity.

</details>


### [73] [Towards Scalable Diagnostic-Driven Whole-Slide Image Retrieval for Pathology Archives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07935)
*Jingsong Liu,Youssef Wally Han Li,Weiwei Zhou,Jing Dai,Elisabeth Wetzer,Peter J. Schüffler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CLEAR-WSI——基于定长嵌入的全切片图像自动检索框架，摆脱手工索引与预设采样，支持标签引导的候选重排与在线扩充记忆库，在四个检索任务上均提升 Precision@5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字病理 WSI 档案快速扩张，但元数据不一致或缺失，难以高效导航；现有基于内容的检索系统依赖手工索引流程与预定义采样策略，限制了可扩展性与泛化能力。

Method: CLEAR-WSI（Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images）：将整张 WSI 编码为固定长度嵌入；检索时依据设置使用预测诊断标签或真实标签对候选进行重排（诊断驱动）；新处理病例增量写入不断扩大的记忆库，实现检索库随时间增长。

Result: 在含 2 个公开数据集与 1 个私有临床数据集、共四个检索任务的基准上，Precision@5 相对最强基线分别提升：CAMELYON16 +3.10、BRACS-1 +2.75、BRACS-2 +1.95、X-HER2 +3.75；消融与延迟实验验证各组件贡献及可扩展部署潜力。

Conclusion: 定长嵌入加标签驱动重排与增量记忆库可构建可扩展、面向诊断的 WSI 检索系统，兼顾性能与部署效率。

Abstract: The growing adoption of digital pathology has rapidly expanded collections of hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images, yet efficient navigation through these archives remains challenging, as metadata is often inconsistent or unavailable. Content-based image retrieval addresses this challenge by identifying similar cases directly from visual representations instead of manual annotations or metadata. Existing retrieval systems have demonstrated promising performance but largely rely on handcrafted indexing pipelines and predefined sampling strategies, constraining scalability and generalization. Here, we present CLEAR-WSI (Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images) as a scalable, diagnostic-driven slide-retrieval framework, validated on both public and clinical data. Using a fixed-length slide embedding, CLEAR-WSI refines retrieved candidates with either a predicted diagnostic label or the ground-truth label, depending on the retrieval setting. Newly processed cases are subsequently added to the expanding memory bank, allowing the retrieval archive to grow over time. On a comprehensive benchmark consisting of two public and one private clinical datasets representing four retrieval tasks, CLEAR-WSI improves Precision@5 over the strongest evaluated baseline, with gains on CAMELYON16 (3.10), BRACS-1 (2.75), BRACS-2 (1.95), and X-HER2 (3.75). Additional ablation and latency studies further examine the contribution of each component and highlight its potential for scalable deployment.

</details>


### [74] [WAM-Sim0.1: World Anchored Memory Meets Online RL for Consistent and Realistic Driving Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07939)
*Jiahao Cui,Jiaye Li,Wenhao Zhang,Yaoyi Li,Shan Luan,Quanhui Tang,Jianhua Han,Lin Cheng,Hang Xu,Siyu Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WAM-Sim 是一个以持久层级记忆为锚、并用在线 flow-matching RL 优化的驾驶世界模型，用于消除自回归长时 rollout 中的结构漂移、身份漂移与质量衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归驾驶世界模型因条件信号是瞬态的、缺乏持久状态，在长时 rollout 中会系统性地出现结构漂移、身份漂移与质量衰减。

Method: 提出 WAM-Sim：以持久层级记忆为锚，跨三个时间与语义尺度组织上下文——(1) 位姿对齐的结构 token 编码持久道路拓扑；(2) 只读场景 token 提供地理定位的背景外观；(3) 一次写入的实例 token 在遮挡与 chunk 边界间保持交通参与者身份。并引入在线后训练框架，以 flow-matching RL 在自生成 rollout 上优化，奖励由层级对齐的视觉奖励与 VLM 物理评判器共同引导。

Result: nuScenes 上生成保真度 FID=3.47、FVD=25.72，下游感知 24.16 mAP、道路 mIoU 71.23；在自采集数据的分钟级 rollout 中显著缓解结构与身份漂移，保持高场景相似度与主体身份一致性。不变记忆经验上将策略优化约束在锚定上下文内，抑制语义崩塌与奖励黑客；在线 RL 系统性地强化物理常识与细粒度视觉保真。

Conclusion: 持久层级记忆锚定 + 在线 flow-matching RL 后训练是缓解自回归世界模型长时漂移的有效范式，兼顾视觉保真、物理合理性与长程一致性。

Abstract: Autoregressive driving world models systematically suffer from structural drift, identity drift, and quality decay over long rollout horizons due to transient conditioning signals that lack persistent state. We present WAM-Sim, a driving world model anchored by a persistent hierarchical memory and optimized via online flow-matching RL. WAM-Sim structures persistent context across three temporal and semantic scales: pose-aligned structural tokens encoding persistent road topology, read-only scene tokens supplying geolocated background appearance, and write-once instance tokens preserving individual traffic participant identities across occlusions and chunk boundaries. To restore visual sharpness and physical plausibility degraded by multi-scale conditioning, we introduce an online post-training framework that optimizes self-generated rollouts via flow-matching RL guided by hierarchy-aligned visual rewards and a vision-language model physical judge. The invariant memory empirically confines policy optimization within the anchored context, helping suppress semantic collapse and reward hacking, while online RL systematically enforces physical commonsense and fine-grained visual fidelity. On the nuScenes benchmark, WAM-Sim achieves a superior generation fidelity (FID=3.47, FVD=25.72) and strong downstream perception performance (24.16 mAP, 71.23 road mIoU). On minute-scale rollouts of self-collected data, WAM-Sim substantially mitigates structural and identity drift, preserving high scene similarity and subject identity coherence across extended horizons. Project page: https://fudan-generative-vision.github.io/WAM-Sim.

</details>


### [75] [IDPrior: Decoupling Identity Generation from Facial Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07941)
*Fadi Boutros,Meriç Demirörs,Darian Tomašević,Vitomir Štruc,Naser Damer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IDPrior 提出两阶段框架，将身份生成与图像合成解耦：先在预训练人脸识别模型的嵌入空间学习扩散先验以建模身份分布并采样新身份嵌入，再以其条件化预训练的身份条件扩散模型合成同身份多图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模带身份标注的人脸数据集对现代人脸识别模型训练至关重要，但采集与标注成本高，并带来隐私与伦理问题。现有合成人脸方法通常从预定义类别标签、无条件图像生成或预定义潜变量采样策略中派生身份，未显式建模人脸身份的潜在分布。

Method: IDPrior 为两阶段框架：（1）在预训练人脸识别模型的身份嵌入空间中学习扩散先验，显式建模身份分布并生成新颖身份嵌入；（2）将生成的身份嵌入作为条件输入预训练的身份条件扩散模型，合成同一身份的多样图像。该模块化设计保证与现有及未来身份条件扩散模型的兼容性。

Result: 实验表明，IDPrior 生成的身份具有多样性与良好可分性，且与真实身份分布更接近；基于 IDPrior 生成身份所构建数据集训练的人脸识别模型，在多个 face verification 基准上相较现有合成数据方法取得相当或更优的性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模身份嵌入分布并将身份生成与图像合成解耦，是一种可扩展且具兼容性的合成人脸数据生成范式，可有效替代真实标注数据用于人脸识别训练。代码与生成数据集已公开。

Abstract: Large-scale identity-labeled face datasets are essential for training modern face recognition models, yet collecting and annotating such data is costly and raises privacy and ethical concerns. Existing synthetic face generation methods typically derive identities from predefined class labels, unconditional image generation, or predefined latent sampling strategies, without explicitly modeling the underlying distribution of facial identities. In this paper, we propose IDPrior, a two-stage framework that decouples identity generation from image synthesis. We first learn a diffusion prior in the embedding space of a pretrained face recognition model to model the distribution of facial identities and generate novel identity embeddings. These embeddings are then used to condition a pretrained identity-conditioned diffusion model (DM), enabling the synthesis of multiple images of the same identity. This modular design provides a scalable approach to identity generation while remaining compatible with existing and future identity-conditioned DMs. Experiments indicate that IDPrior generates diverse and well-separated identities while maintaining a closer correspondence to the distribution of authentic identities. Face recognition models trained on datasets generated using IDPrior-generated identities achieve competitive or improved performance compared with existing synthetic-data-based methods across multiple face verification benchmarks. Code and generated datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/fdbtrs/IDperturb.

</details>


### [76] [Rotation Is Token-Blind: A Structural Criterion for Post-Training Quantization of Feed-Forward Geometry Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07955)
*Huanfei He,Bohao Zhang,Jiaxin Zhang,Wei Sui,John See,Zeyd Boukhers,Cong Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结构感知的训练后量化框架 QMapAnything，用于前馈式三维重建 Transformer 的部署；将旋转与平滑视为"token-blind 重参数化群"并证明其只带来共模增益，引入统计量 Γ 判定是否需要针对特殊 token 的差异化偏置校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈 3D 模型用 Transformer 一次预测相机位姿、深度与结构，避免迭代式多视图优化，但长序列与深层注意力带来高昂计算与内存开销，需要 PTQ 部署。现有 PTQ 主要靠平滑或正交旋转抑制通道级离群值，难以处理 Geometry Transformer 中异构 token 类型共享同一激活量化网格的问题：少数特殊 token 对全局输出具有高杠杆作用，且仅由部分 block 更新，token 无关变换只能降低整体量化误差，无法消除不同 token 类型间的差异化退化。

Method: 1) 将保浮点的旋转与平滑统一刻画为 token-blind 重参数化群，并证明其收益为共模的，不改变 token 间相对 SNR；2) 定义统计量 Γ，融合特殊 token 的量化劣势与输出杠杆，用于预测在旋转之外是否还需差异化偏置校正；3) 据此构建结构感知 PTQ 流程，对特殊 token 施加针对性校正。

Result: 几何基准实验显示 W4A8 性能与全精度接近；W8A8 下峰值内存较 FP32 降低 2.2–3.1 倍，真实硬件上最高获得 3.1 倍加速。

Conclusion: 结果表明显式建模 token 异构性可弥补 token 无关变换的局限，为资源受限边缘设备上部署前馈 3D 重建模型提供了有理论依据且高效的途径。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D models use Transformers to predict camera poses, depth, and structure in one pass, avoiding iterative multi-view optimization. Long sequences and deep attention incur high compute and memory costs, motivating Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) for deployment. Existing PTQ methods mainly suppress channel-wise outliers by smoothing or orthogonal rotation. Geometry Transformers introduce a different challenge: heterogeneous token types share one activation quantization grid. A few special tokens may exert high leverage over global outputs and be updated by only a subset of blocks. Token-blind transforms, which apply the same transformation to every token, reduce overall quantization error but cannot remove differentiated degradation across token types. We propose QMapAnything, a structure-aware PTQ framework. We cast floating-point-preserving rotation and smoothing as a token-blind reparameterization group, and prove that they yield common-mode gains while leaving relative token SNR unchanged. We introduce a statistic $Γ$ that combines a special token's quantization disadvantage and output leverage to predict whether differentiated bias correction is needed beyond rotation. Experiments on geometric benchmarks show that W4A8 closely matches full-precision performance. Under W8A8, peak memory falls by $2.2$--$3.1\times$ versus FP32, with up to $3.1\times$ speedup on real hardware. These results provide a principled and efficient approach to deploying feed-forward 3D reconstruction models in resource-constrained edges.

</details>


### [77] [Bri3D: Bridging the Object-Scene Gap in Single-Image 3D Generation via Scene-Anchor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07961)
*Hongye Hou,Shuai Zhang,Hongjie Li,Zhuoxiao Li,Haiping Wang,Yuan Liu,Wufan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Bri3D 框架，通过实例感知体素场景锚桥接场景级结构推理与物体级生成先验，从单张图像生成高质量组合式 3D 场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单张图像生成组合式3D场景需同时恢复精细物体几何与一致的空间布局。现有 object-to-scene 方法（如 SAM3D、MIDI）依赖图像上下文推理或实例间建模，但缺少场景级监督，难以协调物体；直接将物体中心生成器扩展到整场景会导致几何退化，且无法保持实例的尺度、朝向与位姿。

Method: Bri3D 采用由粗到细范式：先预测一个颜色编码的场景脚手架（scene scaffold），编码粗粒度物体几何与空间布局；将每个实例提取为场景锚，并精炼为保持位姿、与先验兼容的体素支撑（voxel support）；随后在锚定义的局部空间参考下，驱动冻结的物体生成器合成精细纹理几何。该设计将场景组织与物体级细节合成解耦，使场景级训练专注于空间组织与锚精炼，同时复用预训练物体先验。

Result: 实验显示在场景布局、物体几何、视觉质量与泛化能力上均有提升；Bri3D 能高效预测场景布局，整体场景生成速度快于 SceneGen 与 SAM3D。

Conclusion: 以实例感知体素场景锚为桥梁，Bri3D 有效结合场景级结构推理与物体级生成先验，实现高效、保位姿且具泛化性的单图组合式3D场景生成。

Abstract: Generating compositional 3D scenes from a single image requires recovering detailed object geometry and coherent spatial arrangements. Existing object-to-scene methods, including SAM3D and MIDI, extend object generation through image-context reasoning or inter-instance modeling. Coordinating objects remains challenging with limited scene-level supervision. Directly extending object-centric generators to entire scenes can degrade geometry and fail to preserve instance scale, orientation, and pose. We propose Bri3D, a framework bridging scene-level structural reasoning and object-level generative priors through instance-aware voxel scene anchors. Bri3D predicts a color-coded scene scaffold encoding coarse object geometry and spatial arrangements. Each instance is extracted as a scene anchor and refined into a pose-preserving, prior-compatible voxel support, enabling a frozen object generator to synthesize detailed textured geometry in the anchor-defined spatial reference. This coarse-to-fine design separates scene organization from object-scale detail synthesis, focusing scene-level training on spatial organization and anchor refinement while reusing pretrained object priors. Experiments demonstrate improvements in scene layout, object geometry, visual quality, and generalization. Bri3D predicts scene layouts efficiently; full scene generation is faster than SceneGen and SAM3D.

</details>


### [78] [Reviving the Discarded High-Resolution Feature for Transformer-Based Tiny Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07994)
*Zehao Wang,Si Wu,Guiping Cao,Xin Li,Yaowei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReDHF框架通过复活被丢弃的最高分辨率特征并结合跨尺度可变形融合、椭圆引导浅层监督与全尺度查询交互，显著提升类DETR检测器的小目标检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微小目标仅占几个像素，细粒度细节在特征下采样中易丢失；最高分辨率特征虽保留丰富局部细节，但类DETR检测器因计算开销大而丢弃它，直接引入又会带来密集背景噪声。

Method: 三个协同组件：(1) 跨尺度可变形融合CSDF，构建语义增强的最高分辨率特征并以适中代价将细粒度细节注入浅层特征；(2) 椭圆引导浅层监督EGSS，以几何自适应辅助监督引导增强特征学习更可靠的分类与定位先验；(3) 全尺度查询交互FSQI，使解码器查询同时访问低层细节与高层语义，聚合更丰富线索。

Result: 在多种DETR变体与多个基线上稳定提升，达到所评估基准的最优性能；最佳变体较基线在AI-TOD-v2提升+1.4 AP、VisDrone提升+1.6 AP、SODA-D提升+1.5 AP，在微小与小型目标上增益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 复活被丢弃的高分辨率特征是一条有效且代价可控的小目标检测路径，三项组件互补，可即插即用于类DETR检测器并取得一致的性能改进。

Abstract: Tiny object detection remains challenging because tiny instances occupy only a few pixels, and their fine-grained details are easily lost during feature downsampling. Although the highest-resolution feature preserves rich local details for tiny objects, DETR-like detectors often discard it due to its large computational cost, while directly reintroducing this feature also brings dense background noise. To address this problem, we propose ReDHF, a novel framework that Revives the Discarded High-resolution Feature for tiny object detection. ReDHF has three cooperative components. Cross-Scale Deformable Fusion (CSDF) first constructs a semantically enhanced highest-resolution feature and injects its fine-grained details into the shallow feature under a moderate cost. Ellipse-Guided Shallow Supervision (EGSS) then guides the enhanced feature to learn more reliable classification and localization priors by applying geometry-adaptive auxiliary supervision. Full-Scale Query Interaction (FSQI) further enables decoder queries to access both low-level details and high-level semantic information, allowing them to aggregate richer cues for tiny objects. Extensive experiments show that ReDHF consistently improves multiple baselines across different DETR variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the evaluated benchmarks. The best ReDHF variants surpass their baselines by +1.4 AP on AI-TOD-v2, +1.6 AP on VisDrone, and +1.5 AP on SODA-D, with especially notable gains on tiny and small objects.

</details>


### [79] [When GeoFMs Meet VHR: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Very High Resolution Earth Observation Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08003)
*Kshitij Raj Sharma,Pierre Adorni,Minh-Tan Pham,Dirk Tiede,Sébastien Lefèvre*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VHR-Bench基准（10个≥1.5m GSD数据集、5类任务、8个应用领域），系统评测12个编码器在冻结骨干、两种标签比例下的迁移表现，并据此对DINOv3 ViT-L进行VHR自监督续训，实现"先泛化再专门化"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地理空间基础模型多在Sentinel-1/2与Landsat的10m级GSD上预训练，而许多应用依赖可分辨单体建筑、道路的高分辨率（VHR）影像，何种预训练范式能有效迁移到该尺度尚不清楚，也缺乏统一评测基准。

Method: 构建VHR-Bench：10个数据集、GSD≤1.5m、覆盖5类任务族、8个应用领域、卫星与航空双平台。评测三类预训练层级的12个编码器，统一采用冻结骨干，并在两种训练数据比例下比较。基于评测结论，在102.4万块留出VHR瓦片上对DINOv3 ViT-L做自监督续训，下游协议保持不变。

Result: 自然图像大规模预训练与VHR专门预训练均能有效迁移且优势互补：标签稀缺时SkySense领先，全量标签时Web预训练的DINOv3 ViT-L略优，二者接近；仅用Sentinel尺度影像预训练的编码器在RGB输入下迁移最差。续训后的DINOv3 ViT-L在标签稀缺时较原发布骨干有明显提升，全量标签下有小幅提升，且推理参数与计算量不变。

Conclusion: 支持"先泛化再专门化"策略：已具备强泛化能力的广域自然图像预训练，可通过短程VHR续训进一步提升，同时保留其通用视觉特征，是面向VHR遥感任务的高效路径。

Abstract: Geospatial foundation models are a widely adopted starting point for remote sensing tasks. Most are pretrained on Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat imagery at a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 10m or coarser. Many applications instead rely on very high resolution (VHR) imagery, where individual buildings, roads, and amenities are resolved. We study which pretraining regimes transfer well to this scale. We introduce VHR-Bench, a benchmark suite of ten datasets at 1.5m GSD or finer spanning five task families, eight application domains, and both satellite and aerial platforms. We evaluate twelve encoders in three pretraining tiers with frozen backbones at two training-data fractions. We find that both pretraining on large natural-image collections and VHR-specific pretraining transfer effectively to VHR tasks, with complementary strengths. SkySense leads when labels are scarce; at the full label fraction the web-pretrained DINOv3 ViT-L edges ahead, with the two close together there. Encoders pretrained only on Sentinel-scale imagery transfer least well under RGB input. Guided by these complementary results, we continue the self-supervised pretraining of DINOv3 ViT-L on 1.02 million held-out VHR tiles and evaluate the resulting encoder without changing the downstream protocol. The continued model gives a clear improvement over the released backbone when labels are scarce and a modest one at the full fraction, at no increase in inference parameters or compute. These findings support a generalize-then-specialize strategy: already strong, broad natural-image pretraining can be further improved by a short VHR continuation stage while preserving its general visual features.

</details>


### [80] [Deformable Contact-Aware 3D Object Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08005)
*Songhe Wang,David Miller,Charles A. Kamhoua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DCAP 将语言引导的 3D 物体摆放从"预测刚性 6-DoF 位姿"重构为"下落至平衡"过程：先构建语义释放状态（落点、尺度、可变形部件），再由刚-柔耦合仿真器在重力与摩擦下求解稳定构型，实现语义意图与物理实现的解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言引导 3D 摆放方法通常直接预测刚性 6-DoF 位姿，忽略了室内摆放本质上受接触约束支配的物理事实，导致预测位姿悬浮、与支撑面互相穿透，或无法使软质表面发生形变。

Method: 提出 Deformable Contact-Aware Placement (DCAP) 框架：不再输出静态位姿，而是生成一个语义释放状态，显式指定下落位置、物体尺度以及可变形部件；随后交由刚-柔耦合（rigid-deformable）仿真器，在重力与摩擦作用下使物体自然落定至平衡态。该设计将语义意图与物理实现严格分离。

Result: 在包含 2,063 个 prompt-asset-scene 案例的基准上评测：常规摆放任务中，相比最强的纯刚性基线，VLM 物理与自然度评分提升 21.2 分、人类偏好提升 26.5 分，平均穿透深度降低 72.3%；相比仿真 rollout 基线，残余速度降低 72.1%。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明，物理准确的 3D 摆放需要将语义意图建模与物理实现作为两个严格分离的过程来处理；DCAP 的有效性验证了该范式的优越性。

Abstract: Current language-guided 3D object placement typically predicts a rigid 6-DoF pose, ignoring the physical reality that indoor placements are dictated by contact. Consequently, predicted poses often float, interpenetrate supports, or fail to deform soft surfaces. We propose Deformable Contact-Aware Placement (DCAP), a framework that reframes placement as a drop-to-equilibrium process. Rather than predicting a static pose, DCAP constructs a semantic release state that specifies the drop location, object scale, and deformable components, allowing a coupled rigid-deformable simulator to settle the object under gravity and friction. This explicitly separates semantic intent from physical realization. Evaluated on a benchmark of 2,063 prompt-asset-scene cases, DCAP significantly outperforms static baselines. On standard placements, it improves VLM Physics & Naturalness by 21.2 points and human preference by 26.5 points over the strongest raw rigid baseline, while reducing mean penetration depth by 72.3%. Compared to simulated rollout baselines, DCAP reduces residual speed by 72.1%. Ultimately, our results prove that physically accurate 3D placement requires modeling semantic intent and physical realization as strictly separate processes.

</details>


### [81] [NutriVisRAG: Multimodal Exemplar Grounding for Nutrient Estimation with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08054)
*Lubnaa Abdur Rahman,Ioannis Papathanail,Maria Panagiotou,Nefeli Dimitropoulou,Margret Harðardóttir,Elisabeth J. den Brok,Bastiaan E. de Galan,Stavroula Georgia Mougiakakou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NutriVisRAG：用视觉编码器检索相似且有营养标注的餐食图像作为多模态上下文示例，在推理时增强VLM营养估算，无需任务微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由生活场景下的膳食图像营养评估仍具挑战；现有基于检索的VLM方法多依赖文本化食物表示，尚未（据作者所知）研究直接以视觉相似的已标注餐食作为依据（grounding）。

Method: 提出检索增强生成框架NutriVisRAG：以视觉编码器检索相似餐食及其营养标注，作为多模态in-context exemplars供VLM在推理时进行营养估算，不做任务特定微调。评测覆盖4个数据集、4个VLM、3种检索编码器、2种提示策略（整餐/per-item），含胰岛素治疗糖尿病成人自由生活餐食，并以两位营养师标注作参考。

Result: 96种配置中56种降低主误差；整餐提示下改善更常见（35/48）对比逐项提示（21/48）。16个VLM–数据集组合中13个的最低NutriVisRAG误差低于最佳Vanilla误差。GPT-5.4-mini整餐提示下，各数据集最优检索编码器在四个数据集上均降低主误差，降幅1.7%–35.7%。

Conclusion: 以图像加标注构成的多模态示例作为依据可在推理阶段提升营养估算且无需任务特定微调，但收益依赖配置。

Abstract: Diet is a major determinant of health, yet accurate dietary assessment from free-living meal images remains challenging. Existing retrieval-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches to nutrient estimation typically rely on textual food representations, while, to our knowledge, direct grounding on visually similar annotated meals has not been investigated. We present NutriVisRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a vision encoder to retrieve similar meals with known nutritional annotations and provide them as multimodal in-context exemplars for VLM nutrient estimation at inference time, without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate NutriVisRAG across four datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes, where carbohydrate estimates are compared against two dietitians' annotations. Across all 96 configurations (4 datasets x 4 VLMs x 3 retrieval encoders x 2 prompting strategies), NutriVisRAG reduced the primary estimation error in 56, with improvements more frequent under whole-meal (35/48) than per-item prompting (21/48). Across the evaluated configurations, the lowest NutriVisRAG error was below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM--dataset pairs. For GPT-5.4-mini, under whole-meal prompting, the best-performing retrieval encoder for each dataset reduced the primary error on all four datasets relative to Vanilla, with reductions of 1.7--35.7%. Overall, our results show that grounding in multimodal exemplars comprising images and respective annotations can improve nutrient estimation at inference time without task-specific fine-tuning, although the benefits remain configuration-dependent.

</details>


### [82] [Spatiotemporal Dynamics-Aware Industrial Anomaly Detection and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08080)
*S-Wei Chen,Siangyu Yang,Yi-Chen Jan,Chun-Yi Lee,Shao-Yuan Lo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MUSTARD框架，为多模态大模型注入细粒度时空动态感知能力，首次实现基于动态的工业异常检测与推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测（IAD）研究多依赖静态视觉模式，而真实制造场景中许多异常是运动/动态层面的（如不规则运动），仅凭静态线索无法感知；即使是近期的MLLM方法也因时序建模能力有限而失效。

Method: 构建MUSTARD（MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection）框架：引入光流引导的关键帧选择与增强模态，通过局部运动模式与全局动态演化捕获关键运动不规则性；采用基于正常模式的推理流程，仅需少量正常参考样本作为检测基准，无需模型更新。

Result: 实验表明其在检测时空异常方面性能优越，并能给出合理解释；作为首个面向动态IAD的MLLM框架，具备跨产品高效适配与高决策可解释性。

Conclusion: 将细粒度时空动态感知引入MLLM可有效解决动态型工业缺陷检测，且无需微调即可适配多类产品，兼顾性能与可解释性。

Abstract: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) is a long-established problem that aims to detect defects in industrial products during manufacturing for quality control. Most existing studies focus on static visual patterns as the basis for detection. However, in real manufacturing environments, many anomalies are dynamics-based, such as irregular movements that cannot be perceived from static cues alone. We observe that even recent Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based approaches fall short in identifying such dynamic anomalies due to limited temporal modeling capability. To address this, we introduce MUSTARD: MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a framework that equips MLLMs with fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamics awareness for detecting and reasoning about dynamics-based defects. MUSTARD introduces optical-flow-guided keyframe selection and augmented modalities to capture critical motion irregularities through local motion patterns and global dynamic evolution. Its normal pattern-based reasoning pipeline requires only a few normal reference samples as the detection basis, avoiding any model updates. This enables efficient adaptation across various products and provides high decision interpretability. MUSTARD is the first MLLM-based framework for dynamics-based IAD. Experiments demonstrate its superior performance in detecting spatiotemporal anomalies and providing plausible explanations. The code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [83] [ATHAAR: A Medieval Scientific Arabic Manuscript Dataset for Handwritten Text Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08091)
*Ismail El Jamiy,Khadija Msalek,Guillaume Loizelet,Farah Benamara,Nabil Hathout*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个面向科学类阿拉伯语手稿抄录的标注准则（受文本校勘学启发），并发布新数据集ATHAAR，实验揭示当前VLM在古代科学文本上的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中世纪阿拉伯语科学手稿因连体字形、变动的变音符号以及训练数据匮乏，对现有视觉语言模型（VLM）仍是难题；缺少针对该类文本的标注规范与数据资源。

Method: 借鉴文本校勘学（textual criticism）制定首个科学阿拉伯语手稿转录标注准则；据此人工标注构建ATHAAR数据集，涵盖同一文本的不同见证本、书法风格及内容（含数字）；基于先进VLM设计跨书写体、跨章节、跨论著的迁移实验。

Result: 实验显示现有VLM在跨书写体、章节与论著迁移中表现受限，难以应对古代科学文本的特殊性。

Conclusion: ATHAAR与配套准则填补了科学阿拉伯语手稿资源空白；当前系统仍不足以胜任此类文本，需进一步研究。

Abstract: Despite recent progress in handwritten text recognition, medieval Arabic scientific manuscripts remain an open challenge for current vision-language models (VLMs) due to cursive ligatures, variable diacritization, and more importantly the lack of training data. This paper aims to address this gap, by proposing the first annotation guidelines dedicated to the transcription of scientific Arabic manuscripts inspired by textual criticism, a well-established approach to historical text editing. We then propose, ATHAAR, a new dataset manually annotated following this guideline. Unlike previous resources in the field, ATHAAR varies both witnesses of the same text, calligraphic styles, and content to deal with texts but also numerals. Relying on state-of-the-art VLMs, we finally design a set of experiments to study models transfer across scripts, chapters, and treatises. Our findings highlight the limitations of current systems when faced with the specificities of ancient scientific texts.

</details>


### [84] [TerraMesh-Masks: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation for Earth Observation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08081)
*Benedikt Blumenstiel,Hugues Devimeux,Johannes Jakubik,Konrad Schindler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EO首个大规模开放词汇分割数据集TerraMesh-Masks（1600万掩码/900万多模态样本+523样本专家评测集），并构建开放词汇版TerraMind，IoU达35.18%，远超DINOv3.txt（16.29%）与SAM-3（11.33%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放词汇分割（OVS）方法在自然图像上表现良好，但因语义、尺度、传感模态与地理上下文差异，迁移到对地观测（EO）数据时性能显著下降；且EO领域缺乏大规模的OVS专用数据集与基准。

Method: 构建TerraMesh-Masks：1600万二值掩码，与900万TerraMesh多模态样本对齐，语义标注源自OpenStreetMap与Overture；另设523样本、200+类别的专家审核评测集。基于TerraMind构建开放词汇版本作为基线模型。

Result: 开放词汇版TerraMind取得35.18% IoU，显著优于通用SOTA模型：DINOv3.txt为16.29%，SAM-3为11.33%。

Conclusion: TerraMesh-Masks可有效提升EO开放词汇分割性能，填补该领域数据集与基准空白，数据集已以宽松许可在Hugging Face公开。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) enables models to segment a variety of concepts specified in natural language, removing the need for fixed label sets and fine-tuning. While recent OVS approaches have shown strong performance on natural images, they transfer poorly to Earth observation (EO) data due to differing semantics, scales, sensing modality, and geographic context. To date, large-scale EO-specific datasets and benchmarks for OVS remain scarce. We, therefore, introduce TerraMesh-Masks, a large-scale open-vocabulary segmentation dataset for EO, comprising 16 million binary masks aligned with nine million multimodal TerraMesh samples and annotated using OpenStreetMap and Overture-derived semantics. In addition, we provide an expert-reviewed evaluation set of 523 samples covering over 200 classes to enable robust evaluation. To demonstrate the impact of TerraMesh-Masks, we build an open-vocabulary version of TerraMind. Our results demonstrate significantly improved performance over general-purpose state-of-the-art models reaching 35.18% IoU versus 16.29% for DINOv3.txt and 11.33% for SAM-3. We release the dataset publicly under a permissive license at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-esa-geospatial/TerraMesh-Masks.

</details>


### [85] [National-scale mapping of tree species composition in Switzerland from high-resolution aerial imagery and multimodal data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08095)
*Yixin Zhou,Luca Ferrari,Verena C. Griess,Nataliia Rehush,Konrad Schindler,Mirela Beloiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在瑞士全域30 m分辨率下，绘制10个主要树种及"其他"类别的断面积占比图，突破传统单优势树种制图局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树种组成决定森林生产力及对干旱、风倒、虫害等气候干扰的响应，但多数国家森林图将每个像元赋为单一优势树种，无法表达伴生树种占比，难以支撑混交林管理与气候适应规划。

Method: 融合0.1 m航空RGB影像、机载激光扫描（ALS）、年度AlphaEarth卫星嵌入及气候变量的深度学习模型，以3,992个瑞士国家森林调查（NFI）样地的断面积观测为训练标签，逐像元回归11个树种/类别的断面积份额。

Result: 空间交叉验证宏平均R²=0.485；独立森林保护区数据集上，30 m像元宏平均R²=0.552、样地尺度0.733，优势类判别准确率像元73.2%、样地81.1%。制图揭示枫树与白蜡作为广泛分布的次要组分，并复现从低地阔叶林经云杉至树线附近落叶松与瑞士岩松的海拔序列。

Conclusion: 通过解析30 m像元内部的树种混合结构，该图补充了样地调查统计，提供空间连续信息，可服务森林监测、混交林经营与瑞士气候适应规划。

Abstract: Tree-species composition shapes forest productivity and how forests respond to climate disturbances such as drought, windthrow and insect outbreaks. Yet most national forest maps assign each pixel a single dominant species and cannot show the share of accompanying species. We mapped the basal-area shares of ten main tree species and a residual Other class across Switzerland at 30 m resolution. A deep-learning model combining 0.1 m aerial RGB imagery, airborne laser scanning (ALS), annual AlphaEarth satellite embeddings, and climate variables was trained on basal-area observations from 3,992 Swiss National Forest Inventory (NFI) sites. In spatial cross-validation, the model reached a macro-$R^2$ of 0.485 across the 11 classes. On an independent forest-reserve dataset, the map reached a macro-$R^2$ of 0.552 for individual 30 m pixels and 0.733 for plots, and identified the dominant class in 73.2% of pixels and 81.1% of plots. The map shows maple and ash as widespread minor components that dominant-class maps omit. It also reproduces the elevational sequence from broadleaved lowland stands through spruce to larch and Arolla pine near the treeline. By resolving the species mixture within each 30 m pixel, the map complements field inventory statistics with spatially continuous information that can support forest monitoring, the management of mixed stands, and climate-adaptation planning across Switzerland.

</details>


### [86] [ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08216)
*Yufei Xue,Yushi Huang,Jiawei Shao,Pingcheng Dong,Yonghao Tan,Shiyao Li,Kwang-Ting Cheng,Jun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ProQuant：面向低比特MLLM的权值-激活量化感知训练框架，通过自重标注与渐进式块激活机制，在W4A8下显著缩小与全精度模型的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向边缘设备的小规模多模态大模型在低比特量化（如W4A8）下，PTQ性能严重退化，因此需要针对低比特MLLM设计QAT方案。

Method: 提出自重标注（SRL）方案对开源多模态数据集的回答重采样，以对齐微调与预训练数据分布；首次解耦多模态理解与语言建模能力，提出渐进式块激活（PBA）机制优先恢复MM理解能力，并引入视觉敏感因子τ识别MM关键层，进行权值-激活联合QAT。

Result: 在2B–8B参数规模的多模型、多基准实验中显著优于现有方法；W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct平均精度提升6.6%，仅约1%性能损失即可接近全精度水平。

Conclusion: ProQuant为低比特MLLM提供了有效的QAT框架，验证了解耦多模态理解与语言能力、以及视觉敏感层识别在量化恢复中的关键作用。

Abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vecτ$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/.

</details>


### [87] [Towards Practical 20 kbps Generative Video Compression via Adaptive Tokenization and Entropy Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08099)
*Jiancheng Zhao,Jixiang Luo,Haibin Huang,Chi Zhang,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种超低码率视频压缩方法，将预训练因果视频VAE改造为离散tokenizer，并联合优化小型自回归熵模型，实现感知质量与编码效率的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超低码率下感知重要细节易丢失；现有生成式视频压缩多为“先压缩后生成”范式，生成先验仅在重建阶段使用，且生成/重建表示未针对熵编码优化。

Method: 将MiniMax-H3的预训练因果视频VAE适配为离散视频tokenizer；设计小型自回归熵模型捕捉局部与全局token依赖，采用分组预测实现并行解码；用可微码率代理联合优化tokenizer与熵模型，使码率梯度引导token分配趋向低编码代价，同时保持重建质量。

Result: 在UVG、MCL-JCV、HEVC Class B上取得更优感知率失真性能，相对GLC-Video实现BD-LPIPS节省82.2%–87.5%、BD-DISTS节省78.3%–85.0%。

Conclusion: 压缩导向表示适配与端到端率代理联合优化可有效提升超低码率视频压缩的感知率失真效率。

Abstract: Video compression at ultra-low bitrates remains challenging due to the loss of perceptually important details under limited bit budgets. Recent generative video compression methods leverage pretrained video priors to improve perceptual quality and temporal coherence, but many follow a compress-then-generate paradigm, where generative priors are primarily exploited during reconstruction. Moreover, representations learned for generation and reconstruction are not inherently optimized for entropy coding.
  In this work, we propose \method, which adapts pretrained video representations into compression-oriented representations while preserving their reconstruction capability. Specifically, we adapt the pretrained causal video VAE of MiniMax-H3 into a discrete video tokenizer and develop a small autoregressive entropy model that captures local and global token dependencies, with grouped prediction for parallel decoding. To further improve coding efficiency, we jointly optimize the tokenizer and entropy model using a differentiable rate surrogate, allowing rate gradients to adapt token assignments toward lower coding costs while preserving reconstruction quality. Experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and HEVC Class B demonstrate superior perceptual rate--distortion performance, achieving BD-LPIPS savings of 82.2\%--87.5\% and BD-DISTS savings of 78.3\%--85.0\% relative to GLC-Video.

</details>


### [88] [ProtoGestalt: Interpretable Prototypes for Facial Phenotyping and Diagnosis of Rare Genetic Disorders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08125)
*Ranga Baminiwatte,Alexander Hustinx,Fabio Hellmann,Aaron J Masino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ProtoGestalt——一种基于原型的可解释框架，用于面部表型分析、罕见病筛查与综合征识别；通过学习到的视觉特征约束选择面部区域，使预测可由局部化、可加的证据解释，并在多种对照数据集与患病率条件下验证了筛查与鉴别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罕见遗传病种类繁多且临床特征重叠，诊断困难；面部形态虽可提供诊断线索，但现有诊断模型可解释性有限，且并非面向未确诊疾病的广谱筛查设计。

Method: 扩展原型学习（prototype learning）：约束学到的视觉特征以选择特定面部区域，使预测通过局部化且可加的原型证据加以解释；在多个对照数据集与不同患病率下评估综合征与未受累面部的区分能力，并评估对训练中出现过的综合征的诊断性能与综合征间鉴别能力。

Result: 学习到的原型表征在综合征与病例匹配对照图像间产生显著分离，且在对照比例升高时仍保持有用性能；框架亦能区分不同综合征。

Conclusion: 尽管已有较准确的罕见病面部分类专用模型，ProtoGestalt提供了可解释的替代方案，将预测与解剖学上有意义的面部区域关联，有望支持临床决策及表型—基因关联的发现。

Abstract: Rare genetic disorders are difficult to diagnose due to their diversity and overlapping clinical features. Facial morphology can provide diagnostic clues, yet most diagnostic models offer limited interpretability and are not designed to support broad screening for undiagnosed disease. We present ProtoGestalt, an interpretable prototype-based framework for facial phenotyping, rare-disease screening, and syndrome identification. The method extends prototype learning by constraining learned visual features to select facial regions, allowing predictions to be explained through localized and additive evidence. We assess ProtoGestalt's ability to distinguish syndromic from unaffected faces on multiple control datasets and class prevalence values. We further evaluate it's diagnostic performance on syndromes observed during training. The learned prototype-based representations provide significant separation between syndromic and case-matched control images and retain useful performance as the proportion of controls increases. The framework also demonstrates the ability to differentiate among syndromes. Although reasonably accurate specialized models for facial classification of rare disorders already exist, ProtoGestalt offers an interpretable alternative that links predictions to anatomically meaningful facial regions, potentially supporting clinical decision-making and the discovery of phenotype-gene associations.

</details>


### [89] [FreeOcc: Decoupling Ego-Motion for Efficient 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Continuous Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08128)
*Zeping Zhang,Zhuoya Zhao,Samy Metari,Robert Laganière*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FreeOcc，一个轻量级连续时间 4D 占用世界模型，通过显式 $SE(2)$ 几何解耦与不确定性感知混合机制，在仅 28.3M 参数下实现高效、高精度的运动预测与占用预测，并具备强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 4D 占用世界模型依赖重量级交叉注意力或深层递归来解耦自车运动与场景动态，计算开销大；而自车未来运动已由下游运动规划器提供，因此这部分建模努力高度冗余。

Method: 将显式 $SE(2)$ 几何解耦引入条件流匹配框架，通过数学方式剥离自车运动，得到纯动态特征空间；该空间支持无注意力时序融合，并使物理约束 ODE 仅在残差智能体运动学上求解。同时引入不确定性感知混合机制：将观测充分的体素路由至单趟解码器，ODE 求解器仅用于模糊、高不确定性区域。

Result: 模型仅 28.3M 参数（约为同类模型 40%）；最优集成模式 FreeOcc-E 达 27 FPS。nuScenes 上实现 SOTA 预测性能：NFCD 0.47 m、mIoU 32.1%；零样本迁移至 SemanticKITTI；在显著传感器丢包与时间戳抖动下仍保留 92.8% 的理想 mIoU。

Conclusion: 利用下游规划器提供的自车运动先验进行几何解耦，可在保证预测精度的同时大幅降低计算成本与参数量，并获得良好的跨数据集泛化性与传感器退化鲁棒性。

Abstract: Current 4D occupancy world models use heavy cross-attention or deep recurrence to disentangle ego-motion from scene dynamics. This requires significant computational capacity. However, this effort is largely redundant since the ego-vehicle's intended future motion is provided by the downstream motion planner. We present FreeOcc, a lightweight continuous-time world model that introduces explicit $SE(2)$ geometric decoupling into a conditional flow-matching framework. By mathematically factoring out self-motion, we create a purely dynamic feature space. This space supports attention-free temporal fusion and allows physics-constrained ODEs to operate strictly on residual agent kinematics. To maximize deployment efficiency, FreeOcc introduces an uncertainty-aware blending mechanism. This routes well-observed voxels to a single-pass decoder, reserving the ODE solver exclusively for ambiguous, high-uncertainty regions. Requiring only 28.3M parameters-roughly 40% of comparable models-our optimal ensemble mode (FreeOcc-E) runs at 27 FPS. On nuScenes, FreeOcc achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance with a 0.47 m Near Field Chamfer Distance (NFCD) and 32.1% mIoU. Furthermore, the model transfers zero-shot to SemanticKITTI. It also proves highly robust, retaining 92.8% of its ideal mIoU under significant sensor packet loss and timestamp jitter.

</details>


### [90] [Describe Your Facial Expressions by Linking Image Encoders and Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08138)
*Yujian Yuan,Jiabei Zeng,Shiguang Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"面部表情描述"新任务，用三阶段训练框架和GPT-3.5合成图文对，构建可生成细粒度表情描述的语言-视觉模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统表情研究局限于离散情绪类别或面部动作单元(AU)，难以刻画面部动作与情绪状态的细微差别及其推断关系；同时该任务缺乏训练所需的图文对数据。

Method: 提出三阶段训练框架，基于BLIP-2预训练技术训练视觉到语言模型；针对图文对缺失，利用GPT-3.5结合已有情绪类别或AU标注合成并组合描述文本，构造合成图文对进行训练。

Result: 实验表明该方法能生成描述面部动作细节、情绪以及二者推断关系的描述，即使训练数据中未出现相应情绪也能泛化；同时该视觉-语言任务提升了中间视觉特征在AU检测与情绪分类上的性能。

Conclusion: 面部表情自然语言描述是可行且有效的新任务，合成图文对策略可缓解数据稀缺，且该任务对AU检测和情绪分类具有正则/增强作用。

Abstract: This paper presents a novel task of describing human facial expressions of a facial image in natural language, which captures the nuances of facial actions and emotional states beyond traditional emotion categories or facial action units (AUs). To achieve the facial expression captioning model, we propose a three-stage training framework that trains a vision-to-language model using synthesized image-text pairs and the BLIP-2 pre-training techniques. To overcome the challenge of missing training image-text pairs for facial expression captioning, we propose a strategy that involves synthesizing and combining captions using GPT-3.5 and existing annotations on either emotion categories or AUs. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in generating captions that describe details of facial actions and emotions, as well as the inferential relationship between them, even when those emotions are not present in the training data. It is also demonstrated that the vision-to-language task enhances the performance of the intermediate visual features on both AU detection and emotion classification tasks.

</details>


### [91] [Fault-Guided Cross-Layer Prediction for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08140)
*Tao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种单类无监督工业异常检测器：将冻结ViT深度视为离散转移序列，用有向预测器学习块间隐状态转移，相邻层余弦相似度揭示四道"断层线"并据此固定源-目标角色；配合仅用训练图校准的有界前景先验，在MVTec-AD、VisA、Real-IAD上取得SOTA级分割与检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单类设定下的特征重建类方法关注"重建什么"，本文转而追问"一个块能向另一个块传递什么信息"——即利用冻结ViT内部不同深度段之间的信息传输瓶颈来定位异常。

Method: 分析冻结ViT深度的相邻层余弦相似度，在DINOv2 ViT-L中发现四条明显断层，将深度划分为稳定段；深层保留语义但丢失局部细节，故由深/浅源向敏感目标做逐token有向预测可得无法被传输的信息作为异常证据；断层结构固定源/目标角色，规则可迁移至ViT-B与RADIO-B；并用仅在训练图像上校准的有界前景先验衰减背景证据而不误抹前景外缺陷；统一预测器架构与训练-only校准协议。

Result: 图像级AUROC：MVTec-AD 99.75、VisA 99.42、Real-IAD 94.27（Real-IAD对象级96.26）；256×256像素级P-AUROC/P-AUPRO：MVTec-AD 98.46/95.97、VisA 99.21/96.12、Real-IAD 99.26/96.59。

Conclusion: ViT深度间的"传输瓶颈"可作为有效的单类异常判据，且断层结构稳定、跨骨干可迁移；轻量有界前景先验在提升定位精度的同时保持对前景外缺陷的敏感性，方法在多数据集上具备强泛化性与竞争力。

Abstract: Feature reconstruction is widely used for unsupervised industrial anomaly detection in the single-class setting, where only normal images from one product category are available for training. We propose a single-class detector that asks what information one block can pass to another. We treat the depth of a frozen vision transformer as a sequence of discrete transitions. A directed predictor learns a block-to-block hidden-state transition pointwise over tokens. Adjacent-layer cosine similarity exposes four sharp fault lines in DINOv2 ViT-L, separating stable depth segments. The deepest blocks retain semantic context but lose local detail; a prediction from deep or shallow sources to sensitive targets therefore exposes the information that cannot be transported. The fault structure fixes the source and target roles, and the same rule transfers to ViT-B and RADIO-B. We use a bounded foreground prior calibrated solely on training images: it attenuates background evidence without also erasing defects outside the estimated foreground. Using one predictor architecture and a common training-only calibration protocol, image AUROC is 99.75 on MVTec-AD, 99.42 on VisA and 94.27 on Real-IAD. On Real-IAD the object-level AUROC is 96.26. At 256x256 pixel resolution, P-AUROC/P-AUPRO are 98.46/95.97 on MVTec-AD, 99.21/96.12 on VisA and 99.26/96.59 on Real-IAD.

</details>


### [92] [Improving Context-Shift Robustness of Convolutional Networks via Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08157)
*Jinen Setpal,Chaoyue Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对图像分类中的"上下文漂移"问题，提出以空间特征归因为引导的训练框架：先提出更忠实的归因方法ContrastiveCAMs，再基于其设计上下文正则化交叉熵损失（CR-CE），抑制模型对上下文区域的依赖，在多个中大规模数据集上一致提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像分类模型在测试时常遇到与训练分布不同的上下文（context shift），而网络易依赖非因果的上下文线索进行预测，导致上下文变化时性能显著下降。现有特征归因方法存在理论局限，无法提供足够忠实的归因图来指导模型关注物体相关特征。

Method: 1) 分析现有特征归因方法的理论局限，提出新变体ContrastiveCAMs，生成更忠实的模型预测归因图；2) 基于ContrastiveCAMs提出Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy（CR-CE），在标准交叉熵基础上加入上下文正则项，通过抑制上下文区域的影响来约束模型注意力，使其更多依赖物体相关特征。

Result: 在Waterbirds、Spawrious、ImageNet/ImageNet-BG、Hard-ImageNet等中大规模数据集上评估，上下文漂移鲁棒性均取得一致提升。

Conclusion: 利用空间特征归因引导模型减少上下文依赖是一种有效提升上下文漂移鲁棒性的训练策略，且ContrastiveCAMs提供了更忠实的归因基础；该框架在多个基准上验证了一致有效性。

Abstract: Image classification models often encounter objects in diverse and unpredictable contexts at test time, which may differ substantially from those seen during training. This phenomenon, termed context shift, exposes a key fragility in neural networks: when models rely on non-causal contextual cues for prediction, shifts in context can lead to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a novel training framework to improve the robustness of convolutional neural networks under context shift. Our approach leverages spatial feature attribution to guide models toward making predictions that rely less on contextual regions and more on object-relevant features. As a first step, recognizing a theoretical limitation of existing feature attribution methods we introduce a new variant, ContrastiveCAMs, which produces more faithful attribution maps of model predictions. Building on ContrastiveCAMs, we further propose Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy (CR-CE), a modification of the standard cross-entropy loss that regularizes the model's attention by suppressing the influence of contextual regions, thereby improving robustness to context shift. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach on several medium-to-large scale datasets (Waterbirds, Spawrious, ImageNet/ImageNet-BG, Hard-ImageNet), and report consistent improvements in context-shift robustness.

</details>


### [93] [Multimodal Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Vision-Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08185)
*Gizem Mert,Szymon Płotka,Pedro R. A. S. Bassi,Wenxuan Li,Zongwei Zhou,Jarosław B. Ćwikła,Arkadiusz Sitek,Ewa Szczurek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MedHiVE 将层级视觉-语言 Soft Mixture-of-Experts 与对比学习结合，通过按解剖尺度组织的两级 token 路由，在 3D 医学影像上实现细粒度解剖与全局扫描上下文的联合建模，在分割、分类、检测三类任务、6 个数据集上超越 11 个 SOTA 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学 3D 扫描与报告本质上是层级化的，诊断线索集中于特定解剖区域并跨多个组织层级分布；但现有多数医学视觉-语言模型忽略这一结构，无法聚焦临床相关解剖。此外，先前工作采用静态池化特征的直接区域-文本对齐与仅视觉的层级路由，缺乏动态的跨模态信息流。

Method: 提出 MedHiVE：两级、可学习的 token 路由机制。局部图像与文本特征先经局部 SMoE 路由，再由全局 SMoE 融合为统一多模态表示；视觉与文本 token 均沿按解剖尺度组织的两级 SMoE 层级进行路由，并以报告衍生的解剖级对比学习在统一空间中同时对齐解剖级与全局的视觉-语言表示。在 25,000+ 例 CT 扫描上以解剖监督进行预训练。

Result: 在 6 个数据集、3 类任务（分割、分类、检测）上，MedHiVE 一致性地超越 11 个 state-of-the-art 方法，验证了层级建模的重要性。

Conclusion: 层级化的跨模态路由与多尺度对比对齐对 3D 医学视觉-语言建模有效且必要；MedHiVE 是首个在解剖尺度上同时路由视觉与文本 token 的框架，代码已开源。

Abstract: Medical 3D scans and reports are inherently hierarchical, with diagnostic cues concentrated in specific anatomical regions across multiple levels of organization. Yet, most medical vision-language models ignore this structure and fail to focus on clinically relevant anatomy. We introduce MedHiVE, which combines hierarchical vision-language Soft Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) with contrastive learning to jointly model fine-grained anatomy and global scan context. To our knowledge, MedHiVE is the first framework to route both vision and text tokens through a two-level SMoE hierarchy organized by anatomical scale, coupling this with report-derived anatomy-level contrastive alignment for 3D medical imaging. This replaces the direct region-text alignment of statically pooled features and vision-only hierarchical routing of prior work with dynamic, slot-based cross-modal information flow across anatomical scales. MedHiVE operates via a two-level, learnable token-routing mechanism, where local image and text features are first routed through a local SMoE and then fused by a global SMoE into unified multimodal representations. Contrastive learning aligns both anatomy-level and global vision-language representations in a unified space. Pre-trained on 25,000+ CT scans with anatomical supervision, MedHiVE consistently surpasses 11 state-of-the-art methods across 6 datasets on 3 tasks: segmentation, classification, and detection, demonstrating the importance of hierarchical modeling. The code for MedHiVE is at github.com/szczurek-lab/MedHiVE.

</details>


### [94] [SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08264)
*Hao Yu,Zhenwei Wang,Yongzhen Hu,Yuning Gong,Junta Wu,Xiaowei Zhou,Hujun Bao,Tengfei Wang,Chunchao Guo,Sida Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出前馈3DGS方法在径向距离归一化空间中预测高斯属性会导致尺度监督歧义，提出基于高斯间距归一化（GSNorm）的SplatAnything方法，并建立系统基准，在场景尺度与视角变化下取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈3DGS方法通常在与径向距离归一化的空间中预测高斯属性，该空间对重建几何的全局径向统计量做了规范化，但相邻高斯中心之间的间距仍随场景尺度和相机配置显著变化。这种不匹配会导致高斯尺度目标出现系统性偏移，从而产生模糊的监督信号。

Method: 提出SplatAnything，核心是高斯间距归一化（GSNorm）：对高斯间距的稳健场景级统计量进行规范化，为高斯预测提供更一致的空间参照。同时构建覆盖多数据集、不同输入稀疏度和挑战性外推视角的系统性基准以严格评估方法。

Result: 大量实验表明SplatAnything达到SOTA性能，尤其在场景尺度和视角发生显著变化时增益尤为明显。

Conclusion: 通过以高斯间距而非仅径向距离作为规范化参照，可缓解高斯尺度监督歧义，提升前馈3DGS在尺度与视角变化下的鲁棒性；配套基准为后续研究提供了系统评估协议。

Abstract: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.

</details>


### [95] [DART: Domain-Agnostic Residual Transfer for Generalist Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08271)
*Muhammad Aqeel,Maham Nazir,Marco Cristani,Francesco Setti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DART是一个即插即用框架，在"正常-异常参考引导"的通用异常检测中，将残差解耦为异常相关分量与域特定分量，从而提升跨域迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有normal-abnormal引导的GAD方法利用异常参考提升性能，但其残差混杂了可迁移的异常线索与域特定外观因素（纹理、几何、采集条件等），导致残差域纠缠，限制跨域迁移，并在新域上产生虚假激活。

Method: 提出DART，包含两个组件：(1) 残差解耦模块（Residual Disentanglement Module），在保留异常判别信息的同时抑制域信息；(2) 跨域元训练（Cross-Domain Meta-Training），在源域间构造episode使解耦有效。方法架构无关，可插入现有GAD流程的残差计算与检测头之间。

Result: 在MVTec AD、VisA和BraTS上，相对多种基线方法取得一致提升，且在更强域偏移下增益最大。

Conclusion: 通过显式解耦残差中的异常与域因素并对齐跨域训练，可有效缓解域纠缠问题，显著增强normal-abnormal引导通用异常检测的跨域泛化能力，且具备良好的可插拔通用性。

Abstract: Generalist Anomaly Detection (GAD) aims to detect anomalies in unseen domains using only a few reference samples. Recent normal-abnormal guided methods improve this setting by exploiting abnormal references, but their residuals often mix transferable anomaly cues with domain-specific appearance factors such as texture, geometry, and acquisition conditions. This residual domain entanglement limits cross-domain transfer and may produce spurious activations on novel domains. We propose DART, a plug-in framework for normal-abnormal guided GAD that learns to separate residuals into anomaly-relevant and domain-specific components. DART combines a Residual Disentanglement Module, which preserves anomaly-discriminative information while suppressing domain information, with Cross-Domain Meta-Training, which forms episodes across source domains to make the separation effective. The method is architecture-agnostic and can be inserted between residual computation and the detection head of existing GAD pipelines. Experiments on MVTec AD, VisA, and BraTS show consistent improvements over multiple base methods, with the largest gains under stronger domain shifts. https://github.com/aqeeelmirza/DART

</details>


### [96] [Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08286)
*Chenhao Zheng,Zixian Ma,Kai Li,Kanchana Ranasinghe,Jieyu Zhang,Artemis Panagopoulou,Weikai Huang,Jianxu Shangguan,Yuanyuan Tan,Silvio Savarese,Juan Carlos Niebles,Ranjay Krishna,Ran Xu,Honglu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Interactive Visual Gym (IVG) 闭环评测与训练框架，通过任务环境与用户联合仿真来评估视觉交互模型，并构建 315 场景的 IVG-Bench。最佳模型仅完成任务 53.4%，且存在事实依据与可执行指导不足、响应延迟过高等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 支持用户在持续进行的物理任务中的视觉交互模型，其助手回答会改变用户后续行为与任务结果，因此必须闭环评测。现有基准多依赖离线回放，无法捕捉这种反馈效应。

Method: 构建 Interactive Visual Gym 框架：联合仿真可执行任务环境与人类用户；提供烹饪、家庭操作、移动界面三个模拟器，重建日常任务与对齐人类的动作空间；配备 persona-conditioned 用户仿真组件，在协作中引入受控执行错误与偏离计划行为；实例化为含 315 个交互场景的 IVG-Bench，并评测 SOTA VLM。

Result: 最佳模型 Gemini 4 Argon 在时限内仅完成 53.4% 任务，事实依据与可执行指导能力显著薄弱，考虑响应延迟时往往过慢而无法阻止错误。人类研究验证评测协议：交互质量指标与参与者偏好一致率 78.5%。概念验证 GRPO 实验中，闭环训练在烹饪环境同时提升 Qwen3.5-4B 的任务成功率与交互质量。

Conclusion: 闭环仿真框架可有效暴露离线回放无法体现的交互缺陷，其环境同时可作为训练信号来源，实现评测与训练一体化；现有 VLM 作为视觉交互模型仍有明显差距。

Abstract: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of executable task environments and human users. We contribute three simulators that recreate everyday tasks and human-aligned action spaces across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile-interface domains, together with a persona-conditioned user simulation harness that collaborates with the assistant while incorporating controlled execution errors and other out-of-plan behaviors. We instantiate the framework as IVG-Bench, a benchmark with 315 interaction scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, exhibits significant weaknesses in factual grounding and actionable guidance, and is often too slow to prevent errors when response latency is considered. We verify our evaluation protocol with a human study which finds 78.5% agreement between our interaction-quality metric and participant preferences. We further show that the environments provide useful learning signals: in a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment, closed-loop training improves both task success and interaction quality for Qwen3.5-4B model in our cooking environment.

</details>


### [97] [Hierarchical Incremental Beta Splatting for Online Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08288)
*Linus Franke*

Main category: cs.CV
