Although DiffC has shown that pretrained diffusion models can serve as zero-shot codecs, we ask how the choice of coding path and reconstruction method affects rate--distortion--perception behavior. We analyze FluxC along three axes: coding cost and bit allocation, reconstruction method, and low rate distortion. At matched signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), we show that the path choice does not affect the ideal information rate, but changes how bits are allocated across time steps. For reconstruction, we compare ancestral sampling, one-step ODE reconstruction, and many-step ODE reconstruction. Our analysis shows that ODE-based reconstruction can achieve lower distortion than ancestral sampling, especially in the low rate regime. Experiments on Gaussian sources and natural images support this prediction. Moreover, FluxC performs competitively with, and in some cases outperforms, recent neural image compression methods, suggesting that Flux can serve as a principled zero-shot codec.

</details>


### [269] [AttnSR: Attention Step Reward for Long-Horizon Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07932)
*Mengsong Wu,Tianchen Zhou,Zhaochen Su,Zhenhua Liu,Zhe Cui,Aimin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AttnSR 通过策略注意力的反向追踪为长程 LLM 智能体的各步分配步骤级奖励，无需单独奖励模型或额外 rollout。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体需多步决策，但仅用结果奖励的强化学习对单步缺乏直接监督信号。

Method: 从训练回放过程中提取策略注意力，沿策略模型注意力图反向追溯以估计早期步骤与最终响应的相关性；以终局步相对滑动基线的表现决定这些步骤奖励是强化还是惩罚所选步骤。无需独立奖励模型或额外采样。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的受控实验中，ALFWorld 上所有评估 checkpoint 均优于 PPO 基线，最终留出集成功率从 91.2% 提升至 97.1%；ScienceWorld 每个 checkpoint 均提升，并将环境交互减少 29.9%。消融表明收益来源于中间奖励的分配方式，而非步骤奖励的简单累积。

Conclusion: 策略注意力可作为长程智能体强化学习中步骤级奖励分配的实用先验。

Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents make multi-step decisions, yet outcome-reward-only reinforcement learning provides little direct supervision for individual steps. We introduce AttnSR, a step-level reward augmentation method that derives reward allocations from policy attention extracted during training replay, without a separately trained reward model or additional rollouts. AttnSR traces backward through the policy model attention graph to estimate the relevance of earlier steps to the final response. The terminal step, measured relative to a running baseline, determines whether these rewards reinforce or penalize the selected steps. In a controlled Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct study, AttnSR consistently outperforms the PPO baseline across all evaluated checkpoints on ALFWorld, raising final held-out success from 91.2% to 97.1%. The ablation experiment shows that the benefit depends on how intermediate rewards are assigned, rather than simple accumulation of step rewards over time. AttnSR also improves ScienceWorld at every checkpoint while cutting environment interactions by 29.9%. These results support policy attention as a practical prior for step-level reward allocation in long-horizon agentic RL. Code is available at https://github.com/fairyshine/AttnSR .

</details>


### [270] [The Blindfolded Controller: Decision Model-Guided Training for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07934)
*Muhammad Ibrahim Khan,Aniket Dixit,Faizan Ahmed,James Brusey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Decision Model-Guided Training (DMGT)，用决策模型(DM)基于环境与任务描述初始化RL策略，使智能体首回合即能达goal并获奖励，再由RL从奖励中继续改进，从而兼顾DM的免训练能力与RL的持续优化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL在稀疏奖励与探索挑战任务中从零学习效率低、样本利用率差；DM无需训练即可在稀疏奖励任务中表现良好，但不从奖励中学习，无法趋向最优解。二者互补，故希望结合。

Method: DMGT：给定环境与任务的自然语言描述，由决策模型(DM)生成行为以初始化RL策略，替代从零探索；此后用RL基于奖励继续优化策略。另通过消融实验总结出向DM描述环境与任务的操作指南。

Result: 在7个任务上实验：该方法全部7个任务上优于RL，在5个任务上优于DM。

Conclusion: 以DM初始化RL策略可有效缓解稀疏奖励下的探索难题，使学习从首回合即有奖励信号，并最终超过DM的表现；同时给出了面向DM的环境与任务描述规范。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a framework for continuous improvement through interaction with an environment. However, RL agents struggle against tasks that offer exploration challenges and sparse rewards, because learning efficient policies from scratch is slow and sample-inefficient. In contrast, decision models (DMs), given a description of the environment and task, can perform well in sparse-reward tasks, but, as they do not learn from reward, they are not able to improve towards the optimal solution. In this paper, we present Decision Model-Guided Training (DMGT), a technique that uses a DM with a description of the environment and task to initialise an RL policy, combining the DM's ability to act without training with RL's ability to improve from reward. Instead of exploring from scratch, the agent reaches the goal and receives reward from its first episodes, and RL then improves its policy beyond what the DM achieves. We demonstrate through experiments on seven tasks that our approach outperforms RL in all seven and DM in five. In addition, we provide comprehensive guidelines, derived from ablation studies, for describing an environment and task to a DM.

</details>


### [271] [Leakage- and Label-Aware Benchmarking of Class-Imbalance Strategies for Multimodal Chest X-Ray and EHR Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07950)
*Dang-Khoa Bui,Quang-Huy Tran,Minh-Khoi Nguyen-Bui,Duc-Tuan Ngo,Thanh-Trong Tran,Tuan-Khoi Nguyen,Hoang-Anh Ngo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对 MIMIC-CXR+EHR 多模态基准的审计发现：记录级划分导致标签泄漏与重复计数，使原基准结论失效；在患者分离、入院对齐与规则精炼标签下，类不平衡策略、树集成优势与 EHR 变量有效性均不成立，而诊断历史与影像嵌入更有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态 CXR+EHR 类不平衡基准常以"记录级"划分评估，而同一患者贡献多张影像，易造成患者重叠与标签泄漏；作者怀疑此类基准的结论可能被人为抬高，需要系统性审计并给出合规范式。

Method: 以 29,083 张 MIMIC-CXR 影像、10,479 名患者、8 个诊断目标为对象：(1) 复现记录级划分基准，并用"查表法"（复制相同 EHR 向量开发集影像标签）作对照以探测泄漏；(2) 回溯 MIMIC-IV 诊断编码，核查标签生成来源；(3) 采用患者分离划分、入院对齐与规则精炼标签重做评估，比较无增强与多种类不平衡策略、调优树集成与逻辑回归、EHR 变量/诊断历史/影像嵌入（DenseNet、CheXpert 编码器、RAD-DINO）及其组合。

Result: 记录级基准具误导性：查表法几乎追平最佳模型，未见患者上所有模型退化至全阳性水平。标签溯源显示每位患者的标签来自单次入院的诊断编码关键词匹配，并以单一 EHR 向量复制至其全部影像，约三分之一影像标签与其本次入院编码不一致。患者分离评估下：无任何不平衡策略使宏 F2 提升超过 0.01；调优树集成相对逻辑回归无稳定优势；发布版 EHR 变量仅达全阳性基线，而影像时点可得的诊断历史与影像嵌入显著超过基线（含未见过这些影像的 CheXpert 编码器；RAD-DINO 预训练中已见 96.6% 影像）；编码器加入诊断历史无显著 F2 增益，AUROC 探索性增益在 RAD-DINO 显著、DenseNet 不显著。

Conclusion: 记录级划分与标签构造缺陷会系统性夸大基准性能并扭曲方法学结论；需采用患者分离、入院对齐与规则精炼标签的防泄漏评估协议，作者提供可复用诊断工具、防泄漏协议与检查清单。

Abstract: Benchmarks of class-imbalance strategies for multimodal chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) prediction are often evaluated on record-level splits of cohorts in which one patient contributes several radiographs. We audit such a benchmark on 29,083 MIMIC-CXR radiographs of 10,479 patients with eight diagnosis targets. First, the record-split benchmark was misleading: a lookup table that copies the label of a development-set radiograph with the same EHR vector nearly matched the best model, and on unseen patients every model fell to the level of predicting every case positive. Second, tracing the labels back to MIMIC-IV explained why: each patient's labels are keyword matches on the diagnosis codes of a single admission, copied, with one EHR vector per patient, to all of the patient's radiographs, so about a third of the radiographs carry labels that differ from the codes of their own admission. Third, under patient-separated evaluation with admission-aligned and rule-refined labels, the initial conclusions do not hold: in the evaluated configurations no imbalance strategy raised the observed mean macro F2 over no augmentation by more than 0.01, tuned tree ensembles showed no consistent advantage over tuned logistic regression, and the released EHR variables stayed at the level of the all-positive baseline, whereas the diagnostic history available at imaging time and image embeddings exceeded it, including, with rule-refined labels, a CheXpert-trained encoder that never saw these radiographs; RAD-DINO had seen 96.6% of them during self-supervised pretraining. Adding either encoder to the diagnostic history gave no statistically significant F2 gain; exploratory AUROC gains were significant with RAD-DINO but not with DenseNet. We provide reusable diagnostics, a leakage-aware protocol and a checklist.

</details>


### [272] [Invariance before structure: two modes of emergent compression in representation learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07952)
*Hardik Rajpal,Dan Goodman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EARL框架，区分表征涌现的两种模式——状态空间压缩与参数空间压缩，并以Fisher敏感性形式化、用集合层面的信息论度量，在储层网络中验证二者于学习的不同阶段出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物与人工神经网络中学习到的表征表现出显著的跨基质不变性，且能抵抗漂移、异质性与初始化差异；作者希望理解这种不变性从何而来。

Method: 提出Emergent Adaptive Representation Learning（EARL）框架，区分两类涌现：状态空间压缩（表征对自身未来的预测力超出单个单元各自预测能力之和）与参数空间压缩（微观参数不同的网络收敛到相同表征）；将二者形式化为Fisher敏感性，并分别引入集合层面的信息论度量；在一个带可训练瓶颈的循环储层网络中做实证分析。

Result: 参数空间压缩在训练最初几个epoch内即上升，且部分独立于具体任务；状态空间压缩约晚30个epoch才上升，且仅在网络开始学习任务时间结构时出现。

Conclusion: 对基质的不变性与任务特定的涌现结构在学习的不同阶段获得，二者是解耦的、分阶段的涌现过程。

Abstract: Learned representations show striking invariance across biological and artificial neural networks, with different substrates and variations driven by drift, heterogeneity and initialisation. To understand this invariance, we propose Emergent Adaptive Representation Learning (EARL), a framework that distinguishes two modes of emergence in learned representations: state-space compression, where a learned representation gains predictive power over its own future beyond what the network's units can predict individually, and parameter-space compression, where networks with different micro-level parameters converge to the same representation. We formalise both as Fisher sensitivities and introduce ensemble-level information-theoretic measures for each. In a recurrent reservoir with a trained bottleneck, parameter-space compression rises within the first few epochs of training and partly independently of the task, whereas state-space compression rises about 30 epochs later and only when the network begins to learn the temporal structure of the task. These results suggest that invariance to the substrate and task-specific emergent structure are acquired in distinct phases of learning.

</details>


### [273] [Tight Asymptotic Bounds on the Maximum Number of Linear Regions of Piecewise-Linear Kolmogorov--Arnold networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07973)
*Ye Su,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文给出了分段线性 KAN 线性区域数的紧上下界，阶为 Θ_n(k^{Σ min n_s})，并证明在等参数量下 KAN 相对 ReLU 网络有多项式级优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Schoots et al. (AISTATS 2025) 仅给出 CPWL KAN 线性区域数的宽松上界 k^{Σ n_{ℓ-1}n_ℓ}，缺少下界，无法刻画其可达几何复杂度；同时 KAN 与 ReLU 网络的表达能力对比缺乏参数预算下的定量结论。

Method: 对 T 层、宽度向量 n、输入维 d、每条边至多 k≥2 个仿射段的 CPWL KAN 构造匹配的上下界，证明紧增长阶 Θ_n(k^{Σ_{ℓ=1}^T ρ_{ℓ-1}})，其中 ρ_{ℓ-1}=min_{0≤s≤ℓ-1} n_s；再在每模型至多 Λ 个参数、固定非线性深度 T 的稠密参数化下，通过计数可训练节点位置并对宽度与 k 作优化，比较 KAN 与 ReLU 网络的最大区域数之比。

Result: 上界较 Schoots 等人的结果改进了 Θ_n(k^{Σ n_{ℓ-1}n_ℓ − Σ ρ_{ℓ-1}}) 倍，只要存在宽度大于 1 的隐藏层即为严格渐近改进；当所有隐藏宽度 ≥ d 时紧阶简化为 Θ_n(k^{dT})。与 ReLU 网络相比，最大区域数之比为 Θ_{d,T}(Λ^{d⌊T/2⌋})，T≥2 时 KAN 具多项式优势。

Conclusion: 所得紧界精确刻画了 CPWL KAN 可达到的几何复杂度，为理解其表达能力并指导架构设计提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Schoots et al.~\citep{schoots2025relating} (AISTATS 2025) established a generally loose upper bound on the number of linear regions of continuous piecewise-linear (CPWL) Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs), without providing a lower bound. We consider a $T$-layer network with width vector $\mathbf n=(n_0,\ldots,n_T)$, input dimension $n_0=d$, output width $n_T=1$, and at most $k\geq2$ affine segments per edge. Our matching upper and lower bounds determine the tight growth order $Θ_{\mathbf n}(k^{\sum_{\ell=1}^{T}ρ_{\ell-1}})$ in $k$, where $ρ_{\ell-1}:=\min_{0\leq s\leq\ell-1}n_s$. When every hidden width is at least $d$, the tight order simplifies to $Θ_{\mathbf n}(k^{dT})$. The upper bound of \citep{schoots2025relating} is $k^{\sum_{\ell=1}^{T}n_{\ell-1}n_\ell}$. Our upper bound improves it by a factor of $Θ_{\mathbf n}\!\left(k^{\sum_{\ell=1}^{T}n_{\ell-1}n_\ell-\sum_{\ell=1}^{T}ρ_{\ell-1}} \right)$, with strict asymptotic improvement whenever a hidden layer has width greater than one. We further compare CPWL KANs with rectified linear unit (ReLU) networks using dense parameterizations with at most $Λ$ parameters per model and the same fixed nonlinear depth $T$. Counting trainable knot locations and optimizing the widths and $k$, we prove that the maximum region count of CPWL KANs divided by that of ReLU networks is $Θ_{d,T}(Λ^{d\lfloor T/2\rfloor})$ as $Λ\to\infty$, yielding a polynomial advantage for KANs when $T\geq2$. These tight bounds characterize the attainable geometric complexity of CPWL KANs, providing a foundation for understanding their expressive power and guiding architectural design.

</details>


### [274] [QRAE: Query-Relevant Attention Entropy for Context Compression in DeepSearch Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07976)
*Yingjie Tan,Haiquan Qiu,Quanming Yao,Manyi Zhong,Xianzhi Yu,Yaqing Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Query-Relevant Attention Entropy (QRAE)，一种在线上下文压缩方法，用稀疏证据评估头通过配对预填充为检索块打分，仅保留高分块进入推理上下文，从而降低token消耗与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeepSearch类LLM智能体反复检索并把来源带入后续推理，上下文不断膨胀，带来token消耗与延迟上升，而许多检索结果对后续推理并无贡献。

Method: 基于稀疏证据评估头（sparse evidence-assessment heads）对完整检索块进行在线压缩：以有界候选批次为单位，通过配对预填充（paired prefills）打分——无查询控制预填充抑制共享注意力响应，再用归一化熵度量每个块内正向响应的广度；高分块进入持久证据白名单并纳入推理上下文，不确定块移出推理上下文但保留在候选缓存中以供后续重评估。无需额外生成式压缩过程，也不修改注意力算子。

Result: 在多个DeepSearch基准与推理模型上，任务成功率平均提升2.35个百分点，端到端延迟与报告token用量分别平均降低30%和45%；效果可泛化至近100B参数模型。

Conclusion: QRAE以轻量在线打分实现有效上下文压缩，在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低延迟与token开销，且具备跨模型规模的可扩展性。

Abstract: DeepSearch LLM agents repeatedly search and carry retrieved sources into subsequent reasoning steps. This expanding context increases token consumption and latency, although many results do not contribute to later reasoning. We propose Query-Relevant Attention Entropy (QRAE), an online context compression method that uses sparse evidence-assessment heads to decide which intact retrieved chunks should persist across reasoning steps. It scores bounded candidate batches through paired prefills: a query-free control suppresses shared attention responses, while normalized entropy measures the breadth of the positive response within each chunk. High-scoring chunks enter a persistent evidence whitelist and are included in the reasoning context. Uncertain chunks remain outside the reasoning context but are retained in a candidate cache, where they can be retrieved for later reevaluation. QRAE requires neither an additional generative compression pass nor modification of the attention operator. Across multiple DeepSearch benchmarks and reasoning models, QRAE improves task success by an average of 2.35 percentage points and reduces end-to-end latency and reported token usage by an average of 30% and 45%, respectively. These benefits generalize to a model with nearly 100B parameters.

</details>


### [275] [Towards Multiscale Molecular Representation Learning through Geometry-Based Fragmentation for Polymer Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07998)
*Makoto Takamoto,Chaitanya Sampara,Viktor Zaverkin,Daniel Oñoro-Rubio,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于几何的分子碎片化方法，将碎片化建模为受半径约束的k-center优化问题，并构建多尺度几何碎片注意力机制，结合p-SMILES与3D构象进行聚合物性质预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有基于碎片的机器学习方法多依赖预定义化学规则，对未见或化学上陌生的结构可能产生次优碎片，且常忽视多尺度分子表征的重要性。

Method: 将分子碎片化表述为受半径约束的优化问题（受k-center公式启发），簇数由半径决定而非预先固定；利用几何信息对任意分子或材料结构进行划分，可灵活控制碎片尺度以构建多尺度碎片表征；进而设计几何碎片注意力机制，嵌入融合p-SMILES与3D构象的多模态机器学习模型。

Result: 在基准聚合物数据集上，引入3D构象信息相比仅用p-SMILES的模型在多项性质上提升了预测精度；可解释AI分析揭示了所学表征的物理相关性。

Conclusion: 不依赖预定义化学规则的几何碎片化可提供尺度自适应的多尺度碎片表征，几何碎片注意力结合多模态信息有效提升性质预测，并具备一定物理可解释性。

Abstract: It is well established that molecular substructures can contribute unequally to chemical and physical properties, with specific motifs or side chains often playing dominant roles. Fragment-based representations have therefore emerged as an effective strategy for incorporating chemically meaningful inductive biases, as exemplified by molecular fingerprints and fragment-based attention mechanisms. However, many existing fragmentation-based machine learning methods rely on predefined chemical rules, which may yield suboptimal fragmentation for previously unseen or chemically unfamiliar structures and often overlook the importance of multiscale molecular representations. To address these limitations, we formulate molecular fragmentation as a radius-constrained optimization problem inspired by the k-center formulation, where the number of clusters is not fixed a priori but emerges from the specified radius, and propose a geometry-based fragmentation method that partitions arbitrary molecular or material structures using largely geometric information, without relying on predefined chemical fragmentation rules. The method provides flexible control over fragment size, enabling the construction of multiscale fragment representations for scale-adaptive modeling. Building on this framework, we develop a geometric fragment-based attention mechanism that integrates multiscale structural information and incorporate it into a multimodal machine learning model combining p-SMILES representations with three-dimensional (3D) conformational information. Experiments on a benchmark polymer dataset show that incorporating 3D conformational information improves prediction accuracy for several properties over models based exclusively on p-SMILES representations. Explainable artificial intelligence analyses further provide insights into the physical relevance of the learned representations.

</details>


### [276] [GTAFL: Addressing Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning in Medical Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08021)
*Guangyu Chen,Jingyun Zeng,Hui Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"测试不可知长尾联邦学习"（Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed FL）新任务，并设计GTAFL框架，通过自适应重采样、专家分类器重训练、自监督学习及推理期集成机制，解决医疗联邦学习中本地与全局长尾分布及未知测试分布导致的模型失效问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗数据敏感且可及性广，隐私保护至关重要，联邦学习提供去中心化隐私保护训练范式。但真实医疗数据在本地与全局视角均呈长尾分布，且现有长尾联邦学习方法假设模型在均匀测试分布上评估，而实际医疗系统测试数据分布不可知且难以预测，易导致模型失效。

Method: 提出GTAFL框架：训练阶段采用自适应重采样（adaptive re-sampling）、专家分类器重训练（expert classifier retraining）与自监督学习（self-supervised learning），纠正长尾训练分布导致的偏差分类器与扭曲特征空间；推理阶段采用集成机制（ensemble mechanism），融合重训练后的多个专家分类器以应对未知分布的测试数据。

Result: 在CIFAR10及两个医疗数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架优于其他先进方法（state-of-the-art）。

Conclusion: GTAFL作为面向测试不可知长尾联邦学习的综合框架，可有效缓解长尾分布与未知测试分布带来的性能退化，适用于真实医疗联邦学习场景。

Abstract: In healthcare, protecting patient privacy is crucial due to the sensitivity of medical data and its extensive accessibility. Federated Learning (FL) offers a decentralized and privacy-preserving training paradigm, making it an ideal solution for healthcare applications. A critical challenge in healthcare is that real-world medical data often exhibits long-tailed distributions in local and global views. Existing methods addressing long-tailed FL problem typically assume that the model will be evaluated on uniform test data distribution. However, practical test data in healthcare systems is often agnostic and unpredictable, leading to potential model failures in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we introduce a novel task termed Test-Agnostic Long-Tailed Federated Learning and propose GTAFL, a comprehensive framework to address this challenge. During the training stage, GTAFL employs adaptive re-sampling, expert classifier retraining, and self-supervised learning to correct biased classifiers and distorted feature spaces caused by long-tailed training distributions. During the inference stage, an ensemble mechanism combines retrained expert classifiers to handle test data with unknown distributions. Extensive experiments on CIFAR10 and two medical datasets manifest that our framework outperforms other state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/cgy-lavine/GTAFL

</details>


### [277] [Reproducing Kernel (Quasi-)Banach Spaces with the $\ell^p$ Coefficient Norms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08032)
*Tianfang Wang,Guohui Song,Haizhang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推进再生核Banach空间(RKBS)理论，系统研究一般ℓ^p正则化框架，重点考察非凸区域0<p<1：构造ℓ^p拟范数的再生核拟Banach空间(RKQBS)，给出插值与正则化学习的解存在性与稀疏性结果；利用广义Lebesgue常数刻画线性与松弛表示定理，并在核衰减、样本间距与稳定性假设下导出界；对p>1用固定可数字典构造RKBS并识别最优松弛表示因子。数值实验比较三种情形的精度与稀疏性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前期工作建立了ℓ^1范数下RKBS的基础，但为获得更接近ℓ^0伪范数的更强稀疏性，需要将正则化推广到ℓ^p拟范数，并厘清0<p<1、p=1与p>1三种区域在理论上和数值行为上的根本差异，以统一并扩展RKBS框架。

Method: (1) 对0<p<1，构建具有ℓ^p拟范数的再生核拟Banach空间(RKQBS)，在适当假设下证明插值与正则化学习的解存在性与稀疏性；(2) 以广义Lebesgue常数刻画线性表示定理与松弛表示定理，并在核衰减、样本间距与稳定性假设下推导相应界；(3) 对p>1，基于固定可数字典构造RKBS，证明极小元存在性，并通过离样本系数算子识别最优松弛表示因子；(4) 设计数值实验，比较三种情形解的精度与稀疏性。

Result: 成功建立0<p<1下RKQBS的存在性与稀疏性结果；得到由广义Lebesgue常数表达的表示定理刻画及其在核衰减、样本间距与稳定性条件下的界；对p>1给出基于可数字典的RKBS构造、极小元存在性与最优松弛表示因子的识别方法；数值实验显示0<p<1、p=1、p>1三种情形的精度与稀疏性存在本质差异。

Conclusion: ℓ^p正则化框架在RKBS理论中可统一处理p<1、p=1与p>1三类情形，非凸拟范数区域可获得更强稀疏性，而三种区域在表示定理结构与数值表现上存在根本性区别，为后续RKBS研究提供了系统性的理论与实验基础。

Abstract: This paper advances the theory of reproducing kernel Banach spaces (RKBSs) by investigating the general $\ell^p$ regularization framework, with a particular focus on the non-convex regime $0<p<1$.
  While our preceding work established the foundation for RKBSs with the $\ell^1$ norm, the pursuit of stronger sparsity---closer to the $\ell^0$ pseudo-norm---naturally motivates this exploration into $\ell^p$ quasi-norms.
  For $0<p<1$, we construct reproducing kernel quasi-Banach spaces (RKQBSs) with $\ell^p$ quasi-norms and establish existence and sparsity results for interpolation and regularized learning under appropriate assumptions.
  We characterize the linear and relaxed representer theorems in terms of a generalized Lebesgue constant and derive bounds under kernel decay, sample spacing, and stability assumptions.
  For $p>1$, we construct RKBSs using a fixed countable dictionary, establish minimizer existence, and identify the optimal relaxed representer factor through an off-sample coefficient operator.
  These results reveal fundamental differences between the regimes $0<p<1$, $p=1$, and $p>1$.
  Numerical experiments compare the accuracy and sparsity of solutions for these three cases.

</details>


### [278] [Should We Pay This Much for Robustness? Efficient Proxy Certificates with Marginal Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08035)
*Soroush H. Zargarbashi,Mohammad Sadegh Akhondzadeh,Aleksandar Bojchevski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将昂贵的随机平滑认证委托给廉价代理函数，并用鲁棒保形风险控制来约束代理的边际误批准率，从而以单次前向的代价获得稳健性证书，或作为回退机制加速随机平滑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代分类器对微小扰动敏感，而随机平滑等模型无关的强稳健性证书代价过高（每输入需约2000次前向），难以部署。

Method: 将认证委托给廉价代理函数，并统计控制其相对原可靠证书的偏差；给定可交换的无标签校准集，用鲁棒保形风险控制（conformal risk control）调节代理，保证有界边际误批准率，即未来输入中代理接受但预测被扰动翻转的概率；提供单样本与样本重加权两种校准方案；代理既可作为独立边际证书，也可作为回退机制，仅在代理拒绝时调用昂贵证书。

Result: 作为独立证书，测试时认证成本降至单次前向，在小半径下保留随机平滑的大部分认证性能；作为回退机制，以较小加速比恢复随机平滑的认证比例；可支持ViT与语言模型等较大架构的廉价稳健性保障。

Conclusion: 通过代理加保形风险控制，可在保证边际误批准率受控的前提下大幅降低稳健性认证成本，为大规模模型提供廉价而有效的稳健性保证。

Abstract: Modern classifiers remain sensitive to small input perturbations, while strong model-agnostic robustness certificates such as randomized smoothing are often too expensive for deployment, requiring an extensive number (e.g. 2000) of model forward passes per input. We propose a framework that delegates certification to a cheap proxy function while statistically controlling its deviation from the original sound certificate. Given an exchangeable unlabeled calibration set, we tune the proxy via robust conformal risk control to guarantee a bounded marginal (rather than pointwise) false-approval rate: the probability, over future inputs, that the proxy accepts an input whose prediction is flipped due to perturbation. The resulting proxy certificate can be used either as a standalone marginal certificate or as a fallback mechanism that invokes the expensive certificate only when the proxy rejects. We provide both single-sample and sample-heavy calibration recipes. Empirically, as a standalone certificate our method reduces the test-time certification cost to a single model forward while retaining much of the certified performance of randomized smoothing at small radii, and as a fallback it recovers the certified ratio of randomized smoothing at a more modest speedup. This enables cheap yet effective robustness guarantees for larger architectures such as vision transformers and language models.

</details>


### [279] [Performance metrics in machine learning: a scenario-based guide from the confusion matrix to calibration, regression and uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08048)
*Mehmet Baygin,Sengul Dogan,Turker Tuncer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇方法学教程，通过受控情景系统展示类别流行率、决策阈值、聚合规则与软件约定如何影响分类性能指标的解释，并给出目标导向的指标选择表与报告清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一组预测在不同性能指标下可能得出不同结论，研究者常忽视流行率、阈值、聚合层级与软件实现约定对指标的影响，导致误读或错误报告。

Method: 将22个混淆矩阵指标组织为按流行率编码的映射图；设计15个情景，覆盖二分类与多分类、分数判别力、概率校准、回归、不确定性与一致性检验；每个情景固定输入文件、仅变动一个因素；共设205项验证检查（202项独立、3项内部）。

Result: 全部205项检查通过。流行率0.010时"恒预测为负"的规则准确率达0.990，但平衡准确率仅0.500；灵敏度与特异度固定时，流行率由0.5降至0.001使精确率从0.889跌至0.008；三种概率变体ROC-AUC同为0.825，校准斜率分别为2.08、1.04、0.52；10名参与者时参与者多数准确率0.700的95%区间为0.348–0.933；在不恰当的合并测试集模型下，交叉验证折平均分数被误判为不一致。

Conclusion: 情景仅用于阐明机制而非估计其在已发表文献中的出现频率；文献审计与真实数据演示被列为未来协议，尚未执行；作者提供基于目标的指标表与报告清单以指导规范报告。

Abstract: Performance metrics can yield different conclusions from the same predictions. This methodological tutorial explains the effects of class prevalence, decision thresholds, aggregation rules and software conventions through controlled scenarios. Twenty-two confusion-matrix metrics are organized in a prevalence-coded map. Fifteen scenarios cover binary and multi-class classification, score discrimination, probability calibration, regression, uncertainty and consistency checks. Inputs are fixed in released files, and one factor is varied in each scenario. All 205 verification checks passed; 202 were independent and 3 were internal. An always-negative rule achieved an accuracy of 0.990 at a prevalence of 0.010, with balanced accuracy of 0.500. At fixed sensitivity and specificity, precision fell from 0.889 to 0.008 as prevalence fell from 0.5 to 0.001. Three probability variants shared a ROC-AUC of 0.825 but had calibration slopes of 2.08, 1.04 and 0.52. With 10 participants, participant-majority accuracy of 0.700 had a 95% interval of 0.348-0.933. Fold-averaged scores were falsely flagged as inconsistent under an inappropriate pooled-test-set model. A goal-based metric table and a reporting checklist are provided. The scenarios illustrate mechanisms and do not estimate their frequency in published studies. A literature audit and a real-data demonstration are specified as future protocols and were not executed.

</details>


### [280] [Can an LLM Actually Reason and Program about Neural Network's Weights or is it just memorization on steroids? Exploring "Weight-Space Programming"](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08070)
*Nazmus Sakib Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验Claude Opus 5.5的"权重空间编程"能力：在无工具、无前向传播、隐藏数据集信息的条件下读取约12.5万参数的卷积网络权重。结论是零样本权重阅读并非权重流推理，而是"局部算术 + 公开数据集记忆先验"的组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期有研究声称LLM能直接读写神经网络原始权重（weight-space programming）。作者质疑其"阅读"一侧究竟是真正关于权重流的推理，还是仅在网络边缘做局部算术、并叠加对公开数据集的记忆先验。

Method: 以Claude Opus 5.5为被测对象，使用在5个图像数据集上训练的约125,000参数小卷积网络；将全部权重以纯文本输入，禁止使用工具、前向传播，且不提供数据集名或类别名。核验手段包括：由BN统计量推断优化步数、由输出层符号模式恢复类别划分、消融部分追踪、数据集识别、以及标签置换（label permutation）实验。

Result: 局部计算准确：对仅训练3步的网络推断出约3个优化步；从输出层符号模式恢复CIFAR-10的车辆/动物划分。但语义判断严重依赖记忆：对三个快餐网络也判为CIFAR-10；将KMNIST误称为MNIST；把99.57%准确率的SAT-6网络读成CIFAR-10动物照片；把主要响应树木的特征所偏好的输出称为"frog"。标签置换后输出划分随新索引保持，但模型解释的每一对类别都是错的。会话显示模型只精读首末层、对中间层采样；基于部分追踪的多项断言未通过验证（未做直接前向传播测试）。

Conclusion: 该模型的零样本权重阅读应被描述为"局部算术 + 数据集先验"，而非权重流追踪；结果为探索性（多为单次运行）。作者提出一套用于审计未来权重空间相关声明的协议。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of neural networks directly, a capability termed weight-space programming. We ask whether the reading side of this capability reflects reasoning about weight flows or a combination of local arithmetic at the network's edges and memorized priors over public datasets. We test Claude Opus 5.5 on small convolutional networks of about 125,000 parameters trained on five image datasets, providing every weight as plain text with no tools, no forward passes, and no dataset or class names. The model performs accurate local calculations: batch-normalization statistics lead it to infer about three optimizer steps on networks stopped after three updates, and output-layer sign patterns recover the vehicle/animal split of CIFAR-10. The sessions report reading the first and last layers closely and sampling the middle, and several claims built on partial tracing fail verification, although we did not run a direct forward-pass test. Semantic judgments lean on familiar datasets: the model names CIFAR-10 for CIFAR-10 networks but also for all three fast-food networks, relabels KMNIST as MNIST, reads a 99.57%-accurate SAT-6 network as CIFAR-10 animal photos, and calls "frog" the output favored by a feature that fires most on trees. Permuting CIFAR-10's labels preserves the output split at the new indices, but every class pair the model interprets is then wrong, indicating reliance on remembered label order. These are exploratory results from mostly single runs. We conclude that zero-shot weight reading by this model is better described as local arithmetic plus dataset priors than as weight-flow tracing, and we provide a protocol for auditing future weight-space claims.

</details>


### [281] [Optimal Competitive Ratios for Chasing Convex Functions with Quadratic Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08078)
*Linzhe He,Sifan Yang,Wei Jiang,Lijun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为两类移动代价下的凸函数追逐（convex function chasing）建立了最优的无维竞争比：欧氏移动下提出Clipped Proximal Descent（CPD），达到O(κ^{1/3})竞争比；平方欧氏移动下给出精确最优的无维竞争比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凸函数追逐问题中，欧氏移动下κ-良态函数的现有上下界之间存在多项式间隙；平方欧氏移动下虽有二次增长下的无维竞争保证，但最优竞争比仍不明确。本文旨在弥合这些差距。

Method: 欧氏移动：提出Clipped Proximal Descent（CPD）算法，将平衡的近端步与朝当前极小点的裁剪修正相结合。平方欧氏移动：对Regularized Online Balanced Descent（R-OBD）进行新的紧致竞争分析，并构造针对随机算法的匹配下界。

Result: CPD对满足二次增长的光滑凸函数达到O(κ^{1/3})竞争比，改进了此前O(√κ)上界并匹配已有Ω(κ^{1/3})下界；平方欧氏移动下得到精确最优的无维竞争比，且与下界相匹配。

Conclusion: 本文为凸函数追逐在欧氏与平方欧氏两类移动代价下给出了最优（或改进至紧）的无维竞争比，解决了此前上界与下界不符的问题。

Abstract: Chasing convex function has attracted much attention in recent years, which can be formulated as a game between a learner and an adversary. In each round, the adversary reveals a convex function, and the learner selects a decision and incurs a hitting cost and a movement cost for changing its decision. The performance of the learner is measured by the \emph{competitive ratio}, which compares its cumulative cost with that of an optimal offline decision sequence. For Euclidean movement, existing upper and lower bounds for $κ$-well-conditioned functions exhibit a polynomial gap. For squared Euclidean movement, dimension-free competitive guarantees have been established under quadratic growth, but the optimal competitive ratio remains unclear.
  In this paper, we establish optimal dimension-free competitive ratios for convex function chasing under two types of movement costs. For Euclidean movement, we propose Clipped Proximal Descent (CPD), which combines a balanced proximal step with a clipped correction toward the current minimizer. CPD achieves an $O(κ^{1/3})$ competitive ratio for smooth convex functions satisfying quadratic growth, improving the previous $O(\sqrtκ)$ upper bound and matching the existing $Ω(κ^{1/3})$ lower bound. For squared Euclidean movement, we establish the exact optimal dimension-free competitive ratio for convex functions satisfying quadratic growth. Our result is based on a new tight competitive analysis of Regularized Online Balanced Descent (R-OBD) and a matching lower bound against randomized algorithms.

</details>


### [282] [Value or Attention: Investigating Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for Graph Attention Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08088)
*Ken Schreiber,René P. Klausen,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek,Jonas Naujoks*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种带自由权重的单乘积规则分解GAT注意力层中节点相关性为「内容路径」与「路由路径」，并论证应分开解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GAT被用于医学、材料等需可解释性的领域，但其学到的路由对多数解释器不透明。LRP虽跟随模型计算，但在注意力层中到达节点的相关性混合了机制不同的两个量（值路径的内容相关性、注意力路径的路由相关性），现有规则要么丢弃其一、要么合并为单一数值，掩盖了二者语义差异。

Method: 构造一个在两因子（内容项与路由项）上带自由权重的单乘积规则，将现有LRP规则作为特例统一纳入；值路径衡量节点内容相对零基线的供给，注意力路径衡量节点相对其邻域对传递内容的塑造程度，其符号表示节点特征将门控推向预测所需方向与否；在有真值的分类任务上比较规则在不同权重设置下的相关性输出，并给出两条路径的阅读规则。

Result: 在真值分类任务上，同一节点在三种规则设置下分别得到负、正、近零的相关性；分离后的相关性图给出关于模型行为的假设：模型通过「不读取」该节点而获益。

Conclusion: 内容相关性与路由相关性应分离并分别解释，单一合并数值的现有做法会丢失重要信息；所提带权乘积规则可统一现有方法并支持路径级可解释性。

Abstract: Graph Attention Networks (GATs) are increasingly used in domains where scientists need to read a model's reasoning, from medicine to materials science, yet the routing they learn remains opaque to most explainers. Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) follows the model's computation, but in an attention layer the relevance reaching a node is the sum of two mechanically different quantities: its content relevance through the value path and its routing relevance through the attention path. Existing rules either drop one or add them into a single number. We write a single product rule with free weights on the two factors that recovers current approaches as special cases. The value path measures what content a node supplied against a zero baseline; the attention path measures how the node shaped what was passed relative to its neighborhood, and its sign records whether the node's features moved the gating the way the prediction demanded. On a ground-truth classification task, we show that the same node receives negative, positive and near-zero relevance under three settings of the rule. The separated relevance maps yield a hypothesis about the model: it gains by not reading that node. We give reading rules for both paths and argue that they should be interpreted separately.

</details>


### [283] [SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08089)
*Anyuan Zhuo,Shaohua Zhang,Yuan Lin,Pinyan Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过在MoE层输出上训练稀疏自编码器，将隐变量激活精确分解到各专家，量化专家的"贡献"而非"被选择频率"，揭示专家专业化远比门控统计更集中，且存在粗粒度域之下的细分分工。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE专家分析依赖在领域标注语料上统计专家被选中频率，该手段预先固定分类体系、粒度粗糙，且只记录路由选择而非实际贡献，难以刻画专家真正负责什么。

Method: 在MoE层输出上训练SAE；由于该输出是路由加权的专家输出之和、SAE编码器为仿射，每个隐变量的预激活可精确分解为各专家分量；语料聚合后为每个专家得到其主导驱动的隐变量集合（dominant set），并分析主导集重叠与自动解释。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B第4、30、46层上，专家贡献分布远比门控分布集中，多数隐变量仅有1–2个主导专家，主导集重叠集中于少数专家对；自动解释显示存在Java与前端Web代码、几何与算术多项式等粗域之下的分工，而各粗域占用的专家数极不均衡。

Conclusion: 以"贡献"为核心的SAE分解方法能更细粒度、数据驱动地刻画MoE专家专业化，优于预定义领域的门控统计；作者开源SAE与代码。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many experts, yet what an individual expert is responsible for remains unsettled. Existing analyses count how often an expert is selected on domain-labeled corpora, an instrument that fixes the taxonomy in advance, stays coarse, and records selection rather than contribution. We instead study specialization in feature space by training a sparse autoencoder (SAE) on the output of an MoE layer. Since this output is a router-weighted sum of expert outputs and the SAE encoder is affine, the pre-activation of every latent decomposes exactly over the experts. Aggregated over a corpus, this gives each expert a dominant set of latents whose activation it principally drives. On layers 4, 30 and 46 of Qwen3-30B-A3B, contribution is far more concentrated than gating, most latents have only one or two dominators, and the overlap between dominant sets concentrates on a few expert pairs. Auto-interpreting these sets reveals a division of labor below coarse domains, with distinct experts for Java and front-end web code, or for geometry and for arithmetic and polynomials, while the coarse domains themselves take very unequal numbers of experts. Our SAEs and code are available at https://github.com/Bytedance-Seed/SAE-Interprets-MoE.

</details>


### [284] [Gradient Boosting for Efficient Rank Discovery in Tensor Network Kernel Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08093)
*Albert Saiapin,Kim Batselier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GB-CPKM：以梯度提升方式顺序叠加固定秩CP张量网络学习器，用验证集选择集成规模替代显式秩搜索，兼顾性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量网络核机（TNKM）结合非线性特征与低秩张量表示以高效建模复杂关系，但张量秩的选取困难：传统秩搜索需训练多个候选模型，计算开销大。

Method: 采用CP（CANDECOMP/PARAFAC）张量网络参数化；构建梯度提升框架，通过顺序添加固定秩的基学习器来累积提升模型容量；将“秩选择”转化为“集成规模选择”，基于验证集性能确定提升轮数，而非显式秩搜索。

Result: 在真实回归基准上，相比基于交叉验证的传统秩选择方法，GB-CPKM训练速度最高快6倍、峰值内存最高降低2倍，同时取得可比的预测性能。

Conclusion: 梯度提升可有效提升张量网络学习的计算效率与可扩展性，为秩选择问题提供了规避显式搜索的新思路。

Abstract: Tensor network kernel machines (TNKMs) combine nonlinear features with low-rank tensor representations to model complex relationships efficiently. However, selecting an appropriate tensor rank remains challenging, as conventional rank-search methods require training multiple candidate models, increasing computational costs. In this work, we focus on a canonical polyadic (CP) tensor network parameterization and propose GB-CPKM, a gradient boosting framework that builds a higher-capacity predictor by sequentially adding fixed-rank learners. This approach provides a new perspective on rank selection by incrementally increasing model capacity, with ensemble size selected based on validation performance rather than through explicit rank search. Experiments on real-world regression benchmarks show that GB-CPKM trains up to 6x faster and uses up to 2x less peak memory than a conventional rank-selection method based on cross-validation, while achieving comparable predictive performance. These results highlight the potential of gradient boosting to improve the computational efficiency and scalability of tensor-network learning.

</details>


### [285] [PersonaAgent: Retrieval-Augmented Transaction Anomaly Scoring with Refreshable Multi-Entity Persona Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08094)
*Zhengyu Fang,Liang Wang,Yingtong Dou,Yuzhong Chen,Shubham Jain,Junpeng Wang,Xiran Fan,Menghai Pan,Jiarui Sun,Yan Zheng,Yiwei Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PersonaAgent 是一个面向大规模支付网络的智能体式交易异常检测框架：将实体的最新行为信号表示为 persona 并存入可刷新的记忆库，离线每周批量更新，在线由轻量适配器检索并增强基础异常分类器的打分。在 Visa 的实验中，CPU 上 1000 笔交易批处理仅需 1-2 ms，PR-AUC 相对提升 0.65-6.58%，生产业务指标相对提升 8.93-14.24%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模支付网络中，实体（卡、商户等）及其交互对交易异常检测至关重要，但存在两个问题：1）实体间交易模式的变化频率通常快于生产模型的刷新周期，导致模型滞后；2）实体嵌入表面临高基数与交互稀疏的问题，难以有效学习与更新。

Method: 提出 PersonaAgent 框架：1）将实体的最新行为信号抽象为 persona，存入可刷新的记忆库（refreshable memory）；2）离线侧由每周调度的批处理任务抽取最新行为信号并更新记忆；3）推理侧由轻量适配器（lightweight adapter）针对每笔交易检索对应实体的行为信号，用于增强基础异常分类器的打分，而非替换或重训基模型。

Result: 在 Visa 上与多种异常检测模型进行综合基准测试：推理效率高，1000 笔交易的 CPU 批处理耗时 1-2 ms；PR-AUC 相对提升 0.65-6.58%；部署后生产业务指标相对提升 8.93-14.24%。

Conclusion: 通过将实体行为信号外置为可增量刷新的 persona 记忆，并配合轻量检索增强，PersonaAgent 在不改动基分类器的前提下缓解了模式漂移与高基数稀疏嵌入问题，兼顾高效推理与线上收益，具备实际生产部署价值。

Abstract: In large-scale payment networks, entities (card, merchant, etc.) and their interactions play a key role in transaction anomaly detection. However, transaction patterns between different entities usually change more frequently than the production model refresh schedule. Meanwhile, entity embedding tables suffer from high-cardinality and sparse interaction issues. To resolve the above challenges, we present PersonaAgent, an agentic transaction anomaly detection framework which represents the latest entity behavior signals as personas and saves them in a refreshable memory. Offline, a weekly scheduled batch job is used to extract the latest behavior signals and update them in the memory. At inference time, a lightweight adapter retrieves the corresponding entity behavior signals of each transaction from memory and uses them to augment the base anomaly classifier's scoring. Through comprehensive benchmarking with different anomaly detection models at Visa, PersonaAgent is able to score transactions efficiently (a 1,000-transaction CPU batch in 1-2 ms), lifting the PR-AUC by 0.65-6.58% and the production business metric by 8.93-14.24% relatively in deployment.

</details>


### [286] [How Far Can Untrained Neural Networks Go in Anomaly Detection? From Tables to Pixels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08136)
*Hyojun Yi,Geunyoung Kim,Hogeon Seo,Seunghyoung Ryu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PRISM框架，用固定随机非线性特征＋基于正常参考的Mahalanobis打分实现异常检测，无需训练权重或预训练表征，在47个表格数据集与27个视觉类别的基准上均达竞争性性能，并可作为评估学习表征增益的"学习前基线"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流观点将异常检测视为表征学习问题，依赖学习特征或AD专用优化；但该视角可能忽视异常与正常参考之间的内在可分性，即使没有学习表征也可分离。因此作者探究未训练神经网络在AD中的能力上限。

Method: PRISM框架：将固定随机非线性特征与基于正常参考的Mahalanobis打分相结合；PRISM-T用于表格检测，PRISM-V用于稠密视觉定位。全程无神经权重优化、无预训练表征。辅以理论分析（刻画非线性变换如何影响Mahalanobis分数差的均值与协方差贡献）与实证分数可分性分析。

Result: ADBench 47个表格数据集上，PRISM-T取得最高平均AUROC（86.4%）与第二高平均AUPRC（65.9%）；MVTec AD与VisA共27个视觉类别上，PRISM-V图像级与像素级平均AUROC分别为90.4%与96.4%。

Conclusion: PRISM既是具竞争力的异常检测器，也为衡量学习表征在AD中带来的增量价值提供了"先于学习"的基线。

Abstract: Anomaly detection (AD) is often framed as a representation-learning problem, where strong performance is expected to require learned features or AD-specific optimization. However, this view can overlook the intrinsic separability of anomalies from normal references, even in the absence of learned representations. We therefore investigate how far untrained neural networks can go in anomaly detection. To this end, we propose PRISM, a framework combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring for tabular detection and dense visual localization. Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods. On MVTec AD and VisA, covering 27 visual categories, PRISM-V achieves mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively. Notably, both models achieve these results without neural weight optimization or pretrained representations. A theoretical analysis further characterizes how nonlinear transformations affect the mean and covariance contributions to the Mahalanobis score gap, while empirical analyses examine the resulting score separability. These findings establish PRISM as both a competitive anomaly detector and a prior-to-learning baseline for assessing the added value of learned representations in anomaly detection.

</details>


### [287] [Detecting Weather Fronts from Satellite Observations: What Does Reanalysis Add?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08148)
*Ioannis Dravilas,Miruna Stoicescu,Roope Tervo,Carlos Horn,Oriol Hinojo Comellas,Sina Montazeri,Andrea Meraner,Ana Lucic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究比较了纯静止卫星红外观测与叠加28个ERA5再分析场的两种机器学习配置在北太平洋—欧洲区域逐像元锋面分类中的表现，卫星+ERA5模型CSI@150达0.575，较纯卫星模型的0.402提升0.173。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天气锋面对中纬度降水和强天气有重要指示意义，作者希望评估机器学习检测锋面的可行性，并量化再分析数据对检测性能的贡献。

Method: 采用同一ML模型两种配置做逐像元锋面分类：(1)仅用静止红外卫星观测；(2)额外加入28个ERA5再分析场；以150 km容差的邻域临界成功指数(CSI@150)评价，并开展变量可预测性(R²)与消融分析。

Result: 纯卫星模型CSI@150为0.402，处于不同气象机构分析间的一致范围内；卫星+ERA5模型为0.575，提升0.173。低层风最难由卫星表征预测(R²=0.23，温度R²=0.88)，移除风或湿度导致检测性能下降最大。

Conclusion: ML可仅凭卫星观测实现接近机构间一致水平的锋面检测，再分析场尤其是低层风与湿度信息对性能提升贡献最大。

Abstract: Weather fronts are transition regions between air masses with contrasting thermodynamic properties and are associated with mid-latitude precipitation and severe weather. We investigate machine learning (ML) methods for detecting weather fronts and quantify the contribution of reanalysis data to performance. We compare two configurations of the same ML model for pixel-wise frontal classification over the North Atlantic and Europe: (1) using only geostationary infrared satellite observations, and (2) additionally using 28 ERA5 reanalysis fields. The satellite-only model achieves a neighbourhood critical success index at a 150 km tolerance (CSI@150) of $0.402$, which lies within the range of agreement between analyses from different meteorological services. The satellite$+$ERA5 model achieves $0.575$, an improvement of $0.173$. Our analysis shows that low-level winds are the least predictable from the satellite representation ($R^2 = 0.23$, compared with $0.88$ for temperature), while removing winds or moisture causes the largest decreases in detection performance.

</details>


### [288] [Interpretable Multimodal MRI-Clinical Fusion for Functional Outcome Prediction After Acute Ischemic Stroke](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08154)
*Sina Raeisadigh,Henning Müller,Abderrahmane Hedjoudje*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估第1天多模态MRI对急性缺血性卒中（AIS）三个月功能预后的增量预测价值，发现FLAIR-临床融合模型表现最佳（AUC=0.948±0.061）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究第1天多模态MRI（ADC、DWI、FLAIR）在临床变量之外能否为AIS三个月功能预后提供增量、互补的预测信息，并实现可解释且数据高效的结果预测。

Method: 纳入66例具ADC、DWI、FLAIR及临床数据的AIS患者；对各MRI模态提取三维预训练ResNet嵌入，经按折隔离的主成分分析降维，再与结构化临床变量及ADC衍生病灶生物标志物结合；采用线性SVM，并以八折分层分组交叉验证评估各MRI模态组合。

Result: 仅临床模型表现强（AUC=0.899±0.151），仅MRI模型判别力有限（AUC≈0.67–0.73）；FLAIR-临床融合交叉验证均值最高（AUC=0.948±0.061），ADC-临床次之（0.941±0.094）；完整ADC-DWI-FLAIR融合未稳定优于单模态临床融合。特征重要性显示年龄、NIHSS亚项、ADC病灶负荷及学习到的FLAIR表征为主要贡献者，且FLAIR激活图谱大致对应病灶样区域。

Conclusion: 紧凑的第1天FLAIR与ADC表征可在临床变量之外提供互补预后信息，支持AIS中可解释、数据高效的结局预测。

Abstract: This study evaluates the added prognostic value of day-1 multimodal MRI for predicting three-month functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke (AIS). Sixty-six AIS patients with ADC, DWI, FLAIR, and clinical data were analyzed. Three-dimensional pretrained ResNet embeddings were extracted from each MRI modality, reduced using fold-isolated principal component analysis, and combined with structured clinical variables and ADC-derived lesion biomarkers. Linear support vector machines were evaluated using eight-fold stratified group cross-validation across MRI modality combinations. Clinical-only modeling achieved strong performance (AUC = $0.899 \pm 0.151$), while MRI-only models showed limited discrimination (AUC $\approx$ $0.67$-$0.73$). Among multimodal configurations, FLAIR-clinical fusion achieved the highest mean cross-validated performance (AUC = $0.948 \pm 0.061$), followed by ADC-clinical fusion (AUC = $0.941 \pm 0.094$). Full ADC-DWI-FLAIR fusion did not consistently outperform single-modality clinical fusion. Feature-importance analysis identified age, NIHSS subscores, ADC lesion burden, and learned FLAIR representations as key contributors, while qualitative FLAIR activation maps showed responses over lesion-like regions. These findings suggest that compact day-1 FLAIR and ADC representations provide complementary prognostic information beyond clinical variables and support interpretable, data-efficient outcome prediction in AIS.

</details>


### [289] [BUMP: Brief Unexpected Mid-Interpolation Peak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08182)
*Melinda Flóra Kiss,Márton Muntag,Adrián Csiszárik,Dániel Varga*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现对置换对齐网络做线性插值时，测试精度在接近端点处出现短暂提升、向中点下降的现象，命名为 BUMP；该现象跨数据集/架构/训练范式稳定出现且对早期检查点、极端剪枝鲁棒，非平凡正则化所致。基于此提出"权重预测混合集成"（weight-prediction mixed ensembling），在精度与校准上优于标准 logit 集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前大量工作研究置换对齐后的权重插值（线性模式连通性），但插值路径上接近端点的精度增益虽在已有曲线中隐约可见，却未被显式记录与系统分析；作者希望刻画这一现象并挖掘其实际价值。

Method: 1) 在置换对齐（permutation-aligned）网络上做线性插值并密集测量测试精度，识别 BUMP 现象；2) 通过跨数据集、跨架构、跨训练范式的实验验证普遍性，并用早期检查点、极端剪枝等强扰动检验鲁棒性；3) 用受控消融排除平凡正则化解释；4) 提出将权重空间混合与预测空间混合结合的集成方案。

Result: BUMP 在多种数据集、架构与训练设置下稳定出现，并在早期检查点与极端剪枝等扰动下保持；受控消融表明其不能归因于简单正则化效应。所提集成方法在实验中一致优于标准 logit 集成，并取得更好的精度-校准权衡。

Conclusion: BUMP 是一种被长期忽视但普遍存在的插值端点现象，具有鲁棒性；利用它可构造简单新颖的权重-预测混合集成，说明权重空间与预测空间混合具有互补收益。

Abstract: We identify an intriguing phenomenon when linearly interpolating between permutation-aligned neural networks: test accuracy briefly improves near the interpolation endpoints before dropping toward the midpoint, which we term BUMP (Brief Unexpected Mid-interpolation Peak). We observe that BUMP appears consistently across datasets, architectures, training regimes, and remains robust under substantial perturbations such as early checkpoints and extreme pruning. Moreover, controlled ablations suggest that it cannot be attributed to trivial regularization effects. While similar near-endpoint gains are visible in prior interpolation plots, they have not been explicitly documented or systematically and thoroughly analyzed. Leveraging this effect, we propose a simple, novel ensembling scheme: weight-prediction mixed ensembling that combines weight mixing with prediction-space mixing. Across our experiments, the resulting ensembling method consistently outperforms standard logit ensembling in test accuracy and yields improved calibration trade-off, highlighting complementary benefits of weight- and prediction-space mixing.

</details>


### [290] [Beyond Quadratic Attention: Separable Gaussian Operators for ODE Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08236)
*Carlos Boned Riera,David Romero Sanchez,Oriol Ramos Terrades*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SSoG（可分离高斯和）空间算子，用轴因子化高斯核混合替代稠密自注意力，将单层成本由O(N²)降至次二次，并在离散、权重共享和连续深度Transformer中同时提升精度、参数效率与高分辨率吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自注意力相对于token数呈二次成本，限制了ViT随输入分辨率的扩展；同时点积注意力的Lipschitz常数在紧输入域外无界，导致连续深度（Neural ODE）变体缺乏全局存在唯一性保证。

Method: SSoG是可分离的和-高斯空间算子：以学习的轴因子化高斯核混合（在H、W两个方向上分别分解）替代稠密自注意力，把每层复杂度从O(N²)降到关于N的次二次。固定核下的SSoG具有全局Lipschitz连续性，结合Picard–Lindelöf定理可证连续深度变体在整个积分区间上解唯一。

Result: CIFAR-100@224×224：在匹配的离散Transformer与连续深度设定下，三种模型宽度下Top-1提升2.2–4.1点，参数减少8.8–16.6%（深度与训练配方固定）；looped-Transformer设定下Top-1提升5.4–8.1点。推理时扩展到1024×1024（相同batch size）：连续深度（Neural ODE）架构中吞吐最高提升154%、峰值显存降低超60%，且差距随分辨率增大而扩大；离散与looped设定下该分辨率吞吐亦提升超30%。

Conclusion: SSoG是实用、参数高效且有理论保障的稠密注意力替代方案，适用于离散、权重共享与连续深度三类Transformer变体。

Abstract: Self-attention carries a quadratic cost in token count, which limits how far Vision Transformers can scale with input resolution. We introduce SSoG, a separable sum-of-Gaussians spatial operator that replaces dense self-attention with a learned mixture of axis-factorized Gaussian kernels, reducing the per-layer cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ to subquadratic in $N$. Unlike dot-product self-attention, whose Lipschitz constant is unbounded outside a compact input domain, SSoG with fixed kernels is globally Lipschitz continuous, which, via the Picard--Lindelöf theorem, guarantees that the continuous-depth variant has a unique solution on the whole integration interval, a global guarantee that dense-attention counterparts lack in general. On CIFAR-100 at $224\times224$, in a matched discrete-Transformer setting and in the continuous setting, SSoG improves Top-1 accuracy by 2.2--4.1 points across three model widths while using 8.8--16.6\% fewer parameters, with depth and training recipe held fixed. In a looped-Transformer setting, SSoG improves Top-1 accuracy by 5.4--8.1 points. We further probe inference-time scaling by evaluating on inputs up to $1024\times1024$ at matched batch size: in the continuous-depth (Neural ODE) architecture, SSoG reaches up to 154\% higher throughput and over 60\% lower peak memory than dense attention, with the gap widening as resolution grows, consistent with the difference in asymptotic cost. In the discrete and looped settings, SSoG also achieves over 30\% higher throughput than dense attention at this resolution. Together, these results establish SSoG as a practical, parameter-efficient, and theoretically grounded alternative to dense attention across discrete, weight-shared, and continuous-depth Transformer variants.

</details>


### [291] [Do sEMG Foundation Models Improve Cross-Subject Generalisation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08199)
*William Raftery,Dario Farina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了三个sEMG基础模型在三个手势分类数据集上、会话内与跨被试划分下的表现，发现预训练仅在会话内评估中有增益，在跨被试验证下增益基本消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有sEMG基础模型评估难以区分预训练本身是否足以缓解该领域最关键的跨被试过拟合问题，因此需要一个能隔离预训练贡献的受控评估框架。

Method: 对三个sEMG基础模型、三个手势分类数据集，在会话内（intra-session）与跨被试（inter-subject）两种划分下，采用三种旨在隔离预训练贡献的微调策略进行系统评估，并引入经典机器学习基线对照。

Result: 当训练与测试样本来自同一记录会话时，预训练带来性能提升；但在跨被试评估下该增益基本消失。在被试数量较少的数据集上，预训练几乎无收益，经典ML基线可持平或超越基础模型。

Conclusion: 现有sEMG基础模型的预训练收益主要体现在会话内泛化，而非真正解决跨被试泛化；未来需针对跨被试场景改进预训练范式，且在小样本被试设定下经典方法仍是强基线。

Abstract: sEMG Foundation Models aim to learn general purpose representations over diverse subjects and recording conditions that boost performance on a variety of downstream tasks. However, existing evaluations make it difficult to discern whether pretraining alone is sufficient to combat the cross-subject overfitting which makes machine learning on sEMG so challenging. We conduct a systematic evaluation of three sEMG foundation models across three gesture classification datasets under both intra-session and inter-subject splits, using three fine-tuning strategies designed to isolate the contribution of pretraining. We find that pretraining boosts performance when train and test samples are drawn from the same recording session, but this benefit largely disappears under inter-subject evaluation. In low subject count datasets, pretraining provides little to no benefit and classical ML baselines match or exceed foundation model performance.

</details>


### [292] [FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08240)
*Haitao Lin,Minsi Ren,Yang Li,Xingtong Ge,Zheyuan Hu,Peiyan Hu,Tailin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地将主流扩散模型强化学习（RL）目标适配到少步（few-step）模型，通过"变换—分解—适配"三阶段框架统一了 FlowGRPO、AWM、DiffusionNFT、DiffusionOPSD 与 ReFL 的少步版本，并给出不同奖励条件下的方法选择建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RL 后训练目标在处理多步采样器时，每次迭代都需对当前策略做 rollout，而多步采样使 rollout 成为训练成本的主要来源。少步模型虽能降低该成本，但其建模的是区间上的平均速度，而现有 RL 目标基于瞬时速度与多步采样器构建，二者不匹配。

Method: 提出三阶段适配：(1) 变换到 x-space，将各目标统一用共同策略预测表达，默认在洁净端、过渡/flow-map 目标在显式标注层级，使基于密度、速度或奖励的目标可比；(2) 分解，将各目标梯度写成"向参考的自回归"与"奖励增强"之和，使方法在梯度层面归结为锚点与权重的选择；(3) 适配，从少步模型传输末端或沿切线计算锚点，瞬时速度由网络自身或辅助网络恢复。据此在统一模块化代码库中实现五种方法的少步版本。

Result: 实验表明：当奖励可微且梯度可负担时，基于奖励梯度的方法最有效；否则 DiffusionNFT 类方法通常能在较少迭代内达到较高奖励，尽管单次迭代成本有时更高。额外推理步数在总体聚合上无系统性收益，但部分输出在采样步数为训练时 2–4 倍时可见改善。

Conclusion: 少步模型可有效承接 RL 目标，关键在于将瞬时速度语义经 x-space 变换与梯度分解后正确适配到区间平均速度；方法选择应依奖励可微性而定，且推理阶段单纯增加采样步数并不带来系统性总体收益。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard post-training method for diffusion models, but most RL objectives roll out the current policy at every iteration, and with a many-step sampler these rollouts typically dominate the cost of training. Few-step models cut this cost, yet they model an average velocity over an interval, whereas existing RL objectives are built for an instantaneous velocity with a many-step sampler. We adapt RL objectives to few-step models systematically in three phases, namely a transformation, a decomposition and an adaptation. The transformation to $x$-space expresses each objective we consider through a common policy prediction, at the clean end by default and at an explicitly marked level for transition or flow-map objectives, so that objectives stated over densities, velocities or rewards become comparable. The decomposition writes the gradient of each of these objectives as the sum of a self-regression toward a reference and a reward augmentation, so that a method reduces, at the gradient level, to a choice of anchors and weights. The adaptation computes each anchor from a few-step model at the end of its transport or along its tangent, with the instantaneous velocity recovered from the network itself or from an auxiliary network. This yields few-step versions of FlowGRPO, AWM, DiffusionNFT, DiffusionOPSD and ReFL in one modular codebase. In our experiments, reward-gradient-based methods are the most effective when the reward is differentiable and its gradient is affordable; otherwise DiffusionNFT-style methods generally reach high rewards in relatively few iterations despite a sometimes higher per-iteration cost. Extra inference steps show no systematic aggregate benefit in our experiments, although selected outputs visibly improve with two to four times as many sampling steps as in training.

</details>


### [293] [Geometric Relevance Is Not Sufficient: Evaluating Focused Post-Training Supervision in Diffusion Docking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08249)
*Michael Brown,Maryam Rahimimovassagh,Mehdi Yazdani-Jahromi,Sanjeda Sara Jennifer,Ivan Garibay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在固定训练预算下，对 DiffDock 比较"广泛继续训练"与"聚焦式监督"（按笛卡尔后果或条件目标一致性加权），结果表明广泛继续训练在 Top-1 成功率上最优，聚焦或混合监督无稳定收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式分子对接需在较宽的破坏（corruption）分布上学习校正得分场，但单个姿态误差的结构后果差异很大。这形成后训练阶段的冲突：是保持得分场的广泛覆盖，还是将监督集中于看似更影响对接几何的校正。论文旨在检验这一权衡是否真实存在。

Method: 以 DiffDock 为基础开展固定预算的对照研究，比较四类策略：广泛继续训练、以笛卡尔后果为重点的扭转监督、以条件目标一致性为重点的监督，以及广泛/聚焦混合监督。评估分四个维度解耦：固定得分保真度、生成姿态质量、best-of-10 采样能力、以及基于置信度选择的 Top-1 对接性能。

Result: 在 <5 Å 阈值下，广泛继续训练在所有已训练策略中取得最高平均 Top-1 成功率；聚焦与混合监督在所测预算下均无一致优势。起始模型具有更好的固定得分保真度，而评估的广泛继续训练模型在相同总体 best-of-10 恢复率下取得更高平均 Top-1 成功率。

Conclusion: 将监督集中于结构上更具后果或指定更一致的校正，并不能稳定优于广泛继续训练对返回姿态成功率的提升；得分保真度与 Top-1 成功率之间存在解耦，说明后训练中"聚焦监督"的直觉收益在固定预算下未获证据支持。

Abstract: Diffusion-based molecular docking requires learning a corrective score field across a broad corruption distribution, yet individual pose errors can differ substantially in their structural consequences. This creates a post-training conflict between preserving broad score-field coverage and concentrating supervision on corrections that appear more relevant to docking geometry. Using DiffDock, a fixed-budget study compares broad continuation with torsional supervision focused on Cartesian consequence or conditional target consistency, and with a broad/focused mixture. Evaluation separates fixed score fidelity, generated-pose quality, best-of-10 sampling capacity, and confidence-selected Top-1 docking performance. At <5 Angstrom, broad continuation had the highest mean Top-1 success among trained policies, and focused or mixed supervision showed no consistent advantage under the tested budget. The starting model had better fixed score fidelity, whereas the evaluated broad-continuation model had higher mean Top-1 success with the same aggregate best-of-10 recovery. Focusing supervision on structurally consequential or more consistently specified corrections did not consistently improve returned-pose success over broad continuation.

</details>


### [294] [Nowcasting of Tropical Cyclone Wind Fields and Intensity from Geostationary Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08255)
*Simon Donike,Pritthijit Nath,Cristina Radin,Arthur Avenas,Ruben Cartuyvels,Emiliano Diaz,William K. Jones,Anna Jungbluth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用简单神经网络从静止卫星云图预测热带气旋二维风场与风暴尺度强度指标，消融实验表明在模型隐空间联合预测二维场与标量指标能改善最大风速(半径)的反演，对快速增强事件尤其明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR反演的高分辨率海面风场可支撑风暴结构与强度建模，但时空稀疏且无法近实时获取；静止卫星可连续观测云顶却无法直接反演海面风。因此需建立从静止卫星影像到海面风场的映射。

Method: 构建简单的神经网络，以静止卫星影像为输入，从模型隐空间同时输出二维风场与风暴尺度标量强度指标(最大风速及其半径)；并通过一系列消融实验评估联合预测策略的作用。

Result: 联合预测二维场与标量指标相比单独预测提升了最大风速及最大风速半径的反演精度，在快速增强事件上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 在隐空间进行多任务联合预测是提升静止卫星反演热带气旋风场与强度指标的有效且简洁的策略，尤其有利于快速增强情形的监测。

Abstract: High-resolution tropical cyclone surface wind speeds derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations can support storm structure and intensity modelling, but remain spatially and temporally sparse and unavailable near-real-time. Geostationary satellites capture cloud tops continuously in space and time, but do not directly resolve surface winds. Here, we present simple neural networks to predict 2D wind fields and storm-scale intensity metrics from geostationary imagery. Through a series of ablation studies, we find that joint prediction of 2D fields and scalar metrics from the model latent space improves the retrieval of the (radius of) maximum wind, especially for rapid intensification events.

</details>


### [295] [Scaling Neural Motor Decoding via Decoupled Behavioral Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08263)
*Divyansha Lachi,Vinam Arora,Shivashriganesh P. Mahato,Alexandre Andre,Eva L. Dyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BEEMO 是一个可多会话训练的神经解码框架，通过将行为表征学习与神经表征学习解耦，支持任意比例配对神经-行为数据与未配对行为数据的混合训练，从而以低成本的行为数据规模化提升解码与跨任务迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经解码方法依赖大规模配对神经-行为记录进行训练，但这类数据采集昂贵、具侵入性且难以规模化；而行为数据丰富且易采集。因此作者提出疑问：能否将行为表征学习与神经表征学习解耦，使神经解码从大量未配对行为数据中获益。

Method: 提出 BEEMO 多会话灵活框架：行为解码器直接从行为轨迹中学习运动动力学；当存在神经活动时，通过交叉注意力层将神经活动注入行为解码器，使行为监督与神经监督可独立扩展。框架支持任意混合的配对神经-行为数据与未配对行为数据，并支持仅行为预训练。

Result: 在多个非人灵长类皮层内运动数据集与任务上，引入未配对行为数据提升了��码性能，尤其在迁移到新任务时更明显；加入少量目标任务的配对行为数据可进一步改善迁移。仅用行为预训练（无任何神经预训练）的模型性能可与在更大神经数据集上预训练的模型相当。

Conclusion: 通过解耦神经与行为数据，开辟了新的规模化维度：未配对行为数据显著更廉价易得，可直接用于提升解码性能。规模化行为数据是通向跨个体、跨任务泛化神经解码模型的实用且高性价比路径。

Abstract: Recent neural decoding approaches achieve strong performance by training on large collections of paired neural-behavioral recordings, but such datasets are expensive, invasive, and difficult to scale. In contrast, behavioral data is abundant and easy to collect, raising the question of whether neural decoding can benefit from decoupling behavioral and neural representation learning. We introduce BEEMO, a flexible multi-session framework that enables training with arbitrary mixtures of paired neural-behavioral recordings and unpaired behavioral data. A behavior decoder learns movement dynamics directly from behavioral trajectories, while neural activity is incorporated through cross-attention layers when available, allowing behavioral and neural supervision to scale independently. Across multiple intracortical motor datasets and tasks in nonhuman primates, we show that incorporating unpaired behavioral data improves decoding performance, particularly when transferring to new tasks, and that adding even a small amount of behavioral data from the target task further improves transfer. By decoupling neural and behavioral data, we unlock a new dimension for scaling: unpaired behavioral data, which is substantially cheaper and easier to collect than paired neural recordings, can be used directly to improve decoding performance. We further show that behavior-only pretraining, without any neural pretraining, achieves performance comparable to models pretrained on substantially larger neural datasets. Together, our results suggest that scaling behavioral data offers a practical and cost-effective path toward neural decoding models that generalize across subjects and tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/nerdslab/beemo.

</details>


### [296] [Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning with Massive Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08273)
*Joonyoung Lim,Younghwan Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将大规模并行训练(众多环境、短rollout)与CMDP的整回合成本约束对齐：把错峰重置视为短轨迹段的相位混合分布，提出相位聚合成本估计器重建回合级成本，并结合有限样本不确定性与分布失配做约束收紧，在MJX版Safety Gym上取得与非大规模并行相当的性能，同时大幅降低墙钟训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模并行训练提升了数据吞吐与墙钟效率，但短rollout与CMDP中"整回合成本回报"定义的安全约束不匹配，直接沿用会产生偏差，制约safe RL的可扩展性。

Method: 1) 将错峰环境重置建模为短轨迹段上的相位混合分布，刻画相位覆盖不足导致的估计偏差；2) 据此提出相位聚合(phase-aggregated)成本估计器，从短rollout批次重建回合级成本估计；3) 将有限样本不确定性与分布失配纳入约束收紧框架，形成兼容on-policy优化的可扩展Safe RL方法；4) 基于MJX实现Safety Gym进行实验。

Result: 实验表明所提方法性能与非大规模并行实现相当，同时显著减少墙钟训练时间。

Conclusion: 通过对相位混合分布的偏差分析与回合级成本重建，可在保持安全约束语义的前提下实现大规模并行Safe RL，兼顾性能与训练效率。

Abstract: We investigate the problem of scaling safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) to massively parallel training regimes, where a large number of environments are exe- cuted with short rollout horizons. Although this setting improves data throughput and wall-clock efficiency, it creates a mismatch with constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), whose safety constraints are defined over full-episode cost returns. We address this mismatch by analyzing staggered environment resets as a phase-mixture distribution over short trajectory segments. This analysis charac- terizes the bias induced by phase coverage and motivates a phase-aggregated cost estimator that reconstructs episode-level cost estimates from short rollout batches. We further incorporate finite-sample uncertainty and distribution mismatch into a constraint-tightening framework, yielding a scalable Safe RL method compatible with on-policy optimization. Using an MJX-based implementation of Safety Gym, our experiments show that the proposed method achieves performance comparable to non-massively parallel implementations while substantially reducing wall-clock training time.

</details>


### [297] [AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08290)
*Sheldon Liang,Ali Taghibakhshi,Saurav Muralidharan,Sharath Turuvekere Sreenivas,Ashwath Aithal,Pavlo Molchanov,Nima Tajbakhsh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoCompress：将硬件/负载约束直接纳入可微架构搜索的剪枝框架，生成异构结构，在多个硬件上优于Minitron。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有剪枝流程以参数量为目标，需人工挑选满足延迟、吞吐和GPU显存限制的模型尺寸；但参数量无法预测这些指标，它们取决于架构、负载、硬件与推理引擎。

Method: 提出硬件引导的压缩框架AutoCompress，把延迟、吞吐、内存约束直接融入可微架构搜索（DARTS式），联合优化全局与逐层结构以得到异构架构；搜索由经端到端延迟、吞吐、显存实测校验的推理引擎代价模型引导。

Result: 在长上下文本地编码、批处理数据中心服务、时延敏感的游戏中交互三类场景评估。相比SOTA的Minitron，在RTX 5070、RTX 5080、H100上八项基准平均精度分别提升6.57、2.35、0.57个百分点；并将Nemotron 3.5 Super从120B压缩至74B，在单B200 BF16、128K上下文服务下保留95%平均基准分数。

Conclusion: 以硬件实测校准的代价模型驱动可微结构搜索，可在满足部署约束的同时取得优于以参数量为目标的剪枝方法的精度-效率折中。

Abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. We evaluate AutoCompress on long-context local coding, batched datacenter serving, and latency-sensitive in-game interaction. Compared to the state-of-the-art Minitron pruning framework, AutoCompress improves average accuracy across eight benchmarks by 6.57, 2.35, and 0.57 percentage points on RTX 5070, RTX 5080, and H100, respectively. AutoCompress also compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters for single-B200 BF16 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of its mean benchmark score.

</details>


### [298] [Dynamic Optimistic Constrained OCO with Memory via Delay Equivalence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08302)
*Mohammed Abdullah,George Iosifidis,Salah Eddine Elayoubi,Tijani Chahed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文首次系统研究带记忆与时变约束的在线凸优化框架COCO-M，提出乐观算法利用不可信预测，同时控制通用动态遗憾与累积约束违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: COCO-M框架能刻画有状态在线学习与非随机控制中的预算约束动态，表达能力强但研究不足；已有方法受限于函数可分性等强假设，且无法同时适应环境非平稳性与预测质量。

Method: 提出乐观算法融入不可信预测；核心分析采用"记忆到延迟"的归约，将状态依赖梯度视为延迟反馈，并针对带时变约束的延迟OCO建立独立结论。

Result: 给出首批同时适应路径长度P_T与预测精度的界，并放松函数可分性假设；最坏情况亚线性保证随预测精度提升，完美预测下遗憾达O(1)；CCV在未知P_T时为O(√T)，在已知或在线可观测P_T时为O(log T)，记忆消失时恢复COCO最优速率。

Conclusion: COCO-M可在一般设定下被有效求解，记忆到延迟归约与延迟时变约束OCO分析具有独立价值，为有状态在线学习与预算约束控制提供统一理论工具。

Abstract: Online Convex Optimization with memory and time-varying constraints (COCO-M) is a recently-introduced framework that captures the dynamics of stateful online learning and non-stochastic control with budget constraints. Despite its expressive power, COCO-M remains largely understudied. In this work, we tackle this problem in its full scale, providing an optimistic algorithm that incorporates untrusted predictions to tame universal dynamic regret and cumulative constraint violation. Our analysis leverages a potent reduction from memory to delay and treats state-dependent gradients as delayed feedback. We establish the first bounds that adapt to both environment non-stationarity (path length $P_T$) and prediction accuracy, while lifting previous restrictive assumptions such as functional separability. En route to these results, we derive findings of independent interest for the memory-to-delay reduction, and for delayed OCO with time-varying constraints. The proposed framework ensures sublinear worst-case guarantees that improve with prediction accuracy, reaching $\mathcal O(1)$ regret under perfect predictions, with cumulative constraint violation (CCV) $\mathcal O(\sqrt{T})$ for unknown $P_T$ and $\mathcal O(\log T)$ for known or online observable $P_T$ , while recovering the optimal COCO rates when memory disappears.

</details>


### [299] [Interpretable many-body interaction laws for collective motion from few trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08314)
*Timon S. Gutleb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出directional atomic cluster expansion (dACE)，将原子团簇展开(ACE)适配到自驱动个体，得到可系统改进、严格等变的加速度展开，唯一分解为1、2、3体及更高体相互作用项，并分离出自推进项；在模拟与真实鱼群数据上以更少数据逐阶恢复相互作用规律，优于SocialNet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 群体运动建模通常把社会交互简化为成对力，但实证证据表明存在多体效应；现有神经方法(如SocialNet)数据需求大、对多体或手性规则误差大、且受限于二维。

Method: 提出dACE：将原子间势的原子团簇展开(ACE)推广到自驱动个体，构造个体加速度的系统可改进、严格等变的展开，唯一分解为1、2、3体及更高体贡献；另设一项"自身项"拟合个体过去运动，并设计使其不吸收相互作用；在已知规则的二维/三维模拟群体及真实斑马鱼、金鳍鲹追踪数据上学习相互作用律。

Result: dACE用少量数据即可逐体阶恢复交互规律；SocialNet需更多数据，在多体或手性规则上误差更大且仅限2D；真实数据中dACE从数据两个不相交半集学到的规律一致性高于SocialNet；学习到的规律可解释，金鳍鲹中随邻域变密，3体项与成对响应方向相反；指出下一步预测精度主要反映自推进与噪声而非相互作用，并提出更稳健的误差度量组合。

Conclusion: dACE为群体运动交互学习提供了可解释、等变、可系统展开的框架，能有效识别多体效应；同时警示常规预测精度指标不足以评估相互作用学习，应改用更稳健的误差度量组合。

Abstract: Models of collective motion usually reduce social interactions to pairwise forces, despite empirical evidence for many-body effects. We introduce the directional atomic cluster expansion (dACE), which adapts the atomic cluster expansion (ACE) of interatomic potentials to self-propelled agents. dACE provides a systematically improvable, exactly equivariant expansion of an agent's acceleration that splits uniquely into 1-, 2-, 3-body and higher contributions, along with a self term for the agent's own past motion that is fitted so that it does not absorb the interactions. On simulated collectives in two and three dimensions with known rules, dACE recovers the interaction law body order by body order from little data, while the neural model SocialNet, the current closest competitor, needs more data, has much larger errors on many-body or chiral rules and is restricted to 2D. On real data sets of tracked zebrafish and golden shiners, the laws learned by dACE agree better between disjoint halves of the data than SocialNet's. The learned laws are interpretable, and in the shiners the 3-body term opposes the pairwise response as neighbourhoods get dense. Finally, we show that next-step prediction accuracy mostly measures self-propulsion and noise rather than the interactions, and suggest more robust combinations of error measures for interaction learning.

</details>


### [300] [Discovering Learning Rules that Shape Others](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08335)
*Hong Jun Lee,Ziyan Wang,Jun Wang,Stefanos Leonardos,Yali Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DUOS，首个在一般和博弈中通过元学习发现更新规则的方法，仅用自身经验即可实现对手塑造，无需访问对手策略或参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一般和博弈中自利学习者易陷入集体次优结果。LOLA、M-FOS等对手塑造方法虽能促成合作与利用，但部署时需访问对手参数、策略、奖励或学习规则，实用性受限；而单智能体领域元学习发现的更新规则（如DiscoRL）仅读取自身经验且性能优越，故将其扩展至一般和博弈场景。

Method: 提出Discovered Update Rule for Opponent Shaping (DUOS)：将元学习发现的更新规则框架推广至一般和博弈。DUOS以外层元训练最大化智能体生命周期内的期望回报为目标，内层用智能体自身经验更新网络，规则与策略分离，不读取对手信息。

Result: 发现的规则在不读取对手策略或参数的前提下表现出与对手塑造一致的行为；在锦标赛参赛者中，归一化平均得分排名第1，自博弈排名第1。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，DUOS是首个在一般和博弈中为智能体发现更新规则的方法，表明仅凭自身经验即可习得具备对手塑造能力的更新规则，为无需对手信息的对手塑造提供了新范式。

Abstract: In general-sum games, self-interested learners can reach outcomes that are poor for everyone, which has motivated methods that shape the opponent's learning. Methods like Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness (LOLA), which differentiates through the opponent's learning process, and Model-Free Opponent Shaping (M-FOS), which uses model-free optimisation methods for long-horizon opponent shaping, have enabled mutual cooperation and exploitation of learners. However, these methods require access to the opponent's parameters, policy, rewards or learning rule during deployment. In single-agent reinforcement learning, update rules discovered by meta-learning have achieved state-of-the-art results (e.g. DiscoRL). These rules are separate from the policy they train and read only the agent's own experience. We hereby extend this framework to general-sum settings by introducing Discovered Update Rule for Opponent Shaping (DUOS). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first method to discover an update rule for an agent in general-sum games. DUOS meta-trains the rule to maximise the agent's expected return over its lifetime, and updates an inner network using the agent's own experience. We show that our discovered rule exhibits behaviour consistent with opponent shaping without reading opponent policies or parameters, and ranks 1st in normalised mean score and 1st in self-play among tournament entrants.

</details>


### [301] [StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08363)
*Jake Hyun,Ziyu Zhao,Jae-sun Seo,Mohamed S. Abdelfattah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StrataFlux：通过协同设计"精化数据表示—选择—传输"，将主机RAM与SSD作为额外精度的来源，在保留低比特量化显存与速度优势的同时恢复精度损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理中量化可降低显存与带宽需求但损害精度；而卸载高精度数据又会阻塞生成、拖慢吞吐。论文试图打破"精度—显存—速度"这一权衡。

Method: 面向低比特权重与KV-cache量化，StrataFlux协同设计精化（refinement）数据的表示、选择与投递：选择性精度流式传输以减少传输量，将传输与计算重叠，并在多个解码步间复用已取回精度，使生成无需等待每次传输完成。在专用GPU与统一内存平台上评估2–4比特权重、2–3比特KV-cache。

Result: 2比特Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct权重下，WikiText-2困惑度由9.46降至8.40，RTX 5090上保持量化基线的95.4%吞吐；2比特权重+KV下Qwen3-8B在AIME 2024/2025准确率由11.0%升至47.1%且GPU显存不变；128K上下文下，3比特权重+2比特KV达到与vLLM 4比特AWQ权重+8比特KV相当的困惑度与速度，显存约减半。

Conclusion: GPU常驻精度不必决定精度上限，卸载层延迟也无需主导解码速度；低比特量化可在近无损精度与速度下实用化。

Abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on RTX 5090. With 2-bit weights and KV, StrataFlux raises Qwen3-8B's AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use. At 128K context, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with 3-bit weights and 2-bit KV achieves comparable perplexity and speed to vLLM's 4-bit AWQ weights and 8-bit KV on RTX 5090, using approximately half the GPU memory. These results show that GPU-resident precision need not set the accuracy ceiling, nor offloading-tier latency dictate decoding speed.

</details>


### [302] [Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08376)
*Tushaar Gangavarapu,Gil Tabak,Clemens JS Schaefer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Muir，通过低秩门控融合、匹配滤波读出与并行更新，在保持吞吐的同时显著提升线性注意力长上下文性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有门控 delta-rule 线性注意力（如 GDN-2）中，状态更新对擦除的敏感度远低于写入：key 激活与单位归一化使 key 能量集中于稀疏通道，而 value 写入作用于全部通道，因此擦除门可低秩化；同时慢衰减状态行范数远大于快衰减行，主导无权重读出并迫使写入时过度擦除以抑制干扰。

Method: 1) 将所有门融合为一个按敏感度分配的低秩投影；2) 用匹配滤波读出门对状态行重新加权；3) 将节省的参数重新投入更宽的前馈网络；4) 针对大 chunk 下标准分块算法数值不稳定问题，设计稳定的并行更新训练算法。

Result: 166M–1.34B 参数下，困惑度较 GDN-2 降低 1.8–2.0%、较 Transformer 降低 2.5–3.6%；常识准确率最高提升 1.9 点；抽取式召回优于 GDN-2；1.34B 下多跳与多针召回均超两个基线，从 4K 训练长度外推 2,560 倍至 10M token 流无困惑度漂移，静态读出下 1M token passkey 接近 100%。

Conclusion: Muir 在匹配 GDN-2 吞吐的同时，以 1.2 倍更快达到 100B token 验证损失，并在 32K 长度下训练比 Transformer 快 2.7 倍，实现了效率与长上下文能力的同时提升。

Abstract: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates. However, we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes: key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels, whereas value writes scale all channels, so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. Furthermore, slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms than fast rows, dominating unweighted readout and forcing stronger write-time erasure to suppress interference. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Muir, which fuses all gates into a sensitivity-allocated low-rank projection, re-weights state rows with a matched-filter readout gate, and reinvests the saved parameters in a wider feed-forward network. Because standard chunkwise algorithms become numerically unstable at the large chunk sizes needed to saturate wide matrix units, we design a parallel update for stable, efficient training. Across 166M-1.34B parameters, Muir lowers perplexity by 1.8-2.0% over GDN-2 and 2.5-3.6% over Transformer, raises commonsense accuracy by up to 1.9 points, and improves extractive recall over GDN-2. At 1.34B, Muir outperforms both baselines on multi-hop and multi-needle recall, extrapolates 2,560x from its 4K training length to 10M-token streams without perplexity drift, and maintains near-100% passkey retrieval to 1M tokens with static readout. Muir achieves these gains while matching GDN-2 throughput, reaching its 100B-token validation loss 1.2x faster, and training 2.7x faster than Transformer at 32K.

</details>


### [303] [Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08379)
*Guy Hadad,Haggai Roitman,Moshe Eliasof,Bracha Shapira*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GraphMuon，一种图感知优化器，将Muon的矩阵正交化更新适配到图传播输入表示的协方差几何上，缓解图诱导的更新放大，在OGB基准上实现1.32×–2.42×的验证损失到达目标的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化器对参数更新施加不同几何：Adam/AdamW采用逐坐标更新，Muon等矩阵感知方法利用权重矩阵结构进行正交化更新。但在GNN中，权重矩阵的有效几何不仅由可学习的通道混合权重决定，还受其作用的图传播表示影响。因此即使更新作为矩阵被良好归一化，作用到图传播特征上时仍可能被放大，形成"图诱导的更新放大"问题。

Method: GraphMuon在由传播表示定义的度量下执行正交化，即计算图传播层输入的协方差结构，在该度量下做极分解式更新；并按更新对层表示的诱导影响归一化步长，从而得到Muon极更新的"图度量类比"。理论分析表明原始Muon会遭受图诱导更新放大，而GraphMuon可缓解该效应。

Result: 在三个大规模OGB基准上，相对AdamW取得1.32×–2.42×的验证损失到达目标时间加速；在覆盖节点分类、归纳图分类与图回归的15种数据集-架构配置中，13种情况下到达目标时间更短，且预测性能保持相当或更优。

Conclusion: GNN优化应考虑图传播表示的几何结构；GraphMuon通过图度量下的正交化与感知表示影响的步长归一化，兼顾收敛速度与预测质量，为图学习提供了有效的优化器设计范式。

Abstract: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates. Adaptive methods such as Adam and AdamW use coordinate-wise updates, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon utilize weight-matrix structure through orthogonalized updates. For Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), however, the effective geometry of its weight matrices is shaped not only by its learned channel-mixing weights, but also by the graph-propagated representations it acts on. Thus, even if an update is well normalized as a matrix, its effect on the layer output can be amplified when applied to graph-propagated features. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that adapts Muon's matrix updates to the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs. GraphMuon performs orthogonalization in a metric defined by these propagated representations and normalizes step sizes according to the update's induced effect on the layer representation. We show that theoretically, vanilla Muon can suffer from graph-induced update amplification, while our GraphMuon can mitigate this effect. As such, our GraphMuon yields a graph-metric analogue of Muon's polar update step.
