Empirically, GraphMuon achieves $1.32\times$-$2.42\times$ validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks. Across 15 dataset-architecture configurations spanning node classification, inductive graph classification, and graph regression, it achieves lower time-to-target in 13 cases, while maintaining competitive or superior predictive performance. Code is available at https://github.com/guy-hadad/GraphMuon.

</details>


### [304] [Hybrid Machine Learning for Imbalanced Landing-Phase Safety Event Prediction from Flight Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08386)
*Taha Asghar,Bilal Mufti,Syed Qasim Zaheer,Luqman Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可解释混合特征融合框架，用LSTM自编码器重构误差+统计特征+类加权XGBoost预测着陆阶段多类安全事件，跨三个机场macro recall>0.90。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 着陆阶段安全事件预测需在强不平衡多元飞行数据中检测稀有异常进近，难点在于同时捕捉耦合的时间行为并区分不同机场运行情境下的事件特征。

Method: 在正常飞行窗口上训练LSTM自编码器以获得连续重构误差描述子，与参数特定的统计飞行历史特征融合，输入类加权XGBoost分类器，区分Normal、Speed High、Path High、Flaps Late四类；基于NASA DASHlink 53,750个进近窗口、三个到达机场，比较集中式与机场特定学习策略、组件基准、重复重训与特征归因分析。

Result: 重复划分与重训下各机场平均macro recall均超过0.90；组件对比表明类加权关键，连续特征融合优于仅用重构误差及硬门控方案；数据量较大的两个机场本地特化更优，最小数据集机场集中训练更优；特征归因指向垂直路径、构型、速度与进近情境等运行相关变量。

Conclusion: 该框架为稀有事件检测提供了可解释方法，并为依据机场级数据可得性调整飞行数据监测模型提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Landing-phase safety-event prediction requires the detection of rare abnormal approaches within strongly imbalanced multivariate flight data. Capturing coupled temporal behavior while distinguishing event-specific signatures across airport operating contexts remains a central modeling challenge. This study proposes an interpretable hybrid feature-fusion framework for multiclass landing-phase safety-event prediction. A long short-term memory (LSTM) autoencoder trained on nominal flight windows characterizes deviations from routine approach behavior. Its continuous reconstruction-error descriptor is fused with parameter-specific statistical flight-history features and supplied to a class-weighted XGBoost classifier to distinguish Normal, Speed High, Path High, and Flaps Late windows. The framework is evaluated using 53,750 NASA DASHlink approach windows from three arrival airports. Pooled and airport-specific learning strategies are compared alongside component-level benchmarks, repeated pipeline retraining, and feature-attribution analysis. The results demonstrate strong class-balanced detection, with mean macro recall above 0.90 across all airports under repeated partitioning and retraining. Component comparisons establish the importance of class weighting and show that continuous feature fusion outperforms reconstruction-error-only and hard-gate alternatives. Airport-level comparisons reveal benefits from local specialization at the two airports with larger datasets and from pooled training at the airport with the smallest dataset. Feature attributions associate predictions with operationally relevant vertical-path, configuration, speed, and approach-context variables. The framework provides an interpretable approach to rare-event detection and practical guidance for adapting flight-data monitoring models to airport-level data availability.

</details>


### [305] [Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08394)
*Déborah Boyenval,Alina Malyutina,Jaana Oikkonen,Sammeli Liikkanen,Sampsa Hautaniemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一个面向配对多组学合成数据的、生物学知情且患者不相交的评估框架，并在DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列上评估基于VAE的三种多组学整合架构生成RNA表达与CNV配对谱的保真度与模态间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 配对多组学癌症队列构建成本高、共享困难，合成队列成为有价值的补充资源；但生成模型研究多聚焦于提出新架构，缺乏判断合成数据是否保留生物学相关结构的评估标准。

Method: 构建生物学知情、按患者不相交划分的评估框架，以真实训练集与留出数据之间的一致性为参照，评估模态特异性保真度与RNA-CNV配对一致性，并辅以训练数据邻近性诊断；将三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构改造用于生成配对谱，在纵向DECIDER队列上开展案例研究。

Result: 在多项保真度与一致性指标上表现最佳的模型，同时具有最强的训练数据邻近性。

Conclusion: 评估协议与案例研究为社区比较未来多组学生成器提供了可参照的基准，将研究重心从架构创新转向评估标准的定义。

Abstract: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.

</details>


### [306] [Conformal Prediction for Time-Dependent PDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08409)
*Joshua Stiller,Annika Schneider,Eyke Hüllermeier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究PDE代理模型在时间依赖场景下保形预测覆盖率失效问题，证明连续函数空间中任意接近时刻的分布可互奇异导致精确覆盖不可实现，离散化下总变差距离随网格分辨率指数饱和，并提出加权保形预测以获得递增时间视野下的有限样本覆盖保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习中的不确定性量化对洪水预报、金融风险管理、热控制等安全关键任务至关重要，保形预测虽提供无分布覆盖保证，但在物理与工程常见的时间依赖场景下该保证会失效并出现系统性欠覆盖。

Method: 在PDE描述的时间依赖物理系统的代理模型背景下，先于函数空间设定中分析相邻时刻分布间的总变差/奇异性，进而考察离散化设定下总变差距离随网格分辨率的变化，最后采用有原则的加权保形预测构造覆盖保证。

Result: 证明函数空间中任意接近时刻的分布可互相奇异，从而精确覆盖保证不可能实现；在离散化设定中，分布间总变差距离常随网格分辨率指数级饱和，需对空间离散化施加限制才能保证覆盖；在特定设定下，加权保形预测可在增长的时间视野上给出有限样本覆盖保证。

Conclusion: 时间依赖PDE代理模型的不确定性量化中，精确的分布无关覆盖在连续与离散设定下均存在根本性障碍，但通过加权保形预测可在受限设定中恢复有限样本有效性，为时空代理模型提供可行的近似覆盖方案。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification is crucial in scientific machine learning, where models inform safety-critical tasks such as flood forecasting, financial risk management, and thermal control in machines. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, but in time-dependent settings common to physics and engineering, these guarantees can break down, leading to systematic undercoverage. We study this problem in the context of surrogate models for time-dependent physical systems described by partial differential equations. We prove that in a function space setting, distributions at arbitrarily close times can be mutually singular, making exact coverage guarantees impossible. We further show that in discretized settings, the total variation distance between distributions often saturates exponentially fast with the grid resolution, mandating restrictions on the spatial discretization to ensure coverage. Finally, for certain settings, we show how to use principled weighted conformal prediction to obtain finite-sample coverage guarantees over growing time horizons.

</details>


### [307] [Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08414)
*Chenruo Liu,Zihan Wang,Yijun Dong,Qi Lei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文分析LoRA增量在SFT与RL两阶段的动力学差异，指出RL使奇异谱集中、子空间旋转快，而SFT在中等学习率下扩张谱；机制源于组均值基线减除，并据此为两阶段定制LoRA更新配置，在数学推理任务上多数设定取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA在SFT与RL中常采用相近优化器设置，但两种训练范式如何体现于LoRA所优化的低秩增量，其动力学差异尚不清晰，缺乏对谱与子空间行为的统一刻画与可操作的调优指导。

Method: 在数学推理任务上追踪LoRA更新的奇异谱与奇异子空间；逐项在SFT与RL之间插值以定位差异来源；用经LoRA更新的二次多指标模型分析"相干拟合"与"梯度噪声"两种竞争力的平衡机制；并据此设计分阶段LoRA配置：SFT中压平全更新的谱以分散适应方向，RL中压平当前LoRA增量跨度之外的更新部分以促进子空间旋转。

Result: RL在各学习率下均使谱集中，SFT在中等学习率下使谱扩张；小学习率下RL的奇异子空间旋转显著快于SFT；组均值基线减除被确认为两类差异的共同来源，其将竞争力平衡推向谱集中与更快的子空间旋转，并迫使风险有利学习率偏低。分阶段配置在多个模型的数学推理任务、多数评测设定下优于对比方法。

Conclusion: SFT与RL虽共享LoRA参数化，但其低秩更新动力学存在本质差异且可归因于具体算法成分；基于谱与子空间动力学的分阶段LoRA设计是有效且可解释的性能提升途径。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is commonly used in both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), often under similar optimizer settings. Yet, how the different dynamics of the two stages manifest in the low-rank increment that LoRA optimizes remains unclear. Tracking the singular spectrum and subspaces of LoRA updates on mathematical reasoning tasks, we find that RL concentrates the spectrum at every learning rate, while SFT expands it at moderate learning rates; moreover, RL rotates the singular subspaces much faster than SFT at small learning rates. Interpolating between SFT and RL one ingredient at a time, we pinpoint group-mean baseline subtraction as the source of both contrasts. A quadratic multi-index model updated via LoRA unveils the underlying mechanism: group-mean baseline subtraction tilts the balance between two competing forces, coherent fitting and gradient noise, toward spectral concentration and faster subspace rotation, while forcing the risk-favorable learning rate to be low. Guided by these dynamics, we tailor LoRA updates to each stage: in SFT, we flatten the spectrum of the full update to spread adaptation across singular directions, whereas in RL, we flatten the part of the update outside the current LoRA increment span to promote subspace rotation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks across multiple models show that the respective configurations for SFT and RL yield the best performance among the compared methods in most evaluated settings.

</details>


### [308] [On the limitations of molecular representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08420)
*Acer Blake,Fergus Imrie,Charlotte M. Deane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 系统评估分子表示质量，发现最先进的分子嵌入模型在捕捉图结构、3D形状和ADMET端点相似性上均不优于指纹或理化描述符；同时经典指纹在Enamine REAL库中存在大规模非唯一表示问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子表示（指纹、学习嵌入）的评估通常局限于狭窄基准任务上的下游模型性能，缺乏对其内在质量的系统考察。

Method: 对多种分子表示进行系统性调查，以图结构、3D形状、ADMET端点相似性等多维相似性作为评价标准进行比较；并分析10.8B规模Enamine REAL数据库中表示的唯一性。

Result: 无任何SOTA分子嵌入模型在上述相似性维度上超过指纹或理化描述符；取决于所用表示，Enamine REAL数据库中有2.25亿至约40亿个分子存在非唯一表示，对虚拟筛选具有影响。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了当前分子表示的实质局限，为开发更稳健的小分子编码指明了未来方向。

Abstract: Molecular representations such as fingerprints and learned embeddings play a central role in cheminformatics and small-molecule machine learning. They serve as the primary input for a diverse array of tasks, including clustering, dataset splitting, and virtual screening, yet their evaluation is often limited to downstream model performance on narrow benchmark tasks. We carried out a systematic investigation of the quality of molecular representations, finding that none of the state-of-the-art molecular embedding models capture graph structure, 3D shape, or ADMET endpoint similarity better than fingerprints or physicochemical descriptors. However, classical fingerprints also revealed their own material limitations. For example, we show that depending on the representation, between 225M and $\sim$4B molecules have non-unique representations in the 10.8B Enamine REAL database, with implications for virtual screening. Our findings provide an insight into the current limitations of molecular representations, outlining future research directions for the development of more robust encodings of small molecules.

</details>


### [309] [Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08421)
*Ilker Gurcan,Kadir Ustun,Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种算子理论框架，可从采样的 jet 空间数据中直接发现本质李点对称生成元，无需符号确定方程或闭式系统表示，并在具已知 11 维表示本质对称代数的基准上完整恢复生成元及其李括号结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从微分方程数据中发现连续对称性可为模型降阶与科学机器学习揭示几何结构，但传统方法依赖符号确定方程与闭式表示；本文旨在规避这些前提，直接在采样 jet 数据上求解本质对称发现问题。

Method: 将本质李点对称发现表述为采样 jet 空间数据上的算子理论问题：由采样确定算子识别容许生成元，并与冗余、解依赖及几何平凡方向分离；框架结合延拓、顺序子空间限制，以及关于可训练系数线性的固定非线性字典；并提出秩稳定化预检检验以诊断在字典细化下表示本质对称代数不稳定的系统。

Result: 在具解析已知 11 维表示本质对称代数的受控微分方程基准上，方法恢复了完整的表示生成元集合，以数值精度重现其李括号结构，并能外推近似训练域之外的已知生成元。

Conclusion: 显式的本质连续对称生成元可从精确或近似微分系统的数据中恢复，表明该数据驱动、算子理论途径是可行且有效的对称性发现手段。

Abstract: Discovering continuous symmetries directly from differential-equation data can reveal geometric structure for model reduction and scientific machine learning without symbolic determining equations or a closed-form representation of the governing system. We formulate intrinsic Lie point-symmetry discovery as an operator-theoretic problem on sampled jet-space data. Admissible generators are identified from a sampled determining operator and separated from redundant, solution-dependent, and geometrically trivial directions. The framework combines prolongation, sequential subspace restrictions, and a fixed nonlinear dictionary linear in trainable coefficients. A rank-stabilization preflight test diagnoses systems whose represented intrinsic symmetry algebra does not stabilize under dictionary refinement. On a controlled differential-equation benchmark with an analytically known 11-dimensional represented intrinsic symmetry algebra, the method recovers the complete represented generator set, reproduces its Lie-bracket structure to numerical precision, and approximates a known generator beyond the training domain. Here we show that explicit intrinsic continuous-symmetry generators can be recovered from data obtained from exact or approximate differential systems.

</details>


### [310] [A Hidden Markov Preference Model for Online Prediction of Adversary Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08445)
*Angel Daruna,Michael Cogswell,Tixiao Shan,Yi Yao,Han-Pang Chiu,Ajay Divakaran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: A defender anticipating an attacker needs a probability distribution over the attacker's next action from information available before that action occurs. Two structures complicate this: the attacker's behavioral regime persists and can switch within an episode, and each action combines an operation with state-dependent arguments whose feasible values change over time. We capture both with a hidden Markov model whose latent state is the active regime and whose regime-conditioned action law is defined on a feasibility-masked tree of executable actions. The same likelihood forms the next-action distribution and updates the regime belief once the action is seen, and a partially observed prefix contributes its resolved local factors. Estimation separates into convex logistic fits that Baum-Welch reuses when regimes are unlabeled. We derive a reach-weighted nodewise KL expression for regime information, a sequence-wise log-loss bound for switching regime paths, and a uniform fallback guarantee. On the CAGE 2 cyber defense benchmark the filtered latent state is worth 0.8 nats per step, and after a controller switch the loss begins to fall in three steps against ten for a recurrent baseline.

</details>


### [311] [Adversarial Training with Large Step Sizes: Implicit Bias, Optimization, and Sharpness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08457)
*Yi Feng,Andrea Paudice*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大常数步长下确定性梯度下降（GD）在对抗训练（AT）中的动力学，刻画了对抗线性逻辑回归的隐式偏置与优化速度，并分析了神经网络训练中损失尖锐度的演化，揭示其与标准训练（ST）的三点关键差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有关于AT中GD动力学的工作多聚焦于小步长或消失步长区域，此时GD近似连续时间流；但此类步长训练效率低、实践中很少使用。作者希望理解实践中常用的大常数步长下AT的真实动力学行为。

Method: 对采用大常数步长的确定性GD进行理论分析：先在对抗线性逻辑回归中分析两方面——模型参数的收敛点（隐式偏置）与损失下降速度（优化）；随后转向神经网络训练，分析训练过程中损失尖锐度（sharpness）的演化。

Result: 得到三点结论：(i) AT与ST之间的隐式偏置差距此前仅在小步长下成立，本文证明其对任意大的常数步长依然存在；(ii) 与ST不同，AT中优化误差不存在一致的收敛速率；(iii) 尖锐度可呈现两阶段动力学，不同于ST中观察到的"稳定性边缘"（Edge-of-Stability）行为。

Conclusion: 本文推进了对AT中大步长GD行为的理解，并从隐式偏置、优化收敛与尖锐度演化三个维度明确区分了AT与ST的动力学特性。

Abstract: Adversarial Training (AT) is an important method for improving model robustness. We study the dynamics of deterministic Gradient Descent (GD) in AT. Most existing works in this direction focus on the small or vanishing step sizes regime, where GD resembles a continuous-time flow. However, such step sizes can make training inefficient and are rarely used in practice. In this paper, we study the AT dynamics of GD with large constant step sizes. We first study GD in adversarial linear logistic regression, focusing on two aspects: where the model parameters converge (implicit bias) and how quickly the losses decrease (optimization). We then turn to neural networks training and study how the sharpness of losses evolve during AT. Our results advance the understanding of the behaviors of GD with large step sizes in AT and highlight three key differences from its behavior in Standard Training (ST): (i) the implicit bias gap between AT and ST, previously established only for small step sizes, persists for arbitrarily large constant step sizes, (ii) different from ST, there is no uniform rate of convergence for the optimization error in AT, and (iii) sharpness can exhibit two-stage dynamics that differ from the Edge-of-Stability behavior observed in ST.

</details>


### [312] [Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08465)
*Celeste De Schamphelaere,Juan J. Vazquez,Ari Spiesberger,Tomáš Gavenčiak,Gavin Leech,Euan Ong,Jiahai Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出最大激活示例元模型（MAEM），用无标签强化学习把残差流方向映射为强激活该方向的文本示例，效果优于语料检索与自然语言自编码器，且示例可通过前向传播验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释语言模型残差流方向通常依赖在语料中扫描强激活文本，但受限于语料本身的内容覆盖，难以规模化、也难以覆盖多样的方向来源。

Method: 训练MAEM这一语言模型，将主体模型的残差流方向映射为文本示例；以生成文本的激活与给定方向之间的余弦相似度最大化作为无标签强化学习目标，从而可在多样方向来源上规模化训练。

Result: Qwen3.6-27B上的MAEM在反转留出激活上优于语料检索与NLA；在多数留出语言/领域上超过10M token规模的语料检索；激活89%的留出SAE特征；识别引导向量概念的效果与NLA相当；比语料检索更常恢复LoRA后门载荷；还能部分口述模型的内部独白。

Conclusion: MAEM示例可用主体模型一次前向传播进行验证，是一种有根基（grounded）的元模型目标，可作为可扩展到大规模训练的替代方案。

Abstract: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out SAE features. It also identifies concepts behind steering vectors about as well as NLAs, recovers the payloads of LoRA backdoors more often than corpus search, and can even verbalise some model workspace inner monologue. Unlike explanations produced by other metamodels (e.g. NLAs), MAEM exemplars can be verified with a forward pass on the subject model, making the MAEM objective a grounded alternative for scaling the training of metamodels.

</details>


### [313] [Same Behavior, Different Mechanism: What Finite Experiments Can Certify About Integrated Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08469)
*Linqian Wu,Diaoxuan He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究机制层面量（以IIT的整合信息φ为例）能否从有限、部分、含噪干预数据中被辨识、对机制连续且可由数据认证，并在4-5单元随机网络上给出精确答案与可计算的可行性边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释性、AI审计与机器意识评估越来越依赖过渡律的泛函（描述系统“如何计算”而非“输出什么”），但实验只能通过有限、部分、含噪的干预观测该规律。因此需要回答此类量何时可辨识、是否对机制连续、能否用有限数据认证。

Method: 以φ为刻意严苛的案例，在已知ground truth的4与5单元随机随机网络中做精确计算；对比相同输入输出行为但结构不同的网络；在一步记录中剔除单元以考察部分可观测；构造all-but-self parity使其仅通过保真度乘积可见，并用一次干预打破对称；随机网络统计φ的分区选择/报告标准不一致导致的“边缘”；生成近乎完美拟合干预数据的代理模型；并构造64维机制区域用受控转移给出下界认证。

Result: 行为可能完全沉默（相同输入输出下φ为0.28与0 bits，内部记录4-53次试验即可区分）；部分访问造成0.30-1.02 bits的精度下限且不随样本量下降，all-but-self parity中多单元仅以保真度乘积可见；φ存在锐利边缘，跨越边缘的微小机制变化使φ改变25-100%，约1%近乎完美拟合干预数据的代理模型误差>20%；但单侧声明可成立：跨边缘两侧下界均可认证，并在64维区域证明φ>1.004 bits且可由约1e7次受控转移以≤α的假认证概率认证。

Conclusion: 可测性是可由计算回答的设计问题：φ虽在行为层面不可见、部分访问下有不可消除的精度下限且对机制存在不连续边缘，但仍可获得可认证的单侧下界；实验设计与访问方式应视为决定可辨识性的关键变量。

Abstract: Interpretability, AI auditing and assessments of machine consciousness increasingly rest on mechanism-level quantities: functionals of a system's causal transition law that describe how it computes, not what it outputs. Experiments see that law only through finite, partial and noisy interventions. We ask when such a quantity is identifiable from an experiment's access, continuous in the mechanism and certifiable from finite data, and answer exactly for a deliberately demanding case - the integrated information $\varphi$ of integrated information theory - in stochastic networks of four and five units with known ground truth. Behavior can be silent: a recurrent and a feed-forward network with identical input-output laws at their response delay carry 0.28 and 0 bits, yet internal recordings separate them within 4-53 trials. Partial access can be just as blind: in our examples, units left out of a one-step recording impose precision floors of 0.30-1.02 bits that no sample size lowers, and in all-but-self parity networks, recordings of any length see several hidden units only through the product of their fidelities - a symmetry that one intervention broke in exact checks. The measure has sharp edges: because $\varphi$ selects a partition, and the cause and effect it specifies, by one criterion and reports another, infinitesimal changes of mechanism that cross an edge change it by 25-100% at 99% of the edges we found in random networks, and about 1% of surrogate models that fit interventional data almost perfectly misreport it by more than 20%. One-sided claims survive: the same data certify a lower bound on both sides of an edge, and we prove $\varphi>1.004$ bits throughout a 64-dimensional region of mechanisms and certify it from about $10^7$ controlled transitions with false-certificate probability at most $α$. Measurability is thus a design question with computable answers.

</details>


### [314] [XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08472)
*Linrong Cai,Taiming Lu,Haozhe Chen,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%. XStack is a step toward freeing ML code from its ecosystem. We release XStack to make progress toward reliable migration across frameworks and hardware measurable.

</details>


### [315] [User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08487)
*Jonathan Kozaczuk,Zheng Dong,Noyan Evirgen,Keivan Majidi,Eddie K. H. Ng,Chris Porter,Qi Zhao,Jia Geng,Changmao Li,Brandon R. Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将用户嵌入理解为"可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加"，并用稀疏自编码器（SAE）等方法恢复这些模式，从而实现自然语言命名、零样本受众检索与刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户嵌入广泛用于推荐、个性化与行为建模，能紧凑编码丰富行为信息，但其本质是稠密且不透明的，缺乏可解释性。作者希望在不改动上游嵌入系统的前提下，打开这一黑箱。

Method: 理论层面：对线性嵌入，生成式用户行为模型直接预测出"稀疏叠加"结构；借助叠加假设，该结构近似扩展到深度学习表示。实践层面：用稀疏字典学习方法（如稀疏自编码器 SAE）恢复叠加模式，并自动为恢复的模式命名、支持自然语言查询。框架为事后（post-hoc）、模型无关（model-agnostic）。

Result: 在合成数据上以已知真值验证模式恢复，SAE 优于经典稀疏基线（包括对 transformer 编码嵌入）；并在两个真实数据集上对经典与 transformer 用户嵌入应用该方法；结果显示自然语言标签可支持对从未用文本训练的嵌入进行零样本受众检索与刻画。

Conclusion: 用户嵌入可被视为可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加并被有效恢复与命名，提供了一种即插即用、无需修改上游系统的可解释性分析范式。

Abstract: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. Superimposed modes can naturally be recovered by sparse dictionary learning methods, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and recovered modes can be automatically named and queried in natural language. We validate mode recovery against known ground truth on synthetic data, where SAEs recover modes better than classical sparse baselines, including on transformer-encoded embeddings. We then apply the method to classical and transformer-based user embeddings from two real-world datasets. We also show how the corresponding natural-language labels enable zero-shot audience retrieval and characterization over embeddings never trained on text. The framework is post-hoc and model-agnostic, requiring no modification to the upstream embedding system.

</details>

### [316] [Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06962)
*Christian Clason,Tapio Helin,Medet Nursultanov,Lauri Oksanen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoIP 是一个用 AI agent 自动形式化的 Lean 库，涵盖经典线性正则化理论及其依赖的泛函分析；其核心主张是机器验证的证明只保证形式命题正确，因此人类审核的重点应放在"形式命题是否忠实表达原意"上，并通过针对性自动测试暴露陈述层面的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lean 等证明助手可将数学证明检验到公理层面，AI agent 又使撰写此类证明变得廉价，于是验证成本从"证明"转移到"陈述"。由于机器检验只认证所证的形式命题，剩余的人工任务只是确认每条形式陈述确实表达了原意。作者希望以"陈述审阅"为中心组织库结构，减轻审阅负担，并检验形式化能否发现既有文献中的陈述缺陷。

Method: 构建 AutoIP：以 AI agent 自动形式化经典线性正则化理论及所需泛函分析，并以"审阅者只需将形式陈述与自然语言对应物逐一比对、无需阅读证明"为原则组织库结构；同时对形式陈述施加简单的自动化测试（如边界/极端情形检验）以检测陈述偏差。

Result: 经验表明风险主要位于陈述而非证明；简单的陈述自动化测试能够暴露问题，甚至可发现已发表文献中的缺陷——文中以一例教材定理说明：其实际所需假设比所声称的更为严格。

Conclusion: 形式化的验证瓶颈在于陈述的忠实性而非证明正确性，故库设计应以陈述审阅与自动测试为核心；作者公开邀请反问题社区扩展并基于该库继续工作。

Abstract: Proof assistants such as Lean check mathematical proofs down to the axioms, and AI agents have recently made writing such proofs cheap. We describe AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory, together with the functional analysis it rests on, has been autoformalized by AI agents. A machine-checked proof certifies only the formal statement it proves, so the remaining human task is to confirm that each formal statement says what was intended. We organize the library around this task: a reviewer compares the formal statements with their natural-language counterparts and never needs to read a proof. Our experience is that the risks lie in the statements rather than in the proofs, and that simple automated tests on the statements can expose problems even in the established literature. We illustrate this with a textbook theorem whose hypothesis is more restrictive than asserted. We invite the inverse problems community to extend and build on the library.

</details>


### [317] [KDASO: Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization for Liability Adjudication Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06972)
*Zi-Jian Cheng,Weiming Wu,Jie Meng,Zhen Peng,Shan Huang,Qun Li,Guobing Wu,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出知识-数据双驱动的自动化技能优化框架 KDASO，通过邻域条件归纳、执行对齐精炼与上下文预算路由，持续演化用于责任判定任务的技能库，在多任务上显著优于通用与领域基线，并具备良好迁移性与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于可执行技能的责任判定方法存在三大缺陷：技能库随真实场景演化而陈旧；技能描述存在"语义-执行鸿沟"，使 LLM 偏离专家预期逻辑；技能规模增长超出上下文预算导致关键技能被遗漏。

Method: KDASO 由三个组件构成：(1) 基于近期判定数据的邻域条件归纳(neighborhood-conditioned induction)持续扩充技能库；(2) 基于 LLM 轨迹分析的执行对齐精炼(execution-aligned refinement)弥合语义-执行鸿沟；(3) 上下文预算受限的路由(context-budgeted routing)实现可扩展技能选择。

Result: 在网约车责任判定、法律责任认定与逻辑推理判断三类实验上显著超越通用及领域专用基线；技能迁移至概念相似场景取得 8.96% 提升；在持续优化过程中保持稳定性能增益。

Conclusion: 知识-数据双驱动的技能自动优化可有效维持技能库时效性与可执行一致性，并解决上下文预算约束，生成的技能具有高可迁移性与稳定性，适用于责任判定类任务。

Abstract: Liability adjudication tasks (e.g., legal charge determination) require analyzing event descriptions against domain-specific skills to determine whether a party should bear liability. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area by leveraging executable skills for interpretable reasoning, existing approaches face three critical limitations: skill libraries become stale as real-world scenarios dynamically evolve, skill descriptions often suffer from a semantic execution gap where LLMs deviate from intended expert logic, and growing skill collections exceed context budgets causing critical skill omission. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization (KDASO), which continuously evolves a skill library through neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent adjudication data, execution-aligned refinement based on LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing for scalable skill selection. Experiments across ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning judgment demonstrate that KDASO significantly outperforms current general-purpose and domain-specific baselines. KDASO further achieves 8.96% improvement when transferring skills to concept-similar scenarios and maintains consistent performance gains through continuous optimization, underscoring the high transferability and stability of generated skills.

</details>


### [318] [BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06977)
*Xiuyuan Qi,Pedro Reviriego,Javier Conde,Shanshan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BlockLock 通过固定受保护请求所见的“几何形状”而非约束全部算子，在保持共享 batched prefill 的前提下实现 bitwise 可复现的 LLM 推理，延迟较 vLLM Batch-Invariant 降低 53.5–55.0%，吞吐提升 115.2–122.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复现推理要求某请求的输出与同批次其他请求无关。现有方案代价高昂：batch-invariant 内核需约束每个算子（且需自定义实现）；以固定形状 decode 隔离 prefill 的 CoRun 式基线则牺牲共享 prefill 计算并对 decode 做 padding，浪费算力。

Method: 提出 BlockLock，保留共享 batched prefill，仅固定被保护请求的数值路径（固定其可见的几何形状），设两种模式：BlockLock-Rows 采用固定宽度行，保留所有请求的 batched decode；BlockLock-Pack 采用终端锚定打包（terminal-anchored packing）并加入隔离 dummy 段，随后提取被保护请求的 KV state 进行 target-only decode。在给定的每次部署契约下，两种模式在伴随请求变化时均能 bitwise 保持目标输出。

Result: 在 5 个 dense 模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT）、3 种单 GPU 部署（NVIDIA A6000、A100、H100）上，基于 tinyBenchmarks 与 BFCL 评测，另含双 A6000 的初步 tensor-parallel 实验：两种模式均保持目标序列与 Top20-logit 的 bit 一致。在相同实际完成工作量下，BlockLock-Rows 相对 vLLM Batch-Invariant 延迟降低 53.5–55.0%，吞吐提升 115.2–122.2%，且无需自定义 kernel，仅约束被保护请求。

Conclusion: BlockLock 以“固定受保护请求几何形状”替代“全局算子约束”，在无需自定义内核、仅约束少数请求的条件下兼顾可复现性与批处理效率，显著优于 batch-invariant 内核方案，并支持 tensor-parallel 初步验证。

Abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. Under a stated per-deployment contract, both modes preserve the target's output bitwise when its companions change.} Across five {dense} models (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT) and three single-GPU deployments (NVIDIA A6000, A100, and H100), we evaluate our approach on both tinyBenchmarks and BFCL{; we also include initial tensor-parallel experiments on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Both modes preserve target sequences and Top20-logit bits in the reported tests.} At equal delivered work, {BlockLock-Rows} reduces latency by 53.5--55.0\% and improves throughput by 115.2--122.2\% relative to vLLM Batch-Invariant; compared with batch-invariant kernels, it needs no custom kernel implementations and constrains only the protected requests.

</details>


### [319] [Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06984)
*Jia Wei,Ziyi Qiu,Yi Xu,Xuehai Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlexFloor通过在同步响应生成中联合调整响应调度与活跃工作机组，实现MoE模型RL后训练阶段的提前资源释放，在保持rollout奖励基本不变的前提下，将单机时响应token生成量提升约65.40%，吞吐提升52.74%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL后训练可提升大模型能力，但训练响应生成是主要计算瓶颈。在MoE模型中，已生成完自身响应的worker因其专家仍被处理长响应的worker需要而无法释放；基线中约三分之一的占用时间发生在本地响应生成结束之后，造成显著浪费。

Method: FlexFloor在同步响应生成中实现更早的资源释放，同时保留进行中响应所需的专家计算。它联合调整响应调度与活跃worker组：利用历史响应长度与内存约束指导批处理与prompt放置，并在维持专家可用性与通信正确性的前提下逐步释放worker。

Result: 相较verl基线，FlexFloor单位占用计算时间生成响应token数提升约65.40%，响应生成吞吐提升52.74%，rollout奖励几乎无变化。

Conclusion: FlexFloor提升了RL后训练效率，可支持大模型与AI智能体更快开发与迭代改进。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.

</details>


### [320] [The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06989)
*Vivek Acharya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"双账本模型"（Two-Ledger Model），将FOCUS合规的结算账本与基于OpenTelemetry GenAI遥测的调用粒度归因账本关联，使企业可将AI成本归因到具体订单/理赔/案件/业务成果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业通过跨云、LLM与编排框架的多智能体系统运行业务，但财务只拿到按SKU与计费周期聚合的结算粒度AI成本；供应商看不到企业交易边界，"某订单/理赔/案件的AI成本"无法由账单数据回答。即使FOCUS统一了多供应商计费模式并新增token与请求者归因，仍是结算粒度，存在粒度失配问题。

Method: 形式化粒度失配问题并推导七项需求；提出双账本模型：FOCUS合规结算账本 + OpenTelemetry GenAI调用粒度归因账本；构建分层关联主干（trace context、A2A/MCP元数据、业务键关联、概率匹配），为每条记录赋予归因方法与置信度；使用版本化费率卡近实时定价；周期性对账将两账本与发票勾稽，未解释残差识别影子AI；输出按订单/理赔/成果的智能体成本指标。以具真值仿真验证。

Result: 仿真显示：当trace传播降至零时，关联主干仍保持成本覆盖率>99%；对账残差以0.24个百分点以内的误差恢复植入的未计量支出，同时标记供应商计费错误；飞行中拦截（mid-flight gating）将p99交易成本最多降低61%，误暂停率2–4%。

Conclusion: 双账本模型可解决AI成本结算粒度与业务交易粒度间的失配，支持按业务成果报告成本并检测影子AI。作者提议将归因账本作为调用粒度的FOCUS规范profile进行标准化。

Abstract: Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. The FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) gives billing data one schema across providers but remains settlement-grain even as it adds AI token and requester attribution. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. A layered correlation spine (trace context, A2A/MCP metadata, business-key correlation, probabilistic matching) assigns each record to its business transaction with recorded method and confidence; a versioned rate card prices usage in near real time; period reconciliation ties both ledgers to the invoice, and the unexplained residual identifies shadow AI. Costs are reported per order, claim, or outcome with agentic cost metrics. A simulation with known ground truth shows the spine sustaining cost coverage above 99% as trace propagation falls to zero, the reconciliation residual recovering planted unmetered spend within 0.24 percentage points while flagging provider billing errors, and mid-flight gating cutting p99 transaction cost by up to 61% at a 2-4% false-pause rate. We propose the attribution ledger as an invocation-grain FOCUS profile for standardization.

</details>


### [321] [Autonomous AI Agents Systematically Diverge From Human Preferences in Proof Formalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06995)
*Bálint Gyevnár,Simon DeDeo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"模拟协作"方法，在9个大型Lean人类协作项目（4.7M定义、6K+提交）上对比AI与人类在证明构建中的注意力分配与下一步偏好，发现AI偏好显式标记的缺口、回避稠密连接中心与复杂/意外的证明目标、倾向规整意外证明体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI带来"证明过剩"，但人类难以理解这些证明；需关注AI与人类在证明推进方式上的差异，理解AI偏重表层语法还是深层语义，以及其下一步决策偏好与人类的分歧点。

Method: 提出"模拟协作"（simulated collaboration）方法论，基于9个Lean中的人类协作项目（4.7M定义、6K+次提交）的提交轨迹，比较AI代理与人类在证明构建过程中的注意力分配（表层语法 vs. 深层语义）与下一步动作偏好。

Result: 随证明推进，AI相比人类：(1) 明显更被显式标记的缺口（gap）吸引；(2) 相对回避稠密连接的证明中心以及复杂或意外的证明目标；(3) 相对偏好意外的证明体，并倾向将其规整化至基线。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了AI在数学证明中存在的盲点，并为未来人机数学协作中的干预设计提供依据。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems have ushered in a new age of proof abundance, but helping humans understand these proofs requires new attention to the differences in how AI agents and humans pursue a proof-making task. We present "simulated collaboration", a methodology that allows us to examine two key questions: (1) the relative attention AI agents pay to surface syntax or, conversely, deeper underlying semantics, and (2) how and where AI agent preferences for what to do next diverge from human preferences. On a set of nine major human collaborations in Lean with 4.7M definitions across more than 6K commits, we find that, over the course of proof construction, AI agents (1) are far more strongly drawn than humans to explicitly marked gaps; (2) show a relative aversion to densely connected proof centers and to complex or surprising proof goals; and (3) are relatively attracted to surprising proof bodies, which they tend to regularize toward baseline. Our results highlight important blind spots and potential interventions for future human-AI collaboration in mathematics.

</details>


### [322] [Trust Responsive Runtime Authorization for Agentic AI with Empirical Characterization of Policy Behavior and Parameter Sensitivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06996)
*Ahsan Habib Shihab,Imre Felde,Ramis Akhmedov,Stefan Gubo,Berik Sabdenaliyev,Madina Mansurova,Amir Mosavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文首次系统刻画并实测了"信任响应授权策略"(TRAP)——将运行时信任、运行稳定性与情境风险加权得到的授权就绪分数(ARS)通过非对称规则映射为离散授权等级，并与静态、仅信任、仅风险、对称策略在同一组100条蒙特卡洛轨迹上对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体将运行时状态估计转化为操作授权这一政策环节，通常未被明确规定，也缺乏测量；需要给出可复现的经验刻画与对照评估。

Method: 定义ARS为运行时信任、运行稳定性、情境风险的加权组合；采用非对称规则：升级需连续多次观测高于带边缘并附加裕度，而就绪度骤降则立即限权。在100条匹配蒙特卡洛轨迹上，将TRAP与静态、仅信任、仅风险、对称四类策略对比；采用配对自助法(bootstrap)区间；进行单因子扫描(升级裕度、运行长度、分数权重、限制阈值)；并开展冻结后的探索性实验，将同一退化分散到5–20个区间。

Result: 突发退化下，TRAP在退化起始即限权，恢复后比对称策略更早重新升级；在自适应策略中稳定性最高且(描述性上)波动最小，但更多恢复后升级发生在所选信任阈值之下；其余差异的配对bootstrap区间不含零。单因子扫描中，恢复时间随升级裕度与运行长度上升、随分数权重变化而移动、不受限制阈值影响。分散退化实验中，仅在4条仍保留单区间骤降的轨迹上触发限权；在全部100条轨迹上平均，TRAP在20个退化区间中有15.9–18.9个区间保持超出就绪度支持的授权，而突发退化下为0.8、对称策略约为10。

Conclusion: TRAP的限权优势依赖退化的突发性；当退化被平滑分散时，其非对称规则难以触发限权，反而长期维持超出就绪度支撑的授权。全部数值可追溯至公开、带版本的研究发布。

Abstract: The policy that converts runtime estimates of an autonomous agent's condition into operational authority is rarely specified or measured. We empirically characterize the Trust Responsive Authorization Policy (TRAP), which maps an Authorization Readiness Score (ARS), a weighted combination of runtime trust, operational stability, and contextual risk, onto discrete authorization levels through an asymmetric rule: escalation requires consecutive observations above a band edge plus a margin, while a sharp drop in readiness restricts authority at once. On one matched set of 100 Monte Carlo traces, we compare TRAP with static, trust-only, risk-only, and symmetric policies. Under abrupt degradation, TRAP restricts at onset and re-escalates sooner after recovery than the symmetric policy, with the highest and, descriptively, least variable stability among the adaptive policies, although more of its post-recovery escalations occur below the selected trust threshold. Paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero for the remaining differences. In one-factor sweeps, recovery time rises with the escalation margin and run length, shifts with the score weights, and is unchanged by the restriction threshold. In an exploratory post-freeze experiment, when the same degradation is spread over 5-20 intervals, TRAP restricts only on the 4 traces that retain a single-interval drop above that threshold; averaged over all 100 traces, it holds authority above what readiness supports for 15.9-18.9 of the 20 degradation intervals, against 0.8 under abrupt degradation and about 10 for the symmetric policy. Its restriction advantage therefore depends on degradation being abrupt. All reported values are traceable to the publicly available, versioned research release.

</details>


### [323] [Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07048)
*Andrew W. Lo,Chaoyi Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建理论框架，比较达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体自主引导式三种演化机制在环境变化下的适应速度，指出自主改进能力不保证目标正确性，评估目标错配时更强搜索会加速收敛到错误行为，为AI安全提出监督要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体已能修改并评估自身行为，智能或可开始主导自身演化。作者关心两个问题：自我改进能有多快，以及如何保证这种改进是安全的。现有工作缺乏统一框架来比较不同演化/学习机制在环境变化后的适应动力学。

Method: 建立理论框架，形式化对比三种机制：达尔文式（依赖自然选择）、拉马克式（加入可遗传的学习）、智能体自主引导式（智能体生成并评估行为变体，并自主选择搜索强度）。分析学习有效性、变体生成数量、搜索努力与实验成本等因素对适应速度的影响，并引入评估目标错配情形，考察递归自我改进中的误差传递。

Result: 当学习足够有效时，三种机制的适应速度依次加快；生成更多候选变体可加速适应；最优搜索努力取决于学习能力、问题难度与实验成本。但当评估目标被错误设定时，额外搜索会加速向错误行为收敛，即使测量到的性能仍在提升；该错误可在递归自我改进中跨代持续。

Conclusion: 自主引导改进的能力并不保证奖励/评估与真实目标一致。核心挑战不仅是加速智能演化，更在于保持人类引导方向、限制速度并在必要时干预的能力。独立评估与外部监督必须与自主AI发展同步跟进。

Abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior, how quickly could they improve, and how can that improvement remain safe? We develop a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian, and agent-directed evolution following environmental change. Darwinian evolution relies on natural selection, Lamarckian evolution adds inherited learning, and agent-directed evolution allows agents to generate and evaluate behavioral variants and choose how extensively to search. When learning is sufficiently effective, these mechanisms exhibit progressively faster adaptation. Generating more variants accelerates adaptation, while optimal search effort depends on learning ability, problem difficulty, and experimentation costs. However, an agent's ability to direct its improvement does not ensure that improvements are evaluated against the intended objective. When the evaluation target is misspecified, additional search accelerates convergence toward the wrong behavior, even as measured performance improves. In recursive self-improvement, such errors may persist across generations, posing challenges for AI safety. Independent evaluation and oversight must keep pace with autonomous AI development. The central challenge is not simply to accelerate the evolution of intelligence, but to preserve humanity's ability to guide its direction, limit its speed, and intervene when necessary.

</details>


### [324] [Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07051)
*Ruifeng Ren,Gun Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"闭环评估"(closed-loop evaluation)方法用于已部署智能体:将评估建模为有偏评分者与删失结果下的性能估计,要求各层级结论可回溯到原子数据并由版本化规则计算,通过内环证据审计与外环回归检查形成双循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估多是一次性的(跑基准、看trace、给单一分数),结论既不自检也不回流到智能体,无法回答"智能体是否真的在履行职责"。

Method: 四层分析(span、trace、conversation、engagement);沿Execution–Substance–Trajectory–Results主轴度量,Conduct作为全程约束;用Provenance与Adjudication组件认证证据与评估者;由Agent Factory生成带领域知识包与适配器harness的评估者智能体;内环审计证据、规则与指标本身,外环以分组件回归检查驱动改进;并给出自动运行该流程的pipeline。

Result: 以业务分析智能体SharpInsight为案例并迁移至公开对话数据,显示问题在不同层级表现不同;证据-规则判定比整体打分更可靠(ICC 0.86 vs 0.81;kappa 0.81 vs 0.63)。

Conclusion: 闭环评估将部署后评估转化为可追溯、版本化、自审计并可驱动改进的持续过程,细粒度证据与规则判定优于整体评分。

Abstract: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Its conclusions neither check themselves nor reach the agent. We propose closed-loop evaluation, an evaluation method for deployed agents. It models evaluation as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, and it requires every level's conclusion to trace back to atomic data and to be computed by versioned rules. The method covers four levels of analysis (span, trace, conversation and engagement), measures along a spine of Execution, Substance, Trajectory and Results, treats Conduct as a constraint throughout, and uses Provenance and Adjudication components to certify the evidence and the evaluators. Evaluator agents generated by an Agent Factory carry these components, each with a domain knowledge pack and an adapter harness. Two loops close the evaluation: an inner loop audits the evidence, rules and metrics themselves, and an outer loop uses per-component regression checks to drive agent improvement. We also give a pipeline that runs this process automatically. Using the business-analysis agent SharpInsight as a case and porting the method to public conversation data, we show how problems differ across levels and how evidence-and-rule judgment is more reliable than holistic scoring (ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81; kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63).

</details>


### [325] [Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Form Guided Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07066)
*Sungil Son,Hoseong Jung,Dahyun Oh,H. Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EFXPLORER：在保持已有任务性能的约束下最大化探索目标，用 epigraph 重构引入自适应探索预算，并配合 successor distance 内在奖励，在 SMAX、VMAS、MPE 上优于强基线并涌现新的协作策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MARL 中联合状态-动作空间组合爆炸，仅靠试错难以发现协作行为；内在奖励可辅助探索，但与团队目标简单混合会扭曲学习信号、损害任务性能。因此需要一种既能促进探索又不破坏已建立任务性能的机制。

Method: 将问题建模为约束优化：最大化探索目标，约束为保持任务性能不退化；通过 epigraph 重构求解并引入自适应探索预算，从而把内在奖励与任务目标解耦，由任务可行性来调节探索强度；同时设计基于 successor distance 的内在奖励以捕捉长时程依赖、促进多样且时间上延展的探索。

Result: 在 SMAX、VMAS、MPE 三个基准套件上均优于强基线，并诱导出新的协作策略。

Conclusion: 以性能保持为约束的探索框架可有效分离内在奖励与任务目标，在保障任务性能的前提下提升多智能体协作行为的发现能力。

Abstract: Discovering cooperative behavior in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is challenging due to the combinatorial complexity of joint state-action spaces, which hinders the emergence of coordinated behaviors from trial-and-error alone. Intrinsic rewards are often used to aid discovery, but naively combining them with team objectives can distort the learning signal, compromising task performance. In this paper, we propose EFXPLORER, a constrained exploration framework that maximizes exploration objectives subject to a constraint that preserves established task performance. We solve the resulting problem using an epigraph reformulation that introduces adaptive exploration budgets. This approach separates intrinsic rewards from task objectives and regulates exploration through task feasibility. To further encourage diverse and temporally extended exploration, we incorporate a successor distance-based intrinsic reward that captures long-horizon dependencies. Empirically, our method outperforms strong baselines and induces novel cooperative strategies across SMAX, VMAS, and MPE benchmark suites.

</details>


### [326] [When Verification Is Not Agreement: Cross-Agent LLM-to-Dafny Formalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07073)
*Priyanath Maji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出跨智能体形式化协议（Specifier 写 Dafny 谓词、Implementer 写被校验的方法），在 96 份临床试验文档上评估四种配置，发现形式化验证成功不等于独立推理一致：跨模型一致率显著低于同模型自一致基线（59.3%），且受能力分配方向、验证伪影影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dafny 后置条件通过只证明某公式成立，不能保证结论来自独立推理；因此需要区分"验证成功"与"跨智能体独立形式化的一致性"，并考察模型能力及角色分配如何影响这种一致性。

Method: 设计跨智能体形式化协议：Specifier 模型将试验纳入标准翻译为 Dafny 谓词，Implementer 模型编写操作式方法并由该谓词校验。设置同模型对照（同一文本独立重复抽取）作为基线，在 96 份临床试验文档上评测四种模型配置，并引入结构审计以排查实现层伪影。

Result: 同模型对照一致率仅 59.3%；GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini 在强模型任 Implementer 时一致率 53.0%，角色反转后降至 14.3%；最强配置 GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini 为 34.4%，仍低于同模型基线，且以直接矛盾为主（42.7%）。另发现弱 Implementer 直接调用 Specifier 谓词以"满足"后置条件的验证伪影，结构审计后该配置一致率由 14.3% 修正为 13.2%。

Conclusion: 验证通过不足以作为跨智能体独立一致的证据；能力更强并不保证独立形式化同一来源时取得一致，角色能力分配与验证伪影会显著扭曲结论。

Abstract: A verified Dafny postcondition certifies that a formula holds, but it does not guarantee that the result was reached through genuine independent reasoning. We introduce a cross-agent formalization protocol where a Specifier model translates clinical trial criteria into a Dafny predicate, and an Implementer model writes an operational method checked against it. A same-model control establishes that even with no capability gap, independent re-extraction from identical text agrees only 59.3% of the time. Evaluating four model configurations on 96 clinical trial documents, we find that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated across the two roles: the GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini configuration achieves 53.0% agreement when the stronger model is the Implementer, but only 14.3% when the roles are reversed. The strongest tested configuration, GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini, improves agreement to 34.4% but remains below the same-model baseline and is dominated by direct contradiction (42.7%). We also detect a critical verification artifact in which a weaker Implementer satisfies the postcondition by invoking the Specifier's predicate directly; after structural auditing, corrected agreement falls from 14.3% to 13.2%. Our results show that verification success alone is insufficient evidence of independent cross-agent agreement, and that model capability does not guarantee agreement when formalizing the same source independently.

</details>


### [327] [Synthesizing symbolic models of human and machine reasoning at scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07088)
*Solim LeGris,Philipp Mondorf,Jinran Jin,Akshay K. Jagadish,Brenden M. Lake,Todd M. Gureckis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Behavior-Conditioned Symbolic Synthesis (BCSS)，自动搜索可解释的确定性符号程序以复现行为，并用其建模人与机器在推理任务上的策略，发现二者共享"过度简化、部分解释规则、错误依赖推断"的特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号模型虽能有力刻画认知，但受限于手工工程与计算可行性，难以规模化；作者希望借助AI进展突破这些工程瓶颈，并为人与黑箱AI系统提供可比较的规则化推理分析工具。

Method: BCSS：以行为为条件，自动搜索能够可验证地复现行为的可解释、确定性符号程序；在数百个具有挑战性的推理问题上，同时对人类与机器的行为进行建模并分析所得程序。

Result: 人或机器均倾向于过度简化、采用仅部分解释观察的规则、错误推断问题特征间的依赖关系；这些共同特征受可用资源调节，推理投入程度可预测机器简化的程度。

Conclusion: 结果指向人与机器中类似"满意化(satisficing)"的底层机制；BCSS可作为解释与比较人类及黑箱AI系统规则化推理的通用方法。

Abstract: Symbolic models offer a powerful account of cognition, but their scope has historically been limited by the need for hand-engineering and computational tractability. We show how advances in artificial intelligence (AI) can scale symbolic modeling and help overcome these engineering limitations. We introduce Behavior-Conditioned Symbolic Synthesis (BCSS)---an approach for automated search of interpretable, deterministic symbolic programs that verifiably reproduce behavior---and apply it to model both human and machine behavior across hundreds of challenging reasoning problems. Analyzing these programs reveals that both people and machines tend to oversimplify, adopt rules that are partial explanations for their observations, and misinfer dependencies between problem features. These shared signatures are modulated by available resources, with reasoning effort predicting the extent to which machines simplify and explain their observations. Together, these results point to underlying mechanisms reminiscent of satisficing in both people and machines, and illustrate how BCSS offers a general approach for interpreting and comparing rule-based reasoning of humans and black-box AI systems.

</details>


### [328] [PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07123)
*Sven Kleinkop,Tamás Janusko,Ricardo Bochnia,Gunnar Hempel,Steffen Tomschke,Jürgen Anke,Maik Thiele*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文将已部署LLM裁判的持续维护问题形式化为"judge drift"，提出闭环框架PromptOps，并实例化五种提示优化方法以验证迭代重校准的可行性与情境依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为自动裁判（LLMaaJ）在实际部署中，随着用户交互与打分分布变化，其与既定人工评估标准的一致性会下降。现有自动提示优化多被当作静态开发集上的一次性过程，无法指导裁判的长期维护。

Method: 将问题定义为judge drift，提出闭环框架PromptOps，把运维拆解为四个决策：何时优化、采用何种优化流程、使用哪些反馈记录、如何更新裁判提示。以GEPA、SIMBA、Rubric Synthesis及基于模拟退火或TPE的示例选择共五种优化方法实例化框架。

Result: 实验表明迭代提示优化可在参考分数分布发生受控漂移后重新校准LLM裁判并恢复性能；但最优优化算法与更新时机均无法跨情境泛化，维护效果本质依赖于具体情境。

Conclusion: 提示优化对已部署LLM裁判而言本质上是迭代式维护问题，而非一次性优化；PromptOps为研究与实践该过程提供了可操作的抽象框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for evaluating the behavior of chatbots and other AI systems. In deployment, however, their agreement with the intended human evaluation policy may degrade as user interactions and score distributions change. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods are primarily studied as one-shot procedures on static development sets and therefore provide limited guidance for maintaining LLM judges over time. We frame this problem as judge drift and introduce PromptOps, a closedloop framework for monitoring and iteratively recalibrating LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) systems. PromptOps separates four operational decisions: when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt. We instantiate the framework with five prompt optimization methods: GEPA, SIMBA, Rubric Synthesis, and exemplar selection using either simulated annealing or a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator. Our experiments demonstrate that iterative prompt optimization can recalibrate LLM judges and recover performance after controlled shifts in the referencescore distribution. However, effective maintenance is inherently contextdependent: neither optimization algorithm choice nor update timing generalizes universally across settings. These findings establish prompt optimization for deployed LLM judges as an inherently iterative maintenance problem and demonstrate that PromptOps provides a practical abstraction for studying and implementing this process.

</details>


### [329] [Goal Revelation as a Bridge Between Information-Theoretic Empowerment and Capability-Based Human Power](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07247)
*Jaime Ruiz-Serra,Tomáš Gavenčiak,Jobst Heitzig*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在马尔可夫博弈框架下厘清两种"权力"度量（信息论赋能 empowerment 与基于能力达成的个体权力）的关系，证明二者被一条不等式链 $B(s)\le \mathbb{I}(G;\xi\mid s)\le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h\to\xi\mid s)\le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$ 串联，并指出每一层都可能退化为零，从而揭示只看赋能或只看目标揭示的失效模式，主张以"达成端"的满足度下界作为可部署监测指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 智能体在广泛目标下倾向获取权力（工具性收敛），嵌入社会技术系统后可能造成人类被逐步"去权"。既有两种定量度量——empowerment（行为到未来状态的通道容量）与个体权力（目标达成概率）——分属不同范式，缺乏统一关系刻画，导致无法判断哪种度量能提供真正的安全保障。

Method: 在马尔可夫博弈中形式化"目标揭示"量 $\mathbb{I}(G;\xi\mid s)$（人类潜在目标与实现轨迹的互信息）：由个体权力经 Fano 不等式导出下界 $B(s)$；将 empowerment 视为该互信息的上界（数据处理的通道容量链）。构造反例刻画各层之间"上大下零"的失效情形，并基于交互日志的两个统计量给出可计算的满足度下界，配合随机环境仿真比较三者的相关性。

Result: 得到完整不等式链 $B(s)\le\mathbb{I}(G;\xi\mid s)\le\mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h\to\xi\mid s)\le\mathfrak{E}_h(s)$。反例显示：最大化 empowerment 的助手可能偏好提供大量无关自由度、影响力广但无法达成任何目标的界面；最大化目标揭示的助手无法区分正常界面与被重接（每个目标都产生错误结果）的界面，因为目标重标记不改变互信息却使所有达成概率归零。仿真表明三量相关但远不可互换。

Conclusion: 正向保障只能来自链条的"达成端"（个体权力/满足度），信息论量单独不作为安全判据。提出由交互日志两项统计量计算的满足度下界，可作为已部署系统中监测用户保有权力（residual power）的实用工具。

Abstract: Power matters for AI safety. Optimal agents tend to acquire power across a wide range of objectives (instrumental convergence). As we embed AI agents into socio-technical systems, humans risk gradual disempowerment. Both concerns call for a formal, quantitative measure of power. Two such measures in the context of Markov games are information-theoretic empowerment, the capacity of the channel from an agent's actions to future states, and capability-based individual power, a measure of goal attainment built from the probabilities that a human would attain each goal in a family of candidates were they pursuing it. We show where the two meet. From individual power, Fano's inequality yields a floor $B(s)$. This floor is a lower bound on what we term goal revelation, the mutual information $\mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s)$ between the human's latent goal and the realised trajectory. Empowerment caps revelation from above, so that $B(s) \le \mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s) \le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h \to ξ\mid s) \le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$. Each quantity can be large while the one below it stays at zero, highlighting the following failure modes. An assistant maximising empowerment can prefer an interface offering broad influence over goal-irrelevant degrees of freedom to one that lets the human attain every goal they might hold. An assistant maximising revelation cannot tell a working interface from one rewired so that every goal yields the wrong outcome, since relabelling goals leaves mutual information unchanged while zeroing every attainment probability. Positive guarantees therefore come only from the attainment end of the chain. A satisfaction floor, computable from two statistics of interaction logs, offers a way to monitor the power users retain in a deployed system, and simulations in random environments show the three quantities are correlated but far from interchangeable.

</details>


### [330] [Robust Ranking of Port Impacts from Impending Tropical Cyclones: A Two-Stage Recommendation System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07296)
*Chenchen Kuai,Shixuan Tang,Chaolun Ma,Xiaoqiang Kong,Xiubin Bruce Wang,Yunlong Zhang,Zihao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出两阶段推荐框架（候选港口检索+影响天数排序），比较三种港口-气旋交互建模方式，其中Wide & Deep Learning与观测港口排序一致性最高且对登陆点不确定性更稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带气旋威胁多个港口时，需要预判哪些港口受影响及扰动持续时间，但单港口历史观测稀少、登陆位置不确定，使相对影响难以估计。

Method: 构建两阶段推荐框架：第一阶段依据港口与预期登陆点的距离检索候选港口；第二阶段按估计影响天数排序。基于墨西哥湾37个港口、31次气旋的AIS影响天数数据，比较三种港口-气旋交互表示：成对特征交互、树模型特征组合、显式特征交叉结合学习嵌入。以Nicole与Ian飓风为测试案例。

Result: 检索阶段在登陆不确定性下均能识别全部实际受影响港口；排序模型中Wide & Deep Learning与观测排序一致性最佳，平均排序一致度较距离基线分别提升85.5%（Nicole）和55.5%（Ian），且对登陆位置不确定性更不敏感。

Conclusion: 该方法可辅助港口管理部门对同一事件威胁下的港口排定风后巡检优先级并分配恢复资源。

Abstract: When a tropical cyclone (TC) threatens several ports, preparedness planning depends on anticipating which ports are likely to be affected and where disruptions may last longest. Limited historical observations at individual ports and uncertainty in landfall location make these relative impacts difficult to estimate. We use a two-stage recommendation framework that first selects candidate ports based on their proximity to the expected landfall location and then ranks them by their estimated number of impact days. Using AIS-derived impact days for 37 ports and 31 TCs in the Gulf of Mexico study region, we compare three ways of representing port--cyclone interactions: pairwise feature interactions, tree-based feature combinations, and explicit feature crosses combined with learned embeddings. In tests on Hurricanes Nicole and Ian, the retrieval stage consistently identifies all observed affected ports under landfall uncertainty. Among the ranking models, Wide & Deep Learning achieves the closest agreement with the observed port rankings. Its mean ranking agreement exceeds that of the distance-based baseline by 85.5% for Nicole and 55.5% for Ian and is less sensitive to uncertainty in the landfall location. These rankings could help port authorities prioritize post-cyclone inspections and allocate recovery resources across ports threatened by the same event.

</details>


### [331] [EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07372)
*Mingxuan Li,Huanzhi Mao,Qiuyang Mang,Hanchen Li,Joseph E. Gonzalez,Alex Dimakis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EnvOpt，对"静态环境"进行自动化端到端优化，在无需评分器或参考答案的情况下降低LLM智能体成本并提升通过率，且可跨模型、跨harness迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体成本与成功率由模型参数、harness与环境三者共同决定；已有研究集中于参数调优与harness优化，环境这一维度未被系统优化。实际部署中智能体常处于被多任务共享的富信息环境（如企业协作空间、复杂数据源/文档/工单集合），即静态环境，具备优化价值。

Method: EnvOpt：面向任意给定模型与harness，对静态环境进行自动化端到端优化；可利用真实或合成任务，且无需评分器或参考答案即可驱动优化；并总结自动化过程中成功的与被淘汰的环境优化策略。

Result: 在AutomationBench上，Claude Haiku 4.5成本降低72.7%、通过率提升14.34%；同一环境迁移至Opus 5，成本降低68.1%、提升1.34%；叠加在Meta-Harness为Haiku 4.5优化的harness之上，成本再降83.4%、准确率较单用Meta-Harness再增11.17%；在5个基准上均显著降本并保持或提升通过率。

Conclusion: 信息向智能体呈现的表示方式同时决定其成本与成功率，因此环境与参数、harness并列，是值得优化的第三维度；EnvOpt具备跨模型、跨harness的可迁移性。

Abstract: An LLM agent's cost and success depend on its model, its harness, and its environment. In addition to the widely studied directions of parameter tuning and harness optimization, we propose the third direction: optimization over stationary environments. Agents are often deployed in rich environments shared by many tasks, such as a company's Slack workspace or a complex collection of data sources, documents or tickets. We call these environments stationary environments. We introduce EnvOpt, a method for automated end-to-end optimization of stationary environments for any given model and harness, using real or synthetic tasks without needing any graders or reference answers. On AutomationBench, EnvOpt reduces the cost of Claude Haiku 4.5 by 72.7% and raises its pass rate by 14.34%. The same environment transfers to Opus 5, cutting its cost by 68.1% with a 1.34% gain. Added on top of Meta-Harness's optimized harness for Haiku 4.5, it lowers cost by a further 83.4% and adds 11.17% accuracy over Meta-Harness alone. Across 5 benchmarks, EnvOpt significantly reduces the cost of agents while improving or maintaining pass rate, and is transferable to different models and different harnesses. We also discuss common successful and rejected environment optimization strategies during automated optimization. More broadly, our results show that how information is represented to an agent shapes both its cost and its success, making the environment worth optimizing in addition to the parameters and the harness.

</details>


### [332] [FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07464)
*Yupeng Cao,Xueqing Peng,Lingfei Qian,Haohang Li,Yangyang Yu,Anke Xu,Wenbo Cao,Yan Wang,Yuechen Jiang,Yuyan Wang,Zhuohan Xie,Yankai Chen,Zehan Li,Jimin Huang,Xue Liu,Jian-Yun Nie,Sophia Ananiadou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出开放世界金融智能体评测范式FINCOSMOS，用隐藏策略模拟用户、Web取数、时点正确性程序化验收替代参考答案，结果显示现有编码智能体零通过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融是用户最难信任语言智能体的场景：数据须来自开放Web、策略仅存于用户头脑、正确性依赖时间。这类智能体可能"静默失败"（执行用户未要求的策略、使用未核实数据、回测使用未来信息），却产出与正确结果同样有说服力的报告。现有基准通过固定任务、数据或时间线把世界"封闭"起来，反而消除了这些失败模式而非度量它们。

Method: 构建开放世界评测范式FINCOSMOS：模拟用户持有由组合语法采样的隐藏策略，仅在主动询问时披露；智能体初始无数据，须自行从Web获取数据、在数据截止日（data cutoff）约束下自建回测并交付可验证结果。评分无需参考答案：由程序验证时点正确性（point-in-time correctness）、重算全部上报指标、将交付策略与隐藏规格比对，且须用户满意并通过15项否决式检查（veto checks）才判定通过。

Result: 在150次会话中测试四个编码智能体与一个无工具模型，无一会话被接受；所有被模拟用户签字认可的会话均至少未通过一项程序检查；智能体对未被明确告知的细节仅能主动提出54%–64%。人类专家将88.33%的失败归因于智能体本身。

Conclusion: 现有智能体在开放世界金融任务上系统性静默失败，"用户满意"与"结果正确"严重脱节，故需程序化、时点感知、双轨（用户满意+否决检查）的验收机制；借助FINCOSMOS反馈，具备持久记忆的智能体学会全部十项任务，表明该范式可作为可训练、可复现的评测与改进信号。

Abstract: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. Existing benchmarks close the world somewhere, fixing the task, the data, or the timeline, and thereby remove these failures instead of measuring them. We introduce FINCOSMOS, an open-world evaluation paradigm for agents doing financial work. A simulated user holds a hidden strategy sampled from a compositional grammar and reveals it only when asked. The agent receives no data, so it must acquire data from the Web, build its own backtest under a data cutoff, and deliver verifiable results. Grading needs no reference answer. Programs verify point-in-time correctness and recompute every reported metric, the delivered strategy is checked against the hidden specification, and a run is accepted only when the user is satisfied and none of 15 veto checks fails. Across four coding agents and a model without tools in 150 sessions, no session is accepted: every session that the simulated user signed off fails a program check, and agents raise only 54--64\% of the details they were not told. Human experts attribute 88.33\% of failures to the agents. With FINCOSMOS feedback, an agent with persistent memory learned all ten tasks.

</details>


### [333] [SAVeR$^2$: Reasoning-based Safety Alignment for Large Reasoning Models via Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07482)
*Yichen Sun,Qirui Liu,Yan Wang,Jianan Lin,Linbo Jiang,Shiyu Wang,Zhibo Wang,Zhixuan Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SAVeR²方法，利用推理能力进行细粒度安全对齐，在消除"安全税"的同时实现更优安全性能与更低过度拒答率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型（LRM）的显式链式思维（CoT）推理带来安全风险。作者将LRM安全目标形式化为：非恶意推理与非恶意回答、安全一致性、显式意图识别。现有对齐方法忽略了LRM内在推理能力，导致对抗泛化差、推理上的"安全税"（safety tax）以及粗粒度奖励不忠实三大问题。

Method: SAVeR²（Safety Alignment via Rewards with Reasoning capability）：（1）将安全目标分解为四个细粒度可验证奖励信号；（2）采用难度感知的数据选择策略稳定训练；（3）引入推理保持的梯度投影机制，解析地消解安全梯度与推理梯度之间的冲突，从理论上消除安全税。

Result: 在1.5B至671B参数规模的模型上进行广泛实验，SAVeR²在多个基准上取得更优安全表现并显著降低过度拒答率，同时不损害通用推理能力。

Conclusion: 利用LRM自身推理能力进行细粒度、可验证奖励的安全对齐，配合梯度投影解耦安全与推理目标，可在提升安全性的同时避免推理能力退化，为LRM安全对齐提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved impressive performance via explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, yet this process introduces critical safety risks. We formalize LRM safety objectives as requiring non-malicious reasoning and answers, safety consistency, and explicit intent identification. We argue that existing alignment methods suffer from poor adversarial generalization, a significant ``safety tax'' on reasoning, and unfaithful coarse-grained rewards, primarily due to their neglect of the LRM's intrinsic reasoning capabilities for safety. To address these, we propose \textbf{SAVeR$^2$}, a novel \textbf{S}afety \textbf{A}lignment method via \textbf{R}ewards with \textbf{R}easoning capability. SAVeR$^2$ decomposes the safety objective into four fine-grained verifiable reward signals and utilizes a difficulty-aware data selection strategy to stabilize training. Crucially, we introduce a reasoning-preserving gradient projection mechanism that analytically resolves conflicts between safety and reasoning gradients, effectively eliminating the safety tax. Extensive experiments on models ranging from 1.5B to 671B demonstrate that SAVeR$^2$ achieves superior safety performance and significantly lower over-refusal rates across multiple benchmarks without compromising general reasoning capabilities.

</details>


### [334] [DelegateEval: Evaluating Platforms for Personal External Service Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07508)
*Jichao Li,Jinrong Lu,Manjiang Yu,Zhixuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"个人外部服务智能体"（personal external service agent）概念，即由个人授权并持续管理、以其知识/经验/方法/服务边界为外部客户提供服务的智能体；并据此提出平台级评估框架 DelegateEval，涵盖八个维度，以衡量平台能否让不同背景的人把专长转化为可持续、可验证、经济可行的服务。文中给出框架与实验设计，完整数据集、可执行环境、统一评分协议及跨模型结果尚待构建与实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI智能体研究多关注通用任务完成，缺乏对"个人将自身专长委托给智能体、持续为外部客户交付服务"这一场景的系统评估。作者希望明确该智能体形态，并建立平台级评估以判断其能否真正将个人专长规模化、可治理地转化为经济价值，填补评估框架空白。

Method: 提出 DelegateEval 平台级评估框架，面向可能组合大语言模型、可复用技能、MCP 等协议与可执行工具环境的智能体系统。框架设八个评估维度：创建易用性、服务发现与匹配、交付质量、专长继承、服务连续性、学习与改进、可靠性与治理、效率与价值。论文给出框架描述与实验设计（experimental design），尚无完整数据集与统一评分协议。

Result: 论文属于框架/立场性工作，未报告实证结果。完整数据集、可执行环境、统一评分协议与跨模型比较结果均被列为待开发与待验证内容。

Conclusion: 作者确立了"个人外部服务智能体"的问题定义与评估维度，为后续平台化研究与基准建设提供路线图；其有效性仍取决于后续数据集、可执行环境与评分协议的落地及实证检验。

Abstract: AI agents that work for an individual over time may also help that individual serve external clients. We define a personal external service agent as an agent authorized and continuously managed by a specific individual to accept client requests, deliver work, and provide ongoing support using that person's knowledge, experience, professional methods, and service boundaries. Such agents could allow individuals to serve more clients with less direct involvement and generate economic value at scale. We propose DelegateEval, a platform-level evaluation framework for agent systems that may combine large language models, reusable skills, protocols such as MCP, and executable tool environments. It covers eight dimensions: ease of creation, service discovery and matching, delivery quality, expertise inheritance, service continuity, learning and improvement, reliability and governance, and efficiency and value. These dimensions assess whether a platform enables people with different backgrounds to turn their expertise into ongoing services that deliver verifiable work, develop capabilities through experience, and remain economically feasible. We present the framework and an experimental design. Complete datasets, executable environments, a unified scoring protocol, and cross-model results remain to be developed and empirically validated.

</details>


### [335] [Graph learning-assisted logic-based Benders decomposition for distributionally robust in-station train rescheduling under disruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07520)
*Xiaobin Li,Yanbin Gao,Jianing Long,Wuming Lei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出滚动时域分布鲁棒优化模型，联合优化列车路径、顺序与时刻，并用GNN-LBBD算法求解资源关闭恢复时间不确定下的列车扣车与改道决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源关闭的重新开放时间不确定，且与到达延误、处理时间延长叠加，使列车扣车与改道决策复杂化；需在信息逐步揭示的过程中进行鲁棒调度。

Method: 构建滚动时域分布鲁棒模型，随中断解除观测更新剩余关闭时长预测，在场景概率的模糊集上最小化最坏情况期望总完工延误；设计GNN-LBBD算法，以逻辑型Benders分解协调路径与资源调度，基于资源使用模式构造条件割，并用图神经网络指导资源松弛子问题的求解顺序。

Result: 在五轨车站28个测试实例上，GNN-LBBD平均总完工延误61.13 train-min，比禁忌搜索低16.63%、比变邻域搜索低20.06%，平均计算时间接近禁忌搜索；6个代表性实例的信息对比显示，利用中断解除观测使平均总完工延误降低约21.7%；在相同信息条件下，基于场景与条件均值的预测总体结果相近。

Conclusion: 观测信息的价值在具备备选路径的实例中更显著，表明观测利用、车站资源结构与时刻调整空间之间存在关联；分布鲁棒滚动框架结合GNN加速的Benders分解可有效处理恢复时间不确定性。

Abstract: Uncertainty in resource reopening times complicates train holding and rerouting decisions when resource closures coincide with arrival delays and processing-time extensions. We develop a rolling-horizon distributionally robust model that updates predictions of the remaining closure duration as observations of disruption resolution become available. The model jointly optimizes train routes, sequences, and timings. It minimizes the worst-case expected total completion delay over an ambiguity set of scenario probabilities. The solution algorithm, GNN-LBBD, uses logic-based Benders decomposition to coordinate routing and resource scheduling. Conditional cuts are constructed from resource-use patterns, and a graph neural network guides the order in which resource relaxation subproblems are solved. Across 28 test instances for a five-track station, GNN-LBBD achieved a mean total completion delay of 61.13 train-min. This was 16.63\% lower than tabu search and 20.06\% lower than variable neighborhood search, with a mean total computation time close to that of tabu search. Information comparisons on six representative instances showed that using observations of disruption resolution reduced mean total completion delay by approximately 21.7\%. Scenario-based and conditional-mean predictions produced similar overall results under the same information conditions. The benefits of information were more pronounced in some instances with alternative routes. This suggests a relationship between the use of observations, the station resource structure, and the scope for schedule adjustments.

</details>


### [336] [Goal-Branching LaCAM: Temporary Goals as Search Branches in Dense Multi-Agent Pathfinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07528)
*Stephen Chang,Daniel Harabor*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Goal-Branching：为阻塞智能体分配临时目标并作为 LaCAM 搜索的额外分支，在保持完备性的同时显著提升密集场景下的求解速度与成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LaCAM 虽完备，但在密集、走廊型实例中易陷入死锁；解开死锁需要多个智能体协调移动（常需远离目标），而 PIBT 的贪心单步后继很少产生此类动作，LaCAM 又只能逐智能体枚举约束来逼近，导致效率低下。

Method: 对阻塞智能体赋予临时目标，将其作为一种新的分支加入 LaCAM 的联合配置 DFS 搜索；研究随机与走廊感知两类临时目标选择规则，并从理论上证明对任意选择规则完备性均得以保持。

Result: 在三类迷宫与房间地图、60–90% 空闲单元占用率的密集实例上，求解率达 89%（LaCAM* 为 44%）；在双方均可求解的实例上，maze-32-32-2 与 room-32-32-4 首次解快 10–14 倍，room-32-32-4 在 75% 密度下中位时间快近 200 倍；解成本上升 15–22%。在开阔地图与完整 MovingAI 基准上，解成本不高于 LaCAM*，运行时间最多慢 3%。

Conclusion: Goal-Branching 是一种简单且完备的搜索增强机制，在大幅改善密集场景求解能力的同时，对开阔场景几乎无代价，实现了速度与解质量之间的可控权衡。

Abstract: LaCAM is a search-based solver for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF) that runs a depth-first search over joint configurations, using PIBT to generate successors and lazily adding single-agent constraints to explore alternatives. Although LaCAM is complete, it can struggle on dense, corridor-heavy instances because extracting blocking agents from deadlocks requires coordinated moves of several agents, often away from their goals, which PIBT's greedy one-step successors rarely propose and which LaCAM can only reach by enumerating constraints one agent at a time. This paper proposes Goal-Branching, where blocking agents are given temporary goals, each tried as an additional branch of LaCAM's search. We examine random and corridor-aware rules for choosing these temporary goals and show that completeness is preserved for any such rule. On dense instances (60-90% of free cells occupied) of three maze and room maps, Goal-Branching solves 89% of instances against 44% for LaCAM*, and, on instances both solve, it finds a first solution 10-14x faster on maze-32-32-2 and room-32-32-4, and nearly 200x faster in median time at 75% density on room-32-32-4. Solution cost increases by 15-22% on instances both solve, while on open maps and the full MovingAI benchmark its solutions cost no more than those of LaCAM* and it is at most 3% slower.

</details>


### [337] [CST-Bench: Benchmarking Counterfactual Spatial Transition Reasoning with Causal Transition On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07541)
*Ying Li,Yongle Cheng,Jing Li,Xingquan Cai,Yawei Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出反事实空间推理基准 CST-Bench（7,082 例，6 类干预、12 种变换算子，含稠密因果标注），并给出将反事实空间推理建模为因果状态转移的 CT-OPSD 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 空间推理基准主要聚焦静态场景理解；当物体被移动或交换时，模型不仅需推断空间关系，还需推断干预如何改变场景状态，而此能力缺乏评测与监督资源。

Method: 构建 CST-Bench 基准，含 6 类干预、12 种变换算子与稠密因果标注（干预来源、受影响关系、预期效果、不变关系、度量变化）；在基准上评测通用 MLLM 并比较后训练策略；提出 CT-OPSD，将反事实空间推理形式化为因果状态转移建模，用 CST-Bench 标注引导教师模型学习反事实状态转移与因果推理链，再将推理链蒸馏到仅依赖真实观测的学生模型。

Result: 对普通空间推理有效的方法在反事实干预下仍可能失败；CST-Bench 被验证为具有挑战性的基准兼可复用监督资源，CT-OPSD 初步证明其标注可用于提升模型性能。

Conclusion: CST-Bench 填补了反事实空间推理评测的空白，并可作为标注监督资源；CT-OPSD 展示了从反事实标注到模型改进的可行路径。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing benchmarks mainly focus on static scene understanding. When objects are moved or swapped, models must infer not only spatial relations but also how interventions change the scene state. To address this problem, we introduce CST-Bench, a benchmark for counterfactual spatial reasoning. CST-Bench contains 7,082 examples covering 6 intervention types and 12 transformation operators, with dense causal annotations including intervention sources, affected relations, expected effects, invariant relations, and metric changes. We benchmark general-purpose MLLMs on CST-Bench and further compare post-training strategies on CST-Bench and standard spatial benchmarks. Results show that methods effective for ordinary spatial reasoning can still fail under counterfactual interventions. We further formulate counterfactual spatial reasoning as causal state-transition modeling and propose CT-OPSD, which uses CST-Bench annotations to guide a teacher model in learning counterfactual state transitions and causal reasoning chains. These chains are then distilled into a student model that reasons only from real observations. Overall, experiment results establish CST-Bench as a challenging benchmark and reusable supervision resource for counterfactual spatial reasoning. CT-OPSD further provides an initial demonstration of how its annotations can support model improvement.

</details>


### [338] [FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07542)
*Xuan Wang,Zhuanhao Wu,Tingzhu Fang,Xushi Li,Sicheng Zhang,Zhenyu Yang,Feng Liu,Zhaohui Fan,Qiang Xie,Huayi Zou,Yuncong Liu,Zeyu Song,Ke Zhu,Yanjia Zeng,Jingchun Gao,Yan Shi,Kui Luo,Gezi Li,Liangjun Feng,Cheng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlashOffloading 将 KV cache 全量卸载至主机 DRAM，通过滚动 HBM 缓存、热缓存、逆向稀疏索引与计算-加载重叠内核，在 TPOT 约束下显著提升长上下文推理吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 服务中 KV cache 随序列长度与并发数线性增长，长上下文推理易触及 HBM 容量墙，导致并发度受限；卸载到主机 DRAM 虽可释放 HBM、提升并发，但引入缓存管理与 H2D 加载开销，使延迟上升，高并发无法转化为有效吞吐。

Method: 提出以主机 DRAM 为中心的推理架构，prefill 与 decode 阶段均全量卸载 KV cache；设计 prefill 滚动 HBM 缓存、decode 热缓存、零额外缺失查找开销的逆向稀疏索引，以及计算-加载重叠内核，端到端优化卸载延迟。

Result: 在 Ascend910C PD 分离平台上部署 GLM-5.2 并采用 MTP3 投机解码，30 ms TPOT 约束下 prefill 吞吐最高提升 1.38×，decode 吞吐最高提升 1.91×。

Conclusion: FlashOffloading 证明了主机 DRAM 中心化的 KV cache 卸载可在满足 TPOT SLO 的前提下将并发优势转化为实际吞吐收益，并已集成至开源 vLLM-Ascend 框架。

Abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving systems, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency, so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity wall and results in low concurrency. Offloading the KV cache to host dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) frees HBM space and raises concurrency, but the additional cache management and host-to-device (H2D) load overhead inflates inference latency, higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. We present FlashOffloading, a host-DRAM-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the KV cache in both the prefill and decode phases. FlashOffloading builds rolling HBM cache for prefill, a hot cache for decode, a reverse sparse index with zero extra miss-lookup overhead, and a compute--load overlapped kernel, optimizing KV offloading latency across the entire pipeline and delivering throughput gains under a time-per-output-token (TPOT) service-level objective (SLO). In experiments deploying GLM-5.2 with multi-token prediction (MTP3) speculative decoding on an Ascend910C prefill--decode (PD)-disaggregated platform, FlashOffloading improves prefill throughput by up to 1.38\(\times\) and decode throughput by up to 1.91\(\times\) under a 30 ms TPOT constraint.
