Scrutiny is concentrated in some conversations, while its apparent turn-to-turn persistence becomes much smaller when conversation-level differences and response ordering are examined separately. These results suggest that supporting verification requires attention to what evidence can be inspected, which question a user is trying to resolve, and the history of the interaction.

</details>


### [373] [Value-oriented policy distillation for interpretable wind farm power control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08245)
*Max Bruninx,Timothy Verstraeten,Jan Decuyper,Ann Nowé,Jan Helsen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于可解释提升机（EBM）的策略蒸馏框架，将强化学习控制策略转化为透明的风电场隐式均衡控制策略，并引入价值导向视角与专家知识，在比利时电网数据上将不平衡成本降低82%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风电场可通过隐式均衡利用TSO公布的失衡价格信息调整功率设定点，既帮助系统恢复平衡又降低自身失衡成本。但结算价格事先未知且受控制策略本身影响，问题困难；强化学习虽可求解，却缺乏可解释性，难以在真实风电场部署。

Method: 构建策略蒸馏框架，以可解释提升机（EBM，广义加性模型的一种变体）作为学生模型，从强化学习策略中提取透明的控制策略；借鉴能源预测研究提出价值导向的策略蒸馏视角以提升EBM模型捕获的价值；并在模型设计中融入专家知识，使控制策略对利益相关方具备可辩护性。实验采用比利时电网与某海上风电场的真实数据。

Result: 价值导向且基于专家的控制器可将不平衡成本降低82%，同时优于价格阈值控制器以及基于决策树的策略蒸馏基线。

Conclusion: EBM策略蒸馏能够在保持透明性与可解释性的前提下实现高效的风电场隐式均衡控制，兼顾价值获取与利益相关方可接受性，具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Wind farm power control can help the system maintain balance and avoid blackouts. In Europe, this can be achieved through implicit balancing, where a wind farm adjusts its power setpoint in anticipation of the imbalance price using information published by the Transmission System Operator. Thereby, the wind farm helps restore system balance while also reducing its own imbalance costs resulting from forecast errors. However, implicit balancing is a challenging problem since the settlement price is unknown in advance and can be impacted by the pursued control strategy. Reinforcement learning methods could help to solve this problem, but lack the interpretability needed to be deployed on real wind farms. Therefore, we propose a policy distillation framework using explainable boosting machines (EBMs), a variant of generalized additive models, to obtain a transparent control policy. To increase the value captured by the EBM model, we introduce a value-oriented perspective to policy distillation inspired by research in the field of energy forecasting. Furthermore, we suggest to include expert knowledge during model design, such that the control strategy is also justifiable to stakeholders. Using real data of the Belgian grid and an offshore wind farm, we find that our value-oriented and expert-based controller can reduce imbalance costs by 82%, while outperforming a price threshold controller as well as a policy distillation baseline using decision trees.

</details>


### [374] [The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08262)
*Mathis Immertreu,Fitim Abdullahu,Thomas Kinfe,Claus Metzner,Helmut Grabner,Patrick Krauss,Achim Schilling*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究考察Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct中"人格条件化"的视觉趣味性判断，发现内部表征几何与行为判断之间存在系统性解离：提示框定（framing）更强地重塑内部表征，而人格内容更强地影响行为评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态语言模型能模拟不同观察者视角，但被赋予的视角如何重塑其内部表征、这些表征变化是否驱动其判断，尚不清楚。作者希望厘清"表征距离"与"行为相关性"的关系。

Method: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上研究人格条件化的视觉趣味性（visual interestingness）。实验覆盖100张图像与53种提示条件，系统性地变化人格内容（persona content）与引入人格的语言框定方式（linguistic framing），同时记录行为评分与逐层隐藏状态，并分析表征几何随处理深度的演化。

Result: 表征几何随层深发生系统性重组：浅层主要编码图像身份，人格特异结构在较深层出现。值得注意的是，提示框定对内部表征的重塑强于人格身份本身；而人格内容对行为判断的影响更大。此外，不改变回答的最小化身份陈述（minimal identity statements）仍能改变表征，进一步印证二者的解离。

Conclusion: 表征距离并不必然反映行为相关性。模拟视角在人工认知系统的表征空间中呈现出可辨识的结构，揭示了内部表征几何与其功能后果之间的根本区别。

Abstract: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.

</details>


### [375] [LeanContext: Disentangling Mathematical Resources from Local Formal Context in Lean Whole-Proof Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08277)
*Hang Zhang,Qihao Ye,Litong Liu,Yunbei Zhang,Yugyung Lee,Yue Zhou,Bowen Liu,Emily First,Cheng Han,Qiao Zhuang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 LeanContext 基准（129,826 个 Lean 全证明生成问题），用于评估检索到的前提与项目上下文对神经定理证明的价值，并考察该价值对训练方式的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经定理证明越来越多地依赖检索前提与项目上下文，但缺少统一手段来衡量"目标选中的声明相较可比替代项的增益"，以及该增益如何受训练影响。

Method: 将选中的完整前置数学声明编为 Mathematical Context (MC)，其余选中的局部源命令编为 Environment Context (EC)；构造四种对齐的输入视图，共用同一目标与原始 Lean 验证环境，以支持交叉的训练—推理评估；采用扩散与自回归两类模型；并通过最终输入审计识别目标所引用但被遗漏的声明。

Result: 当训练包含 MC 时，选中声明相对可比替代项的增益显著更大；优先纳入被遗漏的依赖使 LLaDA 与 Llama 的 Pass@32 分别在 2,000 个目标上提升 1.40% 与 1.70%。

Conclusion: 选择实验在无法访问目标参考证明、固定检查点、EC 与推理预算的条件下进行，表明 MC 训练与依赖补齐对上下文利用与证明成功率有稳定收益；代码与数据集均已公开。

Abstract: Neural theorem proving increasingly uses retrieved premises and project context to support proof generation. Evaluating these resources requires measuring the advantage of target-selected declarations over comparable alternatives and how this advantage depends on training. We introduce LeanContext, a benchmark of 129,826 Lean whole-proof generation problems, to investigate these questions. We group selected complete preceding mathematical declarations as Mathematical Context (MC) and the remaining selected local source commands as Environment Context (EC). Four aligned input views support crossed training and inference evaluations with shared targets and original Lean verification environments. For both diffusion- and autoregressive-based models, selected declarations outperform comparable alternatives by a larger margin when training includes MC. Final-input audits identify omitted declarations referenced by the target. Prioritizing these dependencies improves Pass@32 by 1.40% and 1.70% for LLaDA and Llama, respectively, on 2,000 targets. The selection experiment operates without access to target reference proofs and holds checkpoints, EC, and inference budgets constant. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/haaaardcvZ/LeanContext.

</details>


### [376] [A Generative Model of Contextual Integrity: Appropriate vs. Inappropriate Information Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08284)
*Omer Ebead,Claude Formanek,Joel Z. Leibo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文用大语言模型构建"语境完整性"(CI)的生成式模型：两个LLM扮演对话双方，一方持有隐私信息、另一方索取，考察信息分享与拒绝如何随情境、决策逻辑、性格倾向及基座模型变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CI理论认为信息流的恰当性取决于语境特定规范，同一披露在此语境合适、在彼语境不当。作者希望提供一个可操作的生成式建模途径，在受控但贴近真实的对话动态中研究披露与拒绝如何形成，弥补静态范式难以刻画对话过程与情境变化的不足。

Method: 以LLM扮演两个行为体进行消息往返的模拟对话：一者持有隐私信息，另一者主动索取。系统性地改变情境（索取者是否有权获知、信息是否被需要）、持有者的决策逻辑、性格倾向（disposition）以及底层语言模型，观察分享与拒绝行为的变化。

Result: 持有者在信息被需要时向合法接收者分享，但也会向无权获知者披露信息，即出现越界披露；分享与拒绝的比例随上述变量（情境、决策逻辑、性格倾向、基座模型）而变化。

Conclusion: 该生成式CI模型为研究披露与拒绝如何在对话中、随情境与行为体变化而演化提供了方法学工具，可作为隐私行为研究与CI规范评估的模拟实验平台。

Abstract: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that appropriate information flow depends on context-specific norms. The same disclosure may be appropriate in one context and inappropriate in another. We build a generative model of contextual integrity to study information sharing through simulated conversations. Two actors played by large language models exchange messages, with one holding private information and the other seeking it. We examine how sharing and refusal vary with the situation, the holder's decision logic, disposition, and the underlying language model. Actors shared information with the rightful recipients when it was needed, but also disclosed it to people who were not entitled to receive it. The model provides a way to study how disclosure and refusal develop through conversation as the situations and the actors vary.

</details>


### [377] [First-Token Attraction in Mamba Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08303)
*Trinh T. Nguyen,Minh-Khoi Nguyen-Nhat,Duy-Tung Pham,Hoang-Son Do,Tan Minh Nguyen,Thieu N. Vo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究深度 Mamba 模型中的 token 动力学，揭示第一个 token 具有"特权"动力学：其极限方向吸引后续 token，导致 token 聚类与 attention-sink 现象，并给出显式指数收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力机制中 token 交互由正标量系数控制，而 Mamba 的交互系数为矩阵值，缺乏正性/定性保证，导致现有注意力分析技术无法直接套用，Mamba 动力学分析困难。作者希望刻画深度 Mamba 中 token 轨迹的极限行为与收敛性。

Method: 提出新分析框架：基于高维不变箱（invariant box）与尖锐的退出时间（exit-time）论证，恢复出有效形式的符号定性；据此刻画 token 轨迹可能的极限点并证明显式指数收敛速率；并将吸引机制推广到更广泛的序列动力学（状态空间模型、因果注意力、经典时间序列模型）。

Result: 理论上证明第一个 token 的极限方向吸引后续 token，诱导 token 聚类与 attention-sink 现象并给出指数收敛率；在 Falcon-Mamba-7B 上的实验验证了预测：对首 token 的集中度随深度增加，并在后层占据主导。

Conclusion: 深度 Mamba 存在类似 attention sink 的首 token 吸引机制，该机制具有一般性，可延伸至状态空间模型、因果注意力与经典时序模型；不变箱+退出时间框架为无正性保证的矩阵值动力学分析提供了有效工具。

Abstract: We study token dynamics in deep Mamba models, with a particular focus on the attracting role of the first token. Unlike attention mechanisms, where token interactions are governed by positive scalar coefficients, Mamba dynamics involve full matrix-valued interaction coefficients with no positivity or definiteness guarantees. This structural difference makes Mamba dynamics substantially harder to analyze and prevents the direct application of existing techniques for attention-based models. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a new analytical framework based on a high-dimensional invariant box and a sharp exit-time argument, which together recover an effective form of sign-definiteness. Using this framework, we characterize the possible limit points of token trajectories and prove explicit exponential convergence rates. Our analysis reveals that the first token has privileged dynamics: its limiting direction attracts subsequent tokens, inducing token clustering and attention-sink phenomena in deep Mamba models. We further show that this attraction mechanism extends to broader sequence dynamics, including state-space models, causal attention, and classical time-series models. Experiments on Falcon-Mamba-7B validate our predictions, showing that concentration on the first token increases with depth and dominates in later layers.

</details>


### [378] [XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11676)
*Wooseong Yang,Wei-Chieh Huang,Weizhi Zhang,Yu Wang,Philip S. Yu,Junhyun Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 XBRIDGE——一种免解码的跨架构 LLM 多智能体通信协议，通过词法锚定映射(LAM)与潜在富化桥(LEB)解决"实体接地"问题，在三种模型族、七个基准上全面优于文本通信且延迟降低11倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构多智能体 LLM 系统可减少冗余推理，但现有通信协议存在两难：文本协议丢弃发送方内部表征；潜在层传输要求架构同构。作者进一步指出跨架构通信中的"实体接地问题"——跨注意力桥在连续瓶颈中发生稀有词元压缩坍缩，导致实体身份丢失（仅桥接时 F1 约30%）。

Method: 1) 词法锚定映射 LAM：将发送方原始上下文词元映射到接收方词表，提供离散实体锚点；2) 潜在富化桥 LEB：让接收方查询发送方隐状态以获得上下文富化信号，并由实体锚点经接收方自身自注意力将桥接信号接地到具体实体。整体为免解码协议，LEB 仅需 264M 可训练参数（接收方 3.8%），在小规模均衡样本集上训练。

Result: 在 Llama、Qwen、Mistral 三个模型族、七个基准、双向通信设置下，XBRIDGE 在每个模型对的全部七项任务上均优于文本通信，延迟降低 11 倍；在同构设置下，七项任务中有六项超过 KV 共享基线；推理开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 显式离散实体锚点与潜在桥接的结合可有效克服跨架构连续通信中的实体坍缩，实现高效、轻量且跨模型族的异构多智能体通信。

Abstract: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) maps the sender's original context tokens to the receiver's vocabulary, providing discrete entity anchors. A Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) lets the receiver query the sender's hidden states for contextual enrichment. The entity anchors ground the bridge's contextual signals to specific entities through the receiver's own self-attention. Across three model families (Llama, Qwen, and Mistral), seven benchmarks, and both communication directions, XBRIDGE outperforms text-based communication on all seven tasks for each model pair while achieving 11x lower latency, and in a same-architecture setting it also exceeds a KV-sharing baseline on six of seven tasks. LEB requires only 264M trainable parameters (3.8% of the receiver), is trained on a small balanced sample set, and adds negligible inference overhead.

</details>


### [379] [RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08308)
*Roko Parac,Christos Ziakas,Leo Ardon,Alessandra Russo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RM-VLM用LLM从自然语言任务描述生成奖励机(RM)，并用视觉语言模型(VLM)充当标签函数，在图像观测上落地RM命题，同时以VLM价值估计器提供稠密奖励，从而实现无需人工设计标签函数的非马尔可夫奖励学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励机能将非马尔可夫任务表示为自动机并纳入马尔可夫框架，但其依赖人工为每个环境设计的标签函数（命题落地oracle），限制了适用范围。作者希望消除这一人工瓶颈。

Method: 提出RM-VLM：1) 用LLM根据自然语言任务描述自动生成奖励机；2) 用VLM作为标签函数，在基于图像的观测上对RM命题做落地；3) 用一个基于VLM的价值函数估计器评估智能体在每个RM转移上的进展，据此导出稠密奖励信号；并在RM引导的策略学习中使用。

Result: 在非马尔可夫网格世界导航、机器人操作、3D物体收集三个域上进行评估，RM-VLM在所有测试域上的任务成功率均稳定高于现有基于VLM的奖励方法。

Conclusion: LLM生成奖励机与VLM标签函数相结合可有效替代人工设计的命题落地，为非马尔可夫任务的自动奖励建模提供可行路径，并在多域上优于已有VLM奖励方法。

Abstract: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.

</details>


### [380] [Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08315)
*Ali Sarabadani,Kheirolah Rahsepar Fard,Tahereh Jeirani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建跨五个知识图谱（DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、BrainMap、GDPKG）的多层级查询基准，评测五个LLM（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen、BioGPT）在KG感知（图接地）与KG无关条件下的推理深度与事实准确性。结论：通用模型在多跳与高层推理上优于领域专用模型，KG接地普遍降低幻觉率，且领域专用模型在无图接地下并未表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在生物医学与认知神经科学中的应用日益广泛，但其在异质知识图谱上进行可靠推理的能力尚不明确；同时领域专用模型是否在专业任务上优于通用模型缺乏系统性证据。

Method: 对5个LLM在5个KG上开展基准评测；构建多层级查询数据集以衡量推理深度与事实准确性；设置KG-aware（图接地）与KG-agnostic两种条件对照；采用双标注者一致性检验（Cohen's kappa=0.781，范围0.753–0.807；Fleiss' kappa=0.77）保证标注质量。

Result: 通用模型（尤以GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro）在多跳与高层推理任务上总体优于领域专用模型，但性能随查询复杂度上升而下降；KG接地在所有模型上均降低幻觉率；与初始假设相反，无图接地下领域专用模型并未稳定优于通用模型。

Conclusion: 广义语言能力与结构化领域知识的结合具有明确价值；作者据此给出按任务复杂度与算力约束选择LLM-KG集成策略的实践指南，并讨论面向个性化医疗、认知障碍诊断与可解释AI的神经符号混合架构。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.

</details>


### [381] [Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08318)
*Wenbo Huang,Jianxin Bi,Shunyu Yang,Ruiyang Si,Rui Ni,Qiang Wang,Shulong Jiang,Yintianrun Zhang,Feixiang Ruan,Kewei Zhang,Ye Huang,Shukai Gong,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文质疑机器人仿真基准中"准则暴露"（CE）的评测效度：受CE的编码智能体虽能快速提高准则下成功率，但准则轻微变动后优势消失且技能迁移差，因而主张使用"忠于指令的准则"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期自改进具身智能体在机器人仿真基准上被频繁比较，其中不少工作把基准的成功判定准则直接暴露给学习智能体（准则暴露，CE）。这些准则原本用于验证模仿学习策略，往往比对应语言指令要求更严，导致验证器分数难以忠实反映"指令任务是否完成"，尤其对智能体编写的机器人控制程序而言。因此需回答：编码智能体接触准则后，生成的是更好完成指令的代码，还是过拟合验证准则的代码。

Method: 在自改进具身编码智能体上开展控制实验，对比有/无CE两种设置；随后在保持原始指令不变的前提下对准则做轻微改动（扰动测试），并考察跨任务技能迁移；最后提出"忠于指令的准则"（instruction-faithful criteria）并验证其评测表现。

Result: 有CE时智能体迅速生成在给定准则下成功率更高的代码；但准则轻微改动后该优势消失，说明提升主要来自对验证准则的过拟合而非指令任务能力的真实提升；此外CE下习得的技能跨任务迁移效果差。提出的忠于指令的准则能更忠实地反映智能体生成程序的实际性能。

Conclusion: 将基准准则暴露给编码智能体会诱发准则过拟合，使基准分数高估任务的真实完成度，且不利于技能泛化；应改用与语言指令一致的"忠于指令的准则"来评测自改进具身智能体。

Abstract: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark's success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark's criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.

</details>


### [382] [Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08341)
*Henry Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出嵌入压缩的评测只关注近邻（局部保真度L）而忽略远端结构（全局保真度G），提出用二者共同评估，并证明远端的近-远排序违背率可由压缩距离噪声界定，由此导出LAQ量化器。LAQ把该界转化为OPQ码本上的hinge目标，在全部52次留出运行中提升G，并在12次Multi-Doc-2025运行中于七种等规模量化器里G最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入压缩以"每个条目的最近邻是否保留"作为接受标准，但AI代理还需执行合并、删除、比较等依赖"哪些条目相距很远"的任务，即全局/远端结构。因此在96字节/段落等紧凑预算下，仅凭局部保真度验收可能掩盖远端结构的严重破坏（如重打分二元码L=0.97但10.1%段落主题漂移）。

Method: 使用前期工作提出的两种无标签保真度：10近邻下的局部保真度L，以及记忆规模30%–50%范围内的全局保真度G。理论上证明在G带内，1−ν_k 至多约为近-远排序违背率平方根的2–2.18倍，且该违背率随压缩的距离噪声变化（相关0.979）。据此提出局部感知量化LAQ：将上述界转为OPQ索引码本上的hinge目标，保持字节数、旋转与检索流程不变。

Result: 96字节下重打分二元码L达0.97，却使10.1%段落换主题；PCA 8-bit码L=0.77但仅1.7%漂移，且重打分不改变存储码因而G不变。仅用重建误差在52次留出运行中0次提升G；远端hinge在52/52中提升。LAQ在全部52次运行提升G（p=8.5×10⁻⁴，覆盖13个记忆编码器组），包括外部FinDER记忆；在12次Multi-Doc-2025运行中G为七种等规模量化器最高；可扩展至百万段落并保持证据召回。

Conclusion: 局部保真度不足以验收嵌入压缩，必须同时评估并优化远端结构。基于可证明界的LAQ是首个目标函数源自远端界证明的量化器，能在不改变OPQ存储与检索接口的前提下稳健提升全局保真度。

Abstract: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-ν_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises $G$ in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises $G$ in all 52 ($p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$ over 13 memory-encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest $G$ of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.

</details>


### [383] [NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08369)
*Pengkai Wang,Wei-Wei Zhang,Yan Li,Min Tang,Zhitian Hou,Zeyu Liu,Guanghao Zhu,Yuanyi Wang,Yanggan Gu,Wenjun Wang,Minheng Ni,Congkai Xie,Zhijie Sang,Jianmin Wu,Ying Sun,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NPCBench——面向鼻咽癌（NPC）的"临床学徒制"评测基准，从指南知识、病例规划到纵向随访、CarePath整合与开放式问诊，检验模型能否将亚专业知识与多模态证据整合并追踪患者病情。在30个模型上发现"组合鸿沟"：单项任务强不等于同一患者的诊断与照护答案同时正确，21个多模态模型的严格CarePath成功率最高仅23%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学基准将临床能力拆解为孤立的事实性问题、单图任务或静态病例短文，只对单个答案打分，难以反映模型是否能把亚专科知识与多模态证据整合，并在完整诊疗过程中追踪患者状态变化。因此需要一个更贴近专科培训路径、以病程为单位的评测范式。

Method: 构建NPCBench：按专科培训阶梯设计评测层级，涵盖指南/基础知识、病例规划、纵向复核、CarePath整合与开放式问诊。数据包含4,777个组件与问诊条目，以及100例患者的CarePath队列（417个计分诊断与照护任务）。采用情节级（episode-level）评估，检验同一照护路径内诊断与照护答案是否"联合正确"；并将分步任务与患者级照护轨迹关联，考察视觉证据落地、状态变化解读与问诊中的临床要求满足度。辅以配对对照实验与医师标注校准，评估证据grounding、纵向修正与问诊评分可靠性。

Result: 在30个受评模型上观察到"组合鸿沟"（composition gap）：单项任务表现优异并不能保证同一患者的诊断与照护答案联合正确。21个多模态模型中，严格CarePath成功率最高仅23%。配对对照与医师校准进一步揭示了模型在证据grounding、纵向修订和问诊评判方面的表现差异。

Conclusion: NPCBench把医学AI评测从静态问答范式拓展到以学徒制为导向的临床工作流评估，为肿瘤诊疗中基于证据、时间一致的推理提供了可测试平台，并揭示组合级与病程级能力仍是当前模型的主要短板。

Abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. The episode-level evaluation tests whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a care pathway. By linking stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories, NPCBench evaluates whether models ground decisions in visual evidence, interpret changes in patient state, and meet clinical requirements in consultation. Across 30 evaluated models, we observe a composition gap: strong performance on individual tasks does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Among 21 multimodal models, strict CarePath success reaches at most 23%. Paired controls and physician calibration further examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging. Overall, NPCBench broadens the evaluation of medical artificial intelligence beyond static question-answering paradigms to an apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, thereby offering a testbed for evidence-based and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.

</details>


### [384] [Learning a patient world model for health system simulation in intensive care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08392)
*Yingtai Li,Ruoyan Wang,Yu Li,Shaohua Kevin Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出从纵向EHR学习患者"世界模型"（神经网络），冻结后通过情景特定映射接入ICU日历/资源/队列，用单一模型支持多种ICU策略仿真，无需针对每个新问题重建状态转移模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计医疗策略需在实施前预判临床与运营后果，依赖卫生系统仿真；而仿真需刻画患者状态演化与照护需求生成。传统方法为单一政策问题定制紧凑状态转移，忽略病史依赖动态，遇到需要不同临床信息的新问题时须重新定义状态与转移，缺乏可复用的共享临床表征。

Method: 以MIMIC-IV训练神经网络患者轨迹世界模型（给出可按时查询的预测），训练后冻结；通过情景特定映射将其预测与共享ICU日历、资源与队列耦合，使同一模型可输出入院需求、照护任务与出院建议；在ICU床位容量、照护调度、ICU后转运容量三类仿真中评估，并与Markov、半Markov基线及观测轨迹回放对比。

Result: 在总体占用率及对容量、调度政策的方向性响应上，与Markov/半Markov基线相当；能复现由观测轨迹回放得到的政策收益。对从不同既往轨迹进入同一支持状态的患者，所学表征捕捉到24小时恢复差异（预测-6.4 vs 观测-6.7个百分点），紧凑状态模型无法体现，且该差异传导为不同的模拟照护需求、队列负担与床位使用。

Conclusion: 学习式患者动态世界模型有潜力替代问题特定的状态模型：只需重配置情景而不重建模型即可评估新照护政策。

Abstract: Designing healthcare strategies requires anticipating their clinical and operational consequences before implementation, a task that often relies on health system simulation. Such a simulation necessitates modeling how patient states evolve and generate care demands. However, conventional approaches typically tailor compact state transitions to a single policy question and omit history-dependent dynamics, thus requiring the redefinition of states and transitions when there is a new question that entails different clinical information. We propose to learn a patient world model from longitudinal EHRs using a neural network to provide a shared clinical representation of patient trajectories that can serve simulation questions across scenarios. Taking ICU operations as an example, we train the model on MIMIC-IV, freeze it, and couple its time-queryable predictions to shared ICU calendars, resources, and queues via scenario-specific mappings, so that one model renders admission demand, care tasks, and discharge proposals across simulations evaluating ICU bed capacity, care dispatch, and post-ICU transfer capacity. Experiments show that our model matches Markov and semi-Markov comparators in aggregate occupancy and directional responses to capacity and dispatch policies. It also reproduces policy gains from replayed observed trajectories. For patients entering the same support state from different prior trajectories, the learned representation captures a 24-h recovery difference (-6.4 predicted versus -6.7 observed percentage points), a contrast missed by compact state models, which propagates into distinct simulated care demand, queue burden, and bed use. These results indicate that a learned world model of patient dynamics has the potential to replace question-specific state models, allowing new care policies to be evaluated by reconfiguring the scenario without model rebuilding.

</details>


### [385] [StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08403)
*Yang Ouyang,Jung-Eun Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出StepBack：一种步骤级、错误定位的重采样方法，用于高效测试时推理，在保持自一致性准确率的同时最多减少41.26%的token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性（SC）虽能提升思维链推理准确率，但需在预设预算下采样大量完整推理轨迹，成本高昂；现有高效变体主要依赖提前停止整条轨迹采样或在不同问题间分配采样次数，未充分利用步骤级信息。

Method: 先用少量草稿轨迹，借助轻量信号定位可能的首个错误步骤位置，然后仅对该错误步骤及其后续后缀进行重采样，最后对答案进行多数投票。

Result: 在七个数学推理与多跳问答基准上，StepBack平均达到与SC相当的准确率，同时token使用量最多降低41.26%。

Conclusion: 步骤级错误定位重采样是降低测试时推理成本的有效途径，且该方法天然可与Adaptive Consistency等自适应推理方法结合，进一步提升推理时效率。

Abstract: Self-consistency (SC) is a widely used decoding strategy for improving chain-of-thought reasoning, but it requires sampling many complete reasoning trajectories with a preset budget. Its efficient variants reduce the cost mainly by stopping full-trajectory sampling early or distributing the number of samples across questions. In this paper, we propose StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for efficient test-time reasoning. Given a small set of draft trajectories, StepBack localizes likely first error positions using lightweight signals and then resamples the detected error step and its suffix, followed by majority answer voting. Empirically, StepBack matches the accuracy of SC on average across seven mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%. In addition, by nature, StepBack can be combined with adaptive inference methods such as Adaptive Consistency, further improving their inference-time efficiency.

</details>


### [386] [The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08412)
*Yuanchuan Guo,Jiashun Jin,Zheng Tracy Ke,Bingcheng Sui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文构建五个队列共8,281篇论文（含配对样本），提出ProofTrace框架，以"即时证明支撑图"（GIPS）刻画证明的数学组织结构，从而在证明层面（而非写作层面）检测AI参与，并发现可解释的AI生成证明signature；在披露实质性使用AI的论文检测中性能稳定，优于文本检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在数学中的使用日益增多，需要区分"AI参与证明实质内容"与"AI仅辅助写作"。既有研究面临三大障碍：缺少匹配的病例-对照样本对；披露可能不完整；缺少可直接刻画证明中AI参与信号的特征。

Method: 将历史arXiv论文、近期披露实质性AI使用的论文与OpenAI发布的手稿，结合研究者用生成式AI产出的论文，构成五个跨AI参与程度的队列（共8,281篇），并包含针对同一研究问题的配对论文；提出ProofTrace，把每篇论文表示为"即时证明支撑图"（GIPS），提取可解释的数学组织特征，并做主成分投影与检测实验。

Result: （1）特征的主成分投影呈现AI参与程度的定性梯度：AI改写论文接近人类论文；两个AI生成队列朝大致共同方向偏离；披露实质性AI使用的论文居中，并随时间向AI生成队列移动。（2）识别出AI生成证明的recurring signature：外部引用结果更少、更依赖中间结论、图连通性改变；在控制领域、篇幅或图规模后多数signature仍成立。（3）检测实验中ProofTrace可区分人类论文与披露实质性AI使用的论文，且在AI改写下性能稳定，而最先进的文本检测器性能显著下降。

Conclusion: 证明的组织结构本身携带AI参与的可检测信号，可作为独立于文本风格的检测维度；ProofTrace对改写鲁棒，弥补文本检测器的脆弱性，为数学论文中AI参与度的实证研究与披露核查提供可解释工具。

Abstract: The growing use of AI in mathematics raises a question: can we detect AI involvement in proofs, separately from AI assistance with writing? Historical arXiv papers, recent papers disclosing substantive AI use, and manuscripts released by OpenAI provide a rich empirical basis for studying this question. However, several challenges remain: lack of matched case-control pairs; potential incompleteness of disclosure; and lack of ready-to-use features designed to capture signals of AI involvement in proofs.
  To address these challenges, we construct five cohorts comprising 8,281 papers by combining existing manuscripts with those we produced using generative AI. These cohorts span different levels of AI involvement and include matched pairs of papers addressing the same research problems. We then introduce ProofTrace, a framework that represents each paper as a graph of immediate proof support (GIPS) and extracts interpretable features of mathematical organization.
  Our study yields three discoveries. First, principal-component projections of our features reveal a qualitative gradient of AI involvement, where AI-reworded papers remain close to human papers, the two AI-generated cohorts depart in broadly shared directions, and papers disclosing substantive AI use occupy intermediate positions which shifts toward AI-generated cohorts over time. Second, we identify recurring signatures of AI-generated proofs, such as fewer externally cited results, greater reliance on intermediate conclusions, and altered graph connectivity; many of these signatures persist under controls for research field, manuscript length, or graph size. Finally, in a separate detection experiment, ProofTrace distinguishes human-written papers from those disclosing substantive AI use. Its performance remains stable under AI rewording, whereas the performance of state-of-the-art text-based detectors declines sharply.

</details>


### [387] [Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08417)
*E. Kelly Buchanan,Crystal Zhou,Scott W. Linderman,Christopher Ré*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出“基准维护债”（benchmark maintenance debt）概念，即随着模型进步与评测基础设施变更，基准分数与其本应衡量的能力之间逐渐扩大的鸿沟；并以持续验证工作流审计 Terminal-Bench 2.0，发现约30%的任务存在问题，修复后发布 Terminal-Bench 2.1，准确率提升超10个百分点、排名最多变动三位，同时指出资源预算（如时限）是测量规范的一部分，需与任务一并验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体是LLM最具经济价值的应用之一，可靠评测日益重要。但即便发布时经过严格验证的基准也会过时：模型会给出被验证器误判为错误的有效解，评测基础设施变更也会使任务与测试中内嵌的假设失效。作者因此需要一种机制来持续识别并偿还这类“维护债”。

Method: 提出面向智能体基准的持续验证工作流，整合社区报告、任务工件、智能体轨迹（agent traces）、自动化判题预言检查（automated oracle checks）与人工把关的修复流程；将该流程应用于发布前已做大量人工与LM辅助审查及红队测试的 Terminal-Bench 2.0，进行系统审计；并额外开展资源分配（固定墙钟时间预算）对结论影响的对照实验。

Result: 审计发现约30%的基准内容存在问题；修复结果发布为 Terminal-Bench 2.1，使准确率提升逾10个百分点，排行榜名次最多变动三位，但整体排序仍高度相关（Spearman ρ = 0.958）。资源实验显示固定墙钟时间显著影响性能：延长时间限制可弥合 GPT 5.4 上20个百分点的 harness 差距，并使 GPT 5.4 mini 的30个百分点差距缩小至5个百分点。

Conclusion: 基准维护不仅是修复任务工件中的实现缺陷，资源预算本身属于测量规范，必须与任务同步验证；随着模型能力提升，评测假设与资源配置都需要被重新审验。持续验证与人工把关的修复闭环应成为智能体基准的常规维护机制。

Abstract: Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure. We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958).
  We evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock can materially change agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves.
  More broadly, benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated implementation bugs: our results show that as models improve, both evaluation assumptions and resource settings may need to be revalidated.

</details>


### [388] [The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08428)
*Julian Kunkel,Ali Doosthosseini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"元访问（meta access）"概念：让LLM获得对聊天界面的结构化、经授权的视图，并给出五级能力阶梯，在原型Meta Chat中落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天仍是LLM任务的主要入口，而智能体工具在编码与自动化上表现优异，但模型只能看到当前对话、看不到周围的工作区。作者希望让聊天客户端从众多页面变为统一入口，同时不牺牲用户控制。

Method: 提出元访问概念及分级阶梯：功能教学；元数据、设置与偏好访问；对摘要与消息的检索；确认式修改；完整编排。指出通用智能体运行时因可修改自身设置而使元访问具有反身性，需独立的控制平面边界。在Chat AI客户端的Meta Chat原型中实现：从摘要、设置、相关消息构建有界上下文，将引用链接到会话、主题与人设，支持确认式可逆修改，提供可浏览教程库，并以用户发起的会话推荐人设。

Result: 原型验证了以结构化形式暴露应用状态可将屏幕阅读器从控件描述扩展到语义化工作区操作；同时讨论了落地环节中的grounding、隐私、提示注入与信任风险。

Conclusion: 元访问使聊天从单一会话窗口转变为整个工作区的控制层，在不放弃用户控制的前提下向智能体能力延伸；AI时代界面应通过类似调试器的接口开放其既有元模型，提供结构化、经授权的状态与能力模型。

Abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.

</details>


### [389] [ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08452)
*Yubo Wang,Rui Meng,Jaehyun Nam,Tomas Pfister,Jinsung Yoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出精炼可复现工件（含精炼代码库、环境配置、实验启动脚本与复现指南）及智能体工作流ReproBridge，并构建ReproBridge-Bench（36篇论文、387个实验、1,029个任务）；精炼工件将平均复现成功率由76.4%提升至92.6%，API开销降低19.7%，跨模型成功率差距由21.6个百分点收窄至3.9个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习实验复现需从论文、代码与配套工件中零散信息重建流程，编码智能体的复现成功依赖其补全缺失细节的能力，而非仅依赖发布工件。作者因此探究：显式保留被恢复的流程与决策是否能提升后续独立复现效果。

Method: 定义标准化工件设计（精炼代码库、环境配置、实验启动器、复现指南），提出ReproBridge智能体工作流以构建此类工件；构建ReproBridge-Bench，覆盖36篇论文、387个实验共1,029个任务，每任务配5个人工核验的参考分数；智能体在全新会话中使用原始代码或精炼工件执行任务，由独立Auditor核查执行证据，并在四个模型上做消融实验。

Result: 四个模型上精炼工件使平均复现成功率从76.4%升至92.6%，下游API支出平均减少19.7%；跨模型成功率极差由21.6个百分点缩小到3.9个百分点，四模型平均成功率均超90%；消融显示移除任一组件都会降低成功率，移除代码与环境造成的损失最大。

Conclusion: 保留执行知识（流程与决策）可帮助原始代码成功率较低的模型也更可靠、更低成本地复现实验，说明工件中的过程性知识是复现成功的关键补充。

Abstract: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. Agents attempt tasks in fresh sessions with raw code or refined artifacts; a separate Auditor checks execution evidence. Across four evaluated models, refined artifacts raise mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average. The cross-model success-rate spread narrows from 21.6 to 3.9 percentage points, with all four models achieving mean success rates above 90%. Removing any component reduces success in the ablation study, with the largest losses from code and environment removal. These results suggest that preserving execution knowledge helps even models with lower raw-code success reproduce experiments more reliably and at lower API cost.

</details>


### [390] [Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08478)
*Taiming Lu,Sachin Konan,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"科学家世界"(Scientist World)：将每篇论文转化为可执行环境，含开放式研究问题与复现的基线方法，AI-Scientist在其中与人类作者成果对比评测；首批发布1000个已验证环境，含6400小时研究轨迹，并可作为训练场提升小模型研究构思能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI-Scientist已出现，但缺乏可供其"在其中生长"的世界：人类科学家拥有数百年文献积累的开放问题与共享思想，对AI-Scientist而言科学文献只是"可读而不可运行"，缺少可执行、可交互、可评测的研究环境。

Method: 构建自主流水线：从每篇论文中抽取开放式研究问题，并将其提出的方法复现为基线，使论文成为可执行环境；AI-Scientist进入环境后，以其达成结果与人类作者原始成果进行对比评估。配套发布1000个已验证环境及完整研究轨迹记录。

Result: 前沿AI-Scientist在74%的情况下可超越人类研究者；环境记录包含6400小时研究轨迹，涵盖每个想法、实验、失败与成功；作为训练场可将小模型的研究构思能力提升+158%，达到与前沿模型相当水平。

Conclusion: Scientist World首次为AI-Scientist提供了可运行、可评测、可训练的科研"世界"，兼具基准评测、过程记录与训练场三重功能，且可随科学本身持续生长。

Abstract: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.

</details>


### [391] [SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08483)
*Qile Jiang,George Em Karniadakis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SwarmEvolve 提出一种以隐空间(KV cache)通信代替文本链式思考的智能体群体进化搜索框架，每轮数百个低成本智能体并行从不同视角探索问题，通过隐状态距离做新颖性过滤、通过汇总智能体合并 KV cache 实现自然交叉，在 21 个数学发现与科学计算问题上取得最高平均分，且达到其他 SOTA 框架 60 分钟成绩的中位耗时仅 3–8 分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 引导的进化搜索（如 AlphaEvolve 类方法）迭代精化程序并重组高分方案，但每轮都要生成冗长的文本思维链，且为维持种群多样性需反复生成，导致过程缓慢、成本高。作者希望降低搜索的时延与计算成本，同时保持或提升解的质量。

Method: 1) 群体（swarm）并行：每轮部署数百个低成本智能体，每个群体从不同角度研究同一问题；2) 隐空间推理：智能体不将推理解码为文本，而是直接在隐空间中进行；3) KV cache 传递：以键值缓存作为信息共享载体；4) 新颖性过滤：直接计算智能体隐状态向量之间的距离，保留最具差异性的想法以维持多样性；5) 隐空间交叉：由一个汇总智能体接收全部群体成员合并后的 KV cache，实现想法的自然重组。

Result: 在 21 个数学发现与科学计算问题上，SwarmEvolve 取得最高平均分；达到其他最先进框架需 60 分钟才能取得的最佳成绩，其中位耗时仅为 3–8 分钟。在若干问题上，使用 Qwen3 8B 的 SwarmEvolve 甚至改进了 AlphaEvolve 借助前沿 LLM 首次找到的解。

Conclusion: 在隐空间中通信的智能体群体为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一条快速、低成本的路径，表明以 KV cache 共享与隐状态新颖性度量替代文本级思维链与文本交叉是可行且高效的范式。

Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.

</details>


### [392] [When Does Test-Time Search Help World Action Models? An Empirical Audit of Candidate Selection and Simulator Integrity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41970)
*Jun Liu,Dajie Sun,Zhenglun Kong,Zhenjiang Fan,Peiyan Dong,Fan Yang,Wenbin Zhang,Geng Yuan,Xue Lin,Yanzhi Wang,Dong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对 world-action 模型（Cosmos Policy、RoboCasa）的 test-time scaling 进行"前提优先、预注册"审计，从决策信号、实际效率、评测完整性三环节检验其增益，发现选择信号近乎不存在、token 剪枝端到端加速有限、并发现并修复一处隐性渲染损坏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: test-time scaling（候选选择、自适应算力分配）的成功率提升只有在候选含可被利用的信号、名义算力节省能转化为真实加速、且评测可靠时才可信；现有工作多以成功率单独汇报，缺乏对这三项前提的逐一核验。

Method: 在 Cosmos Policy 与 RoboCasa 上采用 premise-first、预注册的审计方法，分别检验：(1) 决策信号——对比学习价值选择器与随机选择、后验 oracle，统计状态级候选结果分布；(2) 效率—— token 剪枝的 FLOPs 削减与端到端加速（含 decode-excluded 路径）对比 1.5× 目标，自适应分配实验设 power gate；(3) 评测完整性——追踪渲染损坏及其对结果的影响，并发布检测器、修复与脚本。

Result: 干净数据上学习价值选择器比随机差 1.66 pp；后验 oracle 仅提升 1.40 pp 且 episode 级区间跨越零；82% 的状态候选结果完全相同，选择空间极小。token 剪枝使单次前向 FLOPs 最多降 47%，但部署路径端到端加速至多 1.15×（排除 decode 路径 1.25×），未达 1.5× 目标；自适应分配在 power gate 下结论不确定。另发现一处渲染损坏，其发生率在算力密集规划路径上显著上升，但未影响官方 direct-policy 结果。

Conclusion: test-time scaling 应按"前提链"（决策信号、已实现效率、评测完整性）审计，而非仅看成功率；本文结论限于所测配置。

Abstract: World-action models increasingly apply test-time scaling, spending extra inference computation on candidate selection and adaptive allocation to improve control. Such gains are credible only when candidates carry exploitable signal, nominal compute savings become real speedup, and evaluation stays reliable. We audit all three on Cosmos Policy and RoboCasa with a premise-first, pre-registered methodology. On clean data, a learned value selector is 1.66 pp worse than random; a hindsight oracle gains only 1.40 pp, with an episode-level interval spanning zero; and 82% of states show identical candidate outcomes, leaving little selection headroom. Token pruning cuts per-forward FLOPs by up to 47% but yields at most a measured 1.15$\times$ end-to-end speedup on the deployed path (1.25$\times$ on a decode-excluded path), short of a 1.5$\times$ target, and our adaptive-allocation experiment is inconclusive under a power gate. We further identify and fix a silent rendering corruption whose rate rises sharply along compute-heavy planning paths while leaving the official direct-policy result unaffected, and release a detector, fix, and scripts. These findings show why test-time scaling should be audited as a chain of premises (decision signal, realized efficiency, evaluationintegrity) rather than by success rate alone. Conclusions are scoped to the tested configuration.

</details>


<div id='physics.optics'></div>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [393] [Reliability of Fisher-information bounds for dielectric metalenses: a site-resolved RCWA audit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07077)
*J. Sumaya-Martinez,O. Olmos-Lopez*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文用 site-resolved 复RCWA库与矢量Poisson-Fisher模型复核1716纳米柱介质超透镜的定位精度预测，独立复现的轴向Cramér-Rao下界为20.7695 nm（与存档值20.7738 nm相差0.0044 nm），并说明该结果是模型条件下的可复现基准而非物理器件性能声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超透镜定位精度仿真结果的可信度存疑：缺乏独立复现、对电磁建模收敛性（模态截断、周期单元阶数、衬底折射率假设）与统计模型假设敏感，因此需要一个可复现、明确模型条件的方法学基准。

Method: 构建site-resolved复数RCWA库，结合矢量Poisson-Fisher模型计算局部轴向Cramér-Rao下界；在相同理想探测器与3000个探测信号光子条件下独立复算；用高阶周期单元（high-order periodic-cell）计算检查相位收敛；用39个实际位点重算系数；并以受限相位掩模基准与像素积分校验区分统计预测稳定性与电磁收敛性。

Result: 独立计算复现存档局部轴向CRB 20.7738 nm，偏差仅0.0044 nm，得20.7695 nm；高阶周期单元在选定直径处出现0.1335 rad相位差，但衬底折射率假设不同使该差异不能单独归因于模态截断；用39个实际位点重算系数后CRB变为20.7522 nm。

Conclusion: 提供的是一份可复现、以模型为条件的基准结果，而非物理器件性能声明；统计预测的稳定性可通过受限相位掩模与像素积分校验证明，但其与电磁建模收敛性需分开评价。

Abstract: We assess the reliability of localization precision predicted for a 1716-nanopillar dielectric metalens using a site-resolved complex RCWA library and a vectorial Poisson Fisher model. An independent calculation reproduces the archived local axial Cramer-Rao bound of 20.7738 nm to within 0.0044 nm, yielding 20.7695 nm under the same ideal detector and 3000 detected signal photons. High-order periodic-cell calculations reveal a 0.1335 rad phase difference at a selected diameter; different substrate-index assumptions prevent attributing this difference solely to modal truncation. Replacing the recalculated coefficients at 39 actual sites changes the bound to 20.7522 nm. Restricted phase-mask benchmarks and pixel-integration checks further distinguish a stable statistical prediction from electromagnetic convergence. We provide a reproducible, model-conditional benchmark, not a physical-device performance claim.

</details>


### [394] [Dispersive Corrections to Electromagnetic Energy and Power Flux Are Imprints of Eliminated Degrees of Freedom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07243)
*Stanislav Maslovski,Constantin Simovski*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文阐明Agranovich–Ginzburg(AG)公式中频域/波矢导数项的物理含义：它们度量被Maxwell本构描述"隐藏"的内部场-物质自由度所携带的能量与通量，并给出AG公式对一般双各向异性介质的推广及耗散存在时的成立条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间色散介质中电磁能量与通量由本构参数的频率和波矢导数给出（AG公式），但导数项的物理来源与适用条件长期不清晰，作者希望厘清其微观/内部自由度意义，并界定其在耗散与任意激发条件下的有效性。

Method: 构建描述内部场-物质动力学的扩展状态空间模型，覆盖一大类时间与空间色散介质；通过消去内部变量（内部块的Schur补给出有效材料算符）得到Maxwell本构关系；利用合同恒等式将该Schur补与扩展描述联系起来，从而推广AG公式至一般双各向异性介质，并分析耗散下的成立条件；在Lorentz、Drude、磁化等离子体与流体动力学（非局域金属）模型上验证。

Result: AG色散修正项被证明是被消去自由度的印记而非独立的本构假设；AG公式对任意实频率与波矢驱动的场（不限本征模）成立，条件为源仅作用于电磁场且耗散由电磁子系统承载；在多种色散模型（含Supplemental Material中容性加载线介质）上验证了该构造。

Conclusion: AG公式中的导数项源自内部场-物质动力学自由度，可从扩展状态空间模型的Schur补与合同恒等式系统导出，因而可推广至一般双各向异性介质，并明确了其在耗散情形下适用的充要条件。

Abstract: In a spatially dispersive medium the electromagnetic energy and flux are given by the frequency and wave-vector derivatives of the constitutive parameters, a result known as the Agranovich--Ginzburg (AG) formulas. Here, we clarify the physical meaning of the derivative terms in these relations and show that they measure the energy and flux carried by the degrees of freedom of the internal field-matter dynamics that the Maxwellian constitutive description hides. We construct an extended state-space model of such dynamics for a wide class of temporally and spatially dispersive media, from which the Maxwellian constitutive relations follow upon elimination of the internal variables, the effective material operator resulting from the Schur complement of the eliminated internal block. A congruence identity relates this complement to the extended state-space description, which allows us to extend the AG formulas to general bianisotropic media and to establish the conditions of their validity in the presence of dissipation. The AG dispersive corrections are thus the imprints of the eliminated degrees of freedom rather than independent constitutive postulates. They hold for fields driven at arbitrary real frequency and wave vector, and not only for eigenmodes, provided that the sources act on the fields alone and that any dissipation is carried by the electromagnetic subsystem. We verify the construction on the Lorentz, Drude, magnetized-plasma, and hydrodynamic models, the last of which describes a nonlocal metal. Additionally, a capacitively loaded wire medium is treated in the Supplemental Material.

</details>


### [395] [Laser fabrication of vibrating microcavities on silicon: Formation dynamics and frequency tunability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07742)
*Belen Valiente,Gonzalo Gomez-Munoz,Mario Garcia-Lechuga,Irene Solana,Fernando Agulló-Rueda,David Grojo,Angel Rodriguez-Fernandez,Javier Solis,Jan Siegel*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在商用Si/SiO2平台上用单发飞秒激光脉冲可控剥离SiO2覆盖层，制备出可振动微腔（表面鼓起达1.5 μm），并用泵浦-探测与纳秒反射率测量揭示其形成与振荡动力学；腔体可在低能量密度下无损再激励，以单一频率、高品质因数振动，频率可通过加工通量在8–19 MHz连续调谐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激光加工硅已是晶圆切割、表面织构、离子注入后再结晶等标准工艺，但尚缺乏一种简单、可在商用材料体系上直接制备可振动微腔的方法。作者希望利用商用Si晶圆+厚SiO2层（作膜）平台，借助超短脉冲实现无破裂的覆盖层可控剥离，从而获得可振动微腔，为微纳光学、声学及MEMS应用提供低成本、易实现的途径。

Method: 将Si/SiO2材料体系暴露于超过Si蒸发阈值的单发超短激光脉冲，实现覆盖层（SiO2膜）的无断裂可控剥离，形成微腔并伴随表面鼓起。采用时间分辨光学探测：超快泵浦-探测显微术分辨衬底熔化的初始阶段、层膨胀起始与弛豫；纳秒分辨率实时反射率测量追踪持续数十微秒的膜振荡过程。以低通量脉冲对腔体再激励以测试稳定性，并用简单经典模型描述膜的行为。

Result: 成功制备出表面鼓起达1.5 μm的微腔；泵浦-探测揭示了衬底熔化、层膨胀与弛豫的初始动力学；实时反射率测量分辨出持续数十微秒的高度复杂振荡过程。腔体可在低通量下再激励而无损伤或退化，呈现单一频率、高Q因子振动；振动频率随加工通量在8 MHz至19 MHz间连续可调。简单经典模型与实验行为吻合良好。

Conclusion: 提出并验证了一种基于商用Si/SiO2平台、工艺简单的可调谐振动微腔制备方法，结合时间分辨探测明确了其形成与振荡机理；由于材料平台商用可得且制备流程简洁，该结果有望推动微纳光学与声学应用，并可扩展至微机电系统（MEMS）领域。

Abstract: Laser processing of silicon has long since become a standard method for wafer dicing, surface texturing, re-crystallization after ion implantation, as well as surface amorphization, to name a few examples. Here, we introduce a novel concept, the fabrication of vibrating microcavities in a commercial platform, Si wafers covered by a thick SiO2 layer, acting as a membrane. We demonstrate that by exposing our material system to single ultrashort laser pulses above the evaporation threshold of Si, a controlled delamination of the cover layer without fracture can be achieved, leading to the formation of a microcavity accompanied by a surface bulging up to 1.5 micrometer. The formation dynamics of the microcavities has been investigated by time-resolved optical probe techniques. Ultrafast pump-probe microscopy resolves the initial stages of substrate melting, the onset of layer expansion followed by relaxation. Real-time reflectivity measurements with nanosecond resolution resolve the long lived, highly complex oscillation process of the membrane, extending over tens of microseconds. The formed cavities can be re-excited at low fluence without damage or degradation, featuring vibrations at single frequencies with high Q factors. The frequencies can be tuned continuously from 8 MHz up to 19 MHz by adjusting the fabrication fluence. A simple classical model is found to well describe the behavior of the membranes. Our results pave the way for applications in micro- and nanooptics and acoustics, in great part due to the commercial availability of the Si-SiO2 platform and the simplicity of the fabrication method. An extension to the field of microelectromechanical system (MEMS) of this technology is proposed.

</details>


### [396] [A nonlinear interface for phase transduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07316)
*Linshan Sun,Hao Zhang,Cameron Leary,Alex Amador,Sergio Carbajo*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文识别并通过实验实现了一种“准线性相位转导”区间：借助宽带相位匹配接受度与频率混合响应的有效局域化，在多频混频的宽带非线性频率变换中实现可编程谱相位的近线性、逐点传递。作者在充氩空芯毛细管光纤中通过色散四波混频，将1032 nm近红外信号的谱相位传递到344 nm紫外闲频光。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宽带非线性频率变换会混合多个输入频率，使得已编程的谱相位难以在间隔很远的谱带之间可靠转移；作者希望找到一种不牺牲泵浦谱宽、也不在空间上分离谱成分即可实现的线性相位传递机制。

Method: 识别并实验实现“准线性相位转导”区间，其来源是宽相位匹配接受度与复频率混合响应的有效局域化，该选择性可由相干干涉产生而无需窄化泵浦谱。实验采用充氩空芯毛细管光纤中的色散四波混频，将1032 nm近红外信号相位传给344 nm紫外闲频光；用瞬态光栅频率分辨光学开关（TG-FROG）表征，并扣除模型化的泵浦诱导相位背景后做逐点相关分析，同时改变泵浦啁啾。

Result: TG-FROG 显示频率反转、相位共轭式的二次色散传递，以及局域相位台阶和低频正弦调制的传递。扣除泵浦诱导相位背景后，二次色散与台阶响应呈近似线性的逐点相关；随泵浦啁啾增大，传递的相位台阶保持得更尖锐，拟合的相位传递增益趋近于1，与有效局域化增强一致。

Conclusion: 在共传播宽带非线性相互作用中可实现准线性谱相位转导，且无需在空间上分离其谱成分；这为跨远间隔谱带的相位编程与传递提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Broadband nonlinear frequency conversion mixes multiple input frequencies, complicating the transfer of programmed spectral phase between widely separated spectral bands. Here we identify and experimentally realize a quasi-linear phase-transduction regime enabled by broad phase-matching acceptance and effective localization of the complex frequency-mixing response. This selectivity can arise from coherent interference without narrowing the pump spectrum. We implement this regime through dispersive four-wave mixing in an argon-filled hollow-capillary fiber, transferring spectral phase from 1032-nm near-infrared signals to 344-nm ultraviolet idlers. Transient-grating frequency-resolved optical gating reveals frequency-inverted, phase-conjugating transfer of quadratic dispersion, localized phase steps, and low-frequency sinusoidal modulation. After correction for the modeled pump-induced phase background, the quadratic and step responses exhibit approximately linear point-by-point correlations. With increasing pump chirp, the transferred phase steps become more sharply preserved, and the fitted phase-transfer gains approach unity, consistent with enhanced effective localization. These results demonstrate quasi-linear spectral-phase transduction in a co-propagating broadband nonlinear interaction without spatially separating its spectral components.

</details>


### [397] [Stable dissipative topological solitons in media with even-order dispersion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07467)
*Xianan Sun,Dongdong Wang,Dumitru Mihalache,David Laroze,Boris A. Malomed,Pengfei Li*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文揭示了一类由纯高偶阶色散（PHEOD，色散阶 m=4,6,8,10）支撑的稳定耗散拓扑孤子，包括静止的耗散拓扑孤子（DTS）和运动的拓扑孤子（MTS），二者为具有零振幅点、分隔符号相反的两个连续波背景的暗型结构，并带有常规暗态所不具备的振荡尾；线性稳定性分析证实其完全鲁棒，MTS 碰撞为非弹性排斥，表现为回弹（伴随色散辐射发射）或完全融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耗散孤子的形成与动力学由色散与非线性相互作用及增益-损耗平衡决定；已知二阶以上色散可支持稳定孤子，但在此框架下能否产生耗散拓扑孤子尚未被探索。

Method: 基于含增益-损耗平衡的非线性模型，考察纯高偶阶色散（m=4,6,8,10）情形，构造 DTS 与 MTS 解，并采用线性稳定性分析检验其稳定性，同时数值研究 MTS 间的碰撞动力学。

Result: 获得稳定 DTS 与 MTS：暗型结构，含零振幅点分隔符号相反的两个 CW 背景；PHEOD 孤子具有振荡尾，区别于常规暗态；线性稳定性分析表明其完全鲁棒；MTS 碰撞为排斥且非弹性，或回弹并发射色散辐射，或完全融合。

Conclusion: PHEOD 可作为生成新型耗散孤子的手段，拓展了非线性光学实验可研究的非线性模式种类。

Abstract: The formation and dynamics of dissipative solitons are governed by the interplay of dispersion and nonlinearity, alongside the gain-loss balance. While it is known that dispersion orders beyond the conventional second order support stable solitons, the possibility of the creation of dissipative topological solitons in this setting was not explored. Here, we reveal a class of stable dissipative solitons enabled by the pure-high-even-order dispersion (PHEOD), with dispersion orders m=4, 6, 8, and 10. The resulting dissipative topological solitons (DTSs) and moving topological solitons (MTSs) are dark-type structures featuring a zero-amplitude point that separates two CW backgrounds with opposite signs. In particular, the PHEOD solitons feature oscillatory tails, which are not present in the conventional dark states. The linear-stability analysis confirms full robustness of the PHEOD-supported DTSs and MTSs. We also explore collision dynamics of MTSs, whose repulsive interactions are inelastic, leading either to rebound, accompanied by emission of dispersive radiation, or complete fusion. These findings establish PHEOD as a means for the generation of new species of dissipative solitons, and broaden the variety of nonlinear modes available to experimental studies in nonlinear optics.

</details>


### [398] [Experimental demonstration of dual-polarization nonreciprocal thermal emission at moderate magnetic fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07564)
*Mason Christiansen,Jae S. Hwang,Yi Jie Lin,Aryan Zaveri,Tianjun Li,Daniel Cui,Baolai Liang,Aaswath P. Raman*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文实验实现了单一结构在TE与TM两种偏振下、同一波长与角度上的非互易吸收：通过在掺杂InAs层上集成锗Mie共振超表面，将TE偏振光散射至具有垂直于磁场分量的近场，从而激活InAs的磁光响应。在0.48 T永久Halbach阵列磁场下，16.6 μm处两种偏振的±B吸收率差均为0.035。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统热辐射体遵循基尔霍夫定律，发射率与吸收率在各波长、角度、偏振下必须相等，这对辐射能量技术与传热构成根本限制。磁光半导体可在磁场下打破洛伦兹互易性以突破该约束，但以往实验中的非互易性多局限于TM偏振，因为TE偏振光的电场平行于外加磁场，难以被磁光效应调制。本文旨在实现双偏振非互易吸收。

Method: 设计并制备"掺杂InAs层+锗Mie共振超表面"的平面结构。利用Ge超表面的Mie共振将TE偏振入射光散射为含垂直于磁场分量的近场，使InAs的磁光响应得以作用于TE光；同时TM偏振由InAs直接响应。采用0.48 T的永久Halbach阵列提供磁场，在16.6 μm波长处测量±B下的吸收率差异，比较TE与TM偏振的非互易性。

Result: 在0.48 T磁场、16.6 μm波长下，结构在TE与TM两种偏振中均表现出+ B与−B之间0.035的吸收率差，且两偏振的非互易吸收出现在相同波长和角度上。

Conclusion: 平面半导体的磁光响应与介质超表面的共振可协同设计，从而在永久磁铁可提供的低磁场下实现双偏振非互易性，为新型辐射能量转换与传热技术提供可行路径。

Abstract: Conventional thermal emitters obey Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation, which requires emissivity and absorptivity to be equal at each wavelength, angle, and polarization. This in turn places a fundamental limit on a range of radiative energy technologies as well as heat transfer. This constraint can however be overcome using magneto-optic semiconductors, which break Lorentz reciprocity under an applied magnetic field. However, in most prior experimental demonstrations, nonreciprocity has been restricted to TM polarization, since the electric field of TE-polarized light is parallel to the applied magnetic field. Here, we experimentally demonstrate nonreciprocal absorption in both polarizations at the same wavelengths and angles from a single structure, wherein a germanium Mie-resonant metasurface on a doped InAs layer scatters TE-polarized light into near fields with components perpendicular to the magnetic field, allowing the magneto-optic response of the InAs to act on them. Under a 0.48 T field from a permanent Halbach array, this structure exhibits a difference in absorptivity between $+B$ and $-B$ of 0.035 in both TE and TM polarization at 16.6 $μ$m. Our approach shows that the magneto-optic response of a planar semiconductor and the resonances of a dielectric metasurface can be designed together, offering a potential route to dual-polarization nonreciprocity at fields available from permanent magnets for emerging energy and heat transfer technologies.

</details>


### [399] [Simulation of Refraction Through Voxel Volumes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07690)
*Rainier Mobley,Jean Michel Létang,Max Langer*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出在体素网格上以弯曲光线直接模拟X射线图像的方法，用以刻画材料内部折射率连续变化引起的折射，并基于体素尺寸、插值方式与照明-网格对齐等参数的考察给出模拟建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统X射线追迹仅考虑界面处的折射，忽略了生物样品（如骨）中体内部折射率连续变化导致的折射，导致模拟不准确。

Method: 在体素网格上使用弯曲光线进行X射线图像模拟；先用具有解析解的模型验证方法，再在若干仿真测试对象上考察体素尺寸、插值选择以及照明与网格对齐方式的影响。

Result: 方法通过与解析解模型对比得到验证；实验揭示了体素尺寸、插值方式和照明-网格对齐对模拟结果的影响，并据此提出若干参数选择建议。

Conclusion: 在体素网格上以弯曲光线模拟可有效纳入体内部连续折射效应，为X射线成像仿真中参数配置提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Ray tracing in X-ray science has typically been limited to descriptions where refraction occurs only at interfaces, ignoring the refraction occurring due to the continuous variations in index of refraction in the bulk of a material, as are common in biological samples like bone. We propose a method to simulate X-ray images directly on voxel grids using curved rays. We first validate this method compared to a model with an analytical solution, and then investigate the effects of voxel size, interpolation choice, and illumination to grid alignment on a few simulated test objects. From these investigations, we make several recommendations to guide simulations using these techniques.

</details>


### [400] [Unified design of short mode-evolution couplers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07729)
*S. -Y. Tseng*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 短模式演化耦合器的多种设计方法（FAQUAD、CD驱动、轴弯曲CD、数值优化）实属同一设计空间；三个几何参数仅通过耦合强度与有效失谐两个函数作用于光场，因此规范、弯曲与混合CD实现是同一器件、带宽相同，带宽由∫sin²χ dz决定。据此提出光刻感知设计规则并经BPM验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献中短模式演化耦合器存在多种看似不同设计路线（FAQUAD、调节宽度与间距的CD驱动、轴弯曲CD、几何数值优化），需澄清它们之间的关系，并给出带宽与设计自由度的统一理解及可直接使用的设计规则。

Method: 在Kramers–Henneberger框架下建立弯曲耦合器的精确两模耦合模理论；将宽度差、间距、轴倾角三个几何参数化归为耦合强度（由间距决定）与有效失谐（由宽度差与轴曲率决定）两个函数；以Bloch球上导向场与光场夹角χ的积分∫sin²χ dz刻画带宽；在聚合物平台用BPM仿真验证，并与粒子群优化（BPM在环）对比，另做BCB通道波导三维BPM验证。

Result: 按该设计规则（在反交叉处收窄参考间距以获得允许的最小能隙内最绝热参考，再用精确CD抑制剩余非绝热耦合）得到的500 μm耦合器，在最小边缘间隙1.05 μm下于274 nm带宽内保持>99%传输；固定间距参考的CD耦合器在几乎相同间隙下仅150 nm。PSO不优于该设计规则；三维BPM结果一致。

Conclusion: 规范、弯曲与混合CD耦合器本质同一器件，带宽由参考设计单独决定；带宽受∫sin²χ dz约束，故数值优化无法超越；最小间隙决定可达绝热度，据此得到兼顾光刻可实现性的简洁设计规则。

Abstract: Short mode-evolution couplers have been designed with several seemingly different approaches, including fast quasi-adiabatic dynamics (FAQUAD), counter-diabatic (CD) driving realized by tailoring waveguide widths and spacing, CD driving realized by axis bending, and numerical optimization of the coupler geometry. Using exact two-mode coupled-mode theory in the Kramers--Henneberger frame of the bent coupler, we show that these approaches belong to the same design space. The three geometric parameters, width difference, spacing, and axis tilt, act on the light through two functions only: the coupling strength, set by the spacing, and an effective detuning, set by the width difference and the axis curvature. The gauge, bent, and mixed realizations of a CD coupler are therefore the same device and have the same bandwidth. The bandwidth is set by the angle $χ$ between the light and the field that steers it on the Bloch sphere, integrated along the device as $\int\sin^2χdz$, and for a CD coupler this integral is set by the reference alone. This leads to a lithography-aware design rule: make the reference as adiabatic as the minimum gap allows, by narrowing its spacing at the anticrossing, and let exact CD suppress the remaining nonadiabatic coupling. In beam propagation method (BPM) simulations on a polymer platform, a 500\um{} coupler designed this way, without numerical optimization, maintains ${>}99\%$ transfer over 274~nm at a minimum edge gap of 1.05\um, compared with 150~nm for the CD coupler of a fixed-spacing reference at nearly the same gap. Particle swarm optimization of the geometry with BPM in the loop does not exceed the design rule. Three-dimensional BPM of the BCB channel waveguides also confirms these conclusions.

</details>


### [401] [Continuum Photonic Axion Insulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07893)
*Mario G. Silveirinha*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文研究无晶格、均匀且具反演对称性的电磁连续介质中实现轴子拓扑的条件，定义了仅由零波矢与无穷波矢极限下材料响应谱性质构成的连续反演不变量，发现标准旋光(g yrotropic)类响应在一阶微扰下普遍无法打开轴子能隙，进而类推出可打开能隙的奇磁电耦合(spatially dispersive odd magnetoelectric coupling)一类响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轴子拓扑此前主要在具有晶格结构的拓扑光子晶体/绝缘体中讨论，其实现是否依赖于晶格、以及何种材料响应（如旋光性、磁电耦合）才是打开轴子能隙的充要机制尚不清楚。作者希望在无晶格的均匀反演对称连续介质中厘清这一问题。

Method: 引入仅依赖零波矢与无穷波矢极限下材料响应谱性质的连续反演不变量；在连续介质框架下做一阶微扰分析，考察各向同性/均匀旋光(g yrotropic)型响应对轴子能隙的贡献；并借助晶体光子轴子绝缘体的有效响应与中心对称交变磁体(altermagnet)光学响应之间的类比，构造空间色散的奇磁电耦合。

Result: (1) 标准旋光型电磁响应受到强约束，在相当一般的条件下无法在一阶微扰理论内打开轴子能隙；(2) 通过类比识别出一类空间色散的奇磁电耦合，能够打开轴子能隙；(3) 由此得到非互易机制在电磁连续介质中的层级关系：均匀旋光性对应Chern相，奇磁电耦合对应轴子相。

Conclusion: 轴子拓扑可在无晶格的均匀反演对称电磁连续介质中实现，但其开启机制不是传统旋光性，而是空间色散的奇磁电耦合；非互易机制存在"Chern(均匀旋光)—轴子(奇磁电)"的层级结构，为无需晶格的光子轴子相设计提供了判据。

Abstract: Here, I study the conditions for realizing an axion topology in a homogeneous inversion-symmetric electromagnetic continuum, in the absence of a crystalline lattice. I introduce a continuum inversion invariant expressed solely in terms of the spectral properties of the material response in the zero- and infinite-wave-vector limits. Surprisingly, it is found that standard gyrotropic-type material responses are strongly constrained and, under fairly general conditions, cannot open an axion gap within first-order perturbation theory. Based on an analogy between the effective response of crystalline photonic axion insulators and the optical response of centrosymmetric altermagnets, a class of spatially dispersive odd magnetoelectric couplings that can open an axion gap is identified. These findings suggest an interesting hierarchy of nonreciprocal mechanisms in electromagnetic continua: while uniform gyrotropy relates to Chern phases, odd magnetoelectric coupling relates to axion phases.

</details>


### [402] [A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07894)
*Tristan Lawrie,Gregor Tanner,Luke Bennetts*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 利用量子图论散射框架，对被动超表面反射波场配置进行精确解析求解：通道长度与散射参数由波幅比逐通道闭式给出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统智能超表面多依赖带增益的主动超材料，或需计算昂贵的逆问题求解以获得最优配置，缺乏精确解析的被动设计方案。

Method: 采用量子图论的散射框架。超表面终结于周期性波导晶格，由通道阵列构成：每通道为长度 ℓ_m 的管，末端顶点散射参数 λ_m 控制能量损耗比例。对任意给定入射与反射场，由返回与离开晶格的波幅之比，逐通道闭式求出精确长度与散射参数；当该比值模不超过 1 时超表面为被动。

Result: 在一维与二维超表面上完成构造验证：一维超表面终结二维晶格，实现高斯光束的偏转、分束与完全吸收；二维超表面终结三维晶格，在晶格内部平面生成预定图像，均获得精确边界性质。

Conclusion: 该工作给出被动超表面产生指定反射波场的精确解析设计方法，无需增益材料或数值逆问题求解，可推广至一维、二维乃至更高维波导晶格。

Abstract: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length $\ell_m$ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter $λ_m$ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.

</details>


### [403] [Hybrid integration of a SESAM with a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08057)
*Amaryllis Verstraete,Tom Reep,Jan de Haan,Eero Koivusalo,Riku Isoaho,Thi Ngoc Lam Tran,Bart Kuyken,Kasper Van Gasse*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过微组装将半导体可饱和吸收镜（SESAM）与氮化硅（SiN）光子集成芯片异质集成，实现低损耗波导耦合，为全集成芯片级超快激光器奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在光子集成芯片上实现高性能飞秒激光器，需要可饱和吸收体与光子波导之间具备鲁棒、低损耗的耦合，而现有方案缺乏此类集成手段。

Method: 采用微组装（micro-assembly）策略，将SESAM与带有反向锥形（inverse-tapered）SiN波导的芯片键合，把吸收体的非线性功能转移至PIC上；分别表征未键合SESAM与键合器件的线性及非线性性能。

Result: 在1560 nm波长下，键合器件实现波导耦合调制深度5.2%、最大反射率37.2%、饱和通量47 μJ/cm²。

Conclusion: SESAM可直接集成到氮化硅基PIC平台，为全集成、自启动、芯片级超快激光器提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The realization of high-performance femtosecond lasers on photonic integrated circuits (PICs) requires robust, low-loss coupling between a saturable absorber and a photonic waveguide. In this work, we demonstrate the hybrid integration of a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM) with a silicon nitride (SiN) PIC by micro-assembly. This micro-assembly strategy transfers the non-linear functionality of the absorber onto the PIC. We characterize the linear and non-linear performance of an unbonded SESAM and of a SESAM bonded to inverse-tapered SiN waveguides. At 1560~nm, the bonded device shows a waveguide-coupled modulation depth of 5.2\%, a maximum reflectivity of 37.2\%, and a saturation fluence of 47~\textmu J/cm$^2$. This work demonstrates that SESAMs can be integrated directly onto silicon nitride-based PIC platforms and provides a pathway towards fully integrated, self-starting, chip-scale ultrafast lasers.

</details>


### [404] [Thermal Inverse Design: Tailoring the Transient Response of Resistive Micro-Heaters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08098)
*Muzhang Huang,Junhe Zhang,Khoi Phuong Dao,Juejun Hu,Hyun Jung Kim*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出一种针对脉冲加热的逆向设计算法，通过单步光刻图案化硅微加热器的掺杂区域，在一次闭环设计内即可实现瞬态电压激励下按需的峰值温度分布，并纳入有限光刻分辨率等工艺约束；三个代表性设计分别实现温度非均匀性降低20倍以上、抵消串联二极管引起的热梯度、以及按需生成线性温度梯度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微加热器广泛用于需要局域、动态热控制的应用，其空间与时间温度分布的调控至关重要；但传统设计主要依赖大量全尺度热仿真的迭代试错，效率低且难以按需定制瞬态温度场，因此需要一种面向脉冲加热工况的逆向设计方法。

Method: 提出面向脉冲（瞬态）加热的逆向设计算法：以单步光刻图案化硅微加热器的掺杂区域为设计自由度，在一次闭环优化中求解瞬态电压激励下的峰值温度分布目标；算法同时引入包括有限光刻分辨率在内的实际制造约束。

Result: 通过三个代表性设计验证通用性：(1) 优化加热器相比均匀掺杂常规加热器，温度非均匀性降低20倍以上；(2) 逆向设计掺杂有效抵消了与二极管串联的加热器中的热梯度；(3) 可按需生成预设的线性温度梯度。

Conclusion: 结果表明，逆向设计掺杂是一种可扩展且与制造工艺兼容的方法，可用于定制电阻式微加热器的瞬态温度分布。

Abstract: Microheaters underpin a broad range of applications that require localized and dynamic thermal control. Engineering their spatial and temporal temperature distributions is therefore essential, yet conventional heater design relies largely on iterative trial and error involving numerous full-scale thermal simulations. Here, we introduce an inverse design algorithm for pulsed heating, a common operating modality in thermal processing, sensing, switching, and material characterization. The approach uses a single lithographic step to pattern the doped regions of a silicon microheater and, in principle, enables on-demand peak temperature distributions under transient voltage excitation within one closed design loop. The algorithm also incorporates practical fabrication constraints, including finite lithographic resolution. We demonstrate its versatility through three representative designs. First, an optimized heater achieves more than a 20-fold reduction in temperature nonuniformity compared with a conventional uniformly doped heater. Second, inverse-designed doping effectively cancels the thermal gradient in a heater connected in series with a diode. Third, the method generates prescribed linear temperature gradients on demand. These results establish inverse-designed doping as a scalable and fabrication-compatible approach for tailoring transient temperature distributions in resistive microheaters.

</details>


### [405] [Photonic Exceptional Topological Bound States in the Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08103)
*Liren Chen,Jingming Chen,Zhen Gao*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出利用体能带拓扑抑制奇异束缚态(EBIC)的脆弱性，在人工表面等离激元波导中实现光子"奇异拓扑BIC(ETBIC)"（两个对称保护拓扑BIC在奇异点合并），实验分辨复本征频率合并并观测到对弱扰动的平方根劈裂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统EBIC需精确控制模式耦合与内禀损耗，在奇异点处本征损耗相异的BIC合并，因而对参数失配极其敏感、实验实现困难。作者希望借助体能带拓扑为EBIC提供鲁棒性设计原则。

Method: 在人工表面等离激元(spoof SPP)波导中构建两个对称保护拓扑BIC，通过工程化内禀损耗对比度并调节模式间耦合，使二者在非厄米奇异点处合并为ETBIC；测量复本征频率的合并与近场分布，并用弱扰动检验本征频率劈裂行为。

Result: 直接分辨出复本征频率的合并及与奇异本征态一致的近场分布；弱扰动下本征频率呈近似平方根劈裂，谱响应灵敏度强于孤立TBIC的近似线性频移；拓扑设计在保持对称性的扰动下支持稳健局域。

Conclusion: 确认体能带拓扑可作为奇异BIC的工程设计原则，为基于EBIC的光子传感等应用提供基础。

Abstract: Exceptional bound states in the continuum (EBICs) arise when bound states in the continuum (BICs) with distinct intrinsic losses coalesce at exceptional points (EPs), combining continuum-embedded wave confinement with a non-analytic spectral response. However, conventional EBICs rely on precisely controlled modal coupling and intrinsic loss, making them fragile and difficult to realize experimentally. Here, we introduce bulk-band topology to mitigate this fragility and experimentally realize a photonic exceptional topological BIC (ETBIC) in spoof surface plasmon polariton waveguides by merging two symmetry-protected topological BICs (TBICs) to coalesce at an EP, with the topological design supporting robust localization under symmetry-preserving perturbations. By engineering an intrinsic loss contrast and tuning the intermodal coupling, we directly resolve the coalescence of the complex eigenfrequencies, accompanied by measured near-field distributions consistent with the exceptional eigenstate. Furthermore, weak perturbations induce approximately square-root eigenfrequency splitting, yielding an enhanced spectral response compared with the approximately linear frequency shift of an isolated TBIC. These results establish bulk-band topology as a design principle for exceptional BIC engineering and provide a foundation for EBIC-based photonic sensing.

</details>


### [406] [Characterization and Suppression of Parasitic Back-Reflection Noise in Transponder-Type Heterodyne Interferometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08110)
*Xiaoyang Lin,Xin Xu,Xinhang Lyu,Peijia Tian,Yujie Feng,Mingkuo Hai,Yidong Tan,Yan Li,Haoyun Wei*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文研究转发器型外差干涉中的寄生背向反射相位噪声，通过光程扫描与模型拟合揭示相位误差随工作点周期性变化规律，并结合π测量与平衡探测将相位噪声最大抑制77倍（单频）/23倍（带限ASD）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转发器型外差干涉广泛用于重力场恢复、空间引力波探测、深空测距与多普勒跟踪，但寄生背向反射会污染相位读出、降低测量灵敏度，亟需对其表征与抑制。

Method: 搭建同轴对向传播光束的转发器型干涉仪，在720 pW接收光功率下稳定工作；在主端发射光路中引入可调反射系统模拟真实背向反射；通过光程扫描与模型拟合分析主/寄生干涉信号相对相位（即工作点）对相位误差的影响；借助π测量定位低灵敏度工作点，并与平衡探测结合抑制背向反射相位噪声。

Result: 相位误差随主、寄生信号相对相位周期性变化；调整至低灵敏度工作点并配合平衡探测，单频相位误差最大抑制因子达77，带限相位噪声幅度谱密度抑制因子达23；π测量在3.8 nW背向反射功率下实现工作点诊断，验证其在弱背向反射条件下的适用性。

Conclusion: 所提方法为转发器型外差干涉的背向反射原位表征与相位噪声抑制提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Transponder-type heterodyne interferometry is a versatile metrological technique for high-precision measurements, with applications in Earth's gravity-field recovery, space-based gravitational-wave detection, deep-space ranging, and Doppler tracking. However, parasitic back-reflections can contaminate phase readout and degrade measurement sensitivity. To characterize and suppress this noise, we constructed a transponder-type interferometer with coaxially aligned counter-propagating beams, achieving stable operation at a received optical power of 720 pW. An adjustable reflecting system was introduced into the master-side transmit path to simulate back-reflection under realistic conditions. Optical path scans and model fitting showed that phase errors vary periodically with the relative phase between the main and parasitic interference signals, which defines the working point. Assisted by π measurement, adjustment to low-sensitivity working points was combined with balanced detection to suppress back-reflection phase noise, achieving maximum suppression factors of 77 for single-frequency phase errors and 23 for band-limited phase-noise amplitude spectral density. π measurement also enabled working point diagnosis at 3.8 nW back-reflection power, confirming its applicability under weak back-reflection conditions. These results provide an effective approach for in situ back-reflection characterization and phase-noise suppression in transponder-type heterodyne interferometry.

</details>


### [407] [Goos-Hänchen Shifts at 458 nm from DUV Dichroic Laser Mirrors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08120)
*Shamaila Manzoor,Mauro Chiarotti,Paul J. Robert,Nicola Poli*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在458 nm下测量DUV二向色多层镜反射时的偏振/角度依赖的Goos–Hänchen位移，最大约2 μm（≈4.4λ），并用传输矩阵模型定量复现，指出该相位效应在倍频腔中可累积并影响腔模与共振条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二向色多层镜的复反射系数相位会带来横向光束位移（GH位移），在倍频腔多次反射中可累积偏差，偏离几何光学预测，但相关相位响应缺乏直接约束与表征。

Method: 在458 nm波长下对DUV二向色多层镜做偏振与角度分辨的反射光束位移测量；同步测量反射率R、透射率T与GH位移；采用传输矩阵模型定量拟合；并将分析推广到透射情形以预测相位诱导的横向位移。

Result: GH位移最大达约2 μm（≈4.4λ）；p偏振反射率在伪布儒斯特角θ_B≈46°处最小，该点附近GH位移被增强；R、T与GH数据联合给出对涂层幅值与相位响应的互补约束，模型与实验定量一致。
