Conclusion: GH位移结合RT测量可改进多层膜相位响应表征；该相位效应在多反射倍频腔中累积，可能影响腔模结构与共振条件，需在腔设计中考虑。

Abstract: We report polarization- and angle-dependent lateral beam shifts observed at 458~nm upon reflection from a deep-ultraviolet (DUV) dichroic multilayer mirror. These Goos--Hänchen (GH) shifts originate from the phase of the complex Fresnel reflection coefficient and are quantitatively reproduced using a transfer-matrix model. Simultaneous reflectance (R), transmittance (T), and GH shift measurements provide complementary constraints on the coating's amplitude and phase response. The analysis is extended to transmission, predicting analogous phase-induced lateral shifts. In frequency-doubling cavities using dichroic mirrors, these phase effects can accumulate over multiple reflections, leading to deviations from ray-optics predictions that may affect cavity mode structure and resonance conditions. Our results show a GH shift of as much as 2~\textmu m (\bm{$\approx 4.4λ$}), which, combined with RT data, enables improved characterization of the phase response of the multilayer coating. The p-polarized reflectance is minimized at a pseudo-Brewster angle of \bm{$θ_B \approx 46^\circ$} at 458~nm, providing a natural reference point around which the GH shift is enhanced.

</details>


### [408] [An Agent-Driven, Cross-Validated Inverse-Design Pipeline for Dielectric Metasurfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08127)
*Giuseppe Emanuele Lio,Roberto Caputo,Alain J. Corso,Maria Guglielmina Pelizzo,Antonio Ferraro*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一个开源流程：由AI编码智能体将自然语言需求转化为超表面优化任务，基于可微三维RCWA进行含制造容差鲁棒性的优化，并用FDTD独立验证；在1550 nm的自由形硅超光栅、偏振无关超原子库与超透镜案例中演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 介电超表面逆向设计虽强大但人力成本高：每个新目标都需人工选择参数化与品质因数、调度算力，并判断结果是否数值未收敛、对制造误差敏感或陷入局部最优，缺乏自动化且可信的评估机制。

Method: 构建开源pipeline，由AI编码智能体把纯文本规格说明转换为超表面优化运行并执行；用固定检查清单分析每次运行并提出下一轮迭代；优化采用可微三维RCWA，并纳入制造容差鲁棒性；所有报告设计均以FDTD全波仿真独立交叉验证。在1550 nm演示三类任务：自由形硅超光栅、偏振无关超原子库及由其组装的偏转超胞、以及同库构建的超透镜。

Result: 超光栅案例中，独立FDTD验证发现优化模型高估效率约5%，而常规收敛测试未能察觉；鲁棒设计在±10 nm制造误差下仍保留大部分效率。其他案例中RCWA结果被全波仿真证实。

Conclusion: AI编码智能体驱动的自动化优化流程可行，但优化模型可能存在收敛测试无法发现的系统性偏差，需独立全波验证；该开源框架将参数化选择、算力管理与结果批判性评估自动化，可用于含鲁棒性要求的超表面设计。

Abstract: Inverse design of dielectric metasurfaces is powerful but labour-intensive: each new target requires choosing a parameterization and a figure of merit, managing compute resources, and critically assessing results that may be numerically unconverged, sensitive to fabrication errors or trapped in local optima. Here we present an open-source pipeline in which an artificial intelligence (AI) coding agent turns a plain-language specification into metasurface optimization runs, executes them, analyses every run with a fixed checklist and proposes the next iteration. Designs are optimized with differentiable three-dimensional rigorous coupled-wave analysis (RCWA), including robustness to fabrication tolerances, and every reported design is independently verified with finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations. We demonstrate the workflow at 1550 nm on a freeform silicon metagrating, on a polarization-independent meta-atom library assembled into beam-deflecting supercells, and on metalenses built from the same library. In the metagrating case, the independent FDTD verification revealed a 5\% overestimate of the efficiency by the optimization model that a conventional convergence test had not detected, and the robust design retained most of its efficiency under $\pm$10~nm fabrication errors. In the other cases, instead, the obtained RCWA results are confirmed by full-wave simulations.

</details>


### [409] [Analytical Modeling of the Admittance Tensor of Periodic Elliptical Meta-Atoms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08166)
*Thomas Fromentèze*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对均匀栅格上椭圆形meta-atom的解析模型，用Galerkin法直接作用于贴片几何（无需空间剖分），并以仿射变换将任意旋转椭圆映射到单位圆，统一覆盖所有配置；相比周期性全波求解器，宽带响应计算约快三个数量级（几十毫秒 vs 数分钟至数十分钟），且模型对几何可微，支持超表面准实时优化设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全息超表面天线需通过合成指定导纳张量分布来控制导行表面波向漏波的转换，而每个张量由亚波长单元均质化得到；现有将meta-atom几何与张量关联的数值与半解析方法计算代价高，缺乏解析模型。

Method: 聚焦均匀栅格上的椭圆形meta-atom，采用Galerkin法直接作用于贴片几何而不进行空间网格划分；利用仿射变换将任意旋转椭圆映射为单位圆，从而以单一公式统一处理所有单元配置，得到解析导纳张量模型。

Result: 同一工作站上，周期性全波求解器计算宽带响应需数分钟至数十分钟，而本模型仅需数十毫秒，约快三个数量级；预测导纳在基模谐振之前与矩量法参考结果一致，并能刻画基片的导模异常（guided-mode anomaly）。

Conclusion: 该解析模型兼具物理洞察与效率，且是几何的可微函数，为优化超表面的准实时设计提供了可行途径。

Abstract: A metasurface is an electrically thin interface that controls the phase, amplitude and polarization of a wave, upon reflection or transmission. Printed on a grounded dielectric substrate and spatially modulated across the aperture, it converts a guided surface wave into a radiated leaky wave, a mechanism used in holographic metasurface antennas. Controlling this conversion requires synthesizing a prescribed distribution of admittance tensors, each derived from the homogenization of a subwavelength unit cell. Many numerical and semi-analytical methods have been proposed to relate the geometry of a meta-atom to the tensor it produces. This paper presents, to the author's knowledge, the first analytical model, restricted to elliptical meta-atoms on a uniform lattice. The Galerkin method is applied directly to the geometry of the patches, without spatial meshing. An affine transformation maps any rotated ellipse onto the unit disk, so that a single formulation covers every configuration. A wideband response takes from minutes to tens of minutes with a periodic full-wave solver, while the proposed model evaluates it in a few tens of milliseconds on the same workstation, roughly three orders of magnitude faster. The predicted admittance agrees with a method-of-moments reference up to the fundamental resonance and captures the guided-mode anomaly of the substrate. Beyond the physical insight it brings, the model is a differentiable function of the geometry, which makes the quasi-real-time design of optimized metasurfaces possible.

</details>


### [410] [Machine learning classification of dynamical phases in a driven nonlinear Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08287)
*Chukwunaedum Patrick Izediuno,Ghada H. Alharbi,Stephan Wong,Zeeshan Ahmad,Sunae So,Minkyung Kim,Sang Soon Oh*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在同一相干驱动SSH克尔谐振子链上对比四种分类器（启发式、CNN、aDMD库、GMM），无监督方法在无标签条件下对相图的划分接近监督方法，并揭示参考图收敛性对评估的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驱动非线性光子晶格存在稳定、对称破缺、周期与混沌等多类稳态，参数空间映射对器件设计至关重要；但暴力扫描慢且依赖手工判据，而机器学习分类器多在不同系统上测试，难以判断哪种方法适合新晶格。

Method: 针对同一相干驱动Su-Schrieffer-Heeger克尔谐振子链，应用四类分类器：(1) 基于Lyapunov指数与谱诊断的手工启发式分类器；(2) 以其标签训练的监督CNN；(3) 基于增强动态模态分解(aDMD)的无监督库构建方案；(4) 以四个动力学不变量（含aDMD重构误差）为输入的無监督高斯混合模型(GMM)。以收敛的启发式相图作为基准。

Result: CNN在留出集上准确率达98.0%；两种无标签方法（aDMD库与GMM）的调整兰德指数(ARI)分别为0.916与0.947。aDMD库能清晰分辨稳定相与双稳相，并区分对称与对称破缺的周期振荡（启发式方法漏掉），但无法区分周期性与混沌切换。收敛不良的参考相图会低估无标签方法的准确度。

Conclusion: 无监督、无标签方法可在无先验判据下接近监督CNN的相图划分质量，并具备发现启发式遗漏相区的能力；评价此类方法时须确保参照相图已收敛，否则会系统性低估其性能。

Abstract: Driven nonlinear photonic lattices can settle into steady, symmetry-broken, periodic, or chaotic states, and mapping where each occurs in parameter space is key to device design. Brute-force mapping is slow and relies on hand-built criteria, while machine-learning classifiers are usually tested on different systems, so it is unclear which suits a new lattice. We therefore apply four classifiers to the same coherently driven Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain of Kerr resonators: a hand-built heuristic classifier based on Lyapunov exponents and spectral diagnostics, a supervised convolutional neural network (CNN) trained on the heuristic labels, an unsupervised library-building scheme based on augmented dynamic mode decomposition (aDMD), and an unsupervised Gaussian mixture model (GMM) on four dynamical invariants that include an aDMD reconstruction error. Using a converged heuristic diagram as the reference, the CNN reaches 98.0% held-out accuracy, while the two label-free methods reach adjusted Rand indices (ARIs) of 0.916 and 0.947, respectively, without seeing any labels. We show that the aDMD library cleanly resolves the stable and bistable phases and separates symmetric from symmetry-broken periodic oscillations, which the heuristic misses, though it cannot distinguish periodic from chaotic switching. We also find that a poorly converged reference understates the label-free methods' accuracy.

</details>


### [411] [Reprogrammable polaritonic skyrmion and meron lattices based on the phase-change material In$_3$SbTe$_2$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08328)
*Lina Jäckering,Arvid Schick,Enrico Baù,Lukas Conrads,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Christoph Stampfer,Matthias Wuttig,Andreas Tittl,Thomas Taubner*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作利用相变材料In₃SbTe₂的光学可编程金属化，在hBN中实现可重构六方/方形耦合结构，从而快速重构极化激元拓扑晶格并调控其拓扑不变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极化激元拓扑晶格（如skyrmion、meron）是片上信息编码与纳米尺度光-物质相互作用的潜在平台，但现有方法依赖繁琐耗时的制备工艺，且无法重构拓扑不变量，缺乏主动可调性。

Method: 以hBN中的双曲声子极化激元为载体，采用相变材料In₃SbTe₂作为耦合结构；利用激光脉冲使其在非晶介电相（ε>0）与晶态金属相（ε<0）之间可逆切换，光学编程并重构六方与方形耦合结构，并通过改变入射频率调节拓扑晶格位点尺寸。

Result: 实现了可重构六方与方形的极化激元拓扑晶格光学快速原型化；通过调谐入射频率可调控拓扑晶格位点尺寸；通过重编程耦合结构可调控拓扑不变量；整个重构过程可在数分钟内完成。

Conclusion: 该平台实现了稳健光学拓扑的按需可重写重构，为基于可重构拓扑态的片上光子计算提供了新途径。

Abstract: Optical topological quasiparticles such as skyrmions and merons consist of engineered electromagnetic fields which can be realized via the controlled interference of polaritons. The resulting polaritonic topological lattices offer a promising platform for on-chip information encoding and nanoscale light-matter interaction. However, realizing these functionalities requires active tailoring of the polaritonic topological lattice. Although previous works have achieved tuning of the size of the polaritonic lattice sites, these methods relied on cumbersome and time-consuming fabrication processes and do not allow reconfiguration of the topological invariant. Here, we demonstrate fast optical prototyping of reconfigurable hexagonal and square coupling structures for the generation of polaritonic topological lattices with hyperbolic phonon polaritons in hBN using the phase-change material In$_3$SbTe$_2$. As In$_3$SbTe$_2$ can be switched reversibly between its dielectric ($\varepsilon$>0) amorphous and metallic ($\varepsilon$<0) crystalline phase by laser pulses, metallic In$_3$SbTe$_2$ coupling structures can be optically programmed and reconfigured. Our approach enables tailoring the size of the topological lattice sites by tuning the incident frequency. Moreover, In$_3$SbTe$_2$ allows for tailoring the topological invariant by reprogramming the coupling structure. Our platform enables reprogramming of robust optical topologies within minutes, opening a route toward rewritable on-chip photonic computing based on robust and on demand reconfigurable topological states.

</details>


### [412] [Deep-learning surrogate model for rapid quantum-noise computation in dual-pump fiber-optic phase-sensitive amplifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08437)
*Yousra Bouasria,Debanuj Chatterjee,Abdessamad Belfakir,Debabrota Basu*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文用半量子框架生成噪声系数（NF）数据集，训练优化深度神经网络（DNN）实现双泵相位敏感光纤参量放大器NF的快速预测，计算时间约缩短400倍，MAE为0.0015 dB，并结合聚类快速搜索高增益（20 dB）、低NF（0.3 dB）的参数空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双泵相位敏感光纤参量放大器在强非线性条件下具有理论0 dB噪声系数的低噪特性，但全量子NF计算困难，半量子模型虽可用却复杂且计算资源消耗大，难以支撑大参数空间的设计搜索。

Method: 先采用半量子NF计算框架，在大参数空间上生成数值仿真的输入-输出NF数据集；再用该数据训练优化的深度神经网络用于NF快速预测；最后利用聚类方法在高维参数空间中针对高增益与低NF目标进行快速探索并反演设计参数。

Result: 相比标准半量子NF评估方法，DNN预测将计算时间缩短约400倍，平均绝对误差为0.0015 dB；通过聚类实现了面向20 dB高增益与0.3 dB低NF目标的参数空间快速探索，并检索到相应设计参数。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基于机器学习的方法可高效支撑高维参数空间搜索，尤其适用于计算密集的光子系统设计与优化。

Abstract: Fiber-optic parametric amplifiers in a phase-sensitive amplifier (PSA) configuration are well known for their low noise properties. Quantum mechanics dictates that these amplifiers can have a 0 dB noise figure (NF) (ratio of signal-to-noise ratio at the input and output of the amplifier) under certain conditions. However, for a dual-pump configuration, when the system is highly nonlinear, fully quantum calculations of NF become non-trivial. In such cases, semi-quantum models of NF evaluation exists, however, they are often complicated and resource intensive. To simplify that, in this work, first we use a semi-quantum NF calculation framework for the generation of numerically simulated input-output dataset of NF over a large parameter spaces. Then we use the data to train an optimized deep neural network (DNN) for rapid NF prediction. Utilizing the DNN, we demonstrate about 400 times reduction in the computation time compared to the standard semi-quantum NF evaluation approach with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.0015 dB. Using clustering we demonstrate a rapid exploration of the parameter space with respect to high gain (20 dB) and low NF (0.3 dB) targets and retrieve associated design parameters. These results illustrate the efficacy of machine learning-based approaches for rapid search of high-dimensional parameter spaces especially in compute intensive photonic systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [413] [Rule-Guided and Trajectory-Aware Repair for LLM-Based HLS Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07324)
*Xianjing Zhu,Wenqi Lou,Yuanbo Wen,Teng Wang,Lei Gong,Chao Wang,Xuehai Zhou*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MementoHLS：基于可执行修复契约库与审阅者证伪账本双记忆引导修复的智能体式 HLS-C 生成框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 直接从自然语言规格生成功能正确且可综合的 HLS-C 具有潜力，但现有方法难以将多轮工具反馈与可复用 HLS 知识转化为有效修订，限制端到端生成成功率。

Method: 提出 MementoHLS 智能体框架，核心为可执行、可证伪的双记忆引导修复：ERCL 将跨任务 HLS 知识转为证据门控的修复动作；RFL 将任务内修复历史转为轨迹证据以抑制无效路径、保留已验证进展；并用 Same-Candidate Reviewer 将 Parse/Compile/TB/Synth 结果绑定到对应候选，Single-Commit Arbiter 每轮至多提交一个候选以保证结果归因可靠。

Result: 在 94 个 HLS-Eval 与 170 个 Bench4HLS 任务上，同候选 TB∧Synth pass@1/pass@5 由 41.7%/57.4% 提升至 58.9%/68.1%（HLS-Eval），由 15.5%/32.9% 提升至 32.4%/50.6%（Bench4HLS）。

Conclusion: 将工具反馈与 HLS 知识结构化为可执行修复动作与可证伪轨迹证据，并配合严格归因机制，可显著提升端到端 HLS 生成的可靠性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising path for directly generating functionally correct and synthesizable HLS-C from natural-language specifications. However, existing approaches often struggle to turn multi-round tool feedback and reusable HLS knowledge into effective revisions, limiting end-to-end generation success. We propose MementoHLS, an agentic HLS generation framework built around executable and falsifiable dual-memory-guided repair. MementoHLS combines an Executable Repair Contract Library (ERCL), which converts cross-task HLS knowledge into evidence-gated repair actions, with a Reviewer-Grounded Falsification Ledger (RFL), which converts task-local repair history into trajectory evidence to suppress ineffective routes and preserve validated progress. To ensure reliable outcome attribution, a Same-Candidate Reviewer binds Parse, Compile, Testbench (TB), and Synthesis (Synth) outcomes to the corresponding candidate, while a Single-Commit Arbiter commits at most one candidate per round. Evaluated on 94 HLS-Eval and 170 Bench4HLS tasks, MementoHLS improves same-candidate TB$\wedge$Synth pass@1/pass@5 from 41.7%/57.4% to 58.9%/68.1% on HLS-Eval, and from 15.5%/32.9% to 32.4%/50.6% on Bench4HLS, demonstrating substantial improvements in end-to-end HLS generation reliability.

</details>


### [414] [A Synchronized Tri-Modality Wireless System for Multi-Point Non-Contact Cardiac Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07358)
*Wei Ren,Kaili Zhao,Huansheng Yi,Miaoyang Hu,Jianqi Wang,Canhua Xu,Fugui Qi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出首个集成心电图(ECG)、心震图(SCG)与多普勒心动图(DCG)的三模态无线采集系统，为雷达非接触心脏感知提供严谨验证平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 雷达非接触感知可捕捉胸壁振动并实现局部化心脏监测，但缺乏可靠的研究级硬件平台进行严格验证；现有系统仅将DCG与ECG等粗粒度参考配准，缺少直接的机械真值，限制了对雷达输出的细粒度评估。

Method: 构建统一采集与控制框架下的三模态无线系统：微型可穿戴ECG/SCG模块 + 高分辨率毫米波雷达模块，支持时间对齐记录、空间分辨感知与特征提取；系统支持胸部多点采集与跨模态精确同步，并保持适合可穿戴运行的规格。

Result: 线性运动平台实验显示DCG与SCG推导的位移高度一致，验证了位移测量准确性；人体实验进一步表明跨模态一致性与特征点的稳健提取，确立ECG为电学锚点、SCG为DCG的机械真值。

Conclusion: 该系统为无接触心脏感知提供严谨、空间分辨的验证平台，推动下一代基于雷达的生理监测发展。

Abstract: Cardiac physiological monitoring is fundamental to evaluating cardiovascular health and diagnosing related diseases. Non-contact radar sensing can capture chest-wall vibrations with spatial specificity, enabling localized physiological monitoring and cardiac assessment. Progress, however, has been limited by the absence of a reliable, research-grade hardware platform for rigorous validation of radar-based methods. Prior systems typically pair radar, namely Doppler cardiography (DCG), with only electrocardiography (ECG) or other coarse references, providing no direct mechanical ground truth and thus constraining fine-grained evaluation of radar outputs. We present a tri-modality wireless system that integrates ECG, seismocardiography (SCG), and DCG under a unified acquisition and control framework for time-aligned recording and analysis. The tri-modality system combines miniaturized wearable ECG/SCG modules with a high-resolution mmWave radar module, supporting spatially resolved sensing and subsequent feature extraction. To our knowledge, this is the first integrated ECG--SCG--DCG hardware system for comprehensive cardiac monitoring; it enables multi-point thoracic acquisition, achieves precise cross-modal synchronization, and maintains specifications suitable for wearable operation. Experiments on a linear-motion platform show close agreement between DCG- and SCG-derived displacements, confirming accurate displacement measurement. Human-subject studies further demonstrate cross-modal consistency and robust extraction of feature points, establishing ECG as the electrical anchor and SCG as the mechanical ground truth for DCG. Overall, the system provides a rigorous, spatially resolved validation platform that advances non-contact cardiac sensing and supports next-generation radar-based monitoring.

</details>


### [415] [OpenRDMA: A GPU-Native Multi-Path Reliable RDMA Transport Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07559)
*Ziheng Ji,Chunyu Liu,Weihao Peng,Mingheng Mi,Pu Wang,Hai Zhang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 OpenRDMA——面向 GPU 友好通信的开源多路径可靠 RDMA 传输架构，用 8 字节 GPU doorbell + FPGA NIC 重建 WQE 降低提交开销，并结合 MRC、乱序接收、选择性重传与软硬件协同重传机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 AI 集群算力密度上升，网络通信成为系统性能瓶颈；GPU 发起通信需低开销请求提交以实现通信与计算重叠。但 GDR 控制路径仍依赖 CPU，IBGDA 需 GPU 组装 WQE，额外消耗 SM 资源与内存带宽。

Method: 1) 极简 GPU doorbell：GPU 仅发 8 字节 token，专用 FPGA NIC 依据预配置上下文重建完整 WQE；2) 基于 MRC 支持逐包多路径传输与乱序到达，配合选择性重传、有序 DMA 落位及 GPU 可见 flag 轮询保障可靠交付与安全消费；3) 软硬件协同重传：NIC 负责快速数据传输，CPU 软件负责超时检测、状态跟踪与恢复策略，减轻 GPU 提交路径与 FPGA 硬件状态开销。

Result: 论文给出 OpenRDMA 的体系结构与关键硬件组件设计；FPGA 原型实现正在进行中，尚未报告性能评测数据。

Conclusion: OpenRDMA 以开源、多路径、可靠传输、GPU 友好为设计目标，通过极简 GPU 提交接口与软硬件协同机制，有望在不占用 SM 资源的前提下实现高吞吐、低开销的 GPU 发起通信。

Abstract: As the computing power density of large-scale AI clusters rises, network communication increasingly limits system performance. GPU-initiated communication requires low-overhead request submission to overlap communication with computation. However, GPUDirect RDMA (GDR) still relies on CPU involvement in its control path, while InfiniBand GPUDirect Async (IBGDA) requires GPUs to assemble Work Queue Entries (WQEs), consuming additional SM resources and memory bandwidth. We propose OpenRDMA, an open-source multi-path reliable RDMA transport architecture designed for GPU-friendly communication. First, OpenRDMA provides a minimal GPU doorbell mechanism: the GPU issues an 8-byte token, and a dedicated FPGA NIC reconstructs the complete WQE from preconfigured context. Second, building on Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC), OpenRDMA supports per-packet multi-path transport and out-of-order arrivals, while selective retransmission, ordered DMA placement, and GPU-visible flag polling provide reliable delivery and safe data consumption. Third, a hardware-software co-designed retransmission mechanism keeps the GPU submission path lightweight and reduces FPGA hardware state overhead: the NIC handles fast data transfer, while CPU software manages complex timeout detection, state tracking, and recovery policies. We describe the architecture and key hardware components of OpenRDMA; implementation of the FPGA prototype is underway.

</details>


### [416] [CAMP: Context-Aware Mapping and Placement for LLMs on 3D-IMC Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07707)
*Orhun Görkem,Athanasios Vasilopoulos,Georgios Pagonis,Victoria Clerico,Hadjer Benmeziane,Irem Boybat,Hsinyu Tsai,Abu Sebastian,William Andrew Simon*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出CAMP——面向3D-IMC LLM加速器的上下文感知权重映射与放置算法，用冲突矩阵刻画架构/网络/运行时导致的资源竞争，并通过profiling反馈环剪枝搜索空间，实现吞吐优化的离线映射；无需硬件改动，3D-IMC计算利用率由42.4%提升至60.3%，3D-IMC吞吐最高2.0x、端到端吞吐1.74x于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM因加载大权重矩阵与KV cache产生严重访存开销；AIMC可对静态权重就地计算以降低能耗与延迟，3D-IMC通过垂直堆叠存储阵列提升容量，但同时引出新问题：权重在存储中的放置方式决定了哪些MVM可并发执行，进而影响延迟与吞吐。现有文献对3D-IMC权重映射的并发性研究不足，导致计算资源利用不充分。

Method: 提出CAMP（Context-Aware Mapping and Placement）推理上下文感知的权重映射算法：将架构、目标网络与运行时上下文引起的潜在资源竞争建模为"冲突矩阵"，据此生成吞吐优化映射；再通过profiling驱动的反馈环高效剪枝搜索空间，在实际可接受时间内返回优化映射；为离线、纯软件方案，无需硬件改动。

Result: 3D-IMC计算利用率从42.4%提升至60.3%；相比SOTA映射算法，3D-IMC吞吐最高提升2.0x，端到端吞吐最高提升1.74x。

Conclusion: 并发感知的权重映射是释放3D-IMC LLM加速器性能的关键维度；以冲突矩阵建模竞争并结合profiling反馈剪枝，可在离线软件层面显著提升计算利用率与吞吐，且不引入硬件开销。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) incur severe memory-access overheads due to the cost of loading large weight matrices and key-value (KV) caches. Analog In-Memory Computing (AIMC) is an emerging solution that enables computation directly on static weights stored in memory, substantially reducing energy and latency. 3D-IMC further stacks memory arrays into vertical tiers, increasing capacity but revealing a new challenge: how weights are placed in memory determines which matrix-vector multiplications (MVMs) can execute concurrently, affecting latency and throughput. The concurrency aspect of 3D-IMC weight-mapping remains underexplored in the literature, leading to sub-optimal utilization of compute resources on 3D-IMC chips. In this context we propose CAMP (Context-Aware Mapping and Placement), an inference-context-aware weight mapping algorithm for 3D-IMC-based LLM accelerators. CAMP captures the potential resource contention resulting from the architecture, targeted network, and runtime context in a conflict matrix, enabling throughput-optimized weight mapping. This mapping is refined through a profiling-driven feedback loop that efficiently prunes the search space and returns optimized mappings within practical runtimes. CAMP is an offline, software-based solution requiring no hardware changes and improving 3D-IMC compute utilization from 42.4% to 60.3%, delivering up to 2.0x higher 3D-IMC throughput and 1.74x higher end-to-end throughput over state-of-the-art mapping algorithms.

</details>


### [417] [Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08299)
*Ramyad Hadidi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出 SiliconForge 校准性能模型，独立变化服务分解方式（P/D、P/D+AFD）与硬件分配，在四种模型方向、四类加速器与两种互连上以统一规则协同优化，结论是 AFD 在 SLO goodput/kW 上无稳健优势，关键在 prefill 供给、decode 带宽、链路与资源池粒度，并建议采用可调整映射与池规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中 P/D 分离已用于隔离资源需求不同的阶段；AFD 进一步拆分 decode，但引入通信开销、放置约束和额外资源池。基础设施需在模型与硬件可被实测之前承诺，因此需要回答：随模型与加速器路线图变化，角色专用（role-specific）放置是否值得付出这些代价。

Method: 构建经校准的 SiliconForge 模型，将 serving 分解方案与硬件指派解耦独立变化；对 P/D 与 P/D+AFD 在 4 种模型方向 × 4 类加速器（锚定现有与已发布部件）× 2 种互连上进行协同优化，统一采用相同的流水线重叠规则与功率预算。

Result: 在 SLO goodput per kW 上未发现 AFD 具有稳健的部署级优势，多数名义估计偏向 P/D；AFD 最大领先来自可多放一个 prefill 副本而非更高效的 decode 池。仅在 KV 密集型模型方向且共享专家池横跨多个小 scale-up 域时 AFD 名义占优；更大域或两种设计都使用快速互连会削弱该优势。在相同硬件上重新优化映射与池规模，可将早期承诺的中位归一化 goodput 损失由 36% 降至 9%。

Conclusion: prefill 供给、decode 内存带宽、互连链路与资源池粒度对部署的影响超过是否拆分本身；固定硬件指派会随模型、互连、硬件假设与目标变化而失去优势，建议采用可调整的映射与池规模，使边界与硬件选择跟随模型需求。

Abstract: For large language model (LLM) inference, prefill/decode disaggregation (P/D) is deployed in production to isolate phases with different resource demands. Attention/feed-forward network disaggregation (AFD) splits decode again, but adds communication, placement constraints, and another provisioned pool. We ask whether role-specific placement repays this cost as models and accelerator roadmaps change. Infrastructure is committed before future models and hardware can be benchmarked. We present SiliconForge, a calibrated model that varies the serving decomposition and hardware assignment independently. We compare P/D and P/D+AFD across four model directions, four accelerator classes anchored to current and announced parts, and two fabrics. We co-optimize each design using the same rules for pipeline overlap and the same power budget. Our main comparisons show no robust deployment-level AFD advantage in service-level objective (SLO) goodput per kW. Most nominal estimates favor P/D. The largest AFD lead comes from fitting one more prefill replica, not from a more efficient decode pool. AFD has a nominal lead in the KV-heavy (key-value) model direction when the co-located expert pool spans several small scale-up domains. Larger domains or a fast fabric for both designs weaken that lead. We therefore find that prefill provisioning, decode memory bandwidth, links, and pool granularity decide deployments more than the split alone. A fixed hardware assignment can lose its advantage as models, fabrics, hardware assumptions, and objectives change. Re-optimizing mappings and pool sizes on the same hardware cuts early commitment's median normalized goodput loss from 36% to 9%. We recommend adjustable mappings and pool sizes to let boundary and hardware choices follow model demands.

</details>


### [418] [Scaling Up Analog CIM: A Simulation Framework for Topology-Aware Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08399)
*Yuxin Ren,Danella Zhao,Huanrui Yang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出Isobar仿真平台，显式建模CIM芯粒系统中权重映射拓扑的影响，指导映射搜索：Gemma-7B prefill通信时间降23.3%、端到端时延降18.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型部署需求推动CIM通过芯粒集成扩容，但现有仿真抽象基于局部算子代价与聚合通信指标，掩盖了系统规模扩大时权重映射拓扑对性能的影响。

Method: 先做阶段化分析（phase analysis），量化不同硬件配置下映射拓扑对性能的影响强度及映射优化的时延收益；再构建Isobar仿真平台，集成CIM分解、异构执行与资源建模，并以硅测量和周期级仿真验证其代价估计可靠性，进而支撑跨模型与硬件配置的映射搜索。

Result: 在Gemma-7B prefill场景下，Isobar引导的映射相较最强基线将通信时间降低23.3%、端到端时延降低18.6%；系统级建模表明扩展至数千die时模拟CIM相对GPU仍保持能效优势。

Conclusion: 拓扑感知映射是高效执行的关键设计维度，需系统级建模而非局部算子抽象来评估CIM规模化潜力。

Abstract: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) enables energy-efficient AI inference by performing in-situ matrix multiplication. The growing demand for deploying larger models motivates chiplet integration to expand CIM capacity. However, simulation abstractions based on local operator costs and aggregate communication metrics obscure the impact of weight-mapping topology when CIM system scales up. We develop a phase analysis that quantifies how strongly mapping topology affects system performance across hardware configurations and how mapping optimization translates into latency gains. To evaluate and exploit this design space, we present Isobar, a simulation platform integrating CIM decompositions, heterogeneous execution, and resource modeling. Validated against silicon measurements and cycle-accurate simulation, Isobar provides reliable cost estimates that enable effective mapping search across model and hardware configurations. For Gemma-7B prefill, Isobar-guided mapping reduces communication time by 23.3% and end-to-end latency by 18.6% relative to the strongest baseline. Isobar's system-level modeling show that analog CIM retains energy-efficiency potential relative to GPU when scaled to thousands of dies, and identify topology-aware mapping as a key design dimension for efficient execution.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [419] [A Particle-Based Multiuser Communication with a Budget Limit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07171)
*Shaojie Zhang,Ozgur B. Akan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究多用户分子/粒子网络中精确恢复二进制输入之和所需的最小粒子预算：固定符号时长与目标错误概率时预算随发送端数目平方增长（OOK可达），放宽符号时长与计数区间数可降至 N log N 量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多用户网络可通过共享接收机汇聚本地观测，但"精确求和"这一任务的粒子（资源）开销下界尚不清晰；需要刻画粒子预算随网络规模的增长规律，并寻找降低该开销的手段（更长的符号时长、更多计数区间）。

Method: 1) 在最一般的传输/解码方案（甚至接收机获知全部粒子到达时刻）下推导粒子预算下界与错误概率下界；2) 证明同时 on-off keying (OOK) 达到平方标度；3) 提出 groupwise OOK counting (GOC) 方案：分组、错峰（staggered）组释放，并对各组输入和进行序贯估计以处理延迟到达；4) 基于区间计数接收建立可达上界与下界。

Result: 固定符号时长与目标错误概率时，最小预算随发送端数 N 呈 Θ(N²)，且若预算增长慢于平方则错误概率趋近 1（与方案无关）；同时 OOK 可达该标度。在基于区间计数的接收下，要降低平方标度，符号时长与计数区间数必须同时随 N 增长；当二者均与 N 成正比时，最小预算为 Θ(N log N)。

Conclusion: 精确求和的粒子预算存在与资源维度（时长、区间数）强耦合的标度律：单一维度扩展无法突破平方瓶颈，需时长与区间数协同扩展才能实现 N log N 近线性开销；GOC 提供了可行的实现路径。

Abstract: Multiuser networks can aggregate local observations through a shared receiver. In this paper, we study the particle budget required to recover the exact sum of binary inputs in a multiuser network. We show that, for the considered model, the minimum budget grows quadratically with the number of transmitters when the symbol duration and target error probability are fixed, even when the receiver observes all particle arrival times. Simultaneous on-off keying (OOK) achieves this quadratic scaling, while any slower budget growth makes the error probability approach one at a fixed symbol duration, regardless of the transmission and decoding scheme. We then examine how this particle requirement can be reduced by allowing longer symbol durations and more counting intervals. We develop a groupwise OOK counting (GOC) scheme with staggered group releases and sequential estimation of group input sums, accounting for delayed arrivals. Our bounds show that, when reception is based on interval counts, reducing the quadratic scaling requires both the symbol duration and the number of counting intervals to grow with network size. When both grow in proportion to network size, the minimum budget becomes proportional to the number of transmitters times its logarithm.

</details>


### [420] [Few-Shot Beam Selection for Embodied AI via In-Context Learning and Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07306)
*Weicao Deng,Ruihan Li,Feihang Xu,Min Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出ICL+CVCP框架，用免训练上下文学习与交叉验证保形预测实现小样本、分布无关的毫米波波束预测，在保证覆盖概率的同时降低导频开销与计算时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EAI系统需大规模多模态感知数据交互，毫米波通信是关键；但传统波束训练开销过大导致快速可靠波束选择成为瓶颈。位置辅助波束预测虽可替代，却受定位误差和大量训练数据需求限制。

Method: 两模块组合：（1）ICL（In-Context Learning）利用免训练适配能力，仅需少量演示样本即可推理，无需大规模数据采集与模型微调；（2）CVCP（Cross-Validation Conformal Prediction）构建紧凑、无分布假设的候选波束集，并以用户设定概率保证包含最优波束。

Result: 实验表明ICL+CVCP持续满足目标经验覆盖率，同时显著降低导频开销与计算时延，满足EAI应用对可靠性与效率的严格要求。

Conclusion: 将免训练ICL与保形预测结合，为小样本、带可靠性保证的毫米波波束预测提供了有效方案，兼顾覆盖率保证与低开销低时延。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) communications are essential for supporting massive multimodal sensory data exchange in Embodied Artificial Intelligence (EAI) systems. However, fast and reliable beam selection for mmWave communication remains a critical bottleneck due to the prohibitive overhead associated with conventional beam training. Although location-aided beam prediction offers a promising alternative, its performance is often limited by localization errors and the need for extensive training data. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework termed In-Context Learning driven Cross-Validation Conformal Prediction (ICL+CVCP) for beam prediction. The proposed framework utilizes the training-free adaptation capability of ICL, enabling effective operation with only a small number of demonstration samples and eliminating the need for large-scale data collection and model fine-tuning. In addition, the CVCP module constructs compact, distribution-free candidate beam sets that provably contain the optimal beam with a user-defined probability. Experimental results confirm that ICL+CVCP consistently satisfies the desired empirical coverage while significantly reducing pilot overhead and computational latency, thereby meeting the stringent reliability and efficiency requirements of EAI applications.

</details>


### [421] [A Novel BVH-accelerated Dynamic Ray-Tracing Channel Model for Vehicular Communication Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07311)
*Songjiang Yang,Cheng-Xiang Wang,Yinghua Wang,Chen Wang,Jie Huang,Yunfei Chen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出BVH加速的动态射线追踪信道模型（BVH-DRT），将DRT的"时间驱动更新"转变为"空间驱动更新"，以几何相干距离自适应调整射线更新间隔，降低复杂度，并用于DD域波形（OTFS、ODDM）评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G网络评估需要精确高效的信道建模，而动态射线追踪（DRT）受制于对信道相干时间的依赖，更新频繁、计算复杂度高。

Method: 采用包围体层次（BVH）对复杂散射体进行聚类预处理，结合收发端运动学建立几何相干距离，从而自适应调整射线更新间隔；据此生成非平稳信道冲激响应，评估时延-多普勒域波形（OTFS、ODDM）。

Result: V2V场景验证表明，BVH-DRT与实测及商用软件保持时空一致性，同时显著提升计算效率；误码率评估揭示高动态信道对波形性能的严重影响。

Conclusion: 该框架为6G可靠通信与鲁棒感知设计提供了重要支撑。

Abstract: Accurate and efficient channel modeling is critical for evaluating the sixth-generation (6G) networks, while dynamic ray-tracing (DRT) remains bottlenecked by its reliance on channel coherence time. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a novel bounding volume hierarchy-accelerated DRT (BVH-DRT), which introduces a mechanism shift from a time-driven update in DRT to a spatial-driven update. The proposed channel model clusters complex scatterers using the BVH method as pre-processing to establish a geometric coherence distance guided by transceiver kinematics, so that the ray update intervals in BVH-DRT can be autonomously adjusted to reduce the complexity. Furthermore, the non-stationary channel impulse responses are generated to evaluate delay-Doppler (DD) domain waveforms, including orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) and orthogonal delay-Doppler division multiplexing (ODDM). Validations in vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) scenarios demonstrate that BVH-DRT achieves spatial-temporal consistency with measurements and commercial software while significantly enhancing computational efficiency. Additionally, bit error rate (BER) evaluation highlights the severe impact of high-dynamic channels on waveform performance. The proposed framework is important for designing reliable communications and robust sensing in 6G networks.

</details>


### [422] [Sharp Minimum-Rate Guarantees for Power-Based Discrete RIS Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07548)
*Hernan X. Cordova*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 在固定预编码的离散可重构智能表面（RIS）系统中，刻画了"期望功率优化"何时能保证最小用户速率（MUR）：加权期望功率和无正保证下界，最小期望功率可保证一个锐利常数比例的MUR，并用半定对偶高效验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIS相位配置常以最大化期望接收功率为目标，但该目标与用户最小速率（公平性）并非等价，需明确其失效条件与可保证的公平性下界。

Method: 针对离散相位、固定预编码场景，分别分析两类目标：(1) 加权期望功率和，(2) 最小期望功率。通过构造有界信道的反例证明前者失效；对后者推导最优MUR保留比例的锐利常数（由相位的功率质量与残余干扰决定），并给出半定对偶证书以避免相位枚举。

Result: 加权期望功率和存在有界反例，其精确最优解会使某用户速率趋零，故无正保证；最小期望功率可保证MUR保留比例≥由功率质量与残余干扰刻画的锐利常数。仿真中最小功率相位在弱反射下保留约88%最优MUR，强反射下约一半，损失主要源于被忽略的干扰。

Conclusion: 期望功率最大化并非公平速率设计的可靠代理；最小期望功率目标具有可证明且紧的MUR保证，且可由半定对偶低成本验证，为离散RIS相位设计提供理论依据。

Abstract: We characterise when desired-power optimisation guarantees the minimum user rate (MUR) in discrete reconfigurable intelligent surface systems with fixed precoding. For the weighted sum of desired powers, a bounded channel exists whose exact maximiser starves a user: no positive guarantee exists. For the minimum desired power, the retained fraction of the optimal MUR is at least a sharp constant set by the phase's power quality and residual interference. A semidefinite dual certifies it without enumerating phases. Minimum-power phases keep 88% of the optimum under weak reflection and about half under strong reflection; omitted interference causes most of the loss.

</details>


### [423] [When Does Inter-BS Interference Hurt Sensing in ISAC? An Exact Fisher Information Analysis under Finite-Alphabet Interference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07577)
*Kawon Han,Kaitao Meng,Fan Liu,Christos Masouros*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究网络化ISAC中基站间下行干扰下，信号星座与波形对感知性能的影响；证明随机ISAC信号的平均互模糊函数与调制基无关，给出有限字母干扰下的精确Fisher信息，并表明高斯干扰为最坏情形、有限字母干扰引起非单调CRB损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络化ISAC中，基站用自身下行信号感知时会受到邻站下行传输干扰；需要厘清信号星座与波形在此类基站间干扰下是否以及如何影响感知性能。

Method: 对任意线性接收机，证明两随机ISAC信号的平均均方互模糊函数对调制基与星座不变；在平坦衰落BS-BS链路下推导有限字母干扰下的精确Fisher信息，将其表示为无干扰Fisher信息乘以1-γ·MMSE_C(γ)，其中γ为干噪比、MMSE_C为从含噪观测估计干扰数据符号的最小均方误差；并采用期望最大化（EM）干扰消除接收机进行时延估计。

Result: 精确Fisher信息等于无干扰值按1-γ·MMSE_C(γ)缩放；高斯干扰为最坏情形，对应匹配滤波的CRB损失；有限字母干扰的CRB损失随INR非单调，在中等INR处达到峰值、在高INR处消失；平坦衰落链路下该损失与波形无关；EM干扰消除接收机在时延估计上逼近理论界。

Conclusion: 在存在基站间干扰的网络化ISAC中，感知性能损失主要由干扰的统计特性（经MMSE-CRF刻画）而非星座或波形决定；有限字母干扰在高INR下可被有效抑制，EM干扰消除接收机可达到理论时延估计界。

Abstract: In networked integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), a base station (BS) performing sensing using its own downlink signals is subject to interference from the downlink transmissions of neighboring BSs. This paper investigates the impact of the signal constellation and waveform on the sensing performance in the presence of such inter-BS interference. For any linear receiver, we show that the mean-squared cross-ambiguity between two random ISAC signals is invariant to the modulation bases and constellations. We then derive the exact Fisher information under finite-alphabet interference with a flat-fading link, which equals the interference-free Fisher information scaled by $1-γ\,\mmse_{\C}(γ)$, where $γ$ denotes the interference-to-noise ratio (INR) and $\mmse_{\C}$ is the minimum mean-square error (MMSE) in estimating an interfering data symbol from its noise-corrupted observation at the sensing receiver. Consequently, Gaussian interference is the worst case and corresponds to the CRB loss of the matched filtering, whereas finite-alphabet interference induces a non-monotonic CRB loss that peaks at intermediate INR and vanishes at high INR. The loss is waveform-independent for the flat-fading BS-BS link, and an expectation-maximization (EM) interference-cancellation receiver approaches the theoretical bound for delay estimation.

</details>


### [424] [Re-Planning Budgets under Admission Control in Grant-Free LEO Beam-Hopping Access](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07592)
*Joon-Young Park,Young-Chai Ko*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文推导了LEO波束跳变中"帧间位置变化上限"的精确最坏情况丢包预算：在每帧每组访问一次的约束下，将长期平均投递率损失容差转化为可容许的位移界，且无需估计重访间隔分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 波束跳变顺序的重排虽不改变每区域的服务时长，却能改善无授权（grant-free）更新投递性能；但重排会带来波束指向的帧间位移，需明确"允许多大位移而不超出给定投递率损失"的设计边界。

Method: 以受保护波束的空间平均长期投递率相对"优化周期服务"的损失为指标；先证固定接纳策略可能偏好不规则访问，而在传输成功满足充分条件时，按重访间隔优化接纳使单次访问回报呈凹性，从而固定平均间隔下周期服务最优；再由最短/最长允许间隔确定精确最坏损失，构造满足各组位移限制的交替访问顺序使之可达。

Result: 所得预算不依赖重访间隔分布估计，并可推广至独立平稳更新流。40组、每时隙40资源的碰撞算例中，损失容差从0提高到1%时位移上限由17增至24个位置；在独立优先级下，后者仍保留无限制排序所获优先级加权等待代价降低的90%以上。瑞利衰落下的接收功率仿真与预测损失一致。

Conclusion: 重排自由度可在严格的、分布无关的最坏情况投递率保证下被安全利用；位移预算由损失容差与间隔极值显式决定，兼顾性能增益与可预测的服务保障。

Abstract: Reordering low-Earth-orbit (LEO) beam-hopping visits can reduce grant-free update delivery even when each region receives the same service time. We derive the largest limit on inter-frame position changes that meets a prescribed delivery-rate loss tolerance when every group is visited once per frame. The guarantee concerns a protected beam's spatially averaged long-run delivery rate relative to optimized periodic service under exogenous re-planning. Fixed admission can favor irregular visits, whereas admission optimized for each revisit interval makes the per-visit reward concave under sufficient conditions on transmission success. Periodic service is then optimal at a fixed mean interval. The shortest and longest allowed intervals determine the exact worst-case loss, attained by feasible alternating visit orders that respect every group's displacement limit. The resulting budget requires no estimate of the revisit-interval distribution and extends to independent stationary renewal updates. In a collision example with 40 groups and 40 resources per slot, increasing the loss tolerance from zero to 1% raises the limit from 17 to 24 positions. With independent priorities, the latter retains over 90% of the priority-weighted waiting-cost reduction achieved by unrestricted ordering. Received-power simulations under Rayleigh fading support the predicted loss.

</details>


### [425] [Joint Flexible Beamforming, Resource Allocation, and Task Buffering for Movable-Antenna Enabled MEC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07656)
*Hao Wang,Chunjie Wang,Lingtong Ma,Wenchao Liu,Kan Yu,Jinke Ren,Yanyan Shen,Xuhui Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于可移动天线（MA）与任务缓冲的移动边缘计算（MEC）框架，联合优化接收波束成形、天线位置与计算资源以最小化长期能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI、低空经济等计算密集应用要求MEC既节能又能适应高度动态负载；而传统MEC使用固定位置天线、空间灵活性有限，且采用刚性的单时隙任务执行模型，难以应对突发流量与时变信道。

Method: 构建MA赋能的MEC系统：天线可连续重定位以最大化阵列增益，并以缓冲队列解耦任务生成与即时执行，实现灵活的多时隙调度。建立随机优化问题，联合优化接收波束成形、MA位置与计算资源以最小化长期能耗；借助Lyapunov优化将长期问题转化为可处理的单时隙子问题，并设计高效交替优化算法求解。

Result: 仿真表明，所提方案在能耗上显著优于基准方案，并在不可预测的流量条件下保持稳定的任务队列。

Conclusion: MA与任务缓冲的联合设计可有效提升MEC系统的能效与对动态负载的适应性，为节能且鲁棒的边缘计算架构提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The proliferation of computation-intensive applications, such as generative artificial intelligence and low-altitude economy services, demands mobile edge computing (MEC) systems that are both energy-efficient and adaptable to highly dynamic workloads. However, conventional MEC architectures rely on fixed-position antennas with limited spatial flexibility and rigid single-slot task execution models, which fail to accommodate bursty traffic and time-varying channels. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel MEC framework empowered by movable antennas (MAs) and task buffering. Unlike traditional approaches, our system enables continuous antenna repositioning to maximize array gains and decouples task generation from immediate execution via buffer queues, allowing for flexible multi-slot scheduling. We formulate a stochastic optimization problem to minimize long-term energy consumption by jointly optimizing receive beamforming, MA positions, and computing resources. Leveraging Lyapunov optimization, we transform the long-term problem into tractable per-slot subproblems and develop an efficient alternating optimization algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme significantly outperforms the benchmark schemes in terms of energy consumption, while maintaining stable task queues under unpredictable traffic conditions.

</details>


### [426] [SVM + CFAR + OR: A Hybrid Machine-Learning-CFAR Receiver for Low-False-Alarm PRACH Preamble Detection in 5G NR and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07685)
*Filip Ferenc,Michal Szczachor*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文将PRACH前导码检测建模为64类分类问题，提出模型无关的自适应CFAR阈值(MAD-CFAR)与学习型检测器+传统PDP-CFAR的OR混合接收机，SVM与轻量1D-CNN达98.58%/99.29%准确率，混合方案在不增加虚警与漏检的前提下提升低SNR灵敏度数dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G及后5G设备密度增长、大规模机器类通信及ML驱动空口的趋势，使传统解析式前导码检测器在复杂无线环境与低SNR下失效，需要在保持标准合规虚警率的同时提升检测灵敏度。

Method: 将前导码检测形式化为64类分类；提出在分类器决策分数域实现CFAR原则的鲁棒自适应阈值(MAD-CFAR)；设计学习型检测器与传统功率时延谱CFAR检测器经逻辑OR融合的混合接收机；学习分支基于同一GPU生成数据集训练PCA-SVM与轻量1D-CNN；在6种传播信道、258项一致性测试中评估。

Result: 留出测试集上SVM准确率98.58%(macro-AUC 0.9991)，CNN为99.29%(macro-AUC 1.0000)且推理成本与内存更低；MAD-CFAR使学习分支在噪声校准实验中虚警率降至近零；OR混合保持解析检测器的低标准合规虚警率并扩展检测能力，SVM混合在低SNR下灵敏度提升约数dB且漏检未增加；CNN在部分信道具竞争力，但高时延扩展多径下仍逊于SVM。

Conclusion: MAD-CFAR与OR混合结构为学习型PRACH检测提供了模型无关、标准兼容的工程化路径；轻量CNN在效率上占优，而SVM在高时延扩展多径下更稳健，二者权衡取决于信道条件。

Abstract: The physical random access channel (PRACH) enables initial access between user equipment and the base station, making reliable preamble detection essential for cellular networks. Growing device density in 5G and beyond-5G networks, massive machine-type communication, and the shift towards machine-learning-driven radio interfaces challenge conventional analytical detectors, particularly in complex radio environments and at low signal-to-noise ratios. This article formulates preamble detection as a 64-class classification problem and introduces two model-agnostic contributions: a robust adaptive threshold implementing the constant false alarm rate (CFAR) principle in the classifier decision-score domain (MAD-CFAR), and a hybrid receiver combining a learned detector with a conventional power-delay-profile CFAR detector through a logical OR rule. The learned branch is evaluated using two models trained on the same GPU-generated dataset: a support vector machine (SVM) with principal component analysis and a lightweight one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN). On a held-out test set, the SVM achieves 98.58% accuracy (macro-AUC 0.9991), while the CNN reaches 99.29% accuracy (macro-AUC 1.0000) at lower inference cost and memory footprint. MAD-CFAR reduces the learned branch's false alarm rate to near zero on the noise calibration campaign. The OR hybrid retains the analytical detector's low, standard-compliant false alarm rate while extending detection capability. Across six propagation channels and 258 conformance-style tests, the SVM-based hybrid improves low-SNR sensitivity by several decibels without increasing missed detections relative to the analytical detector. Under the same false alarm constraint, the CNN is competitive in some channels but currently trails the SVM in high-delay-spread multipath conditions.

</details>


### [427] [Copula-Based Dependence Modeling for Resilient 6G Multi-Hop Wireless Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07716)
*Ali Izadimoein,Prathapasinghe Dharmawansa,Nurul Huda Mahmood,Eduard Axel Jorswieck*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出基于copula的框架，建模节点引起的链路SNR统计依赖及其对多跳无线网络端到端中断的影响，给出精确中断表达式与一阶打分规则用于依赖感知的备份路径选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳无线网络中，共同传播条件与共享网络组件会导致链路失效间存在统计依赖；传统基于相关性的模型难以刻画非线性与尾部依赖，从而影响可靠性分析的准确性。

Method: 采用copula方法将边缘衰落分布与依赖结构分离，建模节点引起的链路级SNR依赖；针对边不相交路径与共享链路路径的主备配置推导精确中断表达式；推导给定主路径失效时各候选备份路径的条件中断概率；在高可靠区间导出可分解的一阶打分（含边缘路径中断、共享链路、节点依赖三项），并给出精确与一阶选择规则一致的充分条件。

Result: 数值结果验证了解析结果；具有相同Kendall's τ的不同copula族因尾部依赖性质不同而表现出显著不同的中断行为；低尾依赖与路径重叠会大幅削弱冗余增益，并可能逆转仅基于边缘中断概率的排序。

Conclusion: 依赖结构（尤其尾部依赖）与路径重叠是决定多跳网络冗余增益的关键因素，copula框架与一阶打分可实现高效且依赖感知的备份路径选择。

Abstract: Reliable operation of multi-hop wireless networks requires accounting for statistical dependence among link failures caused by common propagation conditions and shared network components. This paper develops a copula-based framework for modeling node-induced dependence among link-level signal-to-noise ratios and quantifying its effect on end-to-end outage. By separating marginal fading distributions from the dependence structure, the framework captures nonlinear and tail-dependent coupling beyond conventional correlation-based models. Exact outage expressions are derived for primary-backup configurations involving edge-disjoint paths and paths with shared links. We then characterize the conditional outage probability of each candidate backup path given a primary-path failure, jointly accounting for node-induced dependence and shared-link failures. In high-reliability regimes, we derive a first-order score that decomposes conditional outage into terms associated with marginal path outage, shared links, and node-induced dependence, enabling efficient dependence-aware backup-path selection. We also establish sufficient conditions under which the first-order and exact selection rules identify the same backup path. Numerical results validate the analysis and show that copula families with the same Kendall's $τ$ can yield markedly different outage behavior because of their different tail-dependence properties. In particular, lower-tail dependence and path overlap can substantially reduce redundancy gains and reverse rankings based only on marginal outage probability.

</details>


### [428] [Uplink Enhancement for Low-Altitude UAVs via Active RISs Under Existing Cellular Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07724)
*Weicong Chen,Chao-Kai Wen,Wankai Tang,Yiping Zuo,Xiao Li,Shi Jin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 面向低空无人机物联网上行链路覆盖空洞问题，提出每个基站扇区部署一个有源RIS并采用联合扇区最大比合并，通过噪声分析证明有源RIS放大器噪声可忽略，从而用闭式解依次设计反射系数幅度与相位以最大化接收SNR下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空无人机感知/监测等航空物联网应用需要高性能上行链路，但面向地面优化的蜂窝网络基站天线存在下倾角，形成覆盖空洞，严重降低空中上行性能。作者希望在不改造基础设施的前提下解决该问题。

Method: 引入有源可重构智能表面（RIS），每个基站扇区部署一个有源RIS以充分利用多扇区接收；设计联合扇区最大信号合并方案获取分集增益。与已有复杂有源RIS优化不同，作者进行细致的噪声分析：推导RIS引入噪声与基站固有噪声的功率比上界，据此最大化接收信噪比的下界，并用闭式表达式依次设计反射系数的幅度和相位。

Result: 推导出RIS噪声与基站固有噪声功率比的上界，表明典型工作条件下有源RIS噪声影响可忽略；仿真验证了该理论分析，并显示在相同阵列增益下，增大RIS尺寸比提高反射增益更能提升低空上行传输性能。

Conclusion: 有源RIS可在不改造网络基础设施的情况下有效改善低空无人机上行链路；其放大器噪声在典型条件下可忽略，因此可将复杂优化简化为闭式幅度-相位序贯设计；实际部署中应优先扩大RIS尺寸而非追求高反射增益。

Abstract: The proliferation of low-altitude aerial Internet of Things applications, such as UAV-based sensing/monitoring, demands high-performance uplinks, yet terrestrial-optimized cellular networks with downtilted base station (BS) antennas form coverage holes that severely degrade aerial uplink. To address this challenge without modifying infrastructure, active reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) are introduced. Unlike existing studies with complicated active RIS optimizations, we conduct a detailed noise analysis to simplify the transmission design. By deploying one active RIS per BS sector to fully exploit multi-sector reception, we develop a joint sector maximal signal combining scheme that improves signal quality through diversity gain. Active RISs introduce amplifier noise, raising questions about their net benefit. We derive an upper bound on the power ratio between RIS-introduced noise and BS-inherent noise, revealing that the impact of RIS noise is negligible under typical operating conditions. Based on this insight, we maximize a derived lower bound of the received signal-to-noise ratio by sequentially designing the amplitude and phase of reflection coefficients with closed-form expressions. Simulation results validate the theoretical analysis on negligible RIS-introduced noise in typical systems and demonstrate that under the same array gain, a larger RIS size rather than a higher reflection gain is preferred for enhancing the low-altitude uplink transmission.

</details>


### [429] [Fast and Convergent Alternating GPI Precoding for Self-Backhauled Satellite-Terrestrial Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07767)
*Seokjun Park,Jongsoo Baik,Hyoungtae Kim,Joohyun Son,Jinseok Choi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出星地一体化自回传系统的预编码框架，将非凸预编码问题转化为GPI可解形式，并给出带Armijo回溯的收敛型GPI算法（AC-GPI/FAC-GPI），具备有限回溯终止、单调上升与收敛到驻点的保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISTN自回传系统中回传链路与接入链路耦合，形成自回传约束下的用户和频谱效率最大化非凸预编码问题；而已有GPI采用固定步长，可能过冲并出现非单调行为，且现有基于回溯的GPI方法缺乏收敛性证明。

Method: 建模LEO卫星→地球站→基站转发的自回传约束，最大化用户和SE；将非凸预编码问题重构为适配广义功率迭代(GPI)的形式；把GPI更新重新解释为投影预条件梯度上升，据此用Armijo回溯替换固定步长，先提出AC-GPI，再提出每轮一次Armijo接受的卫星更新加一次基站更新的FAC-GPI。

Result: 证明有限步回溯必然终止、目标函数单调上升、收敛至驻点，并给出全局驻点收敛速率保证；仿真显示收敛稳定且快速，性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过将GPI视为投影预条件梯度上升并引入Armijo回溯，可在保持GPI高效性的同时获得严格收敛性保证，为星地自回传预编码提供快速且可靠的算法方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a precoding framework for an integrated satellite terrestrial self-backhauled (ISTS) system, where a low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite transmits a backhaul stream to an earth station (ES), and the ES forwards its payload to the base station (BS) serving the users. We formulate a user sum spectral efficiency (SE) maximization problem subject to a self-backhaul constraint, which ensures that the user data forwarded by the BS do not exceed the data delivered to the ES. We then reformulate the resulting non-convex precoding problem into a form amenable to generalized power iteration (GPI). The GPI update is reinterpreted as projected preconditioned gradient ascent, revealing that its fixed step size may cause overshooting and non-monotonic behavior. Building on this interpretation, we first develop an alternating convergent GPI (AC-GPI), in which the fixed step is replaced by an Armijo backtracking rule, and show that a single Armijo-accepted step per block already guarantees sufficient ascent. This leads to the fast alternating convergent GPI (FAC-GPI), which performs one Armijo-accepted satellite update followed by one BS update in every round. Unlike existing backtracking-based GPI methods, whose convergence has not been established, we establish finite backtracking termination, monotone ascent, convergence to stationary points, along with a global stationarity-rate guarantee. Simulation results demonstrate stable and fast convergence as well as performance gains over existing methods.

</details>


### [430] [Reliable Bistatic Ranging With Unreliable Communication Payloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07803)
*Fangping Yu,Fan Liu,Yifeng Xiong,Jie Yang,Lei Xie,Shi Jin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对双基地ISAC中目标回波过弱导致通信数据难以可靠恢复的问题，提出基于导频初始化的EM估计器，利用后验符号矩迭代精化CIR，使估计渐近无偏且MSE按O(1/M)衰减，从而在符号恢复极不可靠时仍实现可靠测距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代通信系统中数据载荷占用的时频资源远多于导频，可提供更多观测以提升感知精度，但利用数据需先恢复发送符号以构建感知参考。由于传播与反射损耗严重削弱目标回波，感知接收机可能无法恢复为通信用户所选的高速率数据。作者指出，低SNR下以硬判决符号作参考会在CIR估计中引入持续偏差，导致PDP出现误差地板与虚假峰，即使大量观测相干积累后仍不消失。

Method: 提出导频初始化的期望最大化（EM）估计器，以导频获得初值，利用后验符号矩迭代精化CIR估计。在局部正则条件下并假定初始化成功，证明EM收敛到局部最大似然解（需足够多OFDM数据符号），且收敛估计器渐近无偏。

Result: 理论证明CIR估计在每个时延bin上的MSE随累积M个数据符号按O(1/M)衰减，即估计误差可通过充分积累趋于消失，即便符号恢复仍高度不可靠。数值结果表明，在相同低SNR条件下，所提方法的目标检测概率显著高于仅用导频和基于硬判决的双基地测距方案。

Conclusion: 以软信息/后验统计替代硬判决可消除低SNR下的CIR偏差与PDP伪峰，借助数据载荷的大规模积累实现渐近无偏测距，为双基地ISAC在弱回波场景下的可靠感知提供了可行途径。

Abstract: This paper addresses a key challenge in bistatic integrated sensing and communications (ISAC): \textit{How to achieve reliable ranging using communication data signals that cannot be reliably recovered?} In modern communication systems, data payloads typically occupy far more time-frequency resources than pilots, offering substantially more observations to improve sensing accuracy. Exploiting them requires recovering the transmitted symbols to form sensing references. However, propagation and reflection losses can severely weaken target echoes. The sensing receiver may therefore be unable to recover data transmitted at a high rate selected for communication users. We first show that, at low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs), using hard symbol decisions as sensing references can introduce a persistent bias in the estimated channel impulse response (CIR). This bias produces an error floor and spurious peaks in the power delay profile (PDP) that persist even after coherent accumulation over a large number of observations. To address this limitation, we develop a pilot-initialized expectation-maximization (EM) estimator that iteratively refines the CIR using posterior symbol moments. Under local regularity conditions and successful initialization, we establish that the EM method converges to the local maximum-likelihood (ML) solution for a sufficiently large number of OFDM data symbols. The converged estimator is asymptotically unbiased, where the CIR estimation mean-square error (MSE) at each delay bin decays as $O(1/M)$ by accumulating $M$ data symbols. Thus, estimation error can vanish through sufficient accumulation even while symbol recovery remains highly unreliable. Numerical results validate the proposed method, demonstrating substantially higher target detection probabilities than pilot-only and hard-decision-based bistatic ranging under the same low-SNR conditions.

</details>


### [431] [Sparse Bayesian Sensing for Antenna Arrays with Per-Element Gain, Phase, and Position Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07823)
*Patrick Hödl,Erik Leitinger,Klaus Witrisal*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种带自校准的参数化SBL信道估计算法，联合估计时延、DoA、每天线复权重与位置偏差，并在单快拍下逼近HCRLB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G感知依赖相控阵天线的精确模型，但硬件缺陷导致天线位置偏差及增益/相位失配，使假定与实际阵列响应不一致，造成性能退化，需在估计中内嵌自校准。

Method: 基于快速变分SBL并结合字典细化，参数化建模阵列响应；将时延、DoA、每天线复权重与位置偏差作为待估参数联合学习；并推导基于边缘似然的天线位置更新代价函数。

Result: 以时延与DoA的OSPA度量评估感知性能；方法在所考虑单快拍场景下接近基于HCRLB的基准；在实测单快拍数据中，取合适检测阈值时位置OSPA由约6 m降至0.2 m，并分析了检测阈值的影响。

Conclusion: 将自校准融入稀疏贝叶斯信道估计可有效补偿阵列硬件失配，显著提升单快拍相控阵感知精度，阈值选择对性能有重要影响。

Abstract: The sensing capabilities of 6G wireless communication systems rely on accurate models of phased-array antennas. However, hardware imperfections can introduce a mismatch between the assumed and the actual array response, leading to performance degradations. To prevent these, we propose a parametric, model-based sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) channel estimation algorithm with integrated self-calibration, which accounts for antenna-position deviations as well as gain and phase offsets. The algorithm learns channel parameters such as delay and direction-of-arrival (DoA), together with per-antenna complex weights and position deviations based on fast variational SBL with dictionary refinement. We derive a marginal-likelihood-based cost function for the antenna position update. The sensing performance is evaluated in terms of the optimal subpattern-assignment (OSPA) metric of the delay and DoA. The proposed method approaches a benchmark based on the derived hybrid Cramér--Rao lower bound (HCRLB) in the considered single-snapshot sensing scenarios. Finally, we investigate the influence of the detection threshold using synthetic and measurement data. On single-snapshot measurements, our algorithm reduces the position OSPA from about 6 m to 0.2 m for an appropriately chosen threshold.

</details>


### [432] [From Choirs to Solos: Reducing Multi-Cell Cooperation via Pinching Antennas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07901)
*Zhenqiao Cheng,Chongjun Ouyang,Zhiguo Ding*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究柔性“夹持天线”系统(PASS)降低多小区协作需求的能力：通过灵活的PA位置布置提升目标信道增益、降低发射功率，从而缓解小区间干扰与协作传输需求，将协作“合唱”转化为独立“独唱”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多小区协作传输虽能缓解小区间干扰，但会带来显著的协作开销（如额外的基站-用户数据关联）。作者希望验证PASS能否通过灵活的天线位置自由度来减少这种协作需求。

Method: 考虑两小区PASS场景，以额外基站-用户数据关联数来量化协作代价；在用户SINR需求与单天线功率约束下最小化协作代价。采用交替优化与二阶锥规划(SOCP)求解联合PA位置与传输设计，并提出基于迫零(ZF)的低复杂度替代方案。

Result: 数值结果表明，相比传统固定天线系统，PASS显著降低了协作需求。

Conclusion: PASS具备将协作式多小区“合唱”转变为独立“独唱”的潜力，为减少多小区协作开销提供了新思路。

Abstract: This article investigates the potential of the pinching-antenna system (PASS) to reduce multi-cell cooperation requirements. Flexible pinching-antenna (PA) placement can enhance desired channel gains and reduce the required transmit power, which consequently alleviates inter-cell interference and the need for cooperative transmission. A two-cell PASS is considered, where the cooperation cost is quantified by the number of additional base station-user data associations. The cooperation cost is minimized subject to user signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio requirements and individual transmit-power constraints. Joint PA placement and transmission designs are developed using alternating optimization and second-order cone programming, while low-complexity zero-forcing-based alternatives are also proposed. Numerical results demonstrate that PASS substantially reduces cooperation requirements compared with the conventional fixed-antenna system. These findings highlight the potential of PASS to transform cooperative multi-cell ``\emph{choirs}'' into independent ``\emph{solos}''.

</details>


### [433] [Spatial Reuse in Multi-Cell Pinching-Antenna Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07906)
*Zhenqiao Cheng,Chongjun Ouyang,Zhiguo Ding*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究多小区柔性天线（pinching-antenna, PASS）系统中的空间复用能力，以“满足所有用户SINR目标所需的最少资源块(RB)数”为度量，联合优化RB分配、PA位置与功率控制，并给出两小区最优解、一维解析缩放律及多小区加权兼容图贪心算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多小区共用同一时频RB会产生小区间干扰(ICI)，全小区同时同RB传输未必可行，需多个RB才能服务所有用户；而柔性PA放置可提升目标链路增益、降低服务小区发射功率，从而缓解ICI、让更多小区共享同一RB，因此有必要刻画并优化PASS的空间复用能力。

Method: 1) 建模：每小区用一根介质波导、一个激活PA服务单用户，以每小区功率预算下满足各用户SINR目标的最少RB数表征空间复用能力；2) 构建RB分配、PA放置、功率控制的联合优化问题；3) 两小区情形：通过最小化两小区峰值发射功率求得全局最优PA放置；4) 一维特例：推导不同PA放置策略下平均RB需求及其随小区长度的缩放律解析式；5) 多小区情形：以两小区最优解构造加权兼容图（边权为可行成对RB复用的最小峰值发射功率），提出“最小权对初始化+逐元素PA放置优化”的贪心RB分配算法。

Result: 给出两小区全局最优PA放置（等价于最小化峰值发射功率）；一维情形下得到平均RB需求及其关于小区长度的缩放律闭式表达；多小区贪心算法基于加权兼容图实现RB分配与PA放置联合优化；数值结果验证解析结论，并表明相较传统固定天线系统，PASS显著减少所需RB数（即提升空间复用能力）。

Conclusion: 柔性PA放置与RB分配、功率控制的联合设计可有效抑制ICI、提升多小区空间复用效率；所提两小区最优解与兼容图贪心框架为多小区RB规划提供了可扩展方案，PASS在RB资源占用上明显优于固定天线系统。

Abstract: In this paper, spatial reuse in a multi-cell pinching-antenna system (PASS) is investigated, where each cell employs a dielectric waveguide with one activated pinching antenna (PA) to serve a single user. Spatial reuse refers to the simultaneous use of the same time-frequency resource block (RB) by multiple spatially separated cells. Due to inter-cell interference (ICI), simultaneous transmission by all cells on the same RB may be infeasible, and multiple RBs may be required to serve all users. The spatial-reuse capability is thus characterized by the minimum number of RBs required to satisfy all users' signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) targets under per-cell power budgets. Flexible PA placement can enhance the desired-link gain of each user and reduce the required transmit power of its serving cell, which in turn mitigates ICI and allows more cells to share the same RB. To exploit these benefits, a joint optimization problem of RB allocation, PA placement, and power control is formulated. For the two-cell case, the globally optimal PA placement is determined by minimizing the peak transmit power required by the two cells. A one-dimensional special case is further analyzed to derive analytical expressions for the average RB requirement and its scaling laws with respect to cell length under different PA-placement strategies. For the general multi-cell case, the optimal two-cell solution is exploited to construct a weighted compatibility graph, whose edge weights represent the minimum peak transmit powers required for feasible pairwise RB reuse. Based on this graph, a greedy RB allocation algorithm with minimum-weight pair initialization and element-wise PA-placement optimization is developed. Numerical results validate the analytical findings and demonstrate that PASS significantly reduces the required RBs compared with conventional fixed-antenna systems.

</details>


### [434] [Angle Estimation for Initial Access in True-Time-Delay Systems: Communication and Sensing Tradeoff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07911)
*Carl Collmann,Ahmad Nimr,Gerhard Fettweis*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究TTD阵列上行链路中角度估计精度与可达数据率的权衡，基于FI推导Raised Cosine先验下的BCRLB，并在速率约束下用感知加权逐频点注水优化功率分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JCNS中利用数据信号估计AoA以解决波束选择的初始接入问题，TTD阵列的频变响应可将角度信息编码于接收功率谱，但需明确角度估计精度与数据率之间的折中关系。

Method: 针对TTD阵列上行信号，计算角度的Fisher信息，在raised cosine角度先验下求得Bayesian Cramér-Rao下界；在数据率约束下最大化FI，采用依赖感知权重的逐频点注水功率分配。

Result: 相较频率平坦信号，在±10°先验宽度、5%速率损失下，优化功率分配使FI提升约4.9 dB；数值仿真表明ML估计器在高于某SNR阈值时可达到所推导的BCRLB。

Conclusion: 验证了波形设计所依据的FI是可达到的，感知加权注水功率分配能在可控速率损失下显著改善角度估计精度。

Abstract: In joint communication & sensing (JCNS) the data signal is used to obtain parameter estimates. An example is the angle of arrival (AoA) which can be used to solve the initial access problem of beam selection. true-time delay (TTD) arrays are attractive for this purpose, as their frequency-dependent response encodes the angle information in the receive signal power spectrum. This work investigates the tradeoff between angle estimation accuracy and achievable data rate for uplink signals in a TTD array. The Fisher information (FI) for the angle is used to find the bayesian Cramer-Rao lower bound (BCRLB) under the assumption of a raised cosine distributed angle prior. Maximization of the FI under a data rate constraint is solved by waterfilling power per frequency bin dependent on sensing weights. Compared to a frequency flat signal, the optimized power allocation increases the FI \approx 4.9 dB at 5% rate loss for prior width of \pm 10°. Numerical simulations show that the derived BCRLB can be attained by a maximum likelihood (ML) estimator above an signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) threshold, confirming that the FI underlying the waveform design is attainable.

</details>


### [435] [Phase-Matched Design of Pinching-Antenna Elements on a 60-GHz Dielectric Rod Waveguide](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07954)
*Stylianos D. Asimonis,Dimitrios Tyrovolas,Spyridon Daskalakis,Nikos C. Sagias,Donal P. Lynch,George K. Karagiannidis*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出"相位匹配/棱镜耦合"图像解释介质波导上pinching天线的辐射机理，并据此给出尺寸设计规则；全波仿真比较矩形、等腰三角形与直角三角形三种贴片，发现矩形在规则点增益最高（15.9 dBi），直角三角形对高度变化最鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: pinching天线的辐射特性依赖介质元件的形状，但缺乏对其物理机理的清晰解释，也缺少将元件高度与贴片尺寸联系起来的简洁设计准则。

Method: 建立相位匹配（棱镜耦合器）模型：波导杆模以由贴片模有效折射率决定的角度（60 GHz下约31°）耦合进入高密度天线贴片，并从最先到达的面辐射，由此得到连接"元件高度—接触长度"的尺寸规则。在53–67 GHz范围内，用包含波导—杆过渡段的全波openEMS仿真比较接触长度与高度相同的矩形、等腰三角形和直角三角形元件。

Result: 矩形元件在设计规则点处增益峰值为15.9 dBi，但峰很尖锐；直角三角形元件在2:1的高度范围内增益波动不超过0.7 dB、旁瓣至少低10 dB；在设计规则点，二者均比等腰三角形元件高1.2–2.1 dB，且三种元件均保持良好匹配。

Conclusion: 相位匹配/棱镜耦合图像能有效解释pinching天线的辐射并给出可用的尺寸设计规则；元件形状决定带宽与鲁棒性——矩形适合固定高度的峰值增益，直角三角形适合高度容差要求高的场景，等腰三角形性能相对较差。

Abstract: The radiation of pinching antennas, dielectric elements placed on a dielectric waveguide, depends on the element shape. We explain it with a phase-matching, or prism-coupler, picture: the guided rod mode couples into the denser antenna plate at an angle set by the plate-mode effective index, about 31 degrees at 60 GHz, and radiates through the face it reaches first. This yields a simple sizing rule linking element height to contact length. Rectangular, isosceles and right-triangular elements of equal contact length and height are compared from 53 to 67 GHz in full-wave openEMS simulations including the waveguide-to-rod transitions. The rectangle peaks sharply at the rule, reaching 15.9 dBi. The right triangle keeps its gain within 0.7 dB and its side lobes at least 10 dB down over a two-to-one height range. At the rule, both outperform the isosceles element by 1.2 to 2.1 dB, and all remain matched.

</details>


### [436] [Geometry-Aware Channel Aging in MIMO Systems: When Is Kronecker Separability Enough?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08007)
*Steven Rivetti,Gabor Fodor,Emil Bjornson,Mikael Skoglund*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究Kr&#111;necker可分离空间相关何时能近似MIMO信道协方差，在几何感知的信道模型下统一刻画空间耦合与时域相关，并据此界定可分离性适用的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kr&#111;necker可分离假设常被用于简化MIMO信道协方差建模并降低导频与计算开销，但其有效性依赖具体传播几何；同时符号级信道老化与空间结构耦合，缺乏统一的几何感知分析框架。

Method: 提出几何感知信道模型：同一传播环境同时决定Weichselberger空间耦合矩阵与时域相关系数；环境采用3GPP启发的簇状信道模型。考虑用户设备移动引起的符号级信道老化，联合调度上行与下行导频，在不完美CSI下分别推导上下行频谱效率。

Result: 数值结果：信道老化幅度强烈依赖几何，漫散射传播比集中散射导致更强的时间去相关与更严重的SE退化；给出Kr&#111;necker可分离性适用的区间，以及必须采用几何感知Weichselberger耦合的区间。

Conclusion: 空间耦合与时域相关必须由同一几何一致建模；可分离性并非普遍成立，其适用性由传播几何决定。

Abstract: This letter investigates when Kronecker-separable spatial correlation approximates the covariance of multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) channels. We propose a geometry-aware channel model in which the same propagation environment determines both the Weischelberger spatial coupling matrix and the temporal correlation coefficient. The propagation environment follows a 3GPP-inspired clustered channel model. We consider a MIMO system affected by symbol-level channel aging caused by the user equipment's mobility. We schedule both uplink and downlink pilots, thereby deriving the respective spectral efficiencies (SEs) in the presence of imperfect channel state information. Numerical results show that channel aging's magnitude is strongly geometry-dependent, with diffuse propagation inducing greater temporal decorrelation and SE degradation than concentrated scattering. The results also identify regimes where Kronecker separability can be applied and regimes where geometry-aware Weischelberger coupling is needed.

</details>


### [437] [Structured Agentic Learning for Persistent Spatial Acquisition in RDT-TAIS-Assisted Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08141)
*Bin Liu,Wei Ni,Tommy Svensson,Sofie Pollin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究TAIS控制中的持续空间知识维护，将其建模为在中断可靠性约束下权衡物理采集开销与有效通信性能的序贯信息采集问题，并提出结构化智能体空间智能（structured ASI）实现按需物理信息采集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续化TAIS运行可通过跨控制区间复用环境知识来减少重复的无线电信息采集，但该知识随无线环境演化与当前通信任务而变化，因此需要研究如何持续维护空间知识并在采集开销与通信性能之间取得平衡。

Method: 将问题形式化为序贯信息采集问题，在中断可靠性约束下最大化有效通信性能并计入物理采集开销；提出structured ASI，结合无线一致的情境推断、时间维知识充分性评估、图结构区域推理与预测性中断风险反馈，通过闭环交互自适应决定是否需要额外采集、采集方向以及采集量，并在停止或升级为全无线电环境重采集之间做出决策。

Result: 数值结果表明，在每100个控制区间发生6次结构变化时，structured ASI将有效速率提升2.59%，同时将采集开销降低25.0%；在400区间的异构任务中，实现2.82%的有效速率增益与41.8%的开销降低。

Conclusion: structured ASI能够在保证中断可靠性的前提下，以显著更低的物理采集开销获得有效通信性能提升，验证了面向通信的智能体化持续空间知识维护机制的有效性。

Abstract: Persistent TAIS operation can reduce repeated radio-information acquisition by reusing environmental knowledge across control intervals. This knowledge changes with radio-environment evolution and current communication task. This paper studies persistent spatial knowledge maintenance for TAIS control and formulates it as a sequential information-acquisition problem that maximizes effective communication performance while accounting for physical-acquisition overhead under an outage-reliability constraint. We develop structured agentic spatial intelligence (ASI), which realizes a communication-oriented agent that maintains persistent spatial knowledge, forms beliefs from radio and context observations, and adapts physical information acquisition through closed-loop interaction with the radio environment. By jointly exploiting radio-consistent context inference, temporal knowledge-sufficiency assessment, graph-structured regional reasoning, and predictive outage-risk feedback, structured ASI determines when additional acquisition is needed, where it is directed, and how much physical information is sufficient before stopping or escalating to full radio-environment reacquisition. Numerical results show that structured ASI improves the effective rate by 2.59% while reducing acquisition overhead by 25.0% at six structural changes per 100 control intervals, and achieves a 2.82% effective-rate gain with a 41.8% overhead reduction over a heterogeneous 400-interval mission.

</details>


### [438] [Spectral Convergence of Sparse Bipartite Graphs via the Line-Graphon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08246)
*Roxanne Holden,Luana Ruiz*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏二分图序列，利用二分图拉普拉斯算子与线图邻接算子之间的谱对应关系，从稠密线图转移收敛性保证，恢复了一类稀疏图序列的特征值级谱收敛，并进一步分析超线性优先连接树的无穷维极限算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏图序列上纯点谱收敛一般不可得，拉普拉斯特征值在图增长下可能不稳定，这给图神经网络等图学习方法所依赖的谱算子分析带来困难。作者希望刻画一类可恢复特征值级谱收敛的稀疏图。

Method: 识别出一类稀疏二分图序列，重点处理度分布强异质的图；借助其线图序列的收敛性质，通过二分图拉普拉斯与线图邻接算子的谱对应，将稠密线图上的收敛保证回传到原稀疏图；并对超线性优先连接树作极限算子分析。

Result: 框架给出了一类确定性稀疏图序列的特征值级谱收敛；对超线性优先连接树建立了到无穷维极限算子的收敛；数值实验经验性地支持了谱收敛结论。

Conclusion: 通过线图谱对应可在部分稀疏（强异质二分）图与特定随机树模型上恢复特征值级谱收敛，为稀疏图上谱算子与图学习方法的理论分析提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Pure point spectral convergence is generally unavailable for sparse graph sequences, where Laplacian eigenvalues may remain unstable under graph growth. This poses challenges for analyzing spectral operators underlying many graph-based learning methods, including graph neural networks. We identify a class of sparse bipartite graph sequences for which eigenvalue-level spectral convergence can be recovered. Focusing on graphs with strong degree heterogeneity, we exploit the convergence properties of their line-graph sequences. Using a spectral correspondence between bipartite graph Laplacians and line-graph adjacency operators, we transfer convergence guarantees from dense line-graphs back to the original sparse graphs. This framework yields eigenvalue-level spectral convergence for a class of deterministic sparse graph sequences. We further analyze superlinear preferential attachment trees, establishing convergence to an infinite-dimensional limit operator. Numerical experiments empirically support our spectral convergence results.

</details>


### [439] [Wireless Link Scheduling with Graph Signal Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08274)
*Teresa Shang,Romina Garcia Camargo,Yiğit Berkay Uslu,Alejandro Ribeiro*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于U-GNN参数化的扩散模型，通过模仿学习求解带每链路最小传输约束的长时域无线链路调度问题，实现近最优和速率并公平分配资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时域无线链路调度需满足每条链路的最小传输约束，同时要在链路与时间步间公平分配资源；公平分配要求调度具有随机性，确定性方法难以兼顾，故需引入随机生成框架。

Method: 构建扩散框架以随机采样调度决策，在生成过程中以网络拓扑和约束水平为条件；采用模仿学习训练该扩散模型，并用U-Graph Neural Network（U-GNN）进行参数化，以利用图结构与无线网络之间的对应关系。

Result: 在最大化和时间速率的同时，将分配在时间域上分散到各链路，取得接近最优的性能；模型可泛化到训练中未见的约束要求与网络规模，表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 扩散模型+U-GNN的组合为带约束的随机化链路调度提供了有效方案，兼具近优性能与对未见场景的泛化能力。

Abstract: We solve long-horizon wireless link scheduling with per-link minimum transmission constraints. Fair distribution of resources across links and time steps requires stochastic scheduling, motivating a diffusion framework. Via imitation learning, we train a diffusion model to sample scheduling decisions, conditioning generation on the network topology and constraint levels. The parameterization is achieved through a U-Graph Neural Network (U-GNN) to leverage the relationship between graphs and wireless networks for learning. Our approach achieves near-optimal performance, maximizing sum rate while distributing allocations across different links over time horizons. The U-GNN-based diffusion model generalizes to requirements and network sizes unseen during training, demonstrating the robustness of the approach.

</details>


### [440] [Electromagnetically Consistent Monostatic ISAC Beamforming: Mutual Coupling, Active Mismatch and Tx-Rx Leakage in Compact Dipole Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08331)
*Stylianos D. Asimonis,Christos Tselios,Dimitrios Tyrovolas,Ilias Politis,George K. Karagiannidis*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对紧凑型单站ISAC收发机，基于矩量法仿真构建共享孔径偶极子阵列的多端口散射模型，显式刻画嵌入方向图畸变、波束相关功放失配与收发泄漏三类天线效应，并在多用户SINR约束、各端口有源反射约束与泄漏预算下最小化Cramer-Rao界，以半正定规划加一维预算搜索求解。全波评测表明耦合无关设计在小间距下SINR不达标最高达6.2 dB、等效VSWR超3.3；所提设计在0.3–0.5波长间距下全部达标、等效VSWR低于2，并在80 dB/70 dB自干扰消除下将CRB均方根分别降低32%–53%和3.4–5.6倍，openEMS的FDTD模型验证了零陷与设计排序的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ISAC波束成形普遍基于理想阵列流形并仅对发射信号施加范数约束，在紧凑单站收发机中忽略了嵌入方向图畸变、功放波束相关有源失配和收发泄漏抬高雷达噪底三种实际天线效应，导致设计性能在全波条件下失真。

Method: 由矩量法仿真直接建立共享孔径偶极子阵列的多端口散射模型；据此构建以最小化Cramer-Rao界为目标的ISAC波束成形问题，约束包括多用户SINR、逐端口有源反射及泄漏预算；该问题通过半正定规划配合一维预算搜索求解，并用全波仿真与openEMS的独立FDTD模型交叉验证。

Result: 耦合无关设计在0.3–0.5波长小间距下SINR偏离目标最高6.2 dB，并使功放等效VSWR超过3.3；所提设计在所有测试间距下满足全部约束，等效VSWR低于2，在80 dB自干扰消除下将CRB均方根降低32%–53%，在70 dB下降低3.4–5.6倍；openEMS的FDTD独立模型复现了泄漏零陷及设计排序。

Conclusion: 在紧凑单站ISAC系统中，必须将耦合、有源失配与泄漏等电磁效应纳入波束成形设计；基于多端口散射模型与半正定规划的方案可在满足通信SINR、有源反射与泄漏约束的同时显著提升雷达估计精度，且结论经独立全波模型验证具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Beamforming for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is usually designed on ideal array manifolds with a norm constraint on the transmit signal. In a compact monostatic transceiver this hides three antenna effects: distorted embedded patterns, beam-dependent active mismatch at the power amplifiers, and transmit-to-receive leakage that raises the radar noise floor. We build a multiport scattering model of a shared-aperture dipole array directly from method-of-moments simulations and use it to formulate a Cramer-Rao bound minimizing ISAC beamformer with multiuser SINR constraints, per-port active reflection constraints and a leakage budget, solved as a semidefinite program with a one-dimensional budget search. Full-wave evaluation shows that coupling-unaware designs miss their SINR targets by up to 6.2 dB and drive amplifiers to an equivalent VSWR above 3.3 at small spacings. For spacings from 0.3 to 0.5 wavelengths, the proposed design meets all targets with an equivalent VSWR below 2 and lowers the root Cramer-Rao bound by 32 to 53 percent for 80 dB of self-interference cancellation and by a factor of 3.4 to 5.6 for 70 dB. An independent finite-difference time-domain model of the final layout in openEMS confirms that the leakage null and the ranking of the designs are preserved.

</details>


### [441] [Core-Lock Scheduling for 5G NR LDPC Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08400)
*N. Papageorgiou,V. Paliouras*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种硬件高效的 core-lock 调度机制，在每次层更新后评估 core syndrome weight，从而选择性跳过扩展层，实现 LDPC 译码加速且无 BLER 损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在时延受限的 5G NR 与非地面网络中，加速迭代 LDPC 译码同时保持纠错可靠性是关键挑战。

Method: 在每层更新后计算 core syndrome weight，并设置阈值 θ=0.20，据此选择性地旁路（bypass）扩展层；该机制可与静态调度结合，并仅需一个紧凑加法树和一个比较器（已有早期终止的译码器可复用）。

Result: 相比静态调度，时延降低最高 31.3%；相比使用完整校验矩阵的动态方案，时延降低最高 45.5%，且 BLER 无退化。相比估计的全并行全矩阵校验器，仅 core 的方案使移位器网络面积减少 76%、XOR 门数减少 73%。

Conclusion: core-lock 调度以极低的硬件开销实现了显著的译码时延降低，同时不牺牲纠错性能，适合对时延敏感的应用场景。

Abstract: Accelerating iterative LDPC decoding while preserving error-correction reliability is a critical challenge in latency-constrained 5G New Radio (NR) and non-terrestrial networks. This paper proposes a hardware-efficient core-lock scheduling mechanism that evaluates the core syndrome weight after each layer update to selectively bypass extension layers. With the selected threshold $θ{=}0.20$, the mechanism reduces decoding latency by up to 31.3\% when integrated with static schedules, and by up to 45.5\% compared to alternative dynamic schemes utilizing the full parity-check matrix, without block error rate (BLER) degradation. Compared with an estimated fully parallel full-matrix checker, the core-only approach yields a 76\% reduction in shifter network area and a 73\% reduction in XOR gate count. For decoders with existing early termination, the proposed mechanism requires only a compact adder tree and a comparator.

</details>


### [442] [Spectral Regimes of Truncated sinc-Power and Pulse-Train Kernels: Edge Exponents, Per-Edge Plunges, and the Landau-Widom Limit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08401)
*Unnikrishna Pillai*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文将Slepian-Landau-Pollak-Widom经典带限窗聚集问题推广到一般带形与核变形，统一刻画了特征值聚集的"跌落"(plunge)结构：系数由每一边缘的跳跃决定，并在幂核、多区间、收缩带、重叠带、自相似带等情形下分别演化为幂律指数、整数、多级阶梯与Cantor维数控制的层级结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典结果只针对单一矩形带与标准核，跌落宽度仅由带宽与窗长决定、系数为1/π²。作者希望弄清当频带被"变形"（核取逐元素幂、带分裂为多个区间、带收缩为线、带重叠、带自相似）时，特征值簇与跌落如何随之演化，并找出统一的"边缘描述子"。

Method: 以带限算子的截断核为对象，分析其特征值谱的形状；对核取逐元素幂以平滑带边，考察跌落过渡为幂律边缘；利用Landau-Widom多区间定理处理不相交多带，得到跌落宽度的"每条边缘常数"；再分别取带收缩极限（有限秩算子）、重叠带与自相似（Cantor型）带的极限情形，并在此光滑边缘处对重标度特征值进行分析；最后结合特征滤波器零点分布讨论主特征向量的低通滤波性质。

Result: ①幂核平滑带边后，跌落变为幂律边缘，指数为幂次减一；②不相交多带的跌落宽度正比于带边数目，系数为逐边常数，与Landau-Widom结论一致；③带收缩为线得到经典有限秩算子；④重叠带产生多级阶梯；⑤自相似带产生由Cantor维数控制的簇层级；⑥光滑边缘处重标度特征值不塌缩到单一曲线上；⑦边缘描述子依次经历常数→指数→整数→分形维数的过渡；⑧单带情形下所有特征滤波器零点位于单位圆上，阶数越高带内零点越多，故主特征向量表现为低通滤波器。

Conclusion: 带限聚集问题的特征值跌落结构对带的变形具有稳健且可分类的行为：唯一的"边缘描述子"从常数、幂指数、整数一直到分形维数，完整刻画了各类带的谱过渡形态。该框架统一了经典单带结果与多带、幂核、重叠带及分形带等推广情形，并明确了主特征向量的低通滤波特性。

Abstract: A signal band-limited to one rectangular band and observed through a finite window is the classical concentration problem of Slepian, Landau, Pollak, and Widom. The eigenvalues of the operator cluster near one and near zero, separated by a transition called the plunge. The plunge width grows like the logarithm of the window length, with a universal coefficient of one over pi squared set by the band-edge jump. This paper follows the clusters and the plunge as the band is deformed. An elementwise power of the kernel smooths the band edge, and the plunge gives way to a power-law edge with exponent one less than the power. Disjoint copies of the band widen the plunge in proportion to the number of band edges, as the multiple-interval theorem of Landau and Widom implies, so the coefficient is a per-edge constant. Shrinking each band to a line gives the classical finite-rank operator. Overlapping bands give a multilevel staircase, and a self-similar band gives a cluster hierarchy governed by the Cantor dimension. At the smooth edge, rescaled eigenvalues do not collapse onto one curve. The edge descriptor passes from a constant to an exponent to an integer to a fractal dimension. For the single band, classical results place all eigenfilter zeros on the unit circle, with more of them inside the band as the order rises, so the dominant eigenvectors act as lowpass filters.

</details>

### [443] [Reduced-order modeling of squeeze-film damped electrostatically actuated microbeams using complex modes of the coupled problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07205)
*Fehmi Najar*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 提出含完整挤压膜效应的静电驱动微梁非线性降阶模型，采用全耦合流固复模态的Petrov-Galerkin投影，证明流体松弛模态不可被纯结构模态替代，并实现约1.5%误差的高效计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静电驱动微梁动力学中挤压膜效应常被简化，现有降阶模型多以纯结构模态为基，无法准确刻画流体引起的非经典阻尼与耦合动力学。作者希望建立一个能完整包含挤压膜效应的降阶模型，并检验流体模态的必要性。

Method: 对固支-固支与固支-自由Euler-Bernoulli微梁（含中面拉伸与静电力非线性）及非线性可压缩Reynolds方程，用微分求积法离散，求静力解与本征值问题；以全耦合流固问题的阻尼复模态为基，做Petrov-Galerkin投影构建降阶模型。

Result: 复模态中复共轭对描述器件耦合行为，实模态对应流体松弛；固有频率与品质因数与文献实验和数值结果吻合。挤压膜效应依环境压力、梁几何与流体边界条件，既影响有效阻尼也影响动力学；某些情形下丢弃流体松弛模态无法由任何纯结构模态集补偿，流体模态引入的非经典阻尼表现为压力与挠度间的空间分布相位差。

Conclusion: 动态响应收敛分析表明，仅含一组耦合模态加一个流体模态的基即可在1.5%误差内重现全离散模型结果，且计算时间显著缩短；流体松弛模态对含完整挤压膜效应的微梁降阶建模不可或缺。

Abstract: A reduced-order model is developed for the nonlinear dynamics of electrostatically actuated microbeams, including the full squeeze film effect. The model uses Petrov-Galerkin projection on damped complex modes of the fully coupled fluid-structure problem. The Euler-Bernoulli theory for calmped-clamped and clamped-free microbeams, with mid-plane stretching and electrostatic nonlinearities, and the nonlinear compressible Reynolds equation are discretized by the differential quadrature method for the static solution and eigenvalue problem. The calculated eigenmodes are either complex conjugates describing the coupled behavior of the device or real depicting the fluid relaxation. The natural frequencies and quality factors are compared to experimental and numerical results found in the literature. Depending on the ambient pressure, the geometry of the microbeam, and the fluid boundary conditions, squeeze-film effect can impact not only the effective damping of the device but also its dynamics. It is shown that in some cases dropping fluid relaxation modes cannot be compensated by any set of purely structural modes. The non-classical damping introduced by the fluid modes is a spatially distributed phase difference between pressure and deflection. The convergence analysis of the dynamic response resulting from the reduced-order model showed that a basis with one set of coupled modes and one fluid mode can reproduce the results of a fully discretized model within 1.5% error and at much faster computational time.

</details>
